@router.get("/maintenance/search")
def search_maintenance_data(
    q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search term"),
    mode: Optional[str] = Query("customer", description="customer | pan | account | all"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """
    Customer Data Maintenance 360 Search Engine.
    Supports separate search modes:
      1. customer: Search by customer number, name, mobile, email.
      2. pan: Search by full or partial PAN. Returns ONLY the matching card(s) for that PAN
              (never dumping every unrelated card of the customer), along with the owning
              customer, the accounts linked to that matching card, and full Card & Account limits.
      3. account: Search by account number.
    """
    clean_q = (q or "").strip()
    mode = (mode or "customer").lower().strip()
    if mode not in ("customer", "pan", "account", "all"):
        mode = "customer"

    matched_cust_ids_set: set[str] = set()
    matched_pan_card_ids: set[str] = set()
    matched_account_ids: set[str] = set()

    if not clean_q:
        for c in db.query(Customer).order_by(Customer.created_at.desc()).limit(40).all():
            matched_cust_ids_set.add(c.id)
    else:
        term = f"%{clean_q}%"
        exact = clean_q

        if mode in ("customer", "all"):
            for c in db.query(Customer).filter(
                (Customer.customer_number.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.first_name.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.last_name.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.mobile_number.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.email.ilike(term))
                # [PATCH customer_360:search_more_fields]
                | (Customer.nid_number.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.passport_number.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.alternate_mobile.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.father_name.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.mother_name.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.id == exact)
            ).all():
                matched_cust_ids_set.add(c.id)

        if mode in ("account", "all"):
            for a in db.query(Account).filter(
                (Account.account_number.ilike(term)) | (Account.id == exact)
            ).all():
                matched_account_ids.add(a.id)
                if a.customer_id:
                    matched_cust_ids_set.add(a.customer_id)

        if mode in ("pan", "all"):
            pan_q = db.query(Card)
            digits_only = "".join(ch for ch in clean_q if ch.isdigit())
            if len(digits_only) >= 15 and clean_q.isdigit():
                matched_cards = pan_q.filter(Card.test_pan_reference == clean_q).all()
            else:
                matched_cards = pan_q.filter(
                    (Card.test_pan_reference.ilike(term))
                    | (Card.masked_pan.ilike(term))
                    | (Card.id == exact)
                ).limit(50).all()

            for crd in matched_cards:
                matched_pan_card_ids.add(crd.id)
                if crd.customer_id:
                    matched_cust_ids_set.add(crd.customer_id)

    matched_cust_ids = list(matched_cust_ids_set)

    # All accounts (for link dropdown)
    all_accounts = db.query(Account).order_by(Account.account_number.asc()).all()
    all_accounts_out = []
    for a in all_accounts:
        all_accounts_out.append({
            "id": a.id,
            "account_number": a.account_number,
            "account_type": a.account_type,
            "currency": a.currency,
            "available_balance": float(a.available_balance or 0),
            "ledger_balance": float(a.ledger_balance or 0),
            "account_status": a.account_status,
            "customer_id": a.customer_id,
            "customer_name": (
                f"{a.customer.first_name} {a.customer.last_name or ''}".strip()
                if a.customer else ""
            ),
            "institution_code": _short_bank_code(a.institution, "XBANK"),
        })

    all_customers_mini = [
        {
            "id": c.id,
            "customer_number": c.customer_number,
            "name": f"{c.first_name} {c.last_name or ''}".strip(),
        }
        for c in db.query(Customer).order_by(Customer.customer_number.asc()).limit(200).all()
    ]

    customers_out = []
    for cid in matched_cust_ids:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == cid).first()
        if not cust:
            continue

        # Cards belonging to this customer
        raw_cards = db.query(Card).filter(Card.customer_id == cust.id).all()
        seen_card_ids: set[str] = set()
        card_list = []
        linked_acct_ids_for_matched_cards: set[str] = set()

        for card in raw_cards:
            if card.id in seen_card_ids:
                continue
            # CRITICAL PAN SEARCH REQUIREMENT:
            # When searching by PAN with a query, return ONLY the card(s) matching the searched PAN!
            if mode == "pan" and clean_q and card.id not in matched_pan_card_ids:
                continue
            seen_card_ids.add(card.id)

            # Auto-heal missing CardAccount from legacy linked_account_id
            if not card.card_accounts and card.linked_account_id:
                fallback = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == card.linked_account_id).first()
                if fallback:
                    healed = CardAccount(
                        card_id=card.id,
                        account_id=fallback.id,
                        account_role="PRIMARY",
                        currency=fallback.currency,
                        priority=1,
                        status="ACTIVE",
                    )
                    db.add(healed)
                    db.flush()

            # Ensure CardLimit exists
            c_lim = db.query(CardLimit).filter(CardLimit.card_id == card.id).first()
            if not c_lim:
                c_lim = CardLimit(card_id=card.id, currency="BDT")
                db.add(c_lim)
                db.flush()

            ca_links = []
            for ca in sorted(card.card_accounts or [], key=lambda x: (x.priority or 99)):
                if ca.account_id:
                    linked_acct_ids_for_matched_cards.add(ca.account_id)
                acct_lim_obj = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == ca.account_id).first() if ca.account_id else None
                ca_links.append({
                    "id": ca.id,
                    "account_id": ca.account_id,
                    "account_number": ca.account.account_number if ca.account else "UNKNOWN",
                    "account_type": ca.account.account_type if ca.account else "SAVINGS",
                    "available_balance": float(ca.account.available_balance) if ca.account else 0.0,
                    "ledger_balance": float(ca.account.ledger_balance) if ca.account else 0.0,
                    "account_status": ca.account.account_status if ca.account else "ACTIVE",
                    "currency": ca.currency,
                    "account_role": ca.account_role,
                    "priority": ca.priority,
                    "status": ca.status,
                    "account_limits": {
                        "id": acct_lim_obj.id,
                        "per_transaction_limit": float(acct_lim_obj.per_transaction_limit),
                        "daily_limit": float(acct_lim_obj.daily_limit),
                        "weekly_limit": float(acct_lim_obj.weekly_limit),
                        "monthly_limit": float(acct_lim_obj.monthly_limit),
                        "daily_used": float(acct_lim_obj.daily_used),
                        "weekly_used": float(acct_lim_obj.weekly_used),
                        "monthly_used": float(acct_lim_obj.monthly_used),
                        "status": acct_lim_obj.status,
                        "effective_from": acct_lim_obj.effective_from.isoformat() if acct_lim_obj.effective_from else None,
                    } if acct_lim_obj else None,
                    "account_limit_descriptors": _build_account_limit_descriptors(acct_lim_obj),
                })

            if card.linked_account_id:
                linked_acct_ids_for_matched_cards.add(card.linked_account_id)

            pin_p = card.pin_profile
            emv_p = card.emv_profile
            card_list.append({
                "id": card.id,
                "test_pan_reference": card.test_pan_reference,
                "masked_pan": card.masked_pan,
                "cardholder_name": card.cardholder_name,
                "expiry_month": card.expiry_month,
                "expiry_year": card.expiry_year,
                "card_type": card.card_type,
                "card_product": card.card_product,
                "card_status": card.card_status,
                "linked_account_id": card.linked_account_id,
                "institution_id": card.institution_id,
                "institution_code": _short_bank_code(card.institution, _short_bank_code(cust.institution, "XBANK")),
                "card_accounts": ca_links,
                "limits": {
                    "id": c_lim.id,
                    "currency": c_lim.currency,
                    "withdrawal_limit": float(c_lim.withdrawal_limit),
                    "purchase_limit": float(c_lim.purchase_limit),
                    "ecommerce_limit": float(c_lim.ecommerce_limit),
                    "transaction_limit": float(c_lim.transaction_limit),
                    "daily_limit": float(c_lim.daily_limit),
                    "weekly_limit": float(c_lim.weekly_limit),
                    "monthly_limit": float(c_lim.monthly_limit),
                    "daily_used": float(c_lim.daily_used),
                    "weekly_used": float(c_lim.weekly_used),
                    "monthly_used": float(c_lim.monthly_used),
                    "status": c_lim.status,
                },
                "limit_descriptors": _build_card_limit_descriptors(c_lim),
                "pin_profile": {
                    "pin_offset_reference": pin_p.pin_offset_reference if pin_p else None,
                    "verification_method": pin_p.pin_verification_method if pin_p else "VISA_PVV",
                    "pvk_key_reference": pin_p.pvk_key_reference if pin_p else "PVK_VISA_01",
                    "cvv_reference": pin_p.cvv_reference if pin_p else None,
                    "retry_counter": pin_p.retry_counter if pin_p else 0,
                    "maximum_retry_count": pin_p.maximum_retry_count if pin_p else 3,
                    "pin_status": pin_p.pin_status if pin_p else "ACTIVE",
                } if pin_p else None,
                "emv_profile": {
                    "aid": emv_p.aid,
                    "application_profile": emv_p.application_profile,
                    "card_sequence_number": emv_p.card_sequence_number,
                    "master_key_reference": emv_p.master_key_reference,
                } if emv_p else None,
            })

        # Accounts belonging to this customer (or linked to the matched PAN when mode=='pan')
        accts_query = db.query(Account).filter(Account.customer_id == cust.id).all()
        if mode == "pan" and clean_q and linked_acct_ids_for_matched_cards:
            # Also include any cross-customer linked account if linked to the searched PAN
            extra_accts = (
                db.query(Account)
                .filter(Account.id.in_(list(linked_acct_ids_for_matched_cards)))
                .all()
            )
            acct_map_by_id = {a.id: a for a in extra_accts}
            accts = list(acct_map_by_id.values())
        elif mode == "account" and clean_q and matched_account_ids:
            accts = [a for a in accts_query if a.id in matched_account_ids] or accts_query
        else:
            accts = accts_query

        acct_list = []
        for a in accts:
            lim = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == a.id).first()
            if not lim:
                lim = AccountLimit(account_id=a.id, currency=a.currency)
                db.add(lim)
                db.flush()
            acct_list.append({
                "id": a.id,
                "account_number": a.account_number,
                "account_type": a.account_type,
                "currency": a.currency,
                "available_balance": float(a.available_balance or 0),
                "ledger_balance": float(a.ledger_balance or 0),
                "overdraft_limit": float(a.overdraft_limit or 0),
                "account_status": a.account_status,
                "branch_code": a.branch_code,
                "institution_code": _short_bank_code(a.institution, _short_bank_code(cust.institution, "XBANK")),
                "limits": {
                    "id": lim.id,
                    "currency": lim.currency,
                    "per_transaction_limit": float(lim.per_transaction_limit),
                    "daily_limit": float(lim.daily_limit),
                    "weekly_limit": float(lim.weekly_limit),
                    "monthly_limit": float(lim.monthly_limit),
                    "daily_used": float(lim.daily_used),
                    "weekly_used": float(lim.weekly_used),
                    "monthly_used": float(lim.monthly_used),
                    "status": lim.status,
                    "effective_from": lim.effective_from.isoformat() if lim.effective_from else None,
                },
                "limit_descriptors": _build_account_limit_descriptors(lim),
            })

        customers_out.append({
            "id": cust.id,
            "customer_number": cust.customer_number,
            "first_name": cust.first_name,
            "last_name": cust.last_name,
            "email": cust.email,
            "mobile_number": cust.mobile_number,
            "address": cust.address,
            **customer_profile_fields(cust),
            "customer_status": cust.customer_status,
            "risk_category": cust.risk_category,
            "institution_id": cust.institution_id,
            "institution_code": _short_bank_code(cust.institution, "XBANK"),
            "institution_name": cust.institution.name if cust.institution else None,
            "accounts": acct_list,
            "cards": card_list,
        })

    customers_out.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("customer_number") or "")

    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()

    return {
        "mode": mode,
        "query": clean_q,
        "customers": customers_out,
        "all_accounts": all_accounts_out,
        "all_customers": all_customers_mini,
        "total_customers": len(customers_out),
        "total_cards": sum(len(c["cards"]) for c in customers_out),
        "total_accounts": sum(len(c["accounts"]) for c in customers_out),
    }


@router.put("/cards/{card_id}/reassign-customer")
def reassign_card_customer(
    card_id: str,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """Move a card to a different customer (lab maintenance)."""
    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()
    if not card:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Card not found")
    new_cust_id = payload.get("customer_id")
    if not new_cust_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="customer_id is required")
    new_cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == new_cust_id).first()
    if not new_cust:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Target customer not found")

    before = serialize_entity(card)
    old_cust_id = card.customer_id
    card.customer_id = new_cust.id
    if new_cust.institution_id:
        card.institution_id = new_cust.institution_id
    after = serialize_entity(card)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "CARD",
        card.id,
        "REASSIGN_CUSTOMER",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,
        change_summary=f"Reassigned card {card.masked_pan} from customer {old_cust_id} to {new_cust.customer_number}",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(card)
    return {
        "status": "reassigned",
        "card_id": card.id,
        "masked_pan": card.masked_pan,
        "new_customer_id": new_cust.id,
        "new_customer_number": new_cust.customer_number,
    }

"""
audit_service.py — Entity Snapshot and Audit Trail Logger
Captures before/after JSON states and diff summaries for regulatory audit compliance.
"""

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models import AuditTrail


def serialize_entity(entity: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Serialize a SQLAlchemy declarative model into a clean JSON-serializable dict."""
    if entity is None:
        return {}
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    for col in entity.__table__.columns:
        val = getattr(entity, col.name, None)
        if isinstance(val, bool):
            out[col.name] = val
        elif hasattr(val, "isoformat"):
            out[col.name] = val.isoformat()
        elif hasattr(val, "__float__"):
            out[col.name] = float(val)
        else:
            out[col.name] = val
    return out


def record_audit(
    db: Session,
    entity_type: str,
    entity_id: str,
    action: str,
    performed_by: str = "admin",
    before_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    after_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    change_summary: Optional[str] = None,
) -> AuditTrail:
    """Record an immutable audit trail entry."""
    entry = AuditTrail(
        entity_type=entity_type.upper(),
        entity_id=str(entity_id),
        action=action.upper(),
        performed_by=performed_by,
        before_state=before_state,
        after_state=after_state,
        change_summary=change_summary,
    )
    db.add(entry)
    db.flush()
    return entry

"""
card_crypto_service.py — Card Issuing, Luhn Validation, and Cryptographic Calculations
Interfaces with SoftHsmCryptoCore for Visa PVV, IBM 3624, CVV, and ISO PIN Blocks.
"""

import random
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from app.hsm_adapter import SoftHsmCryptoCore


def validate_luhn(pan: str) -> bool:
    """Validate Primary Account Number using Luhn formula (ISO/IEC 7812)."""
    clean = re.sub(r"\D", "", pan or "")
    if len(clean) < 12:
        return False
    digits = [int(d) for d in clean]
    checksum = 0
    reverse_digits = digits[::-1]
    for i, d in enumerate(reverse_digits):
        if i % 2 == 1:
            doubled = d * 2
            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            checksum += d
    return checksum % 10 == 0


def calculate_luhn_check_digit(partial_pan: str) -> str:
    """Calculate the 1-digit Luhn check digit for a partial PAN."""
    clean = re.sub(r"\D", "", partial_pan)
    digits = [int(d) for d in clean]
    checksum = 0
    # The check digit will be at an even position from right when appended
    for i, d in enumerate(digits[::-1]):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            doubled = d * 2
            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            checksum += d
    remainder = checksum % 10
    return str((10 - remainder) % 10)


def generate_luhn_pan(bin_prefix: str = "456789", length: int = 16) -> str:
    """Generate a valid synthetic PAN under a given BIN prefix matching Luhn check digit."""
    clean_bin = re.sub(r"\D", "", bin_prefix)
    random_digits_needed = length - len(clean_bin) - 1
    if random_digits_needed < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"BIN prefix length ({len(clean_bin)}) exceeds or equals target PAN length ({length})")
    
    middle = "".join(str(random.randint(0, 9)) for _ in range(random_digits_needed))
    partial = f"{clean_bin}{middle}"
    check_digit = calculate_luhn_check_digit(partial)
    full_pan = f"{partial}{check_digit}"
    assert validate_luhn(full_pan)
    return full_pan


def calculate_visa_pvv_detailed(pan: str, pin: str, pvki: str = "1", pvk_id: str = "PVK_VISA_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate Visa PVV with step-by-step intermediate cryptographic visibility."""
    pvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(pvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    pan11 = pan[-12:-1]  # Rightmost 11 digits excluding Luhn check digit
    tsp = f"{pan11}{pvki[0]}{pin[:4]}"
    cipher = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(tsp, pvk_hex, decrypt=False)
    
    digits_found = [ch for ch in cipher if ch.isdigit()]
    decimalized_alphas = [str(int(ch, 16) - 10) for ch in cipher if ch in "ABCDEF"]
    combined = "".join(digits_found + decimalized_alphas)
    pvv = combined[:4]
    
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "pin": pin,
        "pvki": pvki,
        "pvk_id": pvk_id,
        "pvk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(pvk_hex),
        "tsp_constructed": tsp,
        "3des_cipher_hex": cipher,
        "decimalized_sequence": combined,
        "calculated_pvv": pvv,
    }


def calculate_ibm_offset_detailed(pan: str, pin: str, pvk_id: str = "PVK_VISA_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate IBM 3624 PIN Offset with step-by-step intermediate visibility."""
    pvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(pvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    dec_table = "0123456789012345"
    val_data = pan[-16:].zfill(16)
    enc = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(val_data, pvk_hex, decrypt=False)
    natural_pin = "".join(dec_table[int(enc[i], 16)] for i in range(len(pin)))
    offset = "".join(str((int(pin[i]) - int(natural_pin[i]) + 10) % 10) for i in range(len(pin)))
    
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "pin": pin,
        "pvk_id": pvk_id,
        "validation_data": val_data,
        "encrypted_validation_data": enc,
        "natural_pin": natural_pin,
        "calculated_offset": offset[:4],
    }


def calculate_cvv_detailed(pan: str, expiry_yy_mm: str, service_code: str = "101", cvk_id: str = "CVK_MAIN_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate CVV1 / CVV2 / iCVV with intermediate DES blocks."""
    cvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(cvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    calculated_cvv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_cvv(pan, expiry_yy_mm, service_code, cvk_hex)
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "expiry_yy_mm": expiry_yy_mm,
        "service_code": service_code,
        "cvk_id": cvk_id,
        "cvk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(cvk_hex),
        "calculated_cvv": calculated_cvv,
    }


def pack_pin_block_detailed(pin: str, pan: str, format_name: str = "ISO_0", awk_id: str = "AWK_ATM_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Pack clear PIN into ISO Format 0, 1, or 3 PIN block and encrypt under AWK."""
    awk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(awk_id, "1A2B3C4D5E6F70811A2B3C4D5E6F7081")
    
    if format_name.upper() == "ISO_0":
        pin_part = f"0{len(pin)}{pin}".ljust(16, "F")
        pan12 = pan[-13:-1].zfill(12)
        pan_part = f"0000{pan12}"
        clear_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.xor_hex(pin_part, pan_part)
    elif format_name.upper() == "ISO_1":
        # Format 1: 1 + L + PIN + Random Pad
        rand_pad = "".join(f"{random.randint(0, 15):X}" for _ in range(14 - len(pin)))
        clear_block = f"1{len(pin)}{pin}{rand_pad}"
    elif format_name.upper() == "ISO_3":
        # Format 3: 3 + L + PIN + Random (F-pad) XOR PAN
        rand_pad = "".join(f"{random.choice('0123456789ABCDEF')}" for _ in range(14 - len(pin)))
        pin_part = f"3{len(pin)}{pin}{rand_pad}"
        pan12 = pan[-13:-1].zfill(12)
        pan_part = f"0000{pan12}"
        clear_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.xor_hex(pin_part, pan_part)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported PIN block format: {format_name}")

    encrypted_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clear_block, awk_hex, decrypt=False)
    
    return {
        "format": format_name.upper(),
        "pin": pin,
        "pan": pan,
        "awk_id": awk_id,
        "awk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(awk_hex),
        "clear_pin_block": clear_block,
        "encrypted_pin_block": encrypted_block,
    }

    )

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=".env",
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore",
        case_sensitive=False,
    )

    @property
    def cors_origin_list(self) -> List[str]:
        return [o.strip() for o in self.CORS_ORIGINS.split(",") if o.strip()]


settings = Settings()

"""
context_trace.py — Request-Scoped Correlation and Cryptographic Event Tracing
Uses contextvars to trace end-to-end execution across API routes and HSM cryptographic steps.
"""

from contextvars import ContextVar
import json
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import uuid
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import Response

# Request-scoped correlation ID
current_correlation_id: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("current_correlation_id", default="")
# Request-scoped crypto event collector
current_crypto_trace: ContextVar[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = ContextVar("current_crypto_trace", default=[])


def get_correlation_id() -> str:
    cid = current_correlation_id.get()
    if not cid:
        cid = f"CORR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}"
        current_correlation_id.set(cid)
    return cid


def record_crypto_step(
    operation_type: str,
    step_number: int,
    step_name: str,
    key_id: Optional[str] = None,
    key_kcv: Optional[str] = None,
    raw_input: Optional[str] = None,
    raw_output: Optional[str] = None,
    expected_output: Optional[str] = None,
    status: str = "COMPLETED",
    details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    duration_ms: int = 1,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Record an individual cryptographic transformation step into the current request trace."""
    event = {
        "correlation_id": get_correlation_id(),
        "operation_type": operation_type,
        "step_number": step_number,
        "step_name": step_name,
        "key_id": key_id,
        "key_kcv": key_kcv,
        "raw_input": raw_input,
        "raw_output": raw_output,
        "expected_output": expected_output,
        "status": status,
        "details": details or {},
        "duration_ms": max(1, duration_ms),
    }
    trace = current_crypto_trace.get()
    trace.append(event)
    return event


class CorrelationTraceMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        # 1. Establish or extract correlation ID
        corr_id = request.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID") or f"CORR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}"
        token_corr = current_correlation_id.set(corr_id)
        token_trace = current_crypto_trace.set([])

        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        
        # Read body safely for API auditing (skip websockets)
        req_body = None
        if request.url.path.startswith("/api") and not request.url.path.startswith("/api/ws"):
            try:
                body_bytes = await request.body()
                if body_bytes:
                    try:
                        req_body = json.loads(body_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
                    except Exception:
                        req_body = {"raw": body_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            response: Response = await call_next(request)
        except Exception:
            current_correlation_id.reset(token_corr)
            current_crypto_trace.reset(token_trace)
            raise

        dur_ms = max(1, int((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000))
        response.headers["X-Correlation-ID"] = corr_id

        # 2. Persist ApiAuditLog and CryptoEvents asynchronously or at end of request
        if request.url.path.startswith("/api") and not request.url.path.startswith("/api/ws"):
            try:
                from app.database import SessionLocal
                from app.models import ApiAuditLog, CryptoEvent
                
                db = SessionLocal()
                try:
                    audit = ApiAuditLog(
                        correlation_id=corr_id,
                        http_method=request.method,
                        path=request.url.path,
                        status_code=response.status_code,
                        client_ip=request.client.host if request.client else "127.0.0.1",
                        user_agent=request.headers.get("User-Agent", "Unknown"),
                        duration_ms=dur_ms,
                        request_headers=dict(request.headers),
                        request_body=req_body,
                        response_body={"status": response.status_code},
                    )
                    db.add(audit)
                    
                    # Flush crypto trace events collected during this request
                    trace_events = current_crypto_trace.get()
                    for ev in trace_events:
                        db.add(CryptoEvent(**ev))
                    
                    db.commit()
                except Exception:
                    db.rollback()
                finally:
                    db.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

        current_correlation_id.reset(token_corr)
        current_crypto_trace.reset(token_trace)
        return response

"""
customer_360.py
Customer Maintenance 360 - backend extensions for the Rajon Host Simulator.

Adds (without touching any existing endpoint):
  GET  /api/maintenance/card/{card_id}/limits            max + usage of every limit that affects a card
  POST /api/maintenance/card/{card_id}/limits/reset      reset usage (legacy counters and/or profile limits)
  PATCH /api/maintenance/card/{card_id}/legacy-limits    edit per-card thresholds (partial update)
  PATCH /api/maintenance/account/{account_id}/legacy-limits   edit per-account thresholds (partial update)
  PUT  /api/maintenance/profile-limit/{assignment_id}/max     edit the maximum of a profile limit
  PUT  /api/maintenance/card/{card_id}                   edit card (name, expiry, status, product)
  GET  /api/maintenance/transactions                     last N transactions of a card / account / customer

Two limit systems exist in the host and BOTH are enforced during authorization:
  * LEGACY   card_limits / account_limits    (per-transaction + daily check; weekly / monthly are tracked)
  * PROFILE  limit_definitions + limit_usage_records, resolved BIN -> Card Profile -> Authorization Profile
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from sqlalchemy import or_
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.audit_service import record_audit, serialize_entity
from app.database import get_db
from app.limit_engine import LimitCalculationEngine, compute_reset_window
from app.models import (
    Account,

    Card,

    Customer,

)
from app.models_limits_profiles import (
    AuthProfileLimitAssignment,
    LimitUsageRecord,
)
from app.security import get_current_user

logger = logging.getLogger("rajon.customer360")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/maintenance", tags=["Customer Maintenance 360"])

CUSTOMER_EXTRA_TEXT_FIELDS: Tuple[str, ...] = (
    "father_name",
    "mother_name",
    "spouse_name",
    "gender",
    "marital_status",
    "nationality",
    "place_of_birth",
    "nid_number",
    "passport_number",
    "driving_license_number",
    "tin_number",
    "occupation",
    "employer_name",
    "alternate_mobile",
    "permanent_address",
    "city",
    "postal_code",
    "country",
    "kyc_status",
    "notes",
)


def customer_profile_fields(cust: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Extra identity fields of a customer as JSON-safe values (safe even on old rows)."""
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    dob = getattr(cust, "date_of_birth", None)
    out["date_of_birth"] = dob.isoformat() if dob else None
    pexp = getattr(cust, "passport_expiry_date", None)
    out["passport_expiry_date"] = pexp.isoformat() if pexp else None
    for name in CUSTOMER_EXTRA_TEXT_FIELDS:
        out[name] = getattr(cust, name, None)
    created = getattr(cust, "created_at", None)
    out["created_at"] = created.isoformat() if created else None
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _f(value: Any) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _pct(used: Optional[float], maximum: float) -> Optional[float]:
    if used is None or not maximum:
        return None
    return round(min(999.0, used * 100.0 / maximum), 1)


def _dec(value: Any, field: str) -> Decimal:
    try:
        d = Decimal(str(value))
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"{field} must be a number")
    if d < 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"{field} cannot be negative")
    return d.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))


def _iso(dt: Optional[datetime]) -> Optional[str]:
    return dt.isoformat() if dt else None


def _linked_accounts(db: Session, card: Card) -> List[Tuple[Account, str, int]]:
    """Accounts linked to a card, primary first. Falls back to the legacy linked_account_id."""
    seen: set = set()
    result: List[Tuple[Account, str, int]] = []
    links = sorted(card.card_accounts or [], key=lambda x: (x.priority or 99))
    for ca in links:
        if ca.account_id in seen:
            continue
        acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == ca.account_id).first()
        if acct:
            seen.add(acct.id)
            result.append((acct, ca.account_role or "PRIMARY", ca.priority or 1))
    if not result and card.linked_account_id:
        acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == card.linked_account_id).first()
        if acct:
            result.append((acct, "PRIMARY", 1))
    return result


def _get_card(db: Session, card_id: str) -> Card:
    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()
    if not card:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Card not found")
    return card


def _ensure_card_limit(db: Session, card: Card) -> CardLimit:
    lim = db.query(CardLimit).filter(CardLimit.card_id == card.id).first()
    if not lim:
        lim = CardLimit(card_id=card.id, currency="BDT")
        db.add(lim)
        db.flush()
    return lim


def _ensure_account_limit(db: Session, acct: Account) -> AccountLimit:
    lim = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == acct.id).first()
    if not lim:
        lim = AccountLimit(account_id=acct.id, currency=acct.currency)
        db.add(lim)
        db.flush()
    return lim


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LEGACY limit rows
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (field, label, period, used_field, enforced_by_host_engine)
_CARD_LEGACY_DEF = [
    ("transaction_limit", "Per-Transaction Limit", "PER_TRANSACTION", None, True),
    ("daily_limit", "Daily Limit", "DAILY", "daily_used", True),
    ("weekly_limit", "Weekly Limit", "WEEKLY", "weekly_used", False),
    ("monthly_limit", "Monthly Limit", "MONTHLY", "monthly_used", False),
    ("withdrawal_limit", "ATM Withdrawal Cap", "CHANNEL", None, False),
    ("purchase_limit", "POS Purchase Cap", "CHANNEL", None, False),
    ("ecommerce_limit", "E-Commerce Cap", "CHANNEL", None, False),
]
_ACCOUNT_LEGACY_DEF = [
    ("per_transaction_limit", "Per-Transaction Limit", "PER_TRANSACTION", None, True),
    ("daily_limit", "Daily Limit", "DAILY", "daily_used", True),
    ("weekly_limit", "Weekly Limit", "WEEKLY", "weekly_used", False),
    ("monthly_limit", "Monthly Limit", "MONTHLY", "monthly_used", False),
]


def _legacy_rows(lim: Any, definition: list, scope: str, target_id: str, label: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for field, name, period, used_field, enforced in definition:
        maximum = _f(getattr(lim, field, 0))
        used = _f(getattr(lim, used_field, 0)) if used_field else None
        rows.append(
            {
                "row_id": f"LEGACY:{scope}:{target_id}:{field}",
                "source": "LEGACY",
                "scope": scope,
                "target_id": target_id,
                "target_label": label,
                "key": field,
                "name": name,
                "period": period,
                "unit": "AMOUNT",
                "currency": getattr(lim, "currency", "BDT"),
                "max": maximum,
                "used": used,
                "remaining": max(0.0, maximum - used) if used is not None else None,
                "percent": _pct(used, maximum),
                "enforced": enforced,
                "status": getattr(lim, "status", "ACTIVE"),
                "editable": True,
            }
        )
    return rows


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PROFILE (limit engine) rows
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _usage_value(rec: Optional[LimitUsageRecord], method: str) -> float:
    if rec is None:
        return 0.0
    m = (method or "").upper()
    if m == "COUNT_TRANSACTION":
        return _f(rec.consumed_count)
    if m == "MAX_SINGLE_TRANSACTION":
        return _f(rec.max_single_amount)
    if m == "MIN_SINGLE_TRANSACTION":
        return _f(rec.min_single_amount)
    return _f(rec.consumed_amount)


def _profile_rows(
    db: Session, card: Card, accounts: List[Tuple[Account, str, int]]
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    engine = LimitCalculationEngine(db)
    bin_row, card_profile = engine.resolve_card_profile(card)
    auth = engine.resolve_authorization_profile(card_profile) if card_profile else None

    info: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "bin_prefix": getattr(bin_row, "bin_prefix", None),
        "card_profile_code": getattr(card_profile, "profile_code", None),
        "card_profile_name": getattr(card_profile, "profile_name", None),
        "auth_profile_code": getattr(auth, "auth_profile_code", None),
        "auth_profile_name": getattr(auth, "profile_name", None),
        "note": None,
    }
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if not card_profile:
        info["note"] = "No active Card Profile resolved for this card (check the BIN or card profile assignment)."
        return info, rows
    if not auth:
        info["note"] = "No active Authorization Profile is linked to the card profile, so no profile limits apply."
        return info, rows

    assigns = (
        db.query(AuthProfileLimitAssignment)
        .filter(
            AuthProfileLimitAssignment.authorization_profile_id == auth.id,
            AuthProfileLimitAssignment.status == "ACTIVE",
        )
        .order_by(AuthProfileLimitAssignment.evaluation_priority.asc())
        .all()
    )
    seen: set = set()
    for a in assigns:
        ldef = a.limit_definition
        if not ldef or ldef.status != "ACTIVE" or ldef.id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(ldef.id)
        scope = (ldef.scope or "CARD").upper()
        method = (a.calculation_method_override or ldef.calculation_method or "SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT").upper()
        eff_max = a.maximum_limit_override if a.maximum_limit_override is not None else ldef.maximum_limit
        interval = (ldef.reset_interval or "DAILY").upper()
        unit = "COUNT" if method == "COUNT_TRANSACTION" else "AMOUNT"

        if scope == "CARD":
            targets = [(card.id, card.masked_pan)]
        else:
            targets = [(acct.id, acct.account_number) for acct, _, _ in accounts]

        for target_id, label in targets:
            win_key, win_start, win_end = compute_reset_window(
                interval, reset_interval_hours=ldef.reset_interval_hours
            )
            used: Optional[float]
            if interval == "PER_TRANSACTION":
                used = None
            else:
                rec = (
                    db.query(LimitUsageRecord)
                    .filter(
                        LimitUsageRecord.scope == scope,
                        LimitUsageRecord.target_entity_id == target_id,
                        LimitUsageRecord.limit_definition_id == ldef.id,
                        LimitUsageRecord.window_key == win_key,
                    )
                    .first()
                )
                used = _usage_value(rec, method)
            maximum = _f(eff_max)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "row_id": f"PROFILE:{scope}:{target_id}:{ldef.id}",
                    "source": "PROFILE",
                    "scope": scope,
                    "target_id": target_id,
                    "target_label": label,
                    "key": ldef.limit_code,
                    "name": ldef.limit_name,
                    "limit_code": ldef.limit_code,
                    "period": interval,
                    "unit": unit,
                    "currency": ldef.currency,
                    "max": maximum,
                    "used": used,
                    "remaining": max(0.0, maximum - used) if used is not None else None,
                    "percent": _pct(used, maximum),
                    "window_key": win_key if interval != "PER_TRANSACTION" else None,
                    "resets_at": _iso(win_end) if interval != "PER_TRANSACTION" else None,
                    "method": method,
                    "operator": a.comparison_operator_override or ldef.comparison_operator,
                    "impact_action": a.impact_action_override or ldef.impact_action,
                    "decline_rc": a.decline_response_code_override or ldef.decline_response_code,
                    "override_active": a.maximum_limit_override is not None,
                    "definition_id": ldef.id,
                    "assignment_id": a.id,
                    "enforced": True,
                    "status": ldef.status,
                    "editable": True,
                }
            )
    return info, rows


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GET limits
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/card/{card_id}/limits")
def card_limits_360(
    card_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    accounts = _linked_accounts(db, card)

    c_lim = _ensure_card_limit(db, card)
    legacy_card = {
        "limit_id": c_lim.id,
        "status": c_lim.status,
        "currency": c_lim.currency,
        "rows": _legacy_rows(c_lim, _CARD_LEGACY_DEF, "CARD", card.id, card.masked_pan),
    }
    legacy_accounts = []
    for acct, role, priority in accounts:
        a_lim = _ensure_account_limit(db, acct)
        legacy_accounts.append(
            {
                "account_id": acct.id,
                "account_number": acct.account_number,
                "account_type": acct.account_type,
                "account_role": role,
                "currency": acct.currency,
                "limit_id": a_lim.id,
                "status": a_lim.status,
                "rows": _legacy_rows(a_lim, _ACCOUNT_LEGACY_DEF, "ACCOUNT", acct.id, acct.account_number),
            }
        )
    info, profile_rows = _profile_rows(db, card, accounts)
    db.commit()
    return {
        "card": {"id": card.id, "masked_pan": card.masked_pan, "card_status": card.card_status},
        "legacy": {"card": legacy_card, "accounts": legacy_accounts},
        "profile": {"info": info, "rows": profile_rows},
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RESET usage
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class LimitResetBody(BaseModel):
    target: str = Field("ALL", description="ALL | LEGACY | PROFILE")
    period: str = Field("ALL", description="Legacy counters: DAILY | WEEKLY | MONTHLY | ALL")
    limit_definition_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Profile limits: reset only this definition")
    account_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Restrict the reset to one linked account")
    include_card: bool = True
    reason: str = Field("Customer 360 manual reset", min_length=3, max_length=250)


def _zero_legacy(lim: Any, period: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    old = {
        "daily_used": _f(lim.daily_used),
        "weekly_used": _f(lim.weekly_used),
        "monthly_used": _f(lim.monthly_used),
    }
    if period in ("DAILY", "ALL"):
        lim.daily_used = Decimal("0.00")
    if period in ("WEEKLY", "ALL"):
        lim.weekly_used = Decimal("0.00")
    if period in ("MONTHLY", "ALL"):
        lim.monthly_used = Decimal("0.00")
    new = {
        "daily_used": _f(lim.daily_used),
        "weekly_used": _f(lim.weekly_used),
        "monthly_used": _f(lim.monthly_used),
    }
    return {"old": old, "new": new}


@router.post("/card/{card_id}/limits/reset")
def reset_card_limits_360(
    card_id: str,
    body: LimitResetBody,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    target = (body.target or "ALL").upper().strip()
    period = (body.period or "ALL").upper().strip()
    if target not in ("ALL", "LEGACY", "PROFILE"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target must be ALL, LEGACY or PROFILE")
    if period not in ("ALL", "DAILY", "WEEKLY", "MONTHLY"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="period must be ALL, DAILY, WEEKLY or MONTHLY")
    reason = (body.reason or "").strip()
    if len(reason) < 3:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="A reason of at least 3 characters is required")

    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    accounts = _linked_accounts(db, card)
    if body.account_id:
        accounts = [t for t in accounts if t[0].id == body.account_id]
        if not accounts:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account is not linked to this card")

    summary: Dict[str, Any] = {"legacy": [], "profile_records_reset": 0}

    if target in ("ALL", "LEGACY"):
        if body.include_card:
            c_lim = _ensure_card_limit(db, card)
            before = serialize_entity(c_lim)
            res = _zero_legacy(c_lim, period)
            record_audit(
                db, "CARD_LIMIT", c_lim.id, "RESET_USAGE", performed_by=current_user,
                before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(c_lim),
                change_summary=f"Customer 360 reset ({period}) of card {card.masked_pan}: {reason}",
            )
            summary["legacy"].append({"entity": "CARD", "label": card.masked_pan, **res})
        for acct, _, _ in accounts:
            a_lim = _ensure_account_limit(db, acct)
            before = serialize_entity(a_lim)
            res = _zero_legacy(a_lim, period)
            record_audit(
                db, "ACCOUNT_LIMIT", a_lim.id, "RESET_USAGE", performed_by=current_user,
                before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(a_lim),
                change_summary=f"Customer 360 reset ({period}) of account {acct.account_number}: {reason}",
            )
            summary["legacy"].append({"entity": "ACCOUNT", "label": acct.account_number, **res})

    if target in ("ALL", "PROFILE"):
        targets: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
        if body.include_card:
            targets.append(("CARD", card.id))
        targets.extend(("ACCOUNT", acct.id) for acct, _, _ in accounts)
        count = 0
        for scope, tid in targets:
            q = db.query(LimitUsageRecord).filter(
                LimitUsageRecord.scope == scope, LimitUsageRecord.target_entity_id == tid
            )
            if body.limit_definition_id:
                q = q.filter(LimitUsageRecord.limit_definition_id == body.limit_definition_id)
            for r in q.all():
                r.consumed_amount = Decimal("0.00")
                r.consumed_count = 0
                r.reserved_amount = Decimal("0.00")
                r.max_single_amount = Decimal("0.00")
                r.min_single_amount = None
                count += 1
        summary["profile_records_reset"] = count
        record_audit(
            db, "CARD", card.id, "RESET_PROFILE_LIMIT_USAGE", performed_by=current_user,
            change_summary=f"Customer 360 reset {count} profile limit usage record(s) for card {card.masked_pan}: {reason}",
        )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "reset", "target": target, "period": period, "reason": reason, **summary}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EDIT legacy limits (partial update)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CardLegacyLimitPatch(BaseModel):
    transaction_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    daily_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    weekly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    monthly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    withdrawal_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    purchase_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    ecommerce_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    status: Optional[str] = None


class AccountLegacyLimitPatch(BaseModel):
    per_transaction_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    daily_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    weekly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    monthly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    status: Optional[str] = None


def _apply_patch(lim: Any, patch: BaseModel) -> None:
    for key, value in patch.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key == "status":
            status = str(value).upper().strip()
            if status not in ("ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "SUSPENDED"):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="status must be ACTIVE, INACTIVE or SUSPENDED")
            lim.status = status
        else:
            setattr(lim, key, _dec(value, key))

@router.put("/profile-limit/{assignment_id}/max")
def edit_profile_limit_max(
    assignment_id: str,
    body: ProfileLimitMaxBody,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """Edits the maximum override of a limit assigned to an Authorization Profile.
    NOTE: it applies to every card that uses that Authorization Profile."""

    )
    db.commit()

        "status": "updated",

    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EDIT card (expiry aware)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CardEditBody(BaseModel):
    cardholder_name: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=120)
    expiry_month: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=12)
    expiry_year: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=2000, le=2099)
    card_status: Optional[str] = None
    card_product: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=60)
    card_type: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=30)


@router.put("/card/{card_id}")
def edit_card_360(
    card_id: str,
    body: CardEditBody,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    before = serialize_entity(card)
    data = body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    old_expiry = (card.expiry_year, card.expiry_month)

    if "cardholder_name" in data and data["cardholder_name"] is not None:
        name = data["cardholder_name"].strip().upper()
        if not name:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cardholder name cannot be empty")
        card.cardholder_name = name
    for key in ("card_product", "card_type"):
        if data.get(key):
            setattr(card, key, data[key].strip())
    if data.get("card_status"):
        card.card_status = data["card_status"].upper().strip()
    if data.get("expiry_month") is not None:
        card.expiry_month = int(data["expiry_month"])
    if data.get("expiry_year") is not None:
        card.expiry_year = int(data["expiry_year"])

    warning: Optional[str] = None
    cvv_regenerated = False
    if (card.expiry_year, card.expiry_month) != old_expiry:
        # The CVV is derived from PAN + expiry, so it must be recalculated for the new expiry.
        try:
            from app.hsm_adapter import HSMAdapter

            yymm = f"{str(card.expiry_year)[-2:]}{int(card.expiry_month):02d}"
            new_cvv = HSMAdapter(db).generate_card_cvv(card.test_pan_reference, yymm, "101", "CVK_MAIN_01")
            pin_prof = db.query(PinProfile).filter(PinProfile.card_id == card.id).first()
            if pin_prof and new_cvv:
                pin_prof.cvv_reference = new_cvv
                cvv_regenerated = True
        except Exception as exc:  # HSM offline / key missing: keep the edit but tell the user
            logger.warning("CVV regeneration failed for card %s: %s", card.id, exc)
            warning = f"Expiry saved, but the CVV could not be recalculated ({exc}). Recalculate it in the PIN & Card Lab."

    record_audit(
        db, "CARD", card.id, "UPDATE", performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(card),
        change_summary=f"Customer 360 edited card {card.masked_pan}"
        + (" (expiry changed, CVV recalculated)" if cvv_regenerated else ""),
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "status": "updated",
        "card_id": card.id,
        "expiry_month": card.expiry_month,
        "expiry_year": card.expiry_year,
        "cvv_regenerated": cvv_regenerated,
        "warning": warning,
    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRANSACTIONS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/transactions")
def maintenance_transactions(
    card_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    account_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    customer_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    q = db.query(Transaction)
    scope_label = ""
    if card_id:
        card = _get_card(db, card_id)
        q = q.filter(or_(Transaction.card_id == card.id, Transaction.masked_pan == card.masked_pan))
        scope_label = card.masked_pan
    elif account_id:
        acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == account_id).first()
        if not acct:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
        q = q.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.account_id == acct.id,
                Transaction.source_account == acct.account_number,
                Transaction.destination_account == acct.account_number,
            )
        )
        scope_label = acct.account_number
    elif customer_id:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == customer_id).first()
        if not cust:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer not found")
        q = q.filter(Transaction.customer_id == cust.id)
        scope_label = cust.customer_number
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Provide card_id, account_id or customer_id")

    total = q.count()
    rows = (
        q.order_by(Transaction.transaction_datetime.desc(), Transaction.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    approved = declined = 0
    approved_amount = 0.0
    for t in rows:
        ok = (t.response_code or "") in ("00", "0", "000") or (t.authorization_status or "").upper() == "APPROVED"
        if ok:
            approved += 1
            approved_amount += _f(t.transaction_amount)
        else:
            declined += 1
        items.append(
            {
                "id": t.id,
                "reference": t.transaction_reference,
                "datetime": _iso(t.transaction_datetime),
                "mti": t.mti,
                "transaction_code": t.transaction_code,
                "type_name": t.transaction_type_name,
                "amount": _f(t.transaction_amount),
                "currency": t.currency,
                "response_code": t.response_code,
                "response_message": t.response_message,
                "status": t.transaction_status,
                "authorization_status": t.authorization_status,
                "approved": ok,
                "decline_reason": t.decline_reason,
                "channel": t.source_channel,
                "terminal_id": t.terminal_id,
                "merchant_name": t.merchant_name,
                "merchant_id": t.merchant_id,
                "rrn": t.rrn,
                "stan": t.stan,
                "approval_code": t.approval_code,
                "masked_pan": t.masked_pan,
                "source_account": t.source_account,
                "destination_account": t.destination_account,
                "is_on_us": t.is_on_us,
            }
        )
    return {
        "scope": scope_label,
        "total": total,
        "returned": len(items),
        "summary": {"approved": approved, "declined": declined, "approved_amount": round(approved_amount, 2)},
        "items": items,
    }

"""
MODULE 1 — database.py
Database connection, SQLAlchemy session management, base configuration, and initialization.
Supports PostgreSQL (Neon/local) and SQLite for zero-config local Windows testing.
"""

from typing import Generator
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker
from app.config import settings

connect_args = {}
if settings.DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite"):
    connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False}

engine_kwargs = {}
if settings.DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite") and ":memory:" in settings.DATABASE_URL:
    # in-memory SQLite is per-connection; share one connection across threads (tests)
    from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool
    engine_kwargs["poolclass"] = StaticPool

engine = create_engine(
    settings.DATABASE_URL,
    connect_args=connect_args,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
    future=True,
    **engine_kwargs,
)

if settings.DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite"):
    @event.listens_for(engine, "connect")
    def set_sqlite_pragma(dbapi_connection, connection_record):
        cursor = dbapi_connection.cursor()
        cursor.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
        cursor.close()

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine, future=True)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


# [PATCH step00_02:database_sync_schema]
def init_db() -> None:
    import app.models  # noqa: F401
    from app.schema_sync import synchronize_database_schema
    synchronize_database_schema(engine, Base)
# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v3:ensure_tx_log_indexes]
    from app.database_indexes_tx_logs import ensure_transaction_log_indexes
    ensure_transaction_log_indexes(engine)

"""
database_indexes_tx_logs.py — Safe Additive Performance Indexes for Transaction Log Viewer
Creates composite and single-column indexes if they do not already exist.
Never drops or alters existing data.
"""

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine

INDEX_STATEMENTS = [
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_created_at_desc ON transactions (created_at DESC)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_auth_tx_status ON transactions (authorization_status, transaction_status)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_rrn_stan ON transactions (rrn, stan)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_correlation_id ON transactions (correlation_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_masked_pan ON transactions (masked_pan)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_ps_code_mti_rc ON transactions (ps_code, mti, response_code)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_issuer_acquirer ON transactions (issuer_institution_id, acquirer_institution_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_terminal_merchant ON transactions (terminal_id, merchant_id)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_logs_source_account ON transactions (source_account)",
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_tx_trace_tx_id_order ON transaction_trace_events (transaction_id, event_order)",
]


def ensure_transaction_log_indexes(engine: Engine) -> None:
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        for stmt in INDEX_STATEMENTS:
            try:
                conn.execute(text(stmt))
            except Exception:
                pass
