class PanRoutingRule(Base):
    '''
    Granular PAN / BIN / Acquirer / Channel routing rule evaluated before fallback BIN table lookup.
    Supports priority ordering, On-Us vs Off-Us determination, issuer/acquirer matching,
    destination processing switch selection, and network profile dispatch.
    '''
    __tablename__ = "pan_routing_rules"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=gen_uuid)
    rule_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    rule_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(140), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    priority: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=10, index=True)
    pan_prefix: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(12), nullable=False, index=True)
    pan_low: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(19), nullable=False, index=True)
    pan_high: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(19), nullable=False, index=True)
    pan_length: Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(SmallInteger, default=16)
    card_type: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(30))  # DEBIT, CREDIT, PREPAID, ANY
    transaction_code: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(20))  # 10, 20, 30, 40, or NULL for ANY
    acquirer_institution_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), ForeignKey("institutions.id"), index=True)
    issuer_institution_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), ForeignKey("institutions.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    processing_system_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), ForeignKey("processing_systems.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    destination_network: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(60), default="INTERNAL_SIMULATOR_TIC")
    scheme: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), nullable=False, default="ITCL")
    is_on_us: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    pin_translation_required: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    source_key_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80), default="AWK_ATM_01")
    destination_key_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80), default="IWK_SW_01")
    enabled: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="ACTIVE")
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=utc_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=utc_now, onupdate=utc_now)

    issuer_institution: Mapped[Optional["Institution"]] = relationship("Institution", foreign_keys=[issuer_institution_id])
    acquirer_institution: Mapped[Optional["Institution"]] = relationship("Institution", foreign_keys=[acquirer_institution_id])
    processing_system: Mapped[Optional["ProcessingSystem"]] = relationship("ProcessingSystem", foreign_keys=[processing_system_id])

"""
models_limits_profiles.py — Normalized SQLAlchemy 2.0 Models for:
  - Module 1 & 2: Configurable Card & Account Limit Definitions (LimitDefinition)
  - Module 3: BIN-to-Card-Profile Inheritance & Extended CardProfile Metadata
  - Module 4: Authorization Profiles (AuthorizationProfile)
    * Tab A: Allowed / Disallowed Transaction Codes (AuthProfileTxCodePermission)
    * Tab B & C: Card & Account Limit Assignments (AuthProfileLimitAssignment)
    * Tab D: Transaction-Code Limit Impact Mappings (TxCodeLimitImpact)
  - Module 6 & 11: Windowed Usage Counters (LimitUsageRecord), Transaction Consumption Ledger
    (LimitTransactionConsumption), and Auditable Limit Evaluation History (LimitEvaluationAudit).
"""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    Integer,
    JSON,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship
from app.database import Base


def _gen_uuid() -> str:
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


class LimitDefinition(Base):
    """
    Central reusable limit definition supporting both CARD and ACCOUNT scopes.
    Kept separate from profile assignments and per-card/per-account runtime usage.
    """
    __tablename__ = "limit_definitions"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("limit_code", name="uq_limit_definitions_code"),
        Index("ix_limit_defs_scope_status", "scope", "status"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_gen_uuid)
    limit_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)  # e.g. "100", "200"
    limit_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="CARD", index=True)  # CARD | ACCOUNT
    currency: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), nullable=False, default="BDT")
    maximum_limit: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False, default=Decimal("10000.00"))
    reset_interval: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), nullable=False, default="DAILY")  # DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY, PER_TRANSACTION, CUSTOM_HOURS
    reset_interval_hours: Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(Integer)
    reset_anchor_time: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False, default="00:00")  # HH:MM UTC
    calculation_method: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(50),
        nullable=False,
        default="SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT",
    )
    # Supported calculation_method values:
    # COUNT_TRANSACTION, SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, MAX_SINGLE_TRANSACTION, MIN_SINGLE_TRANSACTION,
    # SUM_CASH_WITHDRAWAL, SUM_PURCHASE, SUM_TRANSFER, CUSTOM_SUPPORTED_AGGREGATION
    custom_aggregation_filter: Mapped[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]] = mapped_column(JSON)
    comparison_operator: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False, default=">")  # >, <, >=, <=, =, !=
    impact_action: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), nullable=False, default="DECLINE")  # DECLINE, APPROVE_WITH_ALERT, FLAG_REVIEW
    decline_response_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(5), nullable=False, default="61")
    institution_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), ForeignKey("institutions.id"), index=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="ACTIVE", index=True)  # ACTIVE, INACTIVE, ARCHIVED
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now)

    profile_assignments: Mapped[List["AuthProfileLimitAssignment"]] = relationship(
        "AuthProfileLimitAssignment", back_populates="limit_definition"
    )
    tx_code_impacts: Mapped[List["TxCodeLimitImpact"]] = relationship(
        "TxCodeLimitImpact", back_populates="limit_definition"
    )


class AuthorizationProfile(Base):
    """
    Module 4: Authorization Profile linked to a CardProfile (and Institution).
    Controls allowed transaction codes, assigned Card Limits, assigned Account Limits,
    and transaction-code-wise limit impact rules.
    """
    __tablename__ = "authorization_profiles"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("auth_profile_code", name="uq_auth_profile_code"),
        Index("ix_auth_profiles_card_profile_status", "card_profile_id", "status"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_gen_uuid)
    auth_profile_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    profile_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    card_profile_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("card_profiles.id"), index=True
    )
    institution_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("institutions.id"), index=True
    )
    # Secure default behavior when a transaction code is not explicitly configured in Tab A:
    # REJECT (default secure) or ALLOW
    unconfigured_tx_code_policy: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(20), nullable=False, default="REJECT"
    )
    unconfigured_decline_rc: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(5), nullable=False, default="57"
    )
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="ACTIVE", index=True)  # ACTIVE, INACTIVE, ARCHIVED
    effective_from: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)
    effective_to: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now)

    tx_permissions: Mapped[List["AuthProfileTxCodePermission"]] = relationship(
        "AuthProfileTxCodePermission",
        back_populates="authorization_profile",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        order_by="AuthProfileTxCodePermission.transaction_code",
    )
    limit_assignments: Mapped[List["AuthProfileLimitAssignment"]] = relationship(
        "AuthProfileLimitAssignment",
        back_populates="authorization_profile",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        order_by="AuthProfileLimitAssignment.evaluation_priority",
    )
    tx_code_impacts: Mapped[List["TxCodeLimitImpact"]] = relationship(
        "TxCodeLimitImpact",
        back_populates="authorization_profile",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )

        String(36),

        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    transaction_code_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("transaction_codes.id")
    )
    transaction_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, index=True)
    transaction_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=False)
    permission: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="ALLOWED")  # ALLOWED | DISALLOWED
    decline_response_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(5), nullable=False, default="57")
    description: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="ACTIVE")
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now)

    authorization_profile: Mapped["AuthorizationProfile"] = relationship(
        "AuthorizationProfile", back_populates="tx_permissions"
    )

        index=True,

    limit_definition_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(

        ForeignKey("limit_definitions.id"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,

    maximum_limit_override: Mapped[Optional[Decimal]] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2))

    decline_response_code_override: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(5))
    evaluation_priority: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=10)

    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now)

class TxCodeLimitImpact(Base):
    """
    Tab D — Transaction Code Limit Impact inside an Authorization Profile (or global default when
    authorization_profile_id is NULL).
    Controls whether a specific Transaction Code causes INCREASE, DECREASE, or NO_IMPACT on a Limit.
    """
    __tablename__ = "tx_code_limit_impacts"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint(
            "authorization_profile_id",
            "transaction_code",
            "limit_definition_id",
            name="uq_tx_code_limit_impact",
        ),
        Index("ix_tx_code_impact_lookup", "authorization_profile_id", "transaction_code", "limit_definition_id"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_gen_uuid)
    authorization_profile_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(
        String(36),
        ForeignKey("authorization_profiles.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        index=True,
    )
    transaction_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, index=True)
    limit_definition_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(36),
        ForeignKey("limit_definitions.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    impact_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(20), nullable=False, default="INCREASE"
    )  # INCREASE | DECREASE | NO_IMPACT
    calculation_basis: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(40), nullable=False, default="TRANSACTION_AMOUNT"
    )  # TRANSACTION_AMOUNT | BILLING_AMOUNT | TRANSACTION_COUNT | FIXED_UNIT
    multiplier: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        Numeric(10, 4), nullable=False, default=Decimal("1.0000")
    )
    description: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="ACTIVE")
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now)

    authorization_profile: Mapped[Optional["AuthorizationProfile"]] = relationship(
        "AuthorizationProfile", back_populates="tx_code_impacts"
    )
    limit_definition: Mapped["LimitDefinition"] = relationship(
        "LimitDefinition", back_populates="tx_code_impacts"
    )


class LimitUsageRecord(Base):
    """
    Windowed accumulator tracking current consumed usage per (scope, target_entity_id,
    limit_definition_id, window_key).
    - For CARD limits, target_entity_id = card.id
    - For ACCOUNT limits, target_entity_id = account.id
    Locked with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE during authorization to prevent concurrency race conditions.
    """
    __tablename__ = "limit_usage_records"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint(
            "scope",
            "target_entity_id",
            "limit_definition_id",
            "window_key",
            name="uq_limit_usage_window",
        ),
        Index("ix_limit_usage_target_lookup", "scope", "target_entity_id", "limit_definition_id", "window_key"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_gen_uuid)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, index=True)  # CARD | ACCOUNT
    target_entity_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False, index=True)  # card.id or account.id
    limit_definition_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("limit_definitions.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    window_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False, index=True)  # e.g. DAILY:2026-11-08, WEEKLY:2026-W45
    window_start: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)
    window_end: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)
    consumed_amount: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False, default=Decimal("0.00"))
    consumed_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    reserved_amount: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False, default=Decimal("0.00"))
    max_single_amount: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False, default=Decimal("0.00"))
    min_single_amount: Mapped[Optional[Decimal]] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2))
    last_transaction_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36))
    last_updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now, onupdate=_utc_now)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)


class LimitTransactionConsumption(Base):
    """
    Idempotent ledger of exact limit impact committed per approved transaction.
    Guarantees:
      1. Duplicate transactions never increment usage twice.
      2. Reversals (0400/0420) restore the exact original transaction impact.
      3. Repeated reversals never restore usage more than once.
    """
    __tablename__ = "limit_transaction_consumptions"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint(
            "transaction_id",
            "limit_definition_id",
            "scope",
            "target_entity_id",
            name="uq_tx_limit_consumption",
        ),
        Index("ix_limit_tx_cons_orig_tx", "transaction_id", "reversed_flag"),
    )

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_gen_uuid)
    transaction_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("transactions.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    usage_record_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("limit_usage_records.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    limit_definition_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(36), ForeignKey("limit_definitions.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False)  # CARD | ACCOUNT
    target_entity_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False)
    transaction_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False)
    impact_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False)  # INCREASE | DECREASE | NO_IMPACT
    amount_delta: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False, default=Decimal("0.00"))
    count_delta: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    reversed_flag: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    reversal_transaction_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36))
    reversed_at: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)

    """

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_gen_uuid)
    transaction_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), index=True)
    transaction_reference: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80), index=True)
    authorization_profile_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), index=True)
    limit_definition_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False, index=True)
    limit_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False)
    limit_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False)
    scope: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False)  # CARD | ACCOUNT
    target_entity_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False)
    transaction_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False)
    calculation_method: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    reset_interval: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), nullable=False)
    window_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False)
    maximum_value: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False)
    previous_usage: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False)
    transaction_impact: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False)
    projected_usage: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(20, 2), nullable=False)
    comparison_operator: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False)
    condition_matched: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    configured_action: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(30), nullable=False, default="DECLINE")
    final_result: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="PASSED")  # PASSED | DECLINED | ALERT
    response_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(5), nullable=False, default="00")
    decline_reason: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utc_now)

"""
models_local_host.py
Models for the Rajon Local Host control center:

  * LocalHostPolicy    - transaction policy of the host. One GLOBAL row plus optional per-BANK overrides.
  * HostAlgo           - user written Python / SQL risk block (scope: GLOBAL, BANK or CARD_PROFILE).
  * HostAlgoVersion    - every saved version of an algo (audit + rollback).
  * HostAlgoLog        - execution log of algos (matches, blocks, errors).
"""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, Index, Integer, JSON, String, Text, UniqueConstraint
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.database import Base


def _uuid() -> str:
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


class LocalHostPolicy(Base):
    __tablename__ = "local_host_policies"
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("scope_type", "institution_id", name="uq_local_host_policy_scope"),)

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_uuid)
    scope_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False, default="GLOBAL", index=True)  # GLOBAL | BANK
    institution_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False, default="Global Default")
    enabled: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    # Sparse configuration. Sections that are missing are inherited (BANK -> GLOBAL -> built-in defaults).
    config_json: Mapped[Dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=False, default=dict)
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    updated_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_now, onupdate=_now)


class HostAlgo(Base):
    __tablename__ = "host_algos"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=_uuid)
    algo_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(60), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(150), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)
    language: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False, default="PYTHON")  # PYTHON | SQL
    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False, default="")
    scope_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(15), nullable=False, default="GLOBAL", index=True)  # GLOBAL | BANK | CARD_PROFILE
    institution_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), index=True)
    card_profile_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36), index=True)
    stage: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(15), nullable=False, default="PRE_AUTH", index=True)  # PRE_AUTH | POST_AUTH
    priority: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=100, index=True)
    mode: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False, default="ENFORCE")  # ENFORCE | MONITOR
    default_action: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="DECLINE")
    default_response_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(5), nullable=False, default="57")
    default_message: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=False, default="Declined by risk algo")
    on_error: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(10), nullable=False, default="SKIP")  # SKIP | DECLINE
    stop_on_match: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    tx_codes_json: Mapped[Optional[Any]] = mapped_column(JSON)  # list of transaction codes, empty = all
    channels_json: Mapped[Optional[Any]] = mapped_column(JSON)  # list of channels, empty = all
    enabled: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    eval_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    hit_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    error_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    last_run_at: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    last_hit_at: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    created_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80))
    updated_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_now)

"""
network_adapter.py — Enterprise Switch Routing Engine & Simulated Card Schemes
Handles On-Us vs Off-Us resolution, priority-based PAN Router Rules, active BIN Range
validation, cross-zone PIN translation (AWK -> IWK), outbound simulated switch adapters
(Visa/Mastercard/NPSB), and timeout reversal handling.
Never selects a disabled or inactive route, BIN range, or processing switch.
"""

import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.hsm_adapter import HSMAdapter, SoftHsmCryptoCore
from app.models import (
    BinRange,
    Card,
    Institution,
    NetworkProfile,
    PanRoutingRule,
    ProcessingSystem,
    Transaction,
)


def _clean_short_bank_code(code_or_short: Optional[str], fallback: str = "XBANK") -> str:
    raw = (code_or_short or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return fallback
    for sep in (" - ", " — ", " – ", "/"):
        if sep in raw:
            part = raw.split(sep)[0].strip()
            if part:
                return part.upper()
    return raw.upper()


class NetworkAdapter:
    """Base interface for payment network connectivity."""

    def __init__(self, db: Session, network_name: str):
        self.db = db
        self.network_name = network_name
        self.hsm = HSMAdapter(db)

    def route_transaction(self, request_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class SimulatedNetworkAdapter(NetworkAdapter):
    """
    Simulates external card payment switches (VisaNet, Mastercard Banknet, NPSB).
    Translates PIN blocks across cryptographic zones (AWK -> IWK) and handles
    simulation behaviors: Always Approve, Decline with configured RC, Timeout, and Unavailable.
    """

    def route_transaction(self, request_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        profile = (
            self.db.query(NetworkProfile)
            .filter(NetworkProfile.network_name == self.network_name)
            .first()
        )
        if profile and not profile.enabled:
            return {
                "network_status": "UNAVAILABLE",
                "response_code": "91",
                "response_message": f"External network adapter {self.network_name} is disabled (RC 91)",
                "requires_reversal": False,
                "translated_pin_block": None,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }

        sim_mode = getattr(profile, "simulation_mode", "ALWAYS_APPROVE") if profile else "ALWAYS_APPROVE"
        sim_rc = getattr(profile, "simulated_response_code", "00") if profile else "00"
        sim_delay = getattr(profile, "simulated_delay_ms", 0) if profile else 0

        if sim_delay > 0:
            time.sleep(min(sim_delay, 500) / 1000.0)

        pan = request_payload.get("pan", "")
        fields = request_payload.get("fields", {})
        pin_block = fields.get("52")
        awk_id = request_payload.get("source_key_id") or "AWK_ATM_01"
        iwk_id = request_payload.get("destination_key_id") or "IWK_SW_01"

        translated_pin_block = None
        if pin_block:
            trans_res = self.hsm.translate_pin_block(
                pan=pan,
                encrypted_pin_block=pin_block,
                awk_id=awk_id,
                iwk_id=iwk_id,
            )
            translated_pin_block = trans_res.get("sanitized_response", {}).get("destination_pin_block") or "F" * 16

        if sim_mode == "TIMEOUT":
            return {
                "network_status": "TIMEOUT",
                "response_code": "91",
                "response_message": f"{self.network_name} switch timeout (RC 91). Automatic reversal required.",
                "requires_reversal": True,
                "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }
        elif sim_mode == "UNAVAILABLE":
            return {
                "network_status": "UNAVAILABLE",
                "response_code": "91",
                "response_message": f"{self.network_name} switch link disconnected or inoperative (RC 91)",
                "requires_reversal": False,
                "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }
        elif sim_mode == "DECLINE_WITH_RC":
            return {
                "network_status": "DECLINED",
                "response_code": sim_rc,
                "response_message": f"Declined by external network {self.network_name} (RC {sim_rc})",
                "requires_reversal": False,
                "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
                "authorization_code": "000000",
            }

        return {
            "network_status": "APPROVED",
            "response_code": "00",
            "response_message": f"Approved by external network {self.network_name}",
            "requires_reversal": False,
            "translated_pin_block": translated_pin_block,
            "authorization_code": uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper(),
        }


def _resolve_dest_network_name(scheme: str, explicit_dest: Optional[str], is_on_us: bool) -> Optional[str]:
    if is_on_us:
        return None
    if explicit_dest and explicit_dest != "INTERNAL_SIMULATOR_TIC":
        return explicit_dest
    scheme_up = (scheme or "ITCL").upper()
    if "VISA" in scheme_up:
        return "VISA_SCHEME"
    if "MASTER" in scheme_up:
        return "MASTERCARD_SCHEME"
    if "NPSB" in scheme_up:
        return "NPSB_NATIONAL_SWITCH"
    return "INTERNAL_SIMULATOR_TIC"


def resolve_transaction_routing(
    db: Session,
    pan: str,
    acquirer_id: str = "123456",
    transaction_code: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Determines On-Us vs Off-Us status and selects the destination processing system or network adapter.
    Evaluation Order:
      1. Active PanRoutingRule records ordered by priority ASC, prefix length DESC.
         (Never selects disabled/inactive rules, inactive banks, or disabled switches.)
      2. Active BinRange records ordered by prefix length DESC (12..6) and range bounds.
         (Never selects inactive BIN ranges, inactive banks, or disabled switches.)
      3. Fallback to On-Us ITCL internal switch if no rule/BIN matches, or returns route_blocked=True
         if a matching BIN/route exists but its bank or switch is explicitly disabled.
    """
    clean_pan = "".join(ch for ch in (pan or "") if ch.isdigit())
    bin_prefix_6 = clean_pan[:6] if len(clean_pan) >= 6 else clean_pan
    pan_19 = clean_pan.ljust(19, "0")[:19]

    card_rec = db.query(Card).filter(Card.test_pan_reference == clean_pan).first() if clean_pan else None
    card_type_val = card_rec.card_type.upper() if (card_rec and card_rec.card_type) else None

    acq_inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.acquirer_id == str(acquirer_id).strip()).first()

    # 1. Evaluate Active PAN Routing Rules first
    try:
        active_rules = (
            db.query(PanRoutingRule)
            .filter(PanRoutingRule.enabled == True, PanRoutingRule.status == "ACTIVE")  # noqa: E712
            .order_by(PanRoutingRule.priority.asc())
            .all()
        )
    except Exception:
        active_rules = []

    blocked_reason: Optional[str] = None

    for rule in active_rules:
        pfx = rule.pan_prefix or ""
        low_19 = (rule.pan_low or pfx).ljust(19, "0")[:19]
        high_19 = (rule.pan_high or pfx).ljust(19, "9")[:19]

        if not (clean_pan.startswith(pfx) or (low_19 <= pan_19 <= high_19)):
            continue
        if rule.pan_length and len(clean_pan) >= 12 and len(clean_pan) != rule.pan_length:
            continue
        if rule.card_type and rule.card_type != "ANY" and card_type_val and rule.card_type.upper() != card_type_val:
            continue
        if rule.transaction_code and rule.transaction_code != "ANY" and transaction_code and rule.transaction_code != str(transaction_code):
            continue
        if rule.acquirer_institution_id and acq_inst and rule.acquirer_institution_id != acq_inst.id:
            continue

        iss = rule.issuer_institution
        ps = rule.processing_system
        if (iss and iss.status != "ACTIVE") or (ps and not ps.enabled):
            blocked_reason = (
                f"Route {rule.rule_code} matched PAN {bin_prefix_6}*, but target switch "
                f"({ps.ps_code if ps else 'N/A'}) or bank ({iss.institution_code if iss else 'N/A'}) is disabled."
            )
            continue

        dest_net = _resolve_dest_network_name(rule.scheme, rule.destination_network, rule.is_on_us)
        bank_short = _clean_short_bank_code(iss.short_name or iss.institution_code if iss else "XBANK")
        return {
            "matched_record": True,
            "route_blocked": False,
            "match_source": "PAN_ROUTER_RULE",
            "rule_id": rule.id,
            "rule_code": rule.rule_code,
            "rule_name": rule.rule_name,
            "priority": rule.priority,
            "is_on_us": rule.is_on_us,
            "routing_target": "ON_US_HOST" if rule.is_on_us else "EXTERNAL_NETWORK",
            "scheme": rule.scheme.upper(),
            "ps_code": ps.ps_code if ps else rule.scheme.upper(),
            "destination_network": dest_net,
            "bin_prefix": rule.pan_prefix,
            "institution_id": rule.issuer_institution_id,
            "card_type": rule.card_type or card_type_val or "DEBIT",
            "card_product": card_rec.card_product if card_rec else f"{rule.scheme}_ROUTED_CARD",
            "pin_translation_required": rule.pin_translation_required,
            "source_key_id": rule.source_key_id or "AWK_ATM_01",
            "destination_key_id": rule.destination_key_id or "IWK_SW_01",
            "institution": {
                "id": iss.id if iss else rule.issuer_institution_id,
                "code": bank_short,
                "name": iss.name if iss else bank_short,
                "acquirer_id": iss.acquirer_id if iss else acquirer_id,
            },
            "processing_system": {
                "id": ps.id if ps else rule.processing_system_id,
                "code": ps.ps_code if ps else rule.scheme.upper(),
                "name": ps.name if ps else rule.scheme.upper(),
            },
        }

    # 2. Evaluate Active BIN Ranges (longest prefix match 12..6, then range bounds)
    all_bins = db.query(BinRange).all()
    candidate_bins: List[BinRange] = []
    for b in all_bins:
        pfx = b.bin_prefix or ""
        low_19 = (b.bin_low or pfx).ljust(19, "0")[:19]
        high_19 = (b.bin_high or pfx).ljust(19, "9")[:19]
        if clean_pan.startswith(pfx) or (low_19 <= pan_19 <= high_19):
            candidate_bins.append(b)

    candidate_bins.sort(key=lambda x: len(x.bin_prefix or ""), reverse=True)

    for b in candidate_bins:
        iss = b.institution
        ps = b.processing_system
        if b.status != "ACTIVE":
            blocked_reason = f"BIN range {b.bin_prefix} is currently {b.status}."
            continue
        if iss and iss.status != "ACTIVE":
            blocked_reason = f"Issuing bank {iss.institution_code} for BIN {b.bin_prefix} is {iss.status}."
            continue
        if ps and not ps.enabled:
            blocked_reason = f"Processing switch {ps.ps_code} for BIN {b.bin_prefix} is DISABLED."
            continue

        dest_net = _resolve_dest_network_name(b.scheme, None, b.is_on_us)
        bank_short = _clean_short_bank_code(iss.short_name or iss.institution_code if iss else "XBANK")
        return {
            "matched_record": True,
            "route_blocked": False,
            "match_source": "BIN_RANGE",
            "rule_id": None,
            "rule_code": f"BIN-{b.bin_prefix}",
            "rule_name": f"BIN {b.bin_prefix} ({b.card_product})",
            "priority": 100,
            "is_on_us": b.is_on_us,
            "routing_target": "ON_US_HOST" if b.is_on_us else "EXTERNAL_NETWORK",
            "scheme": b.scheme.upper(),
            "ps_code": ps.ps_code if ps else b.scheme.upper(),
            "destination_network": dest_net,
            "bin_prefix": b.bin_prefix,
            "institution_id": b.institution_id,
            "card_type": b.card_type,
            "card_product": b.card_product,
            "pin_translation_required": not b.is_on_us,
            "source_key_id": "AWK_ATM_01",
            "destination_key_id": "IWK_SW_01",
            "institution": {
                "id": iss.id if iss else b.institution_id,
                "code": bank_short,
                "name": iss.name if iss else bank_short,
                "acquirer_id": iss.acquirer_id if iss else acquirer_id,
            },
            "processing_system": {
                "id": ps.id if ps else b.processing_system_id,
                "code": ps.ps_code if ps else "ITCL",
                "name": ps.name if ps else "ITCL Switch",
            },
        }

    if blocked_reason:
        return {
            "matched_record": False,
            "route_blocked": True,
            "match_source": "BLOCKED_ROUTE",
            "is_on_us": False,
            "routing_target": "ROUTE_DISABLED",
            "scheme": "ITCL",
            "ps_code": "ITCL",
            "destination_network": None,
            "bin_prefix": bin_prefix_6,
            "message": blocked_reason,
        }

    return {
        "matched_record": False,
        "route_blocked": False,
        "match_source": "DEFAULT_FALLBACK",
        "is_on_us": True,
        "routing_target": "INTERNAL_ITCL",
        "scheme": "ITCL",
        "ps_code": "ITCL",
        "destination_network": None,
        "bin_prefix": bin_prefix_6,
        "message": "No explicit rule or BIN range matched. Defaulting to On-Us ITCL switch.",
    }

"""
INSTITUTIONS ROUTER — Processing Systems, Member Banks, Network Links, BIN Ranges & PAN Router
Enterprise-grade validation, overlap detection, relational integrity checks, and audit trail logging.
"""

import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.audit_service import record_audit, serialize_entity
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import (
    Account,
    BinRange,
    Card,
    Customer,
    HsmKeyReference,
    Institution,
    InstitutionProcessingSystem,
    PanRoutingRule,
    ProcessingSystem,
    Transaction,
)
from app.schemas import (
    BinRangeCreate,
    BinRangeOut,
    BinRangeUpdate,
    InstitutionCreate,
    InstitutionOut,
    InstitutionProcessingSystemCreate,
    InstitutionProcessingSystemOut,
    InstitutionUpdate,
    PanRoutingRuleCreate,
    PanRoutingRuleOut,
    PanRoutingRuleUpdate,
    ProcessingSystemCreate,
    ProcessingSystemOut,
    ProcessingSystemUpdate,
)
from app.security import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["Institutions, Switches, BINs & PAN Router"])


def clean_bank_short_code(code_or_short: Optional[str], fallback: str = "XBANK") -> str:
    """
    Returns the clean bank short-code (e.g. BAL, TBL, IFIC, XBANK) without composite
    suffixes like 'BAL - IFIC' or 'TBL - IFIC'. Never alters the stored legal name.
    """
    raw = (code_or_short or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return fallback
    for sep in (" - ", " — ", " – ", "/"):
        if sep in raw:
            part = raw.split(sep)[0].strip()
            if part:
                return part.upper()
    return raw.upper()


# ==============================================================================
# 1. PROCESSING SYSTEMS (SWITCHES)
# ==============================================================================

@router.get("/processing-systems", response_model=List[ProcessingSystemOut])
def list_processing_systems(
    q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search by PS code, name, type, or format"),
    system_type: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    enabled: Optional[bool] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    query = db.query(ProcessingSystem)
    if q:
        term = f"%{q.strip()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            (ProcessingSystem.ps_code.ilike(term))
            | (ProcessingSystem.name.ilike(term))
            | (ProcessingSystem.system_type.ilike(term))
            | (ProcessingSystem.message_format.ilike(term))
        )
    if system_type:
        query = query.filter(ProcessingSystem.system_type == system_type.upper().strip())
    if enabled is not None:
        query = query.filter(ProcessingSystem.enabled == enabled)
    return query.order_by(ProcessingSystem.ps_code.asc()).all()


@router.get("/processing-systems/{ps_id}", response_model=ProcessingSystemOut)
def get_processing_system(ps_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
    if not ps:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Processing system not found")
    return ps


@router.post("/processing-systems", response_model=ProcessingSystemOut)
def create_processing_system(
    payload: ProcessingSystemCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    ps_code = payload.ps_code.strip().upper()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_\-]{2,30}", ps_code):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Processing switch code must be 2-30 alphanumeric characters")

    existing = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == ps_code).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Processing system '{ps_code}' already exists")

    if payload.is_default:
        db.query(ProcessingSystem).update({"is_default": False}, synchronize_session=False)

    ps = ProcessingSystem(
        ps_code=ps_code,
        name=payload.name.strip(),
        system_type=payload.system_type.strip().upper(),
        message_format=payload.message_format.strip().upper(),
        enabled=payload.enabled,
        is_default=payload.is_default,
        configuration=payload.configuration or {},
    )
    db.add(ps)
    db.flush()
    record_audit(
        db,
        "PROCESSING_SYSTEM",
        ps.id,
        "CREATE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        after_state=serialize_entity(ps),
        change_summary=f"Created processing switch {ps.ps_code} ({ps.name})",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ps)
    return ps


@router.put("/processing-systems/{ps_id}", response_model=ProcessingSystemOut)
def update_processing_system(
    ps_id: str,
    payload: ProcessingSystemUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
    if not ps:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Processing system not found")

    before = serialize_entity(ps)
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

    if data.get("enabled") is False and ps.is_default:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=f"Cannot disable the primary default switch ({ps.ps_code}). Promote another switch to default first.",
        )

    if data.get("is_default") is True:
        db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id != ps.id).update(
            {"is_default": False}, synchronize_session=False
        )

    for k, v in data.items():
        if isinstance(v, str) and k in ("system_type", "message_format"):
            setattr(ps, k, v.strip().upper())
        elif isinstance(v, str) and k == "name":
            setattr(ps, k, v.strip())
        else:
            setattr(ps, k, v)

    after = serialize_entity(ps)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "PROCESSING_SYSTEM",
        ps.id,
        "UPDATE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,
        change_summary=f"Updated processing switch {ps.ps_code}",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ps)
    return ps


@router.patch("/processing-systems/{ps_id}/toggle", response_model=ProcessingSystemOut)
def toggle_processing_system(
    ps_id: str,
    enabled: Optional[bool] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
    if not ps:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Processing system not found")

    next_state = (not ps.enabled) if enabled is None else bool(enabled)
    if not next_state and ps.is_default:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=f"Cannot disable primary default processing switch ({ps.ps_code}).",
        )

    before = serialize_entity(ps)
    ps.enabled = next_state
    after = serialize_entity(ps)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "PROCESSING_SYSTEM",
        ps.id,
        "STATUS_CHANGE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,
        change_summary=f"{'Enabled' if next_state else 'Disabled'} processing switch {ps.ps_code}",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ps)
    return ps


@router.delete("/processing-systems/{ps_id}")
def delete_processing_system(
    ps_id: str,
    deactivate_only: bool = Query(False),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
    if not ps:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Processing system not found")

    if ps.is_default:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=f"Cannot delete or deactivate the primary default processing switch ({ps.ps_code}).",
        )

    inst_count = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.processing_system_id == ps.id).count()
    bin_count = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.processing_system_id == ps.id).count()
    route_count = db.query(PanRoutingRule).filter(PanRoutingRule.processing_system_id == ps.id).count()
    tx_count = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.ps_code == ps.ps_code).count()

    if deactivate_only:
        before = serialize_entity(ps)
        ps.enabled = False
        record_audit(
            db,
            "PROCESSING_SYSTEM",
            ps.id,
            "DEACTIVATE",
            performed_by=current_user,
            before_state=before,
            after_state=serialize_entity(ps),
            change_summary=f"Deactivated processing switch {ps.ps_code}",
        )
        db.commit()
        return {
            "status": "deactivated",
            "ps_id": ps.id,
            "ps_code": ps.ps_code,
            "message": f"Processing switch {ps.ps_code} has been safely disabled.",
        }

    if inst_count > 0 or bin_count > 0 or route_count > 0 or tx_count > 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=(
                f"Cannot hard-delete processing switch '{ps.ps_code}' because it is referenced by "
                f"{inst_count} bank(s), {bin_count} BIN range(s), {route_count} PAN routing rule(s), "
                f"and {tx_count} historical transaction(s). Disable/deactivate the switch instead."
            ),
        )

    before = serialize_entity(ps)
    db.delete(ps)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "PROCESSING_SYSTEM",
        ps_id,
        "DELETE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        change_summary=f"Deleted processing switch {ps.ps_code}",
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "deleted", "ps_id": ps_id, "ps_code": ps.ps_code}


# ==============================================================================
# 2. INSTITUTIONS (MEMBER BANKS)
# ==============================================================================

def _serialize_institution(inst: Institution) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    short_clean = clean_bank_short_code(inst.short_name or inst.institution_code, inst.institution_code)
    code_clean = clean_bank_short_code(inst.institution_code, inst.institution_code)
    return {
        "id": inst.id,
        "institution_code": code_clean,
        "name": inst.name,
        "short_name": short_clean,
        "display_code": short_clean,
        "acquirer_id": inst.acquirer_id,
        "forwarding_id": inst.forwarding_id,
        "role": inst.role,
        "processing_system_id": inst.processing_system_id,
        "ps_code": inst.primary_processing_system.ps_code if inst.primary_processing_system else "ITCL",
        "ps_name": inst.primary_processing_system.name if inst.primary_processing_system else "ITCL Switch",
        "country_code": inst.country_code,
        "currency": inst.currency,
        "settlement_account_number": inst.settlement_account_number,
        "status": inst.status,
        "configuration": inst.configuration or {},
        "created_at": inst.created_at,
        "updated_at": inst.updated_at,
    }


@router.get("/institutions", response_model=List[InstitutionOut])
def list_institutions(
    q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search by bank code, short name, legal name, or DE32 acquirer ID"),
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    role: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    ps_code: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    query = db.query(Institution)
    if q:
        term = f"%{q.strip()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            (Institution.institution_code.ilike(term))
            | (Institution.short_name.ilike(term))
            | (Institution.name.ilike(term))
            | (Institution.acquirer_id.ilike(term))
        )
    if status:
        query = query.filter(Institution.status == status.upper().strip())
    if role:
        query = query.filter(Institution.role == role.upper().strip())
    if ps_code:
        ps_obj = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == ps_code.upper().strip()).first()
        if ps_obj:
            query = query.filter(Institution.processing_system_id == ps_obj.id)

    insts = query.order_by(Institution.institution_code.asc()).all()
    return [_serialize_institution(i) for i in insts]


@router.get("/institutions/{inst_id}", response_model=InstitutionOut)
def get_institution(inst_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == inst_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Institution not found")
    return _serialize_institution(inst)


@router.post("/institutions", response_model=InstitutionOut)
def create_institution(
    payload: InstitutionCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    icode = clean_bank_short_code(payload.institution_code)
    if not icode:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Institution code is required")

    existing = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == icode).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Institution '{icode}' already exists")

    ps_id = payload.processing_system_id
    if not ps_id:
        ps_code_target = (payload.ps_code or "ITCL").upper()
        ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == ps_code_target).first()
        if not ps:
            ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == "ITCL").first()
        if not ps:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Default ITCL processing system not found in database")
        ps_id = ps.id
    else:
        ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
        if not ps:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Specified processing system not found")

    short_val = clean_bank_short_code(payload.short_name or icode, icode)

    inst = Institution(
        institution_code=icode,
        name=payload.name.strip(),
        short_name=short_val,
        acquirer_id=payload.acquirer_id.strip(),
        forwarding_id=(payload.forwarding_id or payload.acquirer_id).strip(),
        role=payload.role.upper().strip(),
        processing_system_id=ps_id,
        country_code=payload.country_code.strip(),
        currency=payload.currency.upper().strip(),
        settlement_account_number=payload.settlement_account_number,
        status=payload.status.upper().strip(),
        configuration=payload.configuration or {},
    )
    db.add(inst)
    db.flush()

    link = InstitutionProcessingSystem(
        institution_id=inst.id,
        processing_system_id=ps.id,
        card_profile_id=getattr(payload, 'card_profile_id', None) or None,
        member_id=f"{ps.ps_code}-{icode}",
        acquirer_id=inst.acquirer_id,
        network_identifier=f"{ps.ps_code}_HOST",
        issuer_enabled=True,
        acquirer_enabled=True,
        message_format=ps.message_format,
        routing_configuration={"is_primary_host": True},
        status="ACTIVE",
    )
    db.add(link)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "INSTITUTION",
        inst.id,
        "CREATE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        after_state=serialize_entity(inst),
        change_summary=f"Created bank {inst.institution_code} ({inst.name})",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inst)
    return _serialize_institution(inst)


@router.put("/institutions/{inst_id}", response_model=InstitutionOut)
def update_institution(
    inst_id: str,
    payload: InstitutionUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == inst_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Institution not found")

    before = serialize_entity(inst)
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

    if "processing_system_id" in data and data["processing_system_id"]:
        ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == data["processing_system_id"]).first()
        if not ps:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Target processing switch not found")

    if "short_name" in data and data["short_name"] is not None:
        data["short_name"] = clean_bank_short_code(data["short_name"], inst.institution_code)

    for k, v in data.items():
        setattr(inst, k, v)

    after = serialize_entity(inst)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "INSTITUTION",
        inst.id,
        "UPDATE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,
        change_summary=f"Updated bank {inst.institution_code} ({inst.name})",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inst)
    return _serialize_institution(inst)

    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inst)

@router.delete("/institutions/{inst_id}")
def delete_institution(
    inst_id: str,
    deactivate_only: bool = Query(False),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == inst_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Institution not found")

    cust_count = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.institution_id == inst.id).count()
    acct_count = db.query(Account).filter(Account.institution_id == inst.id).count()
    card_count = db.query(Card).filter(Card.institution_id == inst.id).count()
    bin_count = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.institution_id == inst.id).count()
    route_count = db.query(PanRoutingRule).filter(
        (PanRoutingRule.issuer_institution_id == inst.id)
        | (PanRoutingRule.acquirer_institution_id == inst.id)
    ).count()
    tx_count = db.query(Transaction).filter(
        (Transaction.issuer_institution_id == inst.id)
        | (Transaction.acquirer_institution_id == inst.id)
    ).count()

    if deactivate_only:
        before = serialize_entity(inst)
        inst.status = "INACTIVE"
        record_audit(
            db,
            "INSTITUTION",
            inst.id,
            "DEACTIVATE",
            performed_by=current_user,
            before_state=before,
            after_state=serialize_entity(inst),
            change_summary=f"Deactivated bank {inst.institution_code} to preserve relational history",
        )
        db.commit()
        return {
            "status": "deactivated",
            "institution_id": inst.id,
            "institution_code": inst.institution_code,
            "message": f"Bank {inst.institution_code} deactivated safely.",
        }

    if any(cnt > 0 for cnt in (cust_count, acct_count, card_count, bin_count, route_count, tx_count)):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=(
                f"Cannot hard-delete bank '{inst.institution_code}' because it has active/historical dependencies: "
                f"{cust_count} customer(s), {acct_count} account(s), {card_count} card(s), "
                f"{bin_count} BIN range(s), {route_count} PAN routing rule(s), and {tx_count} transaction(s). "
                f"Deactivate the bank instead to preserve historical and relational integrity."
            ),
        )

    before = serialize_entity(inst)
    db.delete(inst)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "INSTITUTION",
        inst_id,
        "DELETE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        change_summary=f"Deleted bank {inst.institution_code}",
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "deleted", "institution_id": inst_id, "institution_code": inst.institution_code}

            "effective_from": l.effective_from,
            "effective_to": l.effective_to,

    db.refresh(link)

        "id": link.id,
        "institution_id": link.institution_id,
        "institution_code": clean_bank_short_code(inst.short_name or inst.institution_code),
        "institution_name": inst.name,
        "processing_system_id": link.processing_system_id,
        "ps_code": ps.ps_code,
        "ps_name": ps.name,
        "member_id": link.member_id,
        "acquirer_id": link.acquirer_id,
        "network_identifier": link.network_identifier,
        "issuer_enabled": link.issuer_enabled,
        "acquirer_enabled": link.acquirer_enabled,
        "message_format": link.message_format,
        "routing_configuration": link.routing_configuration,
        "status": link.status,
        "effective_from": link.effective_from,
        "effective_to": link.effective_to,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
        "updated_at": link.updated_at,
    }

# ==============================================================================
# 4. BIN RANGES (WITH BOUNDARY & OVERLAP VALIDATION)
# ==============================================================================

def _normalize_range_bounds(prefix: str, low_in: Optional[str], high_in: Optional[str], pan_len: int = 16) -> tuple[str, str]:
    clean_pfx = re.sub(r"\D", "", prefix or "")
    if len(clean_pfx) < 6 or len(clean_pfx) > 12:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="BIN/IIN prefix must be between 6 and 12 numeric digits")
    if pan_len < 12 or pan_len > 19:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PAN length must be between 12 and 19 digits")

    low_raw = re.sub(r"\D", "", low_in) if low_in else clean_pfx.ljust(pan_len, "0")
    high_raw = re.sub(r"\D", "", high_in) if high_in else clean_pfx.ljust(pan_len, "9")

    low_norm = low_raw.ljust(19, "0")[:19]
    high_norm = high_raw.ljust(19, "9")[:19]

    if low_norm > high_norm:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Invalid BIN range boundaries: bin_low ({low_raw}) cannot be greater than bin_high ({high_raw})",
        )
    return low_raw, high_raw


def _check_bin_overlap(
    db: Session,
    prefix: str,
    low_raw: str,
    high_raw: str,
    exclude_bin_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> None:
    low_19 = low_raw.ljust(19, "0")[:19]
    high_19 = high_raw.ljust(19, "9")[:19]

    query = db.query(BinRange)
    if exclude_bin_id:
        query = query.filter(BinRange.id != exclude_bin_id)

    for existing in query.all():
        if existing.bin_prefix == prefix:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail=f"Duplicate BIN prefix '{prefix}' already exists (assigned to {existing.institution.institution_code if existing.institution else 'another bank'}).",
            )
        ex_low = (existing.bin_low or existing.bin_prefix).ljust(19, "0")[:19]
        ex_high = (existing.bin_high or existing.bin_prefix).ljust(19, "9")[:19]
        if not (high_19 < ex_low or low_19 > ex_high):
            bank_label = clean_bank_short_code(
                existing.institution.short_name or existing.institution.institution_code
                if existing.institution else "UNKNOWN"
            )
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail=(
                    f"Overlapping BIN range detected: [{low_raw} .. {high_raw}] conflicts with existing "
                    f"BIN {existing.bin_prefix} [{existing.bin_low} .. {existing.bin_high}] owned by {bank_label}."
                ),
            )


def _serialize_bin(b: BinRange) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    bank_short = clean_bank_short_code(
        b.institution.short_name or b.institution.institution_code if b.institution else None,
        "XBANK",
    )
    return {
        "id": b.id,
        "bin_prefix": b.bin_prefix,
        "bin_low": b.bin_low,
        "bin_high": b.bin_high,
        "pan_length": b.pan_length,
        "institution_id": b.institution_id,
        "institution_code": bank_short,
        "institution_name": b.institution.name if b.institution else None,
        "processing_system_id": b.processing_system_id,
        "ps_code": b.processing_system.ps_code if b.processing_system else None,
        "ps_name": b.processing_system.name if b.processing_system else None,
        "card_type": b.card_type,
        "card_product": b.card_product,
        "scheme": b.scheme,
        "country_code": b.country_code,
        "currency": b.currency,
        # [PATCH step13_03:bins_include_card_profile]
        "card_profile_id": getattr(b, "card_profile_id", None),
        "card_profile_code": b.card_profile.profile_code if getattr(b, "card_profile", None) else None,
        "card_profile_name": b.card_profile.profile_name if getattr(b, "card_profile", None) else None,
        "is_on_us": b.is_on_us,
        "status": b.status,
        "created_at": b.created_at,
        "updated_at": b.updated_at,
    }


@router.get("/bin-ranges", response_model=List[BinRangeOut])
def list_bin_ranges(
    q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search by BIN prefix, product, bank, or scheme"),
    institution_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    card_type: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    scheme: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    query = db.query(BinRange)
    if institution_id:
        query = query.filter(BinRange.institution_id == institution_id)
    if card_type:
        query = query.filter(BinRange.card_type == card_type.upper().strip())
    if scheme:
        query = query.filter(BinRange.scheme == scheme.upper().strip())
    if status:
        query = query.filter(BinRange.status == status.upper().strip())

    bins = query.order_by(BinRange.bin_prefix.asc()).all()
    serialized = [_serialize_bin(b) for b in bins]
    if q:
        term = q.strip().lower()
        serialized = [
            item for item in serialized
            if term in (item["bin_prefix"] or "").lower()
            or term in (item["card_product"] or "").lower()
            or term in (item["institution_code"] or "").lower()
            or term in (item["institution_name"] or "").lower()
            or term in (item["scheme"] or "").lower()
            or term in (item["ps_code"] or "").lower()
        ]
    return serialized


@router.get("/bin-ranges/lookup/{pan}")
def lookup_bin_for_pan(
    pan: str,
    acquirer_id: Optional[str] = Query("123456"),
    transaction_code: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    from app.network_adapter import resolve_transaction_routing

    clean_pan = "".join(ch for ch in pan if ch.isdigit())
    if len(clean_pan) < 6:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PAN is too short for BIN lookup (minimum 6 numeric digits)")

    routing = resolve_transaction_routing(db, clean_pan, acquirer_id or "123456", transaction_code=transaction_code)
    if not routing.get("matched_record"):
        return {
            "found": False,
            "pan_masked": clean_pan[:6] + "*" * max(0, len(clean_pan) - 10) + clean_pan[-4:] if len(clean_pan) >= 10 else "****",
            "message": routing.get("message") or "No active BIN range or PAN routing rule matched. Defaulting to On-Us ITCL switch.",
            "routing": routing,
        }

    return {
        "found": True,
        "match_source": routing.get("match_source", "BIN_RANGE"),
        "rule_code": routing.get("rule_code"),
        "bin_prefix": routing["bin_prefix"],
        "institution": routing["institution"],
        "processing_system": routing["processing_system"],
        "card_product": routing["card_product"],
        "card_type": routing.get("card_type", "DEBIT"),
        "scheme": routing["scheme"],
        "is_on_us": routing["is_on_us"],
        "destination_network": routing.get("destination_network"),
        "routing": routing,
    }


@router.post("/bin-ranges", response_model=BinRangeOut)
def create_bin_range(
    payload: BinRangeCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    prefix = re.sub(r"\D", "", payload.bin_prefix.strip())
    low_raw, high_raw = _normalize_range_bounds(prefix, payload.bin_low, payload.bin_high, payload.pan_length)

    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == payload.institution_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Owning institution (bank) not found")

    ps_id = payload.processing_system_id or inst.processing_system_id
    ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
    if not ps:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Processing switch not found")

    _check_bin_overlap(db, prefix, low_raw, high_raw)

    b = BinRange(
        bin_prefix=prefix,
        bin_low=low_raw,
        bin_high=high_raw,
        pan_length=payload.pan_length,
        institution_id=inst.id,
        processing_system_id=ps.id,
        card_type=payload.card_type.upper().strip(),
        card_product=payload.card_product.strip(),
        scheme=payload.scheme.upper().strip(),
        country_code=payload.country_code.strip(),
        currency=payload.currency.upper().strip(),
        is_on_us=payload.is_on_us,
        status=payload.status.upper().strip(),
    )
    db.add(b)
    db.flush()
    record_audit(
        db,
        "BIN_RANGE",
        b.id,
        "CREATE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        after_state=serialize_entity(b),
        change_summary=f"Created BIN range {b.bin_prefix} for {inst.institution_code}",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(b)
    return _serialize_bin(b)


@router.put("/bin-ranges/{bin_id}", response_model=BinRangeOut)
def update_bin_range(
    bin_id: str,
    payload: BinRangeUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    b = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.id == bin_id).first()
    if not b:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BIN range not found")

    before = serialize_entity(b)
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

    new_prefix = re.sub(r"\D", "", data.get("bin_prefix", b.bin_prefix))
    new_len = int(data.get("pan_length", b.pan_length))
    new_low_in = data.get("bin_low", b.bin_low if "bin_prefix" not in data else None)
    new_high_in = data.get("bin_high", b.bin_high if "bin_prefix" not in data else None)

    low_raw, high_raw = _normalize_range_bounds(new_prefix, new_low_in, new_high_in, new_len)
    _check_bin_overlap(db, new_prefix, low_raw, high_raw, exclude_bin_id=b.id)

    if "institution_id" in data and data["institution_id"]:
        inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == data["institution_id"]).first()
        if not inst:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Referenced institution not found")

    if "processing_system_id" in data and data["processing_system_id"]:
        ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == data["processing_system_id"]).first()
        if not ps:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Referenced processing system not found")

    b.bin_prefix = new_prefix
    b.bin_low = low_raw
    b.bin_high = high_raw
    b.pan_length = new_len

    if "card_profile_id" in data:
        b.card_profile_id = data["card_profile_id"] or None

    for k in ("institution_id", "processing_system_id", "card_type", "card_product", "scheme", "country_code", "currency", "is_on_us", "status"):
        if k in data and data[k] is not None:
            val = data[k]
            if isinstance(val, str) and k in ("card_type", "scheme", "currency", "status"):
                val = val.upper().strip()
            setattr(b, k, val)

    after = serialize_entity(b)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "BIN_RANGE",
        b.id,
        "UPDATE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,
        change_summary=f"Updated BIN range {b.bin_prefix}",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(b)
    return _serialize_bin(b)


@router.patch("/bin-ranges/{bin_id}/status", response_model=BinRangeOut)
def toggle_bin_range_status(
    bin_id: str,
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    b = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.id == bin_id).first()
    if not b:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BIN range not found")
    before = serialize_entity(b)
    next_status = status.upper().strip() if status else ("INACTIVE" if b.status == "ACTIVE" else "ACTIVE")
    b.status = next_status
    after = serialize_entity(b)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "BIN_RANGE",
        b.id,
        "STATUS_CHANGE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,

    )
    db.commit()

@router.delete("/bin-ranges/{bin_id}")
def delete_bin_range(
    bin_id: str,
    deactivate_only: bool = Query(False),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    b = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.id == bin_id).first()
    if not b:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BIN range not found")

    matching_cards = db.query(Card).filter(Card.test_pan_reference.startswith(b.bin_prefix)).count()
    if deactivate_only:
        before = serialize_entity(b)
        b.status = "INACTIVE"
        record_audit(
            db,
            "BIN_RANGE",
            b.id,
            "DEACTIVATE",
            performed_by=current_user,
            before_state=before,
            after_state=serialize_entity(b),
            change_summary=f"Deactivated BIN range {b.bin_prefix}",
        )
        db.commit()
        return {"status": "deactivated", "bin_id": b.id, "bin_prefix": b.bin_prefix}

    if matching_cards > 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=(
                f"Cannot hard-delete BIN range '{b.bin_prefix}' because {matching_cards} issued card(s) "
                f"belong to this BIN prefix. Disable/deactivate the BIN range instead."
            ),
        )

    before = serialize_entity(b)
    db.delete(b)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "BIN_RANGE",
        bin_id,
        "DELETE",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        change_summary=f"Deleted BIN range {b.bin_prefix}",
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "deleted", "bin_id": bin_id, "bin_prefix": b.bin_prefix}


# ==============================================================================
# 5. PAN ROUTER RULES MANAGEMENT (WITH PRIORITY & CONFLICT VALIDATION)
