import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 7: CONFIGURABLE TRANSACTION CODES (Code 10, 20, 30, 40 & Custom)
// ============================================================================
export const TransactionCodesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [savedMsg, setSavedMsg] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    const list = await apiFetch('/transaction-codes');
    setCodes(list);
    if (!selected && list.length > 0) setSelected(list[0]);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selected) return;
    await apiFetch('/transaction-codes', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(selected),
    });
    setSavedMsg(`Saved configuration for Transaction Code ${selected.transaction_code}`);
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Configurable Transaction Codes (Codes 10, 20, 30, 40 & Custom)</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Define what each transaction code means, which MTI/processing code it uses, and which HSM & host checks execute
        </p>
      </div>

      {savedMsg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 text-xs font-mono">
          {savedMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Defined Codes</h2>
            <button
              onClick={() =>
                setSelected({
                  transaction_code: '50',
                  transaction_name: 'New Configurable Transaction',
                  description: 'Custom operator-defined rule set',
                  transaction_category: 'FINANCIAL',
                  processing_code: '0500000',
                  default_mti: '0200',
                  financial_flag: true,
                  balance_inquiry_flag: false,
                  debit_flag: true,
                  credit_flag: false,
                  reversal_allowed: true,
                  pin_required: true,
                  cvv_required: false,
                  pvv_required: true,
                  emv_required: false,
                  mac_required: false,
                  account_check_required: true,
                  card_check_required: true,
                  limit_check_required: true,
                  active: true,
                })
              }
              className="text-xs bg-emerald-600 text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded font-semibold"
            >
              + New Code
            </button>
          </div>
          {codes.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              onClick={() => setSelected(c)}
              className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-lg border transition ${
                selected?.transaction_code === c.transaction_code
                  ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10'
                  : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-mono text-xs font-bold">
                <span className="text-emerald-500">CODE {c.transaction_code}</span>
                <span>MTI {c.default_mti}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs font-medium mt-1">{c.transaction_name}</div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {selected && (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSave}
            className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Transaction Code</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.transaction_code}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, transaction_code: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Transaction Name (Operator Defined)</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.transaction_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, transaction_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Default MTI</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.default_mti}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, default_mti: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Processing Code (7-char TIC F3)</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.processing_code}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, processing_code: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Category</label>
                <input
                  value={selected.transaction_category}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, transaction_category: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-slate-400 mb-2">
                Authorization & HSM Verification Flags
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
                {[
                  ['financial_flag', 'Financial Posting'],
                  ['debit_flag', 'Debit Account'],
                  ['credit_flag', 'Credit Account'],
                  ['balance_inquiry_flag', 'Balance Inquiry'],
                  ['reversal_allowed', 'Reversal Allowed'],
                  ['pin_required', 'HSM PIN Check'],
                  ['pvv_required', 'HSM PVV Check'],
                  ['cvv_required', 'HSM CVV Check'],
                  ['emv_required', 'HSM EMV ARQC'],
                  ['mac_required', 'HSM MAC Check'],
                  ['card_check_required', 'Card Status/Exp'],
                  ['account_check_required', 'Account Status'],
                  ['limit_check_required', 'Card/Acct Limits'],
                  ['active', 'Code Active'],
                ].map(([key, label]) => (
                  <label key={key} className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={Boolean(selected[key])}
                      onChange={(e) => setSelected({ ...selected, [key]: e.target.checked })}
                      className="rounded border-slate-600 text-emerald-600"
                    />
                    <span>{label}</span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs"
            >
              Save Transaction Code Rules
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 14: HOST CONFIGURATION (RAJON Parameters)
// ============================================================================
export const HostConfigurationPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [params, setParams] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const load = async () => setParams(await apiFetch('/host-parameters'));
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const toggleParam = async (p: any) => {
    const currentEnabled = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? true;
    const updatedValue = { ...p.parameter_value, enabled: !currentEnabled };
    await apiFetch(`/host-parameters/${p.id}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ parameter_value: updatedValue, active: !currentEnabled }),
    });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Rajon Host Authorization Configuration</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Enable or disable central authorization engine rules (`AUTHORIZEACCTBALANCESTRANS`, `CHECKCARDLIMITS`, `CHECKACCT2CARDLIMITS`)
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
              <th className="py-2.5">Group</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Parameter Name</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Value / Order</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Description</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
            {params.map((p) => {
              const isEnabled = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? p.active;
              return (
                <tr key={p.id}>
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-slate-400">{p.parameter_group}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-500">{p.parameter_name}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">{JSON.stringify(p.parameter_value)}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-sans">{p.description}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        isEnabled ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isEnabled ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => toggleParam(p)}
                      className="text-sky-500 hover:underline text-[11px]"
                    >
                      Toggle Rule
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 15: RESPONSE CODE MANAGEMENT
// ============================================================================
export const ResponseCodesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    response_code: '',
    response_description: '',
    response_category: 'DECLINE',
    approved_flag: false,
  });

  const load = async () => setCodes(await apiFetch('/response-codes'));
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await apiFetch('/response-codes', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(form) });
    setForm({ response_code: '', response_description: '', response_category: 'DECLINE', approved_flag: false });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Response Code Mapping</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Manage TIC DE39 response codes and approval flags</p>
      </div>

      <form
        onSubmit={handleSave}
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3"
      >
        <input
          value={form.response_code}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, response_code: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="2-Char Code (e.g. 59)"
          maxLength={2}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          required
        />
        <input
          value={form.response_description}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, response_description: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Description"
          className="md:col-span-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs"
          required
        />
        <select
          value={form.response_category}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setForm({
              ...form,
              response_category: e.target.value,
              approved_flag: e.target.value === 'APPROVAL',
            })
          }
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
        >
          <option value="DECLINE">DECLINE</option>
          <option value="APPROVAL">APPROVAL</option>
          <option value="ERROR">ERROR</option>
        </select>
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
        >
          + Upsert Code
        </button>
      </form>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
              <th className="py-2">DE39 Code</th>
              <th className="py-2">TIC F39 (5-Char)</th>
              <th className="py-2">Description</th>
              <th className="py-2">Category</th>
              <th className="py-2">Approved Flag</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
            {codes.map((c) => (
              <tr key={c.id}>
                <td className="py-2 font-bold text-emerald-500">{c.response_code}</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-slate-400">000{c.response_code}</td>
                <td className="py-2 font-sans">{c.response_description}</td>
                <td className="py-2">{c.response_category}</td>
                <td className="py-2">{c.approved_flag ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

// PAGE 11: HOST KEY MANAGEMENT

export const HostKeyManagementPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<any[]>([]);
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_inst_state]
  const [institutions, setInstitutions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    key_name: '',
    key_type: 'ZPK',
    key_usage: 'PIN_ENCRYPTION',
    key_identifier: `KEY_${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`,
    kvc: 'A1B2C3',
    algorithm: '3DES_2KEY',
    key_length: 128,
    hsm_key_reference: 'LMK_PROTECTED_SLOT_REF',
    key_status: 'ACTIVE',
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_inst_form_field]
    institution_id: '',
  });

// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_load_inst]
  const load = async () => {
    const [kList, iList] = await Promise.all([apiFetch('/hsm/keys'), apiFetch('/institutions')]);
    setKeys(kList);
    setInstitutions(iList);
    if (!form.institution_id && iList.length > 0) {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, institution_id: iList[0].id }));
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await apiFetch('/hsm/keys', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(form) });
    load();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Host Cryptographic Key Management</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Register key references and KVC metadata for ZMK, ZPK, TMK, AWK, IWK, PVK, CVK, TAK, and MK-AC (clear keys remain inside the Soft-HSM boundary)
        </p>
      </div>

      <form
        onSubmit={handleRegister}
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3"
      >
        <input
          value={form.key_identifier}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, key_identifier: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Key Identifier"
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          required
        />
        <input
          value={form.key_name}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, key_name: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Key Name / Description"
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs"
          required
        />
        <select
          value={form.key_type}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, key_type: e.target.value })}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
        >
          {['ZMK', 'TMK', 'ZPK', 'AWK', 'IWK', 'PVK', 'CVK', 'TAK', 'MK-AC'].map((t) => (
            <option key={t} value={t}>
              {t}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_inst_dropdown]
        <select
          value={form.institution_id}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, institution_id: e.target.value })}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
        >
          <option value="">System Key (ITCL Switch)</option>
          {institutions.map((i) => (
            <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.institution_code} — {i.short_name || i.name}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <input
          value={form.kvc}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, kvc: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
          placeholder="6-Hex KVC"
          maxLength={6}
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          required
        />
        <input
          value={form.hsm_key_reference}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, hsm_key_reference: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Protected HSM Slot / LMK Cryptogram Ref"
          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          required
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
        >
          + Register Key Ref
        </button>
      </form>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
              <th className="py-2.5">Key Identifier</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Name</th>
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_table_inst_th]
              <th className="py-2.5">Owning Bank / Switch</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Type / Usage</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Algorithm</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">KVC</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Protected HSM Reference</th>
              <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
            {keys.map((k) => (
              <tr key={k.id}>
                <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-500">{k.key_identifier}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5 font-sans">{k.key_name}</td>
// [PATCH step02_02:hsm_key_table_inst_td]
                <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-400 font-bold">{k.institution_code || "ITCL SWITCH"}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  {k.key_type} ({k.key_usage})
                </td>
                <td className="py-2.5">
                  {k.algorithm} ({k.key_length}-bit)
                </td>
                <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-amber-500">{k.kvc}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-400">{k.hsm_key_reference}</td>
                <td className="py-2.5">{k.key_status}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const HSM_OPS = [
  { id: 'PIN_VERIFY', label: 'PIN & Visa PVV Verify (Thales DC/DD)', defaultKey: 'PVK_VISA_01' },
  { id: 'PIN_TRANSLATE', label: 'PIN Block Translate AWK ➔ IWK (Thales CA/CB)', defaultKey: 'AWK_ATM_01' },
  { id: 'CVV_VERIFY', label: 'CVV / CVC Verification (Thales CY/CZ)', defaultKey: 'CVK_MAIN_01' },
  { id: 'MAC_GENERATE', label: 'Retail MAC Generate (Thales M6/M7)', defaultKey: 'TAK_MAC_01' },
  { id: 'MAC_VERIFY', label: 'Retail MAC Verify (Thales M8/M9)', defaultKey: 'TAK_MAC_01' },
  { id: 'ARQC_VERIFY', label: 'EMV DE55 ARQC Verify & ARPC Gen (Thales KQ/KR)', defaultKey: 'MK_AC_EMV01' },
  { id: 'KEY_CHECK', label: 'Key Check Value / KVC Verify (Thales BU/BV)', defaultKey: 'ZMK_MAIN' },
];

export const HsmWorkbenchPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [selectedOp, setSelectedOp] = useState(HSM_OPS[0]);
  const [pan, setPan] = useState('4567890123450001');
  const [clearPinHelper, setClearPinHelper] = useState('1234');
  const [pvv, setPvv] = useState('0416');
  const [cvv, setCvv] = useState('011');
  const [dataHex, setDataHex] = useState('48656C6C6F20576F726C64');
  const [de55Hex, setDe55Hex] = useState(
    '9F02060000000050009F03060000000000009F1A020050950500000080005F2A0200509A032610209C01009F370411223344820219809F360200459F2608A1B2C3D4E5F601025F340101'
  );
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);

  const runOperation = async () => {
    const res = await apiFetch('/hsm/workbench/execute', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        operation: selectedOp.id,
        key_identifier: selectedOp.defaultKey,
        secondary_key_identifier: 'IWK_SW_01',
        pan,
        clear_pin_for_test_packing: clearPinHelper,
        pvv_or_offset: pvv,
        cvv,
        data_hex: dataHex,
        de55_hex: de55Hex,
      }),
    });
    setResult(res);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">HSM Cryptographic Operation Workbench</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Interactive server-side test bench for Thales payShield 10K Soft-HSM commands (no clear PINs or keys exposed)
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-2">Supported HSM Operations</h2>
          {HSM_OPS.map((op) => (
            <button
              key={op.id}
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedOp(op);
                setResult(null);
              }}
              className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono transition ${
                selectedOp.id === op.id
                  ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 font-bold'
                  : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
              }`}
            >
              <div>{op.label}</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Default Key: {op.defaultKey}</div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-500">{selectedOp.label}</h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Synthetic Card PAN</label>
              <input
                value={pan}
                onChange={(e) => setPan(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Server Test PIN (Packed under AWK)</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                value={clearPinHelper}
                onChange={(e) => setClearPinHelper(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Expected PVV / CVV</label>
              <input
                value={selectedOp.id === 'CVV_VERIFY' ? cvv : pvv}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  selectedOp.id === 'CVV_VERIFY' ? setCvv(e.target.value) : setPvv(e.target.value)
                }
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {selectedOp.id.includes('ARQC') && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">
                DE55 EMV TLV Hex Payload
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                value={de55Hex}
                onChange={(e) => setDe55Hex(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 text-emerald-300 border border-slate-800 rounded p-2.5 text-xs font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={runOperation}
            className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono"
          >
            Execute HSM Command ➔
          </button>

          {result && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Audit Reference: {result.audit_reference}</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                  Status: {result.status} (Error Code: {result.error_code}) · {result.duration_ms} ms
                </span>
              </div>
              <pre className="text-sky-300 overflow-x-auto pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
                {JSON.stringify(
                  {
                    key_identifier: result.key_identifier,
                    kvc: result.kvc,
                    sanitized_request: result.sanitized_request,
                    sanitized_response: result.sanitized_response,
                  },
                  null,
                  2
                )}
              </pre>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 13: HOST EXECUTION MONITOR (5 Tabs + Live Polling / WebSocket)
// ============================================================================
export const HostExecutionMonitorPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'TX' | 'HSM' | 'SYS' | 'MSG' | 'DB'>('TX');
  const [traces, setTraces] = useState<any>(null);
  const [live, setLive] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/monitor/traces');
      setTraces(res);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    if (!live) return;
    const timer = setInterval(load, 2500);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [live]);

  const exportCsv = () => {
    if (!traces) return;
    const rows = (traces.system_logs || []).map(
      (l: any) => `"${l.created_at}","${l.severity}","${l.component}","${l.event_name}","${l.message}"`
    );
    const blob = new Blob([['Timestamp,Severity,Component,Event,Message', ...rows].join('\n')], {
      type: 'text/csv',
    });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'rajon_host_execution_logs.csv';
    a.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Host Execution Monitor</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Real-time background trace of transaction checks, HSM commands, wire messages, and database operations
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Filter traces..."
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono"
          />
          <button
            onClick={() => setLive(!live)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold ${
              live ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-amber-600 text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {live ? <Pause size={13} /> : <Play size={13} />}
            {live ? 'LIVE STREAM ON' : 'PAUSED'}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={exportCsv}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-mono"
          >
            <Download size={13} /> Export CSV
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5 Monitor Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        {[
          ['TX', 'A. Transaction Trace'],
          ['HSM', 'B. HSM Trace'],
          ['SYS', 'C. Host System Log'],
          ['MSG', 'D. Message Trace'],
          ['DB', 'E. Database Activity'],
        ].map(([k, label]) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k as any)}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
              tab === k
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 text-xs font-mono text-slate-200 max-h-[540px] overflow-y-auto space-y-2">
        {tab === 'TX' &&
          (traces?.transaction_checks || [])
            .filter((c: any) => JSON.stringify(c).toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
            .map((c: any) => (
              <div key={c.id} className="p-2.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 flex justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">[Step #{c.check_order} {c.check_name}]</span>{' '}
                  {c.message}
                </div>
                <span className="text-amber-400">
                  {c.check_status} (RC {c.response_code}) · {c.duration_ms}ms
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}

        {tab === 'HSM' &&
          (traces?.hsm_traces || [])
            .filter((h: any) => JSON.stringify(h).toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
            .map((h: any) => (
              <div key={h.id} className="p-3 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">
                    {h.operation_type} — Ref: {h.request_reference}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-emerald-400">
                    {h.response_status} (EC {h.error_code}) · {h.duration_ms}ms
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-slate-400">
                  Req: {JSON.stringify(h.sanitized_request)} | Resp: {JSON.stringify(h.sanitized_response)}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

        {tab === 'SYS' &&
          (traces?.system_logs || [])
            .filter((l: any) => JSON.stringify(l).toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
            .map((l: any) => (
              <div key={l.id} className="p-2.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 flex justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-sky-400">[{l.severity}]</span>{' '}
                  <span className="text-emerald-400">{l.component}.{l.event_name}:</span> {l.message}
                </div>
                <span className="text-slate-500">{new Date(l.created_at).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
              </div>
            ))}

        {tab === 'MSG' &&
          (traces?.message_traces || []).map((m: any) => (
            <div key={m.id} className="p-3 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
              <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                [{m.message_type} · MTI {m.mti} · Format {m.message_format}]
              </div>
              <div className="break-all text-amber-200">{m.sanitized_message}</div>
            </div>
          ))}

        {tab === 'DB' &&
          (traces?.transaction_checks || [])
            .filter((c: any) =>
              ['Lookup', 'Selection', 'Limit', 'Balance', 'Ledger'].some((k) => c.check_name.includes(k))
            )
            .map((c: any) => (
              <div key={c.id} className="p-2.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 flex justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-indigo-400 font-bold">[DB OPERATION: {c.check_name}]</span>{' '}
                  {c.message}
                </div>
                <span className="text-emerald-400">{c.check_status}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const SystemLogsPage: React.FC = () => {

                <td className="py-2">{new Date(l.created_at).toLocaleString()}</td>

                <td className="py-2">{l.component}</td>
                <td className="py-2">{l.event_name}</td>

export const NotificationsSimulatorPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [traces, setTraces] = useState<any>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch('/monitor/traces').then(setTraces).catch(console.error);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Customer Notifications Simulator</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Simulated SMS and alert dispatches generated after host authorization decisions
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3">
        {(traces?.notifications || []).map((n: any) => (
          <div
            key={n.id}
            className="p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center text-xs font-mono"
          >
            <div>
              <div className="text-emerald-500 font-bold">
                [{n.notification_type}] To: {n.recipient_masked}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 font-sans">{n.message_template}</div>
            </div>
            <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 text-[10px] font-bold">
              {n.delivery_status}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
        {(traces?.notifications || []).length === 0 && (
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 py-6 text-center">
            Submit a transaction in the Transaction Simulator to generate simulated SMS alerts.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { CardProfilesUnderBinTab } from './CardProfilesUnderBinTab';
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Landmark,
  Cpu,
  Network,
  CreditCard,
  Sliders,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit3,
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  Power,
  PowerOff,
  AlertTriangle,
  RefreshCw,
  X,
  Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const InstitutionsAndBinsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'INST' | 'PS' | 'BINS' | 'CARD_PROFILES' | 'PAN_ROUTER' | 'NET'>('INST');
  const [institutions, setInstitutions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processingSystems, setProcessingSystems] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [bins, setBins] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [panRules, setPanRules] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [lookupPan, setLookupPan] = useState('4567890123450001');
  const [lookupAcq, setLookupAcq] = useState('123456');
  const [lookupResult, setLookupResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Search filters per tab
  const [searchInst, setSearchInst] = useState('');
  const [searchPs, setSearchPs] = useState('');
  const [searchBin, setSearchBin] = useState('');
  const [searchRule, setSearchRule] = useState('');

  // Modals state
  const [editInstModal, setEditInstModal] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [editPsModal, setEditPsModal] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [editBinModal, setEditBinModal] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [editRuleModal, setEditRuleModal] = useState<any | null>(null);

  // Creation forms
  const [instForm, setInstForm] = useState({
    institution_code: 'IFIC',
    name: 'IFIC Bank PLC',
    short_name: 'IFIC',
    acquirer_id: '554433',
    forwarding_id: '554433',
    role: 'BOTH',
    ps_code: 'ITCL',
    country_code: '050',
    currency: 'BDT',
    settlement_account_number: 'SETL-IFIC-001',
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  });

  const [psForm, setPsForm] = useState({
    ps_code: 'QCash_EXT',
    name: 'QCash Extended Switch',
    system_type: 'HOST_SWITCH',
    message_format: 'TIC_V2164E',
    enabled: true,
    is_default: false,
  });

  const [binForm, setBinForm] = useState({
    bin_prefix: '456795',
    bin_low: '',
    bin_high: '',
    pan_length: 16,
    institution_id: '',
    processing_system_id: '',
    card_type: 'DEBIT',
    card_product: 'VISA_DEBIT_GOLD',
    scheme: 'ITCL',
    country_code: '050',
    currency: 'BDT',
    is_on_us: true,
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  });

  const [ruleForm, setRuleForm] = useState({
    rule_code: 'RT_CORP_PURCHASE',
    rule_name: 'Corporate Purchasing Route',
    priority: 15,
    pan_prefix: '456789',
    pan_low: '',
    pan_high: '',
    pan_length: 16,
    card_type: 'DEBIT',
    transaction_code: '40',
    acquirer_institution_id: '',
    issuer_institution_id: '',
    processing_system_id: '',
    scheme: 'ITCL',
    destination_network: 'INTERNAL_SIMULATOR_TIC',
    is_on_us: true,
    pin_translation_required: false,
    enabled: true,
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  });

  const loadAll = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [iList, psList, bList, rList] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch(`/institutions${searchInst ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchInst)}` : ''}`),
        apiFetch(`/processing-systems${searchPs ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchPs)}` : ''}`),
        apiFetch(`/bin-ranges${searchBin ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchBin)}` : ''}`),
        apiFetch(`/pan-routing-rules${searchRule ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchRule)}` : ''}`),
      ]);
      setInstitutions(iList || []);
      setProcessingSystems(psList || []);
      setBins(bList || []);
      setPanRules(rList || []);

      if (iList && iList.length > 0 && !binForm.institution_id) {
        setBinForm((f) => ({ ...f, institution_id: iList[0].id }));
        setRuleForm((r) => ({ ...r, issuer_institution_id: iList[0].id }));
      }
      if (psList && psList.length > 0 && !binForm.processing_system_id) {
        setBinForm((f) => ({ ...f, processing_system_id: psList[0].id }));
        setRuleForm((r) => ({ ...r, processing_system_id: psList[0].id }));
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message || 'Failed to load configuration tables');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAll();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [tab]);

  const flash = (text: string, isErr = false) => {
    if (isErr) {
      setError(text);
      setMsg('');
    } else {
      setMsg(text);
      setError('');
    }
  };

  // --- MEMBER BANKS (INSTITUTIONS) ---
  const handleCreateInstitution = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/institutions', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(instForm),
      });
      flash(`Successfully registered bank ${res.short_name || res.institution_code}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateInstitution = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editInstModal) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/institutions/${editInstModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify(editInstModal),
      });
      flash(`Updated bank ${res.short_name || res.institution_code}`);
      setEditInstModal(null);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteInstitution = async (inst: any, forceDeactivate = false) => {
    const actionDesc = forceDeactivate ? 'deactivate' : 'delete';
    if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to ${actionDesc} bank ${inst.short_name || inst.institution_code}?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/institutions/${inst.id}${forceDeactivate ? '?deactivate_only=true' : ''}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
      flash(res.message || `Bank ${inst.short_name} ${res.status}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.message.includes('409') && !forceDeactivate) {
        if (confirm(`${err.message}\n\nWould you like to safely DEACTIVATE this bank instead?`)) {
          handleDeleteInstitution(inst, true);
          return;
        }
      }
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // --- PROCESSING SWITCHES ---
  const handleCreateSwitch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/processing-systems', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(psForm),
      });
      flash(`Registered processing switch ${res.ps_code}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateSwitch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editPsModal) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/processing-systems/${editPsModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify(editPsModal),
      });
      flash(`Updated switch ${res.ps_code}`);
      setEditPsModal(null);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleSwitch = async (ps: any) => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/processing-systems/${ps.id}/toggle`, { method: 'PATCH' });
      flash(`Switch ${res.ps_code} is now ${res.enabled ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteSwitch = async (ps: any, forceDeactivate = false) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete/Deactivate switch ${ps.ps_code}?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/processing-systems/${ps.id}${forceDeactivate ? '?deactivate_only=true' : ''}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
      flash(res.message || `Switch ${ps.ps_code} ${res.status}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.message.includes('409') && !forceDeactivate) {
        if (confirm(`${err.message}\n\nWould you like to safely DISABLE/DEACTIVATE this switch instead?`)) {
          handleDeleteSwitch(ps, true);
          return;
        }
      }
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // --- BIN RANGES ---
  const handleCreateBin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/bin-ranges', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(binForm),
      });
      flash(`Added BIN range prefix ${res.bin_prefix} for ${res.institution_code}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateBin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editBinModal) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/bin-ranges/${editBinModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify(editBinModal),
      });
      flash(`Updated BIN range ${res.bin_prefix}`);
      setEditBinModal(null);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleBin = async (b: any) => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/bin-ranges/${b.id}/status`, { method: 'PATCH' });
      flash(`BIN range ${res.bin_prefix} is now ${res.status}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteBin = async (b: any, deactivate = false) => {
    if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete BIN range ${b.bin_prefix}?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/bin-ranges/${b.id}${deactivate ? '?deactivate_only=true' : ''}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });
      flash(`BIN range ${b.bin_prefix} ${res.status}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.message.includes('409') && !deactivate) {
        if (confirm(`${err.message}\n\nWould you like to safely DEACTIVATE this BIN range instead?`)) {
          handleDeleteBin(b, true);
          return;
        }
      }
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // --- PAN ROUTER RULES ---
  const handleCreateRule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/pan-routing-rules', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(ruleForm),
      });
      flash(`Added PAN Routing Rule ${res.rule_code} (Prio: ${res.priority})`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateRule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editRuleModal) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/pan-routing-rules/${editRuleModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify(editRuleModal),
      });
      flash(`Updated PAN routing rule ${res.rule_code}`);
      setEditRuleModal(null);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleRule = async (r: any) => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/pan-routing-rules/${r.id}/toggle`, { method: 'PATCH' });
      flash(`Rule ${res.rule_code} is now ${res.enabled ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRule = async (r: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete PAN routing rule ${r.rule_code}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/pan-routing-rules/${r.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Deleted PAN routing rule ${r.rule_code}`);
      loadAll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // --- LIVE ROUTER LOOKUP ---
  const handleLookupPan = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/bin-ranges/lookup/${lookupPan.trim()}?acquirer_id=${lookupAcq.trim()}`);
      setLookupResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLookupResult({ found: false, message: err.message });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Network className="text-emerald-500" size={22} />
            Institutions, Switches, BINs & PAN Router Management
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Enterprise member banks, multi-scheme switch adapters (ITCL / Visa / Mastercard / NPSB), BIN boundary overlap validation, and priority PAN routing engine
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={loadAll}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-mono hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> Refresh All
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {msg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><CheckCircle2 size={16} /> {msg}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setMsg('')}><X size={14} /></button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-400 text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><AlertTriangle size={16} /> {error}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setError('')}><X size={14} /></button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        {[
          ['INST', '1. Member Banks', Landmark, institutions.length],
          ['PS', '2. Processing Switches', Cpu, processingSystems.length],
          ['BINS', '3. BIN Ranges', CreditCard, bins.length],
          ['PAN_ROUTER', '4. PAN Router Rules', Sliders, panRules.length],
          ['NET', '5. Switch Participations', Layers, 0],
        ].map(([k, label, Icon, count]: any) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
              tab === k
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon size={15} />
            <span>{label}</span>
            {count > 0 && (
              <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] ${tab === k ? 'bg-emerald-800 text-white' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'}`}>
                {count}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* TAB 1: MEMBER BANKS (INSTITUTIONS)                                       */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {tab === 'INST' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Create Bank Form */}
          <form
            onSubmit={handleCreateInstitution}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 shadow-sm"
          >
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Bank Short Code (BAL/TBL/IFIC)</label>
              <input
                value={instForm.institution_code}
                onChange={(e) => setInstForm({ ...instForm, institution_code: e.target.value.toUpperCase().trim() })}
                placeholder="e.g. IFIC"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Legal Bank Name</label>
              <input
                value={instForm.name}
                onChange={(e) => setInstForm({ ...instForm, name: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="IFIC Bank PLC"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs font-sans font-medium"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Acquirer ID (DE32)</label>
              <input
                value={instForm.acquirer_id}
                onChange={(e) => setInstForm({ ...instForm, acquirer_id: e.target.value.trim() })}
                placeholder="6-digit ID (e.g. 554433)"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-end">
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> Add Member Bank
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Banks Table */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Registered Member Banks</h2>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  value={searchInst}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchInst(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && loadAll()}
                  placeholder="Search bank code, name, DE32..."
                  className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono"
                />
                <button onClick={loadAll} className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 text-xs font-mono">Filter</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2.5">Display Code</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Legal Name</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">DE32 Acquirer ID</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Role</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Primary Switch</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
                {institutions.map((i) => (
                  <tr key={i.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30">
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm">{i.short_name || i.institution_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-sans font-medium">{i.name}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{i.acquirer_id}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{i.role}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-400 font-bold">{i.ps_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${i.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'}`}>
                        {i.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setEditInstModal({ ...i })}
                          className="text-emerald-500 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]"
                        >
                          <Edit3 size={12} /> Edit
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteInstitution(i, false)}
                          className="text-rose-500 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={12} /> Delete
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* TAB 2: PROCESSING SYSTEMS (SWITCHES)                                     */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {tab === 'PS' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <form

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">System Type</label>

                onChange={(e) => setPsForm({ ...psForm, system_type: e.target.value })}

                <option value="HOST_SWITCH">HOST_SWITCH</option>
                <option value="CARD_SCHEME">CARD_SCHEME</option>
                <option value="NATIONAL_SWITCH">NATIONAL_SWITCH</option>
                <option value="INTERNAL">INTERNAL</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Wire Format</label>
              <select
                value={psForm.message_format}
                onChange={(e) => setPsForm({ ...psForm, message_format: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
              >
                <option value="TIC_V2164E">Rajon TIC v2.164e</option>
                <option value="ISO8583_1987">Standard ISO 8583:1987</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-end">
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> Add Switch
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2.5">Switch Code</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Name</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Type</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Message Format</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Default Host</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
                {processingSystems.map((ps) => (
                  <tr key={ps.id}>

                    <td className="py-2.5 font-sans font-medium">{ps.name}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{ps.system_type}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-400">{ps.message_format}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{ps.is_default ? 'YES (Primary Host)' : 'NO'}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${ps.enabled ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'}`}>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                          <Edit3 size={11} /> Edit
                        </button>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Owning Bank</label>

                value={binForm.institution_id}
                onChange={(e) => setBinForm({ ...binForm, institution_id: e.target.value })}

                {institutions.map((i) => (
                  <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.short_name || i.institution_code} — {i.name}</option>

            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Processing Switch</label>
              <select
                value={binForm.processing_system_id}
                onChange={(e) => setBinForm({ ...binForm, processing_system_id: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
              >
                {processingSystems.map((ps) => (
                  <option key={ps.id} value={ps.id}>{ps.ps_code} ({ps.name})</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Card Product Name</label>
              <input
                value={binForm.card_product}
                onChange={(e) => setBinForm({ ...binForm, card_product: e.target.value })}

                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Scheme</label>
              <select
                value={binForm.scheme}
                onChange={(e) => setBinForm({ ...binForm, scheme: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
              >
                <option value="ITCL">ITCL (QCash)</option>
                <option value="VISA">Visa</option>
                <option value="MASTERCARD">Mastercard</option>
                <option value="NPSB">NPSB</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-end">
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> Add BIN Range
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* BIN Table */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto shadow-sm">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">Registered BIN Ranges & Boundary Overlap Controls</h2>
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2.5">BIN Prefix</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Boundary (Low .. High)</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Issuing Bank</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Switch</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Product</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Scheme</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">On-Us?</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
                {bins.map((b) => (
                  <tr key={b.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30">

                      {b.bin_low.slice(0, 8)}..{b.bin_low.slice(-2)} ➔ {b.bin_high.slice(0, 8)}..{b.bin_high.slice(-2)}

                    <td className="py-2.5">{b.ps_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-sans font-medium">{b.card_product}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">{b.scheme}</td>

                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${b.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'}`}>
                        {b.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setEditBinModal({ ...b })}
                          className="text-emerald-500 hover:underline text-[11px] flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          <Edit3 size={11} /> Edit
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleToggleBin(b)}
                          className={`text-[11px] hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 ${b.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}`}
                        >
                          {b.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteBin(b, false)}
                          className="text-rose-500 hover:underline text-[11px] flex items-center gap-0.5"

                          <Trash2 size={11} /> Delete

                  </tr>

      {/* TAB 4: PAN ROUTER RULES (WITH PRIORITY & CONFLICT CHECKS)                 */}

      {tab === 'CARD_PROFILES' && <CardProfilesUnderBinTab />}

      {tab === 'PAN_ROUTER' && (

          {/* Add Rule Form */}

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Priority (Lower = First)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={ruleForm.priority}

                required
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">PAN Prefix (4-12)</label>
              <input
                value={ruleForm.pan_prefix}
                onChange={(e) => setRuleForm({ ...ruleForm, pan_prefix: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') })}
                placeholder="456789"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Issuer Bank</label>
              <select
                value={ruleForm.issuer_institution_id}
                onChange={(e) => setRuleForm({ ...ruleForm, issuer_institution_id: e.target.value })}

              >
                {institutions.map((i) => (
                  <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.short_name || i.institution_code}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Target Switch</label>
              <select
                value={ruleForm.processing_system_id}
                onChange={(e) => setRuleForm({ ...ruleForm, processing_system_id: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
              >
                {processingSystems.map((ps) => (
                  <option key={ps.id} value={ps.id}>{ps.ps_code}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-end">
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> Add Routing Rule
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Rules Table */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto shadow-sm">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">PAN Routing Priority Rules (Evaluated Before Default Switch)</h2>
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2.5">Priority</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Rule Code</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Prefix / Range</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Issuer Bank</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Target Switch</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Routing Mode</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Actions</th>

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">

                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-sky-400">{r.issuer_institution_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">{r.ps_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${r.is_on_us ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400'}`}>
                        {r.is_on_us ? 'ON-US' : `OFF-US (${r.destination_network})`}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${r.enabled ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'}`}>
                        {r.enabled ? 'ACTIVE' : 'DISABLED'}
                      </span>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setEditRuleModal({ ...r })}
                          className="text-emerald-500 hover:underline text-[11px] flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          <Edit3 size={11} /> Edit
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleToggleRule(r)}
                          className={`text-[11px] hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 ${r.enabled ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}`}
                        >
                          {r.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteRule(r)}
                          className="text-rose-500 hover:underline text-[11px] flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={11} /> Delete
                        </button>
                      </div>

                  </tr>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* TAB 5: MULTI-NETWORK PARTICIPATIONS                                      */}

      {tab === 'NET' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Layers size={16} className="text-emerald-500" /> Multi-Network Switch Participation Links
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-sans">
            Member banks operating on the ITCL core host participate in VisaNet, Mastercard Banknet, or NPSB via dedicated member identifiers.
          </p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
