              <div key={inst.id} className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm">{inst.short_name || inst.institution_code}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-sky-400 font-bold">DE32: {inst.acquirer_id}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-slate-300 font-sans font-medium text-xs truncate">{inst.name}</div>
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  <div>Primary Host: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{inst.ps_code}</strong></div>
                  <div>Scheme Member ID: <strong className="text-white">ITCL-{inst.short_name || inst.institution_code}</strong></div>
                  <div>Status: <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{inst.status}</span></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* EDIT MODALS                                                               */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}

      {/* 1. Edit Bank Modal */}
      {editInstModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleUpdateInstitution}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 max-w-md w-full space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Edit Member Bank ({editInstModal.institution_code})</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditInstModal(null)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Bank Short Code (BAL/TBL/IFIC)</label>
                <input
                  value={editInstModal.short_name || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditInstModal({ ...editInstModal, short_name: e.target.value.toUpperCase().trim() })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Legal Name</label>
                <input
                  value={editInstModal.name || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditInstModal({ ...editInstModal, name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">DE32 Acquirer ID</label>
                <input
                  value={editInstModal.acquirer_id || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditInstModal({ ...editInstModal, acquirer_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Status</label>
                <select
                  value={editInstModal.status || 'ACTIVE'}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditInstModal({ ...editInstModal, status: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                >
                  <option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
                  <option value="INACTIVE">INACTIVE</option>
                  <option value="SUSPENDED">SUSPENDED</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditInstModal(null)} className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs">Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="bg-emerald-600 text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold">Save Bank</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. Edit Switch Modal */}
      {editPsModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleUpdateSwitch}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 max-w-md w-full space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Edit Switch ({editPsModal.ps_code})</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditPsModal(null)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Switch Description</label>
                <input
                  value={editPsModal.name || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditPsModal({ ...editPsModal, name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">System Type</label>
                <select
                  value={editPsModal.system_type}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditPsModal({ ...editPsModal, system_type: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                >
                  <option value="HOST_SWITCH">HOST_SWITCH</option>
                  <option value="CARD_SCHEME">CARD_SCHEME</option>
                  <option value="NATIONAL_SWITCH">NATIONAL_SWITCH</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Message Protocol Format</label>
                <select
                  value={editPsModal.message_format}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditPsModal({ ...editPsModal, message_format: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                >
                  <option value="TIC_V2164E">Rajon TIC v2.164e</option>
                  <option value="ISO8583_1987">Standard ISO 8583:1987</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={editPsModal.enabled}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditPsModal({ ...editPsModal, enabled: e.target.checked })}
                />
                <span>Switch Adapter Enabled for Transaction Processing</span>
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditPsModal(null)} className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs">Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="bg-emerald-600 text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold">Save Switch</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. Edit BIN Range Modal */}
      {editBinModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleUpdateBin}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 max-w-md w-full space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Edit BIN Range ({editBinModal.bin_prefix})</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditBinModal(null)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Product Name</label>
                <input
                  value={editBinModal.card_product || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditBinModal({ ...editBinModal, card_product: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Card Type</label>
                  <select
                    value={editBinModal.card_type}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditBinModal({ ...editBinModal, card_type: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  >
                    <option value="DEBIT">DEBIT</option>
                    <option value="CREDIT">CREDIT</option>
                    <option value="PREPAID">PREPAID</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Status</label>
                  <select
                    value={editBinModal.status}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditBinModal({ ...editBinModal, status: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  >
                    <option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
                    <option value="INACTIVE">INACTIVE</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={editBinModal.is_on_us}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditBinModal({ ...editBinModal, is_on_us: e.target.checked })}
                />
                <span>Route as ON-US Internal Host Transaction</span>
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditBinModal(null)} className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs">Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="bg-emerald-600 text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold">Save BIN</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. Edit PAN Routing Rule Modal */}
      {editRuleModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <form
            onSubmit={handleUpdateRule}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 max-w-md w-full space-y-4 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Edit Routing Rule ({editRuleModal.rule_code})</h2>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditRuleModal(null)}><X size={16} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Priority</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={editRuleModal.priority}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditRuleModal({ ...editRuleModal, priority: parseInt(e.target.value) || 10 })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Rule Name</label>
                  <input
                    value={editRuleModal.rule_name || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditRuleModal({ ...editRuleModal, rule_name: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={editRuleModal.enabled}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditRuleModal({ ...editRuleModal, enabled: e.target.checked })}
                />
                <span>Rule Enabled for Switch Routing</span>
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditRuleModal(null)} className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs">Cancel</button>
              <button type="submit" className="bg-emerald-600 text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold">Save Rule</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
</div>

  );
};

FILE PATH: ./frontend/src/pages/KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../services/api';

interface KeyRecord {
  id: string;
  key_identifier: string;
  key_name: string;
  key_type: string;
  thales_key_type_code: string;
  key_usage: string;
  key_scheme: string;
  key_version: number;
  key_status: string;
  kvc: string;
  algorithm: string;
  key_length: number;
  provider_type: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM';
  lmk_id: string;
  lmk_check_value: string | null;
  encrypted_key_block: string;
  masked_key_block: string;
  institution_code?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

export const KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [lmkStatus, setLmkStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [auditReport, setAuditReport] = useState<any>(null);
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<KeyRecord[]>([]);
  const [providerFilter, setProviderFilter] = useState<string>('ACTIVE_PROVIDER');
  const [remoteUrlInput, setRemoteUrlInput] = useState<string>('http://127.0.0.1:8001');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [banner, setBanner] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err' | 'warn'; msg: string } | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'inventory' | 'a0_generate' | 'a6_import' | 'a8_export' | 'audit'>('inventory');

  // A0 Key Generation Form State
  const [a0Alias, setA0Alias] = useState('ZPK_EXT_ISS_01');
  const [a0Name, setA0Name] = useState('External Interchange ZPK');
  const [a0Type, setA0Type] = useState('ZPK');
  const [a0Scheme, setA0Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a0Mode, setA0Mode] = useState('0');
  const [a0ZmkAlias, setA0ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a0Result, setA0Result] = useState<any>(null);

  // A6 Key Import Form State
  const [a6Alias, setA6Alias] = useState('ZPK_PARTNER_IMP_01');
  const [a6Name, setA6Name] = useState('Imported Partner ZPK');
  const [a6Type, setA6Type] = useState('ZPK');
  const [a6ZmkAlias, setA6ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a6EncKey, setA6EncKey] = useState('');
  const [a6Scheme, setA6Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a6Result, setA6Result] = useState<any>(null);

  // A8 Key Export Form State
  const [a8KeyAlias, setA8KeyAlias] = useState('AWK_ATM_01');
  const [a8ZmkAlias, setA8ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a8Scheme, setA8Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a8Result, setA8Result] = useState<any>(null);

  const loadAll = async (filterOverride?: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const statusRes = await api.get('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/status');
      setLmkStatus(statusRes.data);
      if (statusRes.data?.remote_url) {
        setRemoteUrlInput(statusRes.data.remote_url);
      }
      const effFilter = filterOverride || providerFilter;
      const qParam = effFilter === 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' ? statusRes.data.active_provider : effFilter;
      const keysRes = await api.get(`/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/keys?provider_type=${qParam}&include_superseded=true`);
      setKeys(keysRes.data.keys || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || e.message || 'Failed to load HSM key status' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAll();
  }, []);

  const handleSwitchProvider = async (mode: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM') => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/provider', {
        provider_mode: mode,
        remote_url: remoteUrlInput.trim(),
      });
      setLmkStatus(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: res.data.online ? 'ok' : 'warn',
        msg: `Switched Cryptographic Authority to ${res.data.active_provider} (LMK KCV: ${res.data.lmk_check_value})`,
      });
      await loadAll(mode);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Provider switch failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleSyncExternalKeys = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/sync-seeded');
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Synchronized & BU-verified ${res.data.count} LMK-encrypted keys from External Soft-HSM (Domain ${res.data.lmk_check_value})`,
      });
      await loadAll('EXTERNAL_HSM');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to sync keys from External Soft-HSM' });
    }
  };

  const handleGenerateA0 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA0Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/generate', {
        key_identifier: a0Alias,
        key_name: a0Name,
        key_type: a0Type,
        key_scheme: a0Scheme,
        mode: a0Mode,
        export_zmk_key_identifier: a0Mode === '1' ? a0ZmkAlias : undefined,
      });
      setA0Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A0 (A100) succeeded. Stored LMK key block for '${res.data.key.key_identifier}' (KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A0 key generation failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleImportA6 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA6Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/import', {
        key_identifier: a6Alias,
        key_name: a6Name,
        key_type: a6Type,
        zmk_key_identifier: a6ZmkAlias,
        encrypted_key_under_zmk: a6EncKey,
        key_scheme_lmk: a6Scheme,
      });
      setA6Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A6 (A700) succeeded. Imported '${res.data.key.key_identifier}' under LMK (KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A6 key import failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleExportA8 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA8Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/export', {
        key_identifier: a8KeyAlias,
        zmk_key_identifier: a8ZmkAlias,
        export_scheme: a8Scheme,
      });
      setA8Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A8 (A900) succeeded. Exported '${a8KeyAlias}' under '${a8ZmkAlias}' (KCV: ${res.data.kcv})`,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A8 key export failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyBu = async (alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/verify-kcv/${alias}`);
      setBanner({
        type: res.data.kcv_matched ? 'ok' : 'warn',
        msg: `Soft-HSM BU (BV00) check for '${alias}': Calculated KCV ${res.data.calculated_kvc} (Stored: ${res.data.stored_kvc}) | Raw: ${res.data.raw_response}`,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || `BU check failed for ${alias}` });
    }
  };

  const handleRotateKey = async (alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/rotate', { key_identifier: alias });
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Rotated '${alias}' via Soft-HSM A0: v${res.data.previous_version} to v${res.data.new_version} (New KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || `Rotation failed for ${alias}` });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteKey = async (id: string, alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/hsm/keys/${id}?force=true`);
      setBanner({ type: 'ok', msg: `Deleted key record '${alias}' from Host inventory` });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Delete failed' });
    }
  };

  const loadAuditDeliverable = async () => {
    setActiveTab('audit');
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/audit-report');
      setAuditReport(res.data);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: 'Failed to load audit report' });
    }
  };

  const isExternal = lmkStatus?.active_provider === 'EXTERNAL_HSM';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Active Cryptographic Authority Banner */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white font-mono">
              LMK-Centric Key Management & Cryptographic Ownership
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Thales payShield 10K LMK Domain Isolation · Zero Clear Key Storage · Live A0 / A6 / A8 / BU / NC Execution
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleSwitchProvider('INTERNAL_HSM')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
                !isExternal ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Internal Simulator HSM
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleSwitchProvider('EXTERNAL_HSM')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
                isExternal ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              External Soft-HSM Authority
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* LMK Domain Status Grid */}
        {lmkStatus && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">Active Authority</div>
              <div className={`font-bold mt-1 ${isExternal ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-sky-400'}`}>
                {lmkStatus.active_provider} ({lmkStatus.online ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'})
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">LMK Domain Check Value (NC)</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-amber-400 mt-1">
                Slot %{lmkStatus.lmk_id || '00'} · {lmkStatus.lmk_check_value}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">HSM State & Firmware</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1">
                {lmkStatus.hsm_state} ({lmkStatus.firmware})
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded md:col-span-2">
              <div className="text-slate-400 mb-1">External Soft-HSM Endpoint & Seeded LMK Sync</div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={remoteUrlInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setRemoteUrlInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-emerald-300 text-xs"
                  placeholder="http://127.0.0.1:8001"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleSyncExternalKeys}
                  className="bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1 rounded text-white font-bold whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Sync LMK Keys
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {lmkStatus?.persistence_audit?.ephemeral_risk && (
          <div className="bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-700/60 rounded p-2.5 text-xs font-mono text-amber-200">
            <strong>LMK Persistence Notice:</strong> {lmkStatus.persistence_audit.ephemeral_risk}
          </div>
        )}

        {banner && (
          <div
            className={`p-3 rounded text-xs font-mono border ${
              banner.type === 'ok'
                ? 'bg-emerald-950/70 border-emerald-700 text-emerald-200'
                : banner.type === 'warn'
                ? 'bg-amber-950/70 border-amber-700 text-amber-200'
                : 'bg-rose-950/70 border-rose-700 text-rose-200'
            }`}
          >
            {banner.msg}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2 font-mono text-xs">
        {[
          { id: 'inventory', label: '1. Key Inventory & LMK Domains' },
          { id: 'a0_generate', label: '2. Generate Key (Soft-HSM A0)' },
          { id: 'a6_import', label: '3. Import Key (Soft-HSM A6)' },
          { id: 'a8_export', label: '4. Export / Translate Key (Soft-HSM A8)' },
          { id: 'audit', label: '5. Mandatory LMK Audit Deliverable (Part G)' },
        ].map((t) => (
          <button

            }`}

          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: KEY INVENTORY */}
      {activeTab === 'inventory' && (
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
              Cryptographic Key Inventory (Sensitive Key Material Strictly Hidden)
            </h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">

                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60">
                {keys.map((k) => (

                        {k.provider_type}

          </button>

          {a0Result && (
            <pre className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded text-emerald-300 overflow-x-auto">
{`RAW REQUEST         : ${a0Result.raw_request}
RAW RESPONSE        : ${a0Result.raw_response}
KEY ALIAS           : ${a0Result.key.key_identifier} (v${a0Result.key.key_version})

                <option value="TAK">TAK (003)</option>

                <option value="MK-AC">MK-AC (109)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

              <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Wrapping ZMK Alias (in Host DB)</label>
              <input

                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-slate-200"
              >
                <option value="U">U - Variant Double-Length</option>
                <option value="S">S - Thales Key Block</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleImportA6}
            className="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 px-5 py-2.5 rounded text-white font-bold"

            Execute Thales A6 Import on External Soft-HSM
          </button>
          {a6Result && (
            <pre className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded text-sky-300 overflow-x-auto">
{`RAW REQUEST         : ${a6Result.raw_request}
RAW RESPONSE        : ${a6Result.raw_response}
IMPORTED ALIAS      : ${a6Result.key.key_identifier}
MASKED LMK BLOCK    : ${a6Result.key.masked_key_block}
KEY CHECK VALUE     : ${a6Result.key.kvc}`}
            </pre>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: A8 KEY EXPORT */}
      {activeTab === 'a8_export' && (
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4 font-mono text-xs">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-400">
            Export Working Key from LMK to ZMK Encryption (Thales Command A8 / Response A9)
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Working Key Alias (Under LMK)</label>
              <input
                value={a8KeyAlias}
                onChange={(e) => setA8KeyAlias(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-emerald-300"

            </div>
            <div>

              <input
                value={a8ZmkAlias}
                onChange={(e) => setA8ZmkAlias(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded px-3 py-2 text-amber-300"
              />
            </div>

              <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Output ZMK Scheme</label>
              <select
                value={a8Scheme}
                onChange={(e) => setA8Scheme(e.target.value)}

              >
                <option value="U">U - Variant 32H</option>
                <option value="X">X - ANSI X9.17 32H</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleExportA8}
            className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 px-5 py-2.5 rounded text-white font-bold"
          >
            Execute Thales A8 Export on External Soft-HSM
          </button>
          {a8Result && (
            <pre className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded text-amber-300 overflow-x-auto">
{`RAW REQUEST         : ${a8Result.raw_request}
RAW RESPONSE        : ${a8Result.raw_response}
KEY UNDER ZMK       : ${a8Result.key_under_zmk}
KEY CHECK VALUE     : ${a8Result.kcv}`}
            </pre>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 5: PART G AUDIT DELIVERABLE */}
      {activeTab === 'audit' && auditReport && (
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3 font-mono text-xs">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400">
            Part G: Verified Soft-HSM LMK & Key-Management Audit Deliverable
          </h2>
          <pre className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded text-slate-200 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap">
            {JSON.stringify(auditReport, null, 2)}
          </pre>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../services/api';

interface LimitDef {
  id: string;
  limit_code: string;
  limit_name: string;
  description?: string;
  scope: 'CARD' | 'ACCOUNT';
  currency: string;
  maximum_limit: number;
  current_value: number;
  active_window_key?: string;
  reset_interval: string;
  reset_interval_hours?: number | null;
  reset_anchor_time: string;
  calculation_method: string;
  comparison_operator: string;
  impact_action: string;
  decline_response_code: string;
  institution_id?: string | null;
  institution_code?: string;
  status: string;
  assigned_profiles_count: number;
  historical_usage_count: number;
  created_at?: string;
}

interface EvalAuditItem {
  id: string;
  transaction_reference?: string;
  limit_code: string;
  limit_name: string;
  scope: string;
  transaction_code: string;
  calculation_method: string;
  reset_interval: string;
  maximum_value: number;
  previous_usage: number;
  transaction_impact: number;
  projected_usage: number;
  comparison_operator: string;
  condition_matched: boolean;
  configured_action: string;
  final_result: string;
  response_code: string;
  decline_reason?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

const CALC_METHODS = [
  'SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT',
  'COUNT_TRANSACTION',
  'MAX_SINGLE_TRANSACTION',
  'MIN_SINGLE_TRANSACTION',
  'SUM_CASH_WITHDRAWAL',
  'SUM_PURCHASE',
  'SUM_TRANSFER',
  'CUSTOM_SUPPORTED_AGGREGATION',
];

const OPERATORS = ['>', '>=', '<', '<=', '=', '!='];
const RESET_INTERVALS = ['DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY', 'YEARLY', 'PER_TRANSACTION', 'CUSTOM_HOURS'];
const IMPACT_ACTIONS = ['DECLINE', 'APPROVE_WITH_ALERT', 'FLAG_REVIEW'];

export const LimitManagementPage: React.FC<{ initialScope?: 'CARD' | 'ACCOUNT' }> = ({ initialScope = 'CARD' }) => {
  const [activeScope, setActiveScope] = useState<'CARD' | 'ACCOUNT'>(initialScope);
  const [limits, setLimits] = useState<LimitDef[]>([]);
  const [audits, setAudits] = useState<EvalAuditItem[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [banner, setBanner] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Add / Edit Modal State
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingLimit, setEditingLimit] = useState<LimitDef | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    limit_code: '',
    limit_name: '',
    description: '',
    scope: initialScope as 'CARD' | 'ACCOUNT',
    currency: 'BDT',
    maximum_limit: '10000',
    reset_interval: 'DAILY',
    reset_interval_hours: '',
    reset_anchor_time: '00:00',
    calculation_method: 'SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT',
    comparison_operator: '>',
    impact_action: 'DECLINE',
    decline_response_code: '61',
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  });

  // Delete confirmation modal
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<LimitDef | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveScope(initialScope);
  }, [initialScope]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set('scope', activeScope);
      if (statusFilter) params.set('status', statusFilter);
      if (search.trim()) params.set('q', search.trim());
      const [limRes, audRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/limit-definitions?${params.toString()}`),
        api.get(`/limit-evaluations?scope=${activeScope}&limit=25`),
      ]);
      setLimits(Array.isArray(limRes.data) ? limRes.data : []);
      setAudits(Array.isArray(audRes.data) ? audRes.data : []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to load limits' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [activeScope, statusFilter]);

  const openCreateModal = () => {
    setEditingLimit(null);
    setForm({
      limit_code: activeScope === 'CARD' ? '105' : '205',
      limit_name: '',
      description: '',
      scope: activeScope,
      currency: 'BDT',
      maximum_limit: activeScope === 'CARD' ? '25000' : '100000',
      reset_interval: 'DAILY',
      reset_interval_hours: '',
      reset_anchor_time: '00:00',
      calculation_method: 'SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT',
      comparison_operator: '>',
      impact_action: 'DECLINE',
      decline_response_code: '61',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const openEditModal = (lim: LimitDef) => {
    setEditingLimit(lim);
    setForm({
      limit_code: lim.limit_code,
      limit_name: lim.limit_name,
      description: lim.description || '',
      scope: lim.scope,
      currency: lim.currency || 'BDT',
      maximum_limit: String(lim.maximum_limit),
      reset_interval: lim.reset_interval,
      reset_interval_hours: lim.reset_interval_hours ? String(lim.reset_interval_hours) : '',
      reset_anchor_time: lim.reset_anchor_time || '00:00',
      calculation_method: lim.calculation_method,
      comparison_operator: lim.comparison_operator,
      impact_action: lim.impact_action,
      decline_response_code: lim.decline_response_code || '61',
      status: lim.status,
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const payload: any = {
        limit_code: form.limit_code.trim(),
        limit_name: form.limit_name.trim(),
        description: form.description.trim() || null,
        scope: form.scope,
        currency: form.currency.trim().toUpperCase(),
        maximum_limit: Number(form.maximum_limit),
        reset_interval: form.reset_interval,
        reset_interval_hours: form.reset_interval === 'CUSTOM_HOURS' && form.reset_interval_hours ? Number(form.reset_interval_hours) : null,
        reset_anchor_time: form.reset_anchor_time || '00:00',
        calculation_method: form.calculation_method,
        comparison_operator: form.comparison_operator,
        impact_action: form.impact_action,
        decline_response_code: form.decline_response_code.trim() || '61',
        status: form.status,
      };
      if (editingLimit) {
        await api.put(`/limit-definitions/${editingLimit.id}`, payload);
        setBanner({ type: 'success', text: `Updated ${form.scope} Limit ${form.limit_code} (${form.limit_name})` });
      } else {
        await api.post('/limit-definitions', payload);
        setBanner({ type: 'success', text: `Created ${form.scope} Limit ${form.limit_code} (${form.limit_name})` });
      }
      setShowModal(false);
      await loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to save limit definition' });
    }
  };

  const handleToggleStatus = async (lim: LimitDef) => {
    const nextStatus = lim.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'INACTIVE' : 'ACTIVE';
    try {
      await api.patch(`/limit-definitions/${lim.id}/status?status=${nextStatus}`);
      setBanner({ type: 'success', text: `Limit ${lim.limit_code} status set to ${nextStatus}` });
      await loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update status' });
    }
  };

  const handleResetUsage = async (lim: LimitDef) => {
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/limit-definitions/${lim.id}/reset-usage`);
      setBanner({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Reset active usage counters for Limit ${lim.limit_code} (${res.data?.records_reset ?? 0} window record(s) zeroed)`,
      });
      await loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to reset usage' });
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async (archiveIfInUse: boolean, force: boolean = false) => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.delete(
        `/limit-definitions/${deleteTarget.id}?archive_if_in_use=${archiveIfInUse}&force=${force}`
      );
      setBanner({
        type: 'success',
        text: res.data?.message || `Deleted limit ${deleteTarget.limit_code}`,
      });
      setDeleteTarget(null);
      await loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'error', text: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Delete failed' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase rounded bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">
              LIMIT CALCULATION ENGINE
            </span>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">
              {activeScope} SCOPE
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mt-1">
            {activeScope === 'CARD' ? 'Card Limit Management' : 'Account Limit Management'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
            Configure reusable {activeScope.toLowerCase()}-level velocity & amount limits with dynamic calculation methods,
            configurable comparison operators (&gt;, &lt;, &gt;=, &lt;=, =, !=), and reset schedules.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-slate-950 p-1 border border-slate-800">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveScope('CARD')}
              className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                activeScope === 'CARD'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow'
                  : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Card Limits (Module 1)
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveScope('ACCOUNT')}
              className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                activeScope === 'ACCOUNT'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow'
                  : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Account Limits (Module 2)
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={openCreateModal}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow transition"
          >
            + Add New {activeScope === 'CARD' ? 'Card' : 'Account'} Limit
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {banner && (
        <div
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-sm flex items-center justify-between ${
            banner.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-200'
              : 'bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200'
          }`}
        >
          <span>{banner.text}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setBanner(null)} className="text-xs underline ml-4">
            Dismiss
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filter Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4">
        <input
          type="text"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && loadData()}
          placeholder={`Search ${activeScope.toLowerCase()} limits by Limit ID (e.g. 100) or name...`}
          className="flex-1 min-w-[240px] bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm text-white placeholder-slate-500"
        />
        <select
          value={statusFilter}
          onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
          className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200"
        >
          <option value="">All Statuses</option>
          <option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
          <option value="INACTIVE">INACTIVE</option>
        </select>
        <button
          onClick={loadData}
          className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200"
        >
          {loading ? 'Refreshing...' : 'Search / Refresh'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Limits Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">
            Configured {activeScope === 'CARD' ? 'Card' : 'Account'} Limit Definitions ({limits.length})
          </h2>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Condition triggers configured Impact when: <code className="text-amber-300">Projected Value [Operator] Maximum Limit</code>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Limit ID</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Limit Name & Description</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Maximum Limit</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Current Value</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Reset Schedule</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Calculation Method</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Operator</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Impact / Action</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Status</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/70 text-sm">
              {limits.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={10} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-500">
                    No {activeScope.toLowerCase()} limits found. Click "+ Add New Limit" to create one.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                limits.map((lim) => {
                  const pct = lim.maximum_limit > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((lim.current_value / lim.maximum_limit) * 100)) : 0;
                  return (
                    <tr key={lim.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-300">
                        #{lim.limit_code}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-white">{lim.limit_name}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 line-clamp-1">
                          {lim.description || 'No description'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                          Assigned Profiles: {lim.assigned_profiles_count} · Historical Evaluations: {lim.historical_usage_count}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-100">
                        {lim.calculation_method === 'COUNT_TRANSACTION'
                          ? `${lim.maximum_limit.toLocaleString()} TX`
                          : `${lim.maximum_limit.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${lim.currency}`}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                        <div className="font-mono font-semibold text-amber-300">
                          {lim.calculation_method === 'COUNT_TRANSACTION'
                            ? `${lim.current_value.toLocaleString()} TX`
                            : `${lim.current_value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${lim.currency}`}
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-24 ml-auto h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-1">
                          <div
                            className={`h-full ${pct >= 90 ? 'bg-rose-500' : pct >= 60 ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-500'}`}
                            style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700">
                          {lim.reset_interval}
                        </span>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                          {lim.active_window_key}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded bg-indigo-950/80 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">
                          {lim.calculation_method}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-sm font-mono font-bold rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40">
                          {lim.comparison_operator}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded ${
                            lim.impact_action === 'DECLINE'
                              ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30'
                              : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {lim.impact_action} (RC {lim.decline_response_code})
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleToggleStatus(lim)}
                          className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded border transition ${
                            lim.status === 'ACTIVE'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-500/30'
                              : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-700 hover:text-white'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {lim.status}
                        </button>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right space-x-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => openEditModal(lim)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-200"
                        >
                          Edit
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleResetUsage(lim)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-amber-950/70 hover:bg-amber-900/70 text-xs text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30"
                          title="Reset current window usage counter to 0"
                        >
                          Reset Usage
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(lim)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-rose-950/70 hover:bg-rose-900/70 text-xs text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30"
                        >
                          Delete
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Limit Evaluation History Table */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">
            Recent {activeScope} Limit Evaluation Audit Trail ({audits.length})
          </h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Real-time trace from HostTransactionProcessor &amp; LimitCalculationEngine
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60 text-[11px] uppercase text-slate-400">
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Limit</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Tx Ref / Code</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Previous Usage</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Tx Impact</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Projected Usage</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Condition</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Max Limit</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Verdict</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Reason / Timestamp</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60">
              {audits.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={9} className="py-6 text-center text-slate-500">
                    No limit evaluations recorded yet for {activeScope} scope.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                audits.map((a) => (
                  <tr key={a.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30">
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono text-indigo-300">
                      #{a.limit_code} <span className="text-slate-300 font-sans">{a.limit_name}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono text-slate-300">
                      {a.transaction_reference || 'N/A'} (Code {a.transaction_code})
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-300">
                      {a.previous_usage.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono text-amber-300">
                      +{a.transaction_impact.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-white">
                      {a.projected_usage.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center font-mono text-amber-300">
                      {a.comparison_operator}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-300">
                      {a.maximum_value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      <span
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold ${
                          a.final_result === 'PASSED'
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'
                            : 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {a.final_result} (RC {a.response_code})
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-slate-400">
                      <div>{a.decline_reason || 'Within configured limit threshold'}</div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add / Edit Limit Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/75 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
                {editingLimit ? `Edit ${form.scope} Limit #${form.limit_code}` : `Create New ${form.scope} Limit`}
              </h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowModal(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-sm">
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Limit ID (Unique Code)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    disabled={!!editingLimit}
                    value={form.limit_code}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, limit_code: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. 100 or 200"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono disabled:opacity-60"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Limit Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={form.limit_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, limit_name: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. Daily Transaction Limit"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Description</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.description}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Explanation of how this limit is evaluated during authorization"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Maximum Limit Value</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="0.01"
                    required
                    value={form.maximum_limit}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, maximum_limit: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Comparison Operator</label>
                  <select
                    value={form.comparison_operator}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, comparison_operator: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-300 font-mono"
                  >
                    {OPERATORS.map((op) => (
                      <option key={op} value={op}>
                        {op} (Projected {op} Maximum)
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Currency</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={3}
                    value={form.currency}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, currency: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Calculation Method</label>
                  <select
                    value={form.calculation_method}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, calculation_method: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono"
                  >
                    {CALC_METHODS.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m} value={m}>
                        {m}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Reset Time / Schedule</label>
                  <select
                    value={form.reset_interval}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, reset_interval: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono"
                  >
                    {RESET_INTERVALS.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r} value={r}>
                        {r}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Authorization Impact / Action</label>
                  <select
                    value={form.impact_action}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, impact_action: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
                  >
                    {IMPACT_ACTIONS.map((a) => (
                      <option key={a} value={a}>
                        {a}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Decline Response Code (ISO DE39)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={5}
                    value={form.decline_response_code}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, decline_response_code: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Status</label>
                  <select
                    value={form.status}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, status: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
                  >
                    <option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
                    <option value="INACTIVE">INACTIVE</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300 font-mono">
                Rule Preview: When <span className="text-indigo-300">{form.calculation_method}</span> ({form.reset_interval}){' '}
                <span className="text-amber-300 font-bold">{form.comparison_operator}</span>{' '}
                <span className="text-emerald-300">{Number(form.maximum_limit || 0).toLocaleString()}</span> &rarr;{' '}
                <span className="text-rose-300 font-bold">
                  {form.impact_action} (RC {form.decline_response_code})
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  {editingLimit ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Limit Definition'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Dialog */}
      {deleteTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/75 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
              Delete {deleteTarget.scope} Limit #{deleteTarget.limit_code} ({deleteTarget.limit_name})?
            </h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-300">
              Assigned Profiles: <strong className="text-white">{deleteTarget.assigned_profiles_count}</strong> ·
              Historical Usage Records: <strong className="text-white">{deleteTarget.historical_usage_count}</strong>
            </p>
            {(deleteTarget.assigned_profiles_count > 0 || deleteTarget.historical_usage_count > 0) && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-500/40 text-xs text-amber-200">
                This limit is assigned to an authorization profile or has historical usage records.
                Deactivating/archiving is recommended to preserve audit history.
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleConfirmDelete(true, false)}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Safely Deactivate (Recommended)
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleConfirmDelete(false, true)}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Force Hard Delete
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default LimitManagementPage;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Network, Server, Play, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertTriangle, Clock, RefreshCw, Lock, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const NetworkRoutingPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [testPan, setTestPan] = useState('4567890123450001');
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const loadProfiles = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/networks/profiles');
      setProfiles(res);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfiles();
  }, []);

  const handleUpdateMode = async (p: any, mode: string, rc: string = '00', delay: number = 0) => {
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/networks/profiles/${p.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          simulation_mode: mode,
          simulated_response_code: rc,
          simulated_delay_ms: delay,
        }),
      });
      setMsg(`Updated network ${p.network_name} behavior to ${mode}`);
      loadProfiles();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleTestRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/networks/route-test', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ pan: testPan }),
      });
      setTestResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Network Routing & Card Scheme Simulators</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Configure external switch behaviors for Visa, Mastercard, and NPSB (Approve, Decline RC, Network Timeout, Link Unavailable)
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 font-bold">
            Zone PIN Translation: AWK ➔ IWK Enabled
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {msg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          {msg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Network Profiles Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {profiles.map((p) => (
          <div key={p.id} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">{p.network_name}</h2>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-sans">{p.network_type}</div>
              </div>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                p.simulation_mode === 'ALWAYS_APPROVE' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' :
                p.simulation_mode === 'TIMEOUT' ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400'
              }`}>
                {p.simulation_mode}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulation Mode</label>
                <select
                  value={p.simulation_mode}
                  onChange={(e) => handleUpdateMode(p, e.target.value, p.simulated_response_code, p.simulated_delay_ms)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                >
                  <option value="ALWAYS_APPROVE">ALWAYS_APPROVE (RC 00)</option>
                  <option value="DECLINE_WITH_RC">DECLINE_WITH_RC</option>
                  <option value="TIMEOUT">TIMEOUT (RC 91 + Auto-Reversal)</option>
                  <option value="UNAVAILABLE">UNAVAILABLE (RC 91 Link Inoperative)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {p.simulation_mode === 'DECLINE_WITH_RC' && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulated Decline Response Code</label>
                  <select
                    value={p.simulated_response_code}
                    onChange={(e) => handleUpdateMode(p, p.simulation_mode, e.target.value, p.simulated_delay_ms)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                  >
                    <option value="51">51 — Insufficient Funds</option>
                    <option value="05">05 — Do Not Honor</option>
                    <option value="54">54 — Expired Card</option>
                    <option value="55">55 — Incorrect PIN</option>
                    <option value="61">61 — Exceeds Limit</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Simulated Network Latency (ms)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={p.simulated_delay_ms}
                  onChange={(e) => handleUpdateMode(p, p.simulation_mode, p.simulated_response_code, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Interactive PAN Routing Inspector */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
          <Play size={15} className="text-emerald-500" /> Interactive BIN Routing & Outbound Dispatch Test
        </h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input
            value={testPan}
            onChange={(e) => setTestPan(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Enter synthetic PAN (e.g. 456789... or 512345...)"
            className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono"
          />
          <button
            onClick={handleTestRoute}
            className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            Resolve Route & Dispatch ➔
          </button>
        </div>

        {testResult && (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
              <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">Routing Target: {testResult.routing.routing_target}</span>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${testResult.routing.is_on_us ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400'}`}>
                {testResult.routing.is_on_us ? 'ON-US (Internal ITCL)' : 'OFF-US (External Scheme)'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div><span className="text-slate-400">Card Scheme:</span> {testResult.routing.scheme}</div>
            <div><span className="text-slate-400">Destination Adapter:</span> {testResult.routing.destination_network || 'None (Internal Host)'}</div>
            {testResult.outbound_response && (
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
                <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-400 font-bold mb-1">Simulated Network Response:</div>
                <div>Status: <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{testResult.outbound_response.network_status}</span> (RC {testResult.outbound_response.response_code})</div>
                <div>Message: {testResult.outbound_response.response_message}</div>
                <div>Auth Code: {testResult.outbound_response.authorization_code}</div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

type Fields = Record<string, string>;
type Flags = Record<string, boolean>;
type TabKey = 'fields' | 'paste' | 'time' | 'cases';
type SplitMode = 'auto' | 'separate' | 'join';

interface NextIds {
  has_history: boolean;
  last_stan: string | null;
  last_rrn: string | null;
  next_stan: string;
  next_rrn: string;
  last_transaction: any;
}

interface SavedCase {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  mti: string;
  transaction_code: string | null;
  clear_pin_helper: string;
  fields: Fields;
  enabled_fields: Flags;
