logger = logging.getLogger("rajon.customer360")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/maintenance", tags=["Customer Maintenance 360"])

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Customer profile fields (used by /maintenance/search and the Customers page)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CUSTOMER_EXTRA_TEXT_FIELDS: Tuple[str, ...] = (
    "father_name",
    "mother_name",
    "spouse_name",
    "gender",
    "marital_status",
    "nationality",
    "place_of_birth",
    "nid_number",
    "passport_number",
    "driving_license_number",
    "tin_number",
    "occupation",
    "employer_name",
    "alternate_mobile",
    "permanent_address",
    "city",
    "postal_code",
    "country",
    "kyc_status",
    "notes",
)


def customer_profile_fields(cust: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Extra identity fields of a customer as JSON-safe values (safe even on old rows)."""
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    dob = getattr(cust, "date_of_birth", None)
    out["date_of_birth"] = dob.isoformat() if dob else None
    pexp = getattr(cust, "passport_expiry_date", None)
    out["passport_expiry_date"] = pexp.isoformat() if pexp else None
    for name in CUSTOMER_EXTRA_TEXT_FIELDS:
        out[name] = getattr(cust, name, None)
    created = getattr(cust, "created_at", None)
    out["created_at"] = created.isoformat() if created else None
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _f(value: Any) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _pct(used: Optional[float], maximum: float) -> Optional[float]:
    if used is None or not maximum:
        return None
    return round(min(999.0, used * 100.0 / maximum), 1)


def _dec(value: Any, field: str) -> Decimal:
    try:
        d = Decimal(str(value))
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"{field} must be a number")
    if d < 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"{field} cannot be negative")
    return d.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))


def _iso(dt: Optional[datetime]) -> Optional[str]:
    return dt.isoformat() if dt else None


def _linked_accounts(db: Session, card: Card) -> List[Tuple[Account, str, int]]:
    """Accounts linked to a card, primary first. Falls back to the legacy linked_account_id."""
    seen: set = set()
    result: List[Tuple[Account, str, int]] = []
    links = sorted(card.card_accounts or [], key=lambda x: (x.priority or 99))
    for ca in links:
        if ca.account_id in seen:
            continue
        acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == ca.account_id).first()
        if acct:
            seen.add(acct.id)
            result.append((acct, ca.account_role or "PRIMARY", ca.priority or 1))
    if not result and card.linked_account_id:
        acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == card.linked_account_id).first()
        if acct:
            result.append((acct, "PRIMARY", 1))
    return result


def _get_card(db: Session, card_id: str) -> Card:
    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()
    if not card:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Card not found")
    return card


def _ensure_card_limit(db: Session, card: Card) -> CardLimit:
    lim = db.query(CardLimit).filter(CardLimit.card_id == card.id).first()
    if not lim:
        lim = CardLimit(card_id=card.id, currency="BDT")
        db.add(lim)
        db.flush()
    return lim


def _ensure_account_limit(db: Session, acct: Account) -> AccountLimit:
    lim = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == acct.id).first()
    if not lim:
        lim = AccountLimit(account_id=acct.id, currency=acct.currency)
        db.add(lim)
        db.flush()
    return lim


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LEGACY limit rows
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (field, label, period, used_field, enforced_by_host_engine)
_CARD_LEGACY_DEF = [
    ("transaction_limit", "Per-Transaction Limit", "PER_TRANSACTION", None, True),
    ("daily_limit", "Daily Limit", "DAILY", "daily_used", True),
    ("weekly_limit", "Weekly Limit", "WEEKLY", "weekly_used", False),
    ("monthly_limit", "Monthly Limit", "MONTHLY", "monthly_used", False),
    ("withdrawal_limit", "ATM Withdrawal Cap", "CHANNEL", None, False),
    ("purchase_limit", "POS Purchase Cap", "CHANNEL", None, False),
    ("ecommerce_limit", "E-Commerce Cap", "CHANNEL", None, False),
]
_ACCOUNT_LEGACY_DEF = [
    ("per_transaction_limit", "Per-Transaction Limit", "PER_TRANSACTION", None, True),
    ("daily_limit", "Daily Limit", "DAILY", "daily_used", True),
    ("weekly_limit", "Weekly Limit", "WEEKLY", "weekly_used", False),
    ("monthly_limit", "Monthly Limit", "MONTHLY", "monthly_used", False),
]


def _legacy_rows(lim: Any, definition: list, scope: str, target_id: str, label: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for field, name, period, used_field, enforced in definition:
        maximum = _f(getattr(lim, field, 0))
        used = _f(getattr(lim, used_field, 0)) if used_field else None
        rows.append(
            {
                "row_id": f"LEGACY:{scope}:{target_id}:{field}",
                "source": "LEGACY",
                "scope": scope,
                "target_id": target_id,
                "target_label": label,
                "key": field,
                "name": name,
                "period": period,
                "unit": "AMOUNT",
                "currency": getattr(lim, "currency", "BDT"),
                "max": maximum,
                "used": used,
                "remaining": max(0.0, maximum - used) if used is not None else None,
                "percent": _pct(used, maximum),
                "enforced": enforced,
                "status": getattr(lim, "status", "ACTIVE"),
                "editable": True,
            }
        )
    return rows


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PROFILE (limit engine) rows
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _usage_value(rec: Optional[LimitUsageRecord], method: str) -> float:
    if rec is None:
        return 0.0
    m = (method or "").upper()
    if m == "COUNT_TRANSACTION":
        return _f(rec.consumed_count)
    if m == "MAX_SINGLE_TRANSACTION":
        return _f(rec.max_single_amount)
    if m == "MIN_SINGLE_TRANSACTION":
        return _f(rec.min_single_amount)
    return _f(rec.consumed_amount)


def _profile_rows(
    db: Session, card: Card, accounts: List[Tuple[Account, str, int]]
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    engine = LimitCalculationEngine(db)
    bin_row, card_profile = engine.resolve_card_profile(card)
    auth = engine.resolve_authorization_profile(card_profile) if card_profile else None

    info: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "bin_prefix": getattr(bin_row, "bin_prefix", None),
        "card_profile_code": getattr(card_profile, "profile_code", None),
        "card_profile_name": getattr(card_profile, "profile_name", None),
        "auth_profile_code": getattr(auth, "auth_profile_code", None),
        "auth_profile_name": getattr(auth, "profile_name", None),
        "note": None,
    }
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if not card_profile:
        info["note"] = "No active Card Profile resolved for this card (check the BIN or card profile assignment)."
        return info, rows
    if not auth:
        info["note"] = "No active Authorization Profile is linked to the card profile, so no profile limits apply."
        return info, rows

    assigns = (
        db.query(AuthProfileLimitAssignment)
        .filter(
            AuthProfileLimitAssignment.authorization_profile_id == auth.id,
            AuthProfileLimitAssignment.status == "ACTIVE",
        )
        .order_by(AuthProfileLimitAssignment.evaluation_priority.asc())
        .all()
    )
    seen: set = set()
    for a in assigns:
        ldef = a.limit_definition
        if not ldef or ldef.status != "ACTIVE" or ldef.id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(ldef.id)
        scope = (ldef.scope or "CARD").upper()
        method = (a.calculation_method_override or ldef.calculation_method or "SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT").upper()
        eff_max = a.maximum_limit_override if a.maximum_limit_override is not None else ldef.maximum_limit
        interval = (ldef.reset_interval or "DAILY").upper()
        unit = "COUNT" if method == "COUNT_TRANSACTION" else "AMOUNT"

        if scope == "CARD":
            targets = [(card.id, card.masked_pan)]
        else:
            targets = [(acct.id, acct.account_number) for acct, _, _ in accounts]

        for target_id, label in targets:
            win_key, win_start, win_end = compute_reset_window(
                interval, reset_interval_hours=ldef.reset_interval_hours
            )
            used: Optional[float]
            if interval == "PER_TRANSACTION":
                used = None
            else:
                rec = (
                    db.query(LimitUsageRecord)
                    .filter(
                        LimitUsageRecord.scope == scope,
                        LimitUsageRecord.target_entity_id == target_id,
                        LimitUsageRecord.limit_definition_id == ldef.id,
                        LimitUsageRecord.window_key == win_key,
                    )
                    .first()
                )
                used = _usage_value(rec, method)
            maximum = _f(eff_max)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "row_id": f"PROFILE:{scope}:{target_id}:{ldef.id}",
                    "source": "PROFILE",
                    "scope": scope,
                    "target_id": target_id,
                    "target_label": label,
                    "key": ldef.limit_code,
                    "name": ldef.limit_name,
                    "limit_code": ldef.limit_code,
                    "period": interval,
                    "unit": unit,
                    "currency": ldef.currency,
                    "max": maximum,
                    "used": used,
                    "remaining": max(0.0, maximum - used) if used is not None else None,
                    "percent": _pct(used, maximum),
                    "window_key": win_key if interval != "PER_TRANSACTION" else None,
                    "resets_at": _iso(win_end) if interval != "PER_TRANSACTION" else None,
                    "method": method,
                    "operator": a.comparison_operator_override or ldef.comparison_operator,
                    "impact_action": a.impact_action_override or ldef.impact_action,
                    "decline_rc": a.decline_response_code_override or ldef.decline_response_code,
                    "override_active": a.maximum_limit_override is not None,
                    "definition_id": ldef.id,
                    "assignment_id": a.id,
                    "enforced": True,
                    "status": ldef.status,
                    "editable": True,
                }
            )
    return info, rows


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GET limits
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/card/{card_id}/limits")
def card_limits_360(
    card_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    accounts = _linked_accounts(db, card)

    c_lim = _ensure_card_limit(db, card)
    legacy_card = {
        "limit_id": c_lim.id,
        "status": c_lim.status,
        "currency": c_lim.currency,
        "rows": _legacy_rows(c_lim, _CARD_LEGACY_DEF, "CARD", card.id, card.masked_pan),
    }
    legacy_accounts = []
    for acct, role, priority in accounts:
        a_lim = _ensure_account_limit(db, acct)
        legacy_accounts.append(
            {
                "account_id": acct.id,
                "account_number": acct.account_number,
                "account_type": acct.account_type,
                "account_role": role,
                "currency": acct.currency,
                "limit_id": a_lim.id,
                "status": a_lim.status,
                "rows": _legacy_rows(a_lim, _ACCOUNT_LEGACY_DEF, "ACCOUNT", acct.id, acct.account_number),
            }
        )
    info, profile_rows = _profile_rows(db, card, accounts)
    db.commit()
    return {
        "card": {"id": card.id, "masked_pan": card.masked_pan, "card_status": card.card_status},
        "legacy": {"card": legacy_card, "accounts": legacy_accounts},
        "profile": {"info": info, "rows": profile_rows},
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RESET usage
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class LimitResetBody(BaseModel):
    target: str = Field("ALL", description="ALL | LEGACY | PROFILE")
    period: str = Field("ALL", description="Legacy counters: DAILY | WEEKLY | MONTHLY | ALL")
    limit_definition_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Profile limits: reset only this definition")
    account_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Restrict the reset to one linked account")
    include_card: bool = True
    reason: str = Field("Customer 360 manual reset", min_length=3, max_length=250)


def _zero_legacy(lim: Any, period: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    old = {
        "daily_used": _f(lim.daily_used),
        "weekly_used": _f(lim.weekly_used),
        "monthly_used": _f(lim.monthly_used),
    }
    if period in ("DAILY", "ALL"):
        lim.daily_used = Decimal("0.00")
    if period in ("WEEKLY", "ALL"):
        lim.weekly_used = Decimal("0.00")
    if period in ("MONTHLY", "ALL"):
        lim.monthly_used = Decimal("0.00")
    new = {
        "daily_used": _f(lim.daily_used),
        "weekly_used": _f(lim.weekly_used),
        "monthly_used": _f(lim.monthly_used),
    }
    return {"old": old, "new": new}


@router.post("/card/{card_id}/limits/reset")
def reset_card_limits_360(
    card_id: str,
    body: LimitResetBody,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    target = (body.target or "ALL").upper().strip()
    period = (body.period or "ALL").upper().strip()
    if target not in ("ALL", "LEGACY", "PROFILE"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target must be ALL, LEGACY or PROFILE")
    if period not in ("ALL", "DAILY", "WEEKLY", "MONTHLY"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="period must be ALL, DAILY, WEEKLY or MONTHLY")
    reason = (body.reason or "").strip()
    if len(reason) < 3:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="A reason of at least 3 characters is required")

    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    accounts = _linked_accounts(db, card)
    if body.account_id:
        accounts = [t for t in accounts if t[0].id == body.account_id]
        if not accounts:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account is not linked to this card")

    summary: Dict[str, Any] = {"legacy": [], "profile_records_reset": 0}

    if target in ("ALL", "LEGACY"):
        if body.include_card:
            c_lim = _ensure_card_limit(db, card)
            before = serialize_entity(c_lim)
            res = _zero_legacy(c_lim, period)
            record_audit(
                db, "CARD_LIMIT", c_lim.id, "RESET_USAGE", performed_by=current_user,
                before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(c_lim),
                change_summary=f"Customer 360 reset ({period}) of card {card.masked_pan}: {reason}",
            )
            summary["legacy"].append({"entity": "CARD", "label": card.masked_pan, **res})
        for acct, _, _ in accounts:
            a_lim = _ensure_account_limit(db, acct)
            before = serialize_entity(a_lim)
            res = _zero_legacy(a_lim, period)
            record_audit(
                db, "ACCOUNT_LIMIT", a_lim.id, "RESET_USAGE", performed_by=current_user,
                before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(a_lim),
                change_summary=f"Customer 360 reset ({period}) of account {acct.account_number}: {reason}",
            )
            summary["legacy"].append({"entity": "ACCOUNT", "label": acct.account_number, **res})

    if target in ("ALL", "PROFILE"):
        targets: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
        if body.include_card:
            targets.append(("CARD", card.id))
        targets.extend(("ACCOUNT", acct.id) for acct, _, _ in accounts)
        count = 0
        for scope, tid in targets:
            q = db.query(LimitUsageRecord).filter(
                LimitUsageRecord.scope == scope, LimitUsageRecord.target_entity_id == tid
            )
            if body.limit_definition_id:
                q = q.filter(LimitUsageRecord.limit_definition_id == body.limit_definition_id)
            for r in q.all():
                r.consumed_amount = Decimal("0.00")
                r.consumed_count = 0
                r.reserved_amount = Decimal("0.00")
                r.max_single_amount = Decimal("0.00")
                r.min_single_amount = None
                count += 1
        summary["profile_records_reset"] = count
        record_audit(
            db, "CARD", card.id, "RESET_PROFILE_LIMIT_USAGE", performed_by=current_user,
            change_summary=f"Customer 360 reset {count} profile limit usage record(s) for card {card.masked_pan}: {reason}",
        )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "reset", "target": target, "period": period, "reason": reason, **summary}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EDIT legacy limits (partial update)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CardLegacyLimitPatch(BaseModel):
    transaction_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    daily_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    weekly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    monthly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    withdrawal_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    purchase_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    ecommerce_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    status: Optional[str] = None


class AccountLegacyLimitPatch(BaseModel):
    per_transaction_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    daily_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    weekly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    monthly_limit: Optional[Decimal] = None
    status: Optional[str] = None


def _apply_patch(lim: Any, patch: BaseModel) -> None:
    for key, value in patch.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key == "status":
            status = str(value).upper().strip()
            if status not in ("ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "SUSPENDED"):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="status must be ACTIVE, INACTIVE or SUSPENDED")
            lim.status = status
        else:
            setattr(lim, key, _dec(value, key))


@router.patch("/card/{card_id}/legacy-limits")
def patch_card_legacy_limits(
    card_id: str,
    body: CardLegacyLimitPatch,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    lim = _ensure_card_limit(db, card)
    before = serialize_entity(lim)
    _apply_patch(lim, body)
    record_audit(
        db, "CARD_LIMIT", lim.id, "UPDATE_CONFIG", performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(lim),
        change_summary=f"Customer 360 edited limit thresholds of card {card.masked_pan}",
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "updated", "card_id": card.id, "limits": serialize_entity(lim)}


@router.patch("/account/{account_id}/legacy-limits")
def patch_account_legacy_limits(
    account_id: str,
    body: AccountLegacyLimitPatch,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == account_id).first()
    if not acct:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
    lim = _ensure_account_limit(db, acct)
    before = serialize_entity(lim)
    _apply_patch(lim, body)
    record_audit(
        db, "ACCOUNT_LIMIT", lim.id, "UPDATE_CONFIG", performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(lim),
        change_summary=f"Customer 360 edited limit thresholds of account {acct.account_number}",
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "updated", "account_id": acct.id, "limits": serialize_entity(lim)}


class ProfileLimitMaxBody(BaseModel):
    maximum_limit: Optional[Decimal] = Field(None, description="New maximum, or null to remove the override")


@router.put("/profile-limit/{assignment_id}/max")
def edit_profile_limit_max(
    assignment_id: str,
    body: ProfileLimitMaxBody,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """Edits the maximum override of a limit assigned to an Authorization Profile.
    NOTE: it applies to every card that uses that Authorization Profile."""
    a = db.query(AuthProfileLimitAssignment).filter(AuthProfileLimitAssignment.id == assignment_id).first()
    if not a:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Limit assignment not found")
    before = serialize_entity(a)
    a.maximum_limit_override = None if body.maximum_limit is None else _dec(body.maximum_limit, "maximum_limit")
    code = a.limit_definition.limit_code if a.limit_definition else a.limit_definition_id
    record_audit(
        db, "AUTH_PROFILE_LIMIT", a.id, "UPDATE_MAX", performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(a),
        change_summary=f"Customer 360 changed maximum of profile limit {code} to {a.maximum_limit_override}",
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "status": "updated",
        "assignment_id": a.id,
        "maximum_limit_override": _f(a.maximum_limit_override) if a.maximum_limit_override is not None else None,
    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EDIT card (expiry aware)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CardEditBody(BaseModel):
    cardholder_name: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=120)
    expiry_month: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=1, le=12)
    expiry_year: Optional[int] = Field(None, ge=2000, le=2099)
    card_status: Optional[str] = None
    card_product: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=60)
    card_type: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=30)


@router.put("/card/{card_id}")
def edit_card_360(
    card_id: str,
    body: CardEditBody,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    card = _get_card(db, card_id)
    before = serialize_entity(card)
    data = body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    old_expiry = (card.expiry_year, card.expiry_month)

    if "cardholder_name" in data and data["cardholder_name"] is not None:
        name = data["cardholder_name"].strip().upper()
        if not name:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cardholder name cannot be empty")
        card.cardholder_name = name
    for key in ("card_product", "card_type"):
        if data.get(key):
            setattr(card, key, data[key].strip())
    if data.get("card_status"):
        card.card_status = data["card_status"].upper().strip()
    if data.get("expiry_month") is not None:
        card.expiry_month = int(data["expiry_month"])
    if data.get("expiry_year") is not None:
        card.expiry_year = int(data["expiry_year"])

    warning: Optional[str] = None
    cvv_regenerated = False
    if (card.expiry_year, card.expiry_month) != old_expiry:
        # The CVV is derived from PAN + expiry, so it must be recalculated for the new expiry.
        try:
            from app.hsm_adapter import HSMAdapter

            yymm = f"{str(card.expiry_year)[-2:]}{int(card.expiry_month):02d}"
            new_cvv = HSMAdapter(db).generate_card_cvv(card.test_pan_reference, yymm, "101", "CVK_MAIN_01")
            pin_prof = db.query(PinProfile).filter(PinProfile.card_id == card.id).first()
            if pin_prof and new_cvv:
                pin_prof.cvv_reference = new_cvv
                cvv_regenerated = True
        except Exception as exc:  # HSM offline / key missing: keep the edit but tell the user
            logger.warning("CVV regeneration failed for card %s: %s", card.id, exc)
            warning = f"Expiry saved, but the CVV could not be recalculated ({exc}). Recalculate it in the PIN & Card Lab."

    record_audit(
        db, "CARD", card.id, "UPDATE", performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before, after_state=serialize_entity(card),
        change_summary=f"Customer 360 edited card {card.masked_pan}"
        + (" (expiry changed, CVV recalculated)" if cvv_regenerated else ""),
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "status": "updated",
        "card_id": card.id,
        "expiry_month": card.expiry_month,
        "expiry_year": card.expiry_year,
        "cvv_regenerated": cvv_regenerated,
        "warning": warning,
    }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRANSACTIONS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/transactions")
def maintenance_transactions(
    card_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    account_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    customer_id: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    q = db.query(Transaction)
    scope_label = ""
    if card_id:
        card = _get_card(db, card_id)
        q = q.filter(or_(Transaction.card_id == card.id, Transaction.masked_pan == card.masked_pan))
        scope_label = card.masked_pan
    elif account_id:
        acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == account_id).first()
        if not acct:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
        q = q.filter(
            or_(
                Transaction.account_id == acct.id,
                Transaction.source_account == acct.account_number,
                Transaction.destination_account == acct.account_number,
            )
        )
        scope_label = acct.account_number
    elif customer_id:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == customer_id).first()
        if not cust:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer not found")
        q = q.filter(Transaction.customer_id == cust.id)
        scope_label = cust.customer_number
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Provide card_id, account_id or customer_id")

    total = q.count()
    rows = (
        q.order_by(Transaction.transaction_datetime.desc(), Transaction.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    approved = declined = 0
    approved_amount = 0.0
    for t in rows:
        ok = (t.response_code or "") in ("00", "0", "000") or (t.authorization_status or "").upper() == "APPROVED"
        if ok:
            approved += 1
            approved_amount += _f(t.transaction_amount)
        else:
            declined += 1
        items.append(
            {
                "id": t.id,
                "reference": t.transaction_reference,
                "datetime": _iso(t.transaction_datetime),
                "mti": t.mti,
                "transaction_code": t.transaction_code,
                "type_name": t.transaction_type_name,
                "amount": _f(t.transaction_amount),
                "currency": t.currency,
                "response_code": t.response_code,
                "response_message": t.response_message,
                "status": t.transaction_status,
                "authorization_status": t.authorization_status,
                "approved": ok,
                "decline_reason": t.decline_reason,
                "channel": t.source_channel,
                "terminal_id": t.terminal_id,
                "merchant_name": t.merchant_name,
                "merchant_id": t.merchant_id,
                "rrn": t.rrn,
                "stan": t.stan,
                "approval_code": t.approval_code,
                "masked_pan": t.masked_pan,
                "source_account": t.source_account,
                "destination_account": t.destination_account,
                "is_on_us": t.is_on_us,
            }
        )
    return {
        "scope": scope_label,
        "total": total,
        "returned": len(items),
        "summary": {"approved": approved, "declined": declined, "approved_amount": round(approved_amount, 2)},
        "items": items,
    }
'''

import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- locate the project
def find_root():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and not sys.argv[1].startswith("--"):
        return Path(sys.argv[1])
    cwd = Path.cwd()
    if (cwd / "backend" / "app").exists():
        return cwd
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if (here / "backend" / "app").exists():
        return here
    return Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator-github-prod")


ROOT = find_root()
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / f"{PATCH_NAME}_{datetime.now():%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}"
problems = []


def load(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    return raw.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ("\r\n" in raw)


def save(path, text, crlf):
    if crlf:
        text = text.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def backup(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    dest = BACKUP / path.relative_to(ROOT)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)


def check_syntax(path, text):
    if path.suffix == ".py":
        try:
            compile(text, str(path), "exec")
        except SyntaxError as exc:
            return f"syntax error: {exc}"
    return None


def edit(rel, label, marker, old, new, count=1):
    """Replace `old` by `new` in file `rel` (exactly `count` occurrences). Idempotent via `marker`."""
    path = ROOT / rel
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {rel} (file missing)  - {label}")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    text, crlf = load(path)
    if (marker and marker in text) or (old not in text and new in text):
        print(f"[ALREADY DONE] {label}")
        return
    found = text.count(old)
    if found != count:
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {label}  ({rel}: expected {count} match, found {found})")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    new_text = text.replace(old, new)
    err = check_syntax(path, new_text)
    if err:
        print(f"[FAILED] {label}: {err}; file NOT changed")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    backup(path)
    save(path, new_text, crlf)
    print(f"[APPLIED] {label}")


def write_new(rel, label, marker, content):
    path = ROOT / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        existing, _ = load(path)
        if marker in existing:
            if existing.strip() == content.strip():
                print(f"[ALREADY DONE] {label}")
                return
        backup(path)
    err = check_syntax(path, content)
    if err:
        print(f"[FAILED] {label}: {err}")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    path.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    print(f"[APPLIED] {label}")


def banner(title):
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f" {title}")
    print(f" Project folder: {ROOT}")
    print("=" * 72)
    if not (ROOT / "backend" / "app").exists():
        print("[STOP] backend/app not found here. Run from the project folder or pass the folder as argument.")
        sys.exit(2)


def finish(next_steps):
    print("=" * 72)
    if problems:
        print(f" FINISHED WITH {len(problems)} PROBLEM(S): " + "; ".join(problems))
        print(" Nothing else was touched for the failed edits. Send me this output if you need help.")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f" Done. Backups: {BACKUP}")
    for s in next_steps:
        print(" " + s)
    print("=" * 72)

"""
patch_2_frontend_fields_and_expiry.py
Run in the project folder:   python patch_2_frontend_fields_and_expiry.py
Customers page: father, mother, DOB, NID, passport, address ... (create + edit).
Cards & Profiles page and PIN & Card Lab: a real Expiry (MM / YYYY) input instead of the fixed 12/2028.
Idempotent. Backups go to _backups/.
"""

PATCH_NAME = "patch2_frontend"

import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- locate the project
def find_root():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and not sys.argv[1].startswith("--"):
        return Path(sys.argv[1])
    cwd = Path.cwd()
    if (cwd / "backend" / "app").exists():
        return cwd
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if (here / "backend" / "app").exists():
        return here
    return Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator-github-prod")


ROOT = find_root()
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / f"{PATCH_NAME}_{datetime.now():%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}"
problems = []


def load(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    return raw.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ("\r\n" in raw)


def save(path, text, crlf):
    if crlf:
        text = text.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def backup(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    dest = BACKUP / path.relative_to(ROOT)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)


def check_syntax(path, text):
    if path.suffix == ".py":
        try:
            compile(text, str(path), "exec")
        except SyntaxError as exc:
            return f"syntax error: {exc}"
    return None


def edit(rel, label, marker, old, new, count=1):
    """Replace `old` by `new` in file `rel` (exactly `count` occurrences). Idempotent via `marker`."""
    path = ROOT / rel
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {rel} (file missing)  - {label}")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    text, crlf = load(path)
    if (marker and marker in text) or (old not in text and new in text):
        print(f"[ALREADY DONE] {label}")
        return
    found = text.count(old)
    if found != count:
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {label}  ({rel}: expected {count} match, found {found})")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    new_text = text.replace(old, new)
    err = check_syntax(path, new_text)
    if err:
        print(f"[FAILED] {label}: {err}; file NOT changed")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    backup(path)
    save(path, new_text, crlf)
    print(f"[APPLIED] {label}")


def write_new(rel, label, marker, content):
    path = ROOT / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        existing, _ = load(path)
        if marker in existing:
            if existing.strip() == content.strip():
                print(f"[ALREADY DONE] {label}")
                return
        backup(path)
    err = check_syntax(path, content)
    if err:
        print(f"[FAILED] {label}: {err}")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    path.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    print(f"[APPLIED] {label}")


def banner(title):
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f" {title}")
    print(f" Project folder: {ROOT}")
    print("=" * 72)
    if not (ROOT / "backend" / "app").exists():
        print("[STOP] backend/app not found here. Run from the project folder or pass the folder as argument.")
        sys.exit(2)


def finish(next_steps):
    print("=" * 72)
    if problems:
        print(f" FINISHED WITH {len(problems)} PROBLEM(S): " + "; ".join(problems))
        print(" Nothing else was touched for the failed edits. Send me this output if you need help.")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f" Done. Backups: {BACKUP}")
    for s in next_steps:
        print(" " + s)
    print("=" * 72)

      className={`${cardCls} w-full ${wide ? 'max-w-3xl' : 'max-w-md'} max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">{title}</h2>
        <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200">
          <X size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto">{children}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
);

const Field: React.FC<{ label: string; value: any; mono?: boolean; wide?: boolean }> = ({ label, value, mono, wide }) => (
  <div className={wide ? 'col-span-2 sm:col-span-3 lg:col-span-4' : ''}>
    <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-semibold">{label}</div>
    <div className={`text-xs mt-0.5 break-words ${mono ? 'font-mono' : ''} ${value ? '' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
      {dash(value)}
    </div>
  </div>
);

const LabeledInput: React.FC<{
  label: string;
  value: any;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  type?: string;
  span?: number;
  placeholder?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ label, value, onChange, type = 'text', span = 1, placeholder, children }) => (
  <label className={`space-y-1 block ${span === 2 ? 'col-span-2' : ''}`}>
    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">{label}</span>
    {children ? (
      children
    ) : (
      <input
        type={type}
        value={value ?? ''}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className={inputCls}
      />
    )}
  </label>
);

const ProgressBar: React.FC<{ pct: number | null | undefined }> = ({ pct }) => (
  <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 overflow-hidden">
    <div
      className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${barColor(pct)}`}
      style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(pct ?? 0, pct ? 2 : 0))}%` }}
    />
  </div>
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- one limit row
const LimitRow: React.FC<{
  row: any;
  onEdit: (row: any) => void;
  onReset?: (row: any) => void;
}> = ({ row, onEdit, onReset }) => {
  const hasUsage = row.used !== null && row.used !== undefined;
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-3 items-center px-4 py-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-50/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30">
      <div className="col-span-12 md:col-span-4 min-w-0">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">{row.name}</span>
          {row.limit_code && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-400">#{row.limit_code}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400 font-mono">{row.period}</span>
          {row.enforced === false && (
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-400" title="Stored and tracked, but not blocking authorizations">
              tracked only
            </span>
          )}
          {row.override_active && (
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-400">override</span>
          )}
          {row.method && row.method !== 'SUM_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT' && (
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 font-mono">{row.method}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="col-span-12 md:col-span-4">
        {hasUsage ? (
          <>
            <ProgressBar pct={row.percent} />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 font-mono">
              <span>{row.percent ?? 0}% used</span>
              {row.resets_at ? <span>resets {dateTime(row.resets_at)}</span> : <span>&nbsp;</span>}
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 italic">Checked per transaction - no running usage</div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="col-span-7 md:col-span-2 text-right font-mono tabular-nums">
        <div className="text-xs font-bold">
          {hasUsage ? (
            <>
              {fmtLimit(row.used, row.unit)} <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">/ {fmtLimit(row.max, row.unit)}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>max {fmtLimit(row.max, row.unit)}</>
          )}
        </div>
        {hasUsage && (
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">left {fmtLimit(row.remaining, row.unit)}</div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="col-span-5 md:col-span-2 flex justify-end gap-1">
        {hasUsage && onReset && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onReset(row)}
            title="Reset usage"
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-500/20"
          >
            <RotateCcw size={12} /> Reset
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onEdit(row)}
          title="Edit maximum"
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-500/20"
        >
          <Pencil size={12} /> Edit
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const SectionHead: React.FC<{ icon: React.ReactNode; title: string; sub?: string; right?: React.ReactNode }> = ({
  icon,
  title,
  sub,
  right,
}) => (
  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
    <div className="text-emerald-500">{icon}</div>
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <div className="text-xs font-bold">{title}</div>
      {sub && <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">{sub}</div>}
    </div>
    <div className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{right}</div>
  </div>
);

// ============================================================================
export const CustomerDataMaintenancePage: React.FC = () => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<SearchMode>('all');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allAccounts, setAllAccounts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allCustomers, setAllCustomers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedCustId, setSelectedCustId] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedCardId, setSelectedCardId] = useState<string>('');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<DetailTab>('cards');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ total_customers: 0, total_cards: 0, total_accounts: 0 });
  const [showKyc, setShowKyc] = useState(true);

  // modals
  const [editAccountModal, setEditAccountModal] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [pinModalCard, setPinModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [newPin, setNewPin] = useState('1234');
  const [linkModalCard, setLinkModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [targetAccountId, setTargetAccountId] = useState('');
  const [linkRole, setLinkRole] = useState('SECONDARY');
  const [reassignModalCard, setReassignModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [reassignCustId, setReassignCustId] = useState('');
  const [editCustomer, setEditCustomer] = useState<Record<string, any> | null>(null);
  const [editCard, setEditCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [limitEdit, setLimitEdit] = useState<{ row: any; value: string } | null>(null);
  const [resetModal, setResetModal] = useState<{ title: string; text: string; run: (reason: string) => Promise<void> } | null>(null);
  const [resetReason, setResetReason] = useState('Testing reset');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  // limits + transactions
  const [limitsData, setLimitsData] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [limitsLoading, setLimitsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [limitsError, setLimitsError] = useState('');
  const [txData, setTxData] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [txLoading, setTxLoading] = useState(false);
  const [txError, setTxError] = useState('');
  const [txCount, setTxCount] = useState(20);
  const [txScope, setTxScope] = useState<string>('card');
  const [txOpen, setTxOpen] = useState<string>('');

  const flash = (text: string, isError = false) => {
    if (isError) {
      setError(text);
      setMsg('');
    } else {
      setMsg(text);
      setError('');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!msg) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 6000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [msg]);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- load workspace
  const loadWorkspace = useCallback(
    async (query: string = searchTerm, activeMode: SearchMode = mode) => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (query.trim()) params.set('q', query.trim());
        params.set('mode', activeMode);
        const res = await apiFetch(`/maintenance/search?${params.toString()}`);
        const custList = res.customers || [];
        setCustomers(custList);
        setAllAccounts(res.all_accounts || []);
        setAllCustomers(res.all_customers || []);
        setStats({
          total_customers: res.total_customers ?? custList.length,
          total_cards: res.total_cards ?? 0,
          total_accounts: res.total_accounts ?? 0,
        });
        if (custList.length > 0) {
          const still = custList.find((c: any) => c.id === selectedCustId);
          const chosen = still || custList[0];
          setSelectedCustId(chosen.id);
          const cards = chosen.cards || [];
          setSelectedCardId((prev) => (cards.some((c: any) => c.id === prev) ? prev : cards[0]?.id || ''));
          // PAN search -> jump straight to the limits of the matched card
          if (activeMode === 'pan' && query.trim() && cards.length > 0) {
            setSelectedCardId(cards[0].id);
            setTab('limits');
          }
        } else {
          setSelectedCustId('');
          setSelectedCardId('');
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message || 'Search failed');
        setCustomers([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [searchTerm, mode, selectedCustId]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadWorkspace('', 'all');
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const selectedCust = useMemo(
    () => customers.find((c) => c.id === selectedCustId) || null,
    [customers, selectedCustId]
  );
  const selectedCard = useMemo(() => {
    const cards = selectedCust?.cards || [];
    return cards.find((c: any) => c.id === selectedCardId) || cards[0] || null;
  }, [selectedCust, selectedCardId]);

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
  };
  const switchMode = (m: SearchMode) => {
    setMode(m);
    loadWorkspace(searchTerm, m);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- limits / transactions loaders
  const loadLimits = useCallback(async (cardId: string) => {
    if (!cardId) return;
    setLimitsLoading(true);
    setLimitsError('');
    try {
      setLimitsData(await apiFetch(`/maintenance/card/${cardId}/limits`));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLimitsError(err.message || 'Could not load limits');
      setLimitsData(null);
    } finally {
      setLimitsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadTransactions = useCallback(
    async (scope: string, count: number, cardId: string, custId: string) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(count) });
      if (scope === 'card' && cardId) params.set('card_id', cardId);
      else if (scope.startsWith('acct:')) params.set('account_id', scope.slice(5));
      else if (custId) params.set('customer_id', custId);
      else return;
      setTxLoading(true);
      setTxError('');
      try {
        setTxData(await apiFetch(`/maintenance/transactions?${params.toString()}`));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setTxError(err.message || 'Could not load transactions');
        setTxData(null);
      } finally {
        setTxLoading(false);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'limits' && selectedCard?.id) loadLimits(selectedCard.id);
  }, [tab, selectedCard?.id, loadLimits]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'transactions' || !selectedCust) return;
    const scope = txScope === 'card' && !selectedCard ? 'customer' : txScope;
    loadTransactions(scope, txCount, selectedCard?.id || '', selectedCust.id);
  }, [tab, txScope, txCount, selectedCard?.id, selectedCust?.id, loadTransactions]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setTxScope(selectedCard ? 'card' : 'customer');
    setTxOpen('');
    setLimitsData(null);
    setTxData(null);
  }, [selectedCard?.id, selectedCust?.id]);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- existing actions (kept)
  const handleSaveAccountEdit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editAccountModal) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/accounts/${editAccountModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_type: editAccountModal.account_type,
          available_balance: Number(editAccountModal.available_balance),
          ledger_balance: Number(editAccountModal.ledger_balance),
          overdraft_limit: Number(editAccountModal.overdraft_limit || 0),
          account_status: editAccountModal.account_status,
        }),
      });
      flash(
        `Account ${editAccountModal.account_number} updated - Available ${Number(
          editAccountModal.available_balance
        ).toLocaleString()} ${editAccountModal.currency}`
      );
      setEditAccountModal(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Update failed', true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAccount = async (acct: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete account ${acct.account_number}? Cards will be detached.`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/accounts/${acct.id}?force=true`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Account ${acct.account_number} deleted`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleLinkAccount = async () => {
    if (!linkModalCard || !targetAccountId) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/${linkModalCard.id}/accounts`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_id: targetAccountId,
          account_role: linkRole,
          priority: (linkModalCard.card_accounts?.length || 0) + 1,
        }),
      });
      flash(`Linked account to ${linkModalCard.masked_pan} as ${linkRole}`);
      setLinkModalCard(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUnlink = async (linkId: string, acctNum: string, maskedPan: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Unlink ${acctNum} from ${maskedPan}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/accounts/${linkId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Unlinked ${acctNum}`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleSetPrimary = async (linkId: string, acctNum: string) => {
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/accounts/${linkId}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ account_role: 'PRIMARY', priority: 1 }),
      });
      flash(`${acctNum} is now PRIMARY`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleChangePin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!pinModalCard) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/cards/${pinModalCard.id}/pin`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ new_pin: newPin }),
      });
      flash(`PIN updated for ${pinModalCard.masked_pan} - new PVV/Offset: ${res.new_pvv || 'OK'}`);
      setPinModalCard(null);
      setNewPin('1234');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleReassignCustomer = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reassignModalCard || !reassignCustId) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/cards/${reassignModalCard.id}/reassign-customer`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ customer_id: reassignCustId }),
      });
      flash(`Card ${reassignModalCard.masked_pan} moved to customer ${res.new_customer_number}`);
      setReassignModalCard(null);
      setReassignCustId('');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteCard = async (card: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete card ${card.masked_pan}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/${card.id}?force=true`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Card ${card.masked_pan} deleted`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateCustomer = async (fields: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (!selectedCust) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/customers/${selectedCust.id}`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(fields) });
      flash('Customer updated');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- new actions
  const openEditCustomer = () => {
    if (!selectedCust) return;
    const f: Record<string, any> = {};
    CUSTOMER_FORM_FIELDS.forEach((k) => {
      f[k] = selectedCust[k] ?? '';
    });
    setEditCustomer(f);
  };

  const saveCustomer = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editCustomer || !selectedCust) return;
    if (!String(editCustomer.first_name || '').trim()) {
      flash('First name is required', true);
      return;
    }
    const payload: Record<string, any> = {};
    CUSTOMER_FORM_FIELDS.forEach((k) => {
      const v = editCustomer[k];
      if (k === 'first_name') payload[k] = String(v).trim();
      else if (DATE_FIELDS.includes(k)) payload[k] = v ? v : null;
      else payload[k] = typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() === '' ? null : v;
    });
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/customers/${selectedCust.id}`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
      flash('Customer profile saved');
      setEditCustomer(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Save failed', true);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const openEditCard = (card: any) =>
    setEditCard({
      id: card.id,
      masked_pan: card.masked_pan,
      cardholder_name: card.cardholder_name,
      expiry_month: card.expiry_month,
      expiry_year: card.expiry_year,
      card_status: card.card_status,
      card_product: card.card_product,
      card_type: card.card_type,
    });

  const expiryPreset = (kind: 'plus1' | 'plus3' | 'expired') => {
    if (!editCard) return;
    const now = new Date();
    if (kind === 'expired') {
      const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1);
      setEditCard({ ...editCard, expiry_month: d.getMonth() + 1, expiry_year: d.getFullYear() });
    } else {
      const years = kind === 'plus1' ? 1 : 3;
      setEditCard({ ...editCard, expiry_month: now.getMonth() + 1, expiry_year: now.getFullYear() + years });
    }
  };

  const saveCard = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editCard) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/maintenance/card/${editCard.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          cardholder_name: editCard.cardholder_name,
          expiry_month: Number(editCard.expiry_month),
          expiry_year: Number(editCard.expiry_year),
          card_status: editCard.card_status,
          card_product: editCard.card_product,
          card_type: editCard.card_type,
        }),
      });
      if (res.warning) flash(res.warning, true);
      else flash(`Card ${editCard.masked_pan} updated${res.cvv_regenerated ? ' - CVV recalculated for the new expiry' : ''}`);
      setEditCard(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Card update failed', true);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleCardStatus = async (card: any) => {
    const next = card.card_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'BLOCKED' : 'ACTIVE';
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/maintenance/card/${card.id}`, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ card_status: next }) });
      flash(`Card ${card.masked_pan} is now ${next}`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---- limits: edit
  const openLimitEdit = (row: any) => setLimitEdit({ row, value: String(row.max ?? 0) });

  const saveLimitEdit = async (e: React.FormEvent, clearOverride = false) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!limitEdit) return;
    const { row } = limitEdit;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (row.source === 'PROFILE') {
        await apiFetch(`/maintenance/profile-limit/${row.assignment_id}/max`, {
          method: 'PUT',
          body: JSON.stringify({ maximum_limit: clearOverride ? null : limitEdit.value }),
        });
      } else if (row.scope === 'CARD') {
        await apiFetch(`/maintenance/card/${selectedCard.id}/legacy-limits`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({ [row.key]: limitEdit.value }),
        });
      } else {
        await apiFetch(`/maintenance/account/${row.target_id}/legacy-limits`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          body: JSON.stringify({ [row.key]: limitEdit.value }),
        });
      }
      flash(clearOverride ? `Override removed for ${row.name}` : `${row.name} maximum saved`);
      setLimitEdit(null);
      if (selectedCard) await loadLimits(selectedCard.id);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Limit update failed', true);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // ---- limits: reset
  const askReset = (title: string, text: string, body: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (!selectedCard) return;
    setResetReason('Testing reset');
    setResetModal({
      title,
      text,
      run: async (reason: string) => {
        const res = await apiFetch(`/maintenance/card/${selectedCard.id}/limits/reset`, {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ ...body, reason }),
        });
        const legacyCount = (res.legacy || []).length;
        flash(`Usage reset - ${legacyCount} counter set(s), ${res.profile_records_reset || 0} profile record(s)`);
        await loadLimits(selectedCard.id);
        await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
      },
    });
  };

  const askResetRow = (row: any) => {
    if (row.source === 'PROFILE') {
      askReset(
        `Reset usage: ${row.name}`,
        `Clears the running usage of limit #${row.limit_code} for ${row.target_label}.`,
        {
          target: 'PROFILE',
          limit_definition_id: row.definition_id,
          include_card: row.scope === 'CARD',
          include_accounts: row.scope === 'ACCOUNT',
          account_id: row.scope === 'ACCOUNT' ? row.target_id : null,
        }
      );
    } else {
      askReset(
        `Reset ${row.period.toLowerCase()} usage`,
        `Sets the ${row.period.toLowerCase()} used counter of ${row.target_label} back to zero.`,
        {
          target: 'LEGACY',
          period: row.period,
          include_card: row.scope === 'CARD',
          include_accounts: row.scope === 'ACCOUNT',
          account_id: row.scope === 'ACCOUNT' ? row.target_id : null,
        }
      );
    }
  };

  const runReset = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!resetModal) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await resetModal.run(resetReason.trim() || 'Testing reset');
      setResetModal(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Reset failed', true);
      setResetModal(null);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  // account legacy limits (from the search payload) - used by the Accounts tab
  const accountLimitRows = (a: any) => {
    const l = a.limits;
    if (!l) return [];
    const mk = (key: string, name: string, period: string, usedKey: string | null, enforced: boolean) => ({
      row_id: `A:${a.id}:${key}`,
      source: 'LEGACY',
      scope: 'ACCOUNT',
      target_id: a.id,
      target_label: a.account_number,
      key,
      name,
      period,
      unit: 'AMOUNT',
      max: Number(l[key] || 0),
      used: usedKey ? Number(l[usedKey] || 0) : null,
      remaining: usedKey ? Math.max(0, Number(l[key] || 0) - Number(l[usedKey] || 0)) : null,
      percent: usedKey && Number(l[key]) ? Math.round((Number(l[usedKey] || 0) * 1000) / Number(l[key])) / 10 : null,
      enforced,
    });
    return [
      mk('per_transaction_limit', 'Per-Transaction Limit', 'PER_TRANSACTION', null, true),
      mk('daily_limit', 'Daily Limit', 'DAILY', 'daily_used', true),
      mk('weekly_limit', 'Weekly Limit', 'WEEKLY', 'weekly_used', false),
      mk('monthly_limit', 'Monthly Limit', 'MONTHLY', 'monthly_used', false),
    ];
  };

  const askResetAccountRow = (row: any) => {
    setResetReason('Testing reset');
    setResetModal({
      title: `Reset ${row.period.toLowerCase()} usage`,
      text: `Sets the ${row.period.toLowerCase()} used counter of account ${row.target_label} back to zero.`,
      run: async (reason: string) => {
        await apiFetch(`/accounts/${row.target_id}/limits/reset-usage`, {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ scope: row.period, reason, confirm_reset: true }),
        });
        flash(`Account ${row.target_label} ${row.period.toLowerCase()} usage reset`);
        await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
      },
    });
  };

  // ======================================================================== RENDER
  const legacyCard = limitsData?.legacy?.card;
  const legacyAccounts: any[] = limitsData?.legacy?.accounts || [];
  const profileRows: any[] = limitsData?.profile?.rows || [];
  const profileInfo = limitsData?.profile?.info;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* ------------------------------------------------ Header */}
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/20 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-600/15 via-sky-500/10 to-violet-500/10 p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="text-emerald-500" size={24} />
              Customer Maintenance 360
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-2xl">
              One workspace for a customer: profile and KYC, cards, accounts, limits with live usage, and the latest
              transactions. Search by customer, PAN or account.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
            <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-500 border border-sky-500/20">
              <Users size={12} className="inline mr-1 -mt-0.5" />
              {stats.total_customers} customers
            </span>
            <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <CreditCard size={12} className="inline mr-1 -mt-0.5" />
              {stats.total_cards} cards
            </span>
            <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20">
              <Landmark size={12} className="inline mr-1 -mt-0.5" />
              {stats.total_accounts} accounts
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ------------------------------------------------ Alerts */}
      {msg && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 text-xs font-mono">
          <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> <span className="flex-1">{msg}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setMsg('')} className="opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-500 text-xs font-mono">
          <ShieldAlert size={16} /> <span className="flex-1">{error}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setError('')} className="opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ------------------------------------------------ Search */}
      <div className={`${cardCls} p-4 shadow-sm space-y-3`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {MODE_TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => switchMode(t.id)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                mode === t.id
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/25'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              {t.icon}
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
            <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={MODE_TABS.find((t) => t.id === mode)?.hint || 'Search...'}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-sm font-mono focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/40 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20"
          >
            {loading ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Search size={14} />}
            Search
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSearchTerm('');
              loadWorkspace('', mode);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} /> Reset
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* ------------------------------------------------ Split layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 min-h-[520px]">
        {/* ---------- Left: customer list */}
        <div className={`lg:col-span-3 ${cardCls} overflow-hidden flex flex-col`}>
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Matched Customers</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-500">{customers.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[760px]">
            {loading && customers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                <Loader2 className="animate-spin mx-auto mb-2" size={20} /> Searching...
              </div>
            )}
            {!loading && customers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">No customers matched. Try a different mode or term.</div>
            )}
            {customers.map((c) => {
              const active = c.id === selectedCustId;
              return (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedCustId(c.id);
                    setSelectedCardId(c.cards?.[0]?.id || '');
                  }}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-l-2 border-l-emerald-500'
                      : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 border-l-2 border-l-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-sky-500 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center">
                    {initials(c)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-500 truncate">{c.customer_number}</span>
                      <StatusPill value={c.customer_status} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium truncate">
                      {c.first_name} {c.last_name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      <span className="text-sky-400">{c.institution_code || '—'}</span>·<span>{(c.cards || []).length} cards</span>·
                      <span>{(c.accounts || []).length} accts</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ---------- Right: detail workspace */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-9 space-y-4 min-w-0">
          {!selectedCust ? (
            <div className={`${cardCls} p-16 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm`}>
              Select a customer from the list, or search by PAN / account above.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* ===== Profile card */}
              <div className={`${cardCls} overflow-hidden`}>
                <div className="p-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-50 to-transparent dark:from-slate-800/40">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-4 min-w-0">
                    <div className="w-14 h-14 shrink-0 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 via-teal-500 to-sky-500 text-white text-lg font-bold flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20">
                      {initials(selectedCust)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold truncate">
                          {selectedCust.first_name} {selectedCust.last_name}
                        </h2>
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
                          {selectedCust.customer_number}
                        </span>
                        <StatusPill value={selectedCust.customer_status} />
                        {selectedCust.kyc_status && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-sky-500/25 bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-500 font-bold">
                            <BadgeCheck size={11} /> KYC {selectedCust.kyc_status}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-500/25 bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-400 font-bold">
                          RISK {selectedCust.risk_category || 'NORMAL'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Phone size={13} className="text-emerald-500" />
                          <span className="font-mono">{dash(selectedCust.mobile_number)}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Mail size={13} className="text-sky-500" />
                          <span className="font-mono">{dash(selectedCust.email)}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Landmark size={13} className="text-amber-500" />
                          <span className="font-mono text-sky-500 font-bold">{selectedCust.institution_code || '—'}</span>
                        </span>
                        {selectedCust.date_of_birth && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Calendar size={13} className="text-violet-500" />
                            {dateOnly(selectedCust.date_of_birth)}
                            {ageFrom(selectedCust.date_of_birth) !== null && (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">({ageFrom(selectedCust.date_of_birth)} yrs)</span>
                            )}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={openEditCustomer}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20"
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={13} /> Edit Customer
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        handleUpdateCustomer({
                          customer_status: selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'BLOCKED' : 'ACTIVE',
                        })
                      }
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      {selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? <Ban size={13} /> : <CheckCircle2 size={13} />}
                      {selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Block' : 'Activate'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* KYC details (collapsible) */}
                <div className="border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowKyc(!showKyc)}
                    className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40"
                  >
                    <Fingerprint size={14} className="text-emerald-500" /> Personal &amp; KYC details
                    <ChevronDown size={14} className={`ml-auto transition-transform ${showKyc ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                  </button>
                  {showKyc && (
                    <div className="px-5 pb-5 pt-1 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-6 gap-y-3.5">
                      <Field label="Father's name" value={selectedCust.father_name} />
                      <Field label="Mother's name" value={selectedCust.mother_name} />
                      <Field label="Spouse name" value={selectedCust.spouse_name} />
                      <Field label="Gender" value={selectedCust.gender} />
                      <Field label="Date of birth" value={selectedCust.date_of_birth ? dateOnly(selectedCust.date_of_birth) : ''} />
                      <Field label="Place of birth" value={selectedCust.place_of_birth} />
                      <Field label="Marital status" value={selectedCust.marital_status} />
                      <Field label="Nationality" value={selectedCust.nationality} />
                      <Field label="NID number" value={selectedCust.nid_number} mono />
                      <Field label="Passport number" value={selectedCust.passport_number} mono />
                      <Field label="Passport expiry" value={selectedCust.passport_expiry_date ? dateOnly(selectedCust.passport_expiry_date) : ''} />
                      <Field label="Driving licence" value={selectedCust.driving_license_number} mono />
                      <Field label="TIN" value={selectedCust.tin_number} mono />
                      <Field label="Occupation" value={selectedCust.occupation} />
                      <Field label="Employer" value={selectedCust.employer_name} />
                      <Field label="Alternate mobile" value={selectedCust.alternate_mobile} mono />
                      <Field label="City / Postal code" value={[selectedCust.city, selectedCust.postal_code].filter(Boolean).join(' / ')} />
                      <Field label="Country" value={selectedCust.country} />
                      <Field label="Customer since" value={selectedCust.created_at ? dateOnly(selectedCust.created_at) : ''} />
                      <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-3 lg:col-span-2">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                          <MapPin size={10} /> Present address
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs mt-0.5">{dash(selectedCust.address)}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-3 lg:col-span-2">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                          <MapPin size={10} /> Permanent address
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs mt-0.5">{dash(selectedCust.permanent_address)}</div>
