def test_sql_validation_rejects_unsafe(sql):
    assert validate_sql(sql)[0], sql


def test_sql_algo_condition_and_custom_action(db_session):
    add_algo(db_session, "SQL1", language="SQL",
             src="SELECT COUNT(*) >= 2 FROM transactions WHERE card_id = :card_id AND authorization_status = 'APPROVED' AND transaction_datetime >= :since_1h",
             default_action="DECLINE", default_response_code="65")
    assert tx(db_session, amount=10)["response_code"] == "00"
    assert tx(db_session, amount=10)["response_code"] == "00"
    assert tx(db_session, amount=10)["response_code"] == "65"          # two approved earlier -> SQL matches
    db_session.query(HostAlgo).delete(); db_session.commit()
    add_algo(db_session, "SQL2", language="SQL",
             src="SELECT 'BLOCK_CARD' AS action, '62' AS response_code, 'sql says block' AS message WHERE :tx_amount > 7000")
    assert tx(db_session, amount=100)["response_code"] == "00"
    res = tx(db_session, amount=8000)
    assert res["response_code"] == "62" and card_of(db_session).card_status == "BLOCKED"
    failed = [c for c in res["checks"] if c["check_status"] == "FAILED"][0]
    assert "sql says block" in failed["message"]


# ============================================================================ algo API
def _body(**kw):
    b = {"algo_code": "api algo 1", "name": "API Algo", "language": "PYTHON", "code": "if tx.amount > 100:\n    decline('57','big')\n",
         "scope_type": "GLOBAL", "stage": "PRE_AUTH", "priority": 50, "mode": "ENFORCE", "default_action": "DECLINE",
         "default_response_code": "57", "default_message": "msg", "on_error": "SKIP", "stop_on_match": True,
         "tx_codes": [], "channels": [], "enabled": True}
    b.update(kw)
    return b


def test_algo_crud_versions_rollback_toggle_logs(client, db_session):
    r = client.post("/api/local-host/algos", json=_body())
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    algo = r.json()
    assert algo["algo_code"] == "API_ALGO_1" and algo["version"] == 1
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/algos", json=_body()).status_code == 409
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/algos", json=_body(algo_code="bad code", code="import os")).status_code == 400
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/algos", json=_body(algo_code="no bank", scope_type="BANK")).status_code == 400
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/algos", json=_body(algo_code="bad sql", language="SQL", code="DELETE FROM cards")).status_code == 400
    lst = client.get("/api/local-host/algos").json()
    assert len(lst) == 1 and "code" not in lst[0]
    aid = algo["id"]
    upd = client.put(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}", json=_body(code="return False", change_note="no-op")).json()
    assert upd["version"] == 2 and upd["code"] == "return False"
    vers = client.get(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}/versions").json()
    assert [v["version"] for v in vers] == [2, 1]
    rb = client.post(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}/rollback", json={"version": 1}).json()
    assert rb["version"] == 3
    assert "decline" in client.get(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}").json()["code"]
    assert client.post(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}/toggle", json={"enabled": False}).json()["enabled"] is False
    assert client.post(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}/toggle", json={"mode": "MONITOR", "enabled": True}).json()["mode"] == "MONITOR"
    assert client.post(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}/toggle", json={"mode": "NOPE"}).status_code == 400
    # run a real transaction through it and read the logs / overview
    client.post(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}/toggle", json={"mode": "ENFORCE"})
    assert tx(db_session, amount=500)["response_code"] == "57"
    logs = client.get("/api/local-host/algos/logs", params={"algo_id": aid, "matched_only": True}).json()
    assert len(logs) == 1 and logs[0]["action"] == "DECLINE"
    ov = client.get("/api/local-host/overview").json()
    assert ov["algos_total"] == 1 and ov["matches_24h"] == 1 and ov["top_algos"][0]["algo_code"] == "API_ALGO_1"
    assert client.delete(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}").status_code == 200
    assert client.get(f"/api/local-host/algos/{aid}").status_code == 404


def test_algo_test_endpoint_is_side_effect_free(client, db_session):
    card = card_of(db_session)
    draft = _body(code="block_card('test block', '62')", default_action="BLOCK_CARD")
    r = client.post("/api/local-host/algos/test", json={"draft": draft, "card_id": card.id, "overrides": {"amount": 9999, "channel": "ATM", "hour": 3}}).json()
    assert r["ok"] and r["result"]["matched"] and r["result"]["action"] == "BLOCK_CARD" and r["result"]["would_block_card"]
    assert r["context"]["tx"]["amount"] == 9999 and r["context"]["tx"]["channel"] == "ATM" and r["context"]["tx"]["hour"] == 3
    assert r["context"]["card"]["pan"].startswith("456789******")   # never exposes the full PAN
    db_session.expire_all()
    assert card_of(db_session).card_status == "ACTIVE" and db_session.query(HostAlgoLog).count() == 0
    bad = client.post("/api/local-host/algos/test", json={"draft": _body(code="import os"), "card_id": card.id}).json()
    assert bad["ok"] is False and bad["errors"]
    sqlr = client.post("/api/local-host/algos/test", json={"draft": _body(language="SQL", code="SELECT 1 AS x WHERE :tx_amount > 5"), "pan": PAN, "overrides": {"amount": 50}}).json()
    assert sqlr["ok"] and sqlr["result"]["matched"] is True and sqlr["result"]["rows"] == [{"x": 1}]
    v = client.post("/api/local-host/algos/validate", json={"language": "PYTHON", "code": "while True: pass"}).json()
    assert v["valid"] is False
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/algos/validate", json={"language": "SQL", "code": "SELECT 1"}).json()["valid"] is True


def test_catalog_templates_and_schema(client, db_session):
    cat = client.get("/api/local-host/algos/fields").json()
    keys = {f["python"] for g in cat["groups"] for f in g["fields"]}
    for must in ("tx.amount", "tx.hour", "tx.channel", "bank.name", "terminal.owner", "profile.auth_name", "customer.risk",
                 "card.status", "account.balance", "limits.card_daily_used"):
        assert must in keys, must
    assert all(f["sql"].startswith(":") for g in cat["groups"] for f in g["fields"])
    assert cat["actions"] and cat["history"] and cat["time_params"]
    tpls = client.get("/api/local-host/algos/templates").json()
    assert len(tpls) == len(ALGO_TEMPLATES) >= 8
    card = card_of(db_session)
    for t in tpls:                                                      # every template is valid and runs
        v = client.post("/api/local-host/algos/validate", json={"language": t["language"], "code": t["code"]}).json()
        assert v["valid"], (t["key"], v)
        r = client.post("/api/local-host/algos/test", json={"draft": {**t, "algo_code": t["key"]}, "card_id": card.id,
                                                            "overrides": {"amount": 30000, "channel": "ATM", "hour": 2}}).json()

        assert not r["result"]["error"], (t["key"], r["result"]["error"])
    schema = client.get("/api/local-host/algos/schema").json()
    assert any(t["table"] == "transactions" for t in schema)
    # every SQL param in the catalog really exists in the live context
    ctx = build_test_context(db_session, card, {})
    for g in cat["groups"]:
        for f in g["fields"]:
            assert f["sql"][1:] in ctx.params

def test_builtin_checks_list_toggle_and_really_switch_off(client, db_session):
    checks = client.get("/api/local-host/checks").json()
    live = [c for c in checks if c["affects_host"]]
    assert [c["name"] for c in live] == ["CHECKCARDLIMITS", "CHECKACCT2CARDLIMITS", "AUTHORIZEACCTBALANCESTRANS"]
    assert all(c["enabled"] and c["title"] and c["what"] and c["decline_rc"] for c in live)
    assert [c["name"] for c in checks if not c["affects_host"]] == ["DEFAULTREQUESTFUNCTION", "DEFAULTRESPONSEFUNCTION", "POSRESPONSECONTROLFUNCTION"]

    acct = db_session.query(Account).filter(Account.account_number == "1001000001").first()
    acct.available_balance = Decimal("10.00"); db_session.commit()
    bal = next(c for c in live if c["name"] == "AUTHORIZEACCTBALANCESTRANS")
    assert tx(db_session, amount=500)["response_code"] == "51"
    assert client.post(f"/api/local-host/checks/{bal['id']}/toggle", json={"enabled": False}).status_code == 200
    assert next(c for c in client.get("/api/local-host/checks").json() if c["id"] == bal["id"])["enabled"] is False
    assert tx(db_session, amount=500)["response_code"] == "00"          # really OFF now
    client.post(f"/api/local-host/checks/{bal['id']}/toggle", json={"enabled": True})
    assert tx(db_session, amount=500)["response_code"] == "51"          # and ON again

    # what the OLD page saved (active = false) also switches the check off now
    p = db_session.query(HostParameter).filter(HostParameter.parameter_name == "AUTHORIZEACCTBALANCESTRANS").first()
    p.active = False
    p.parameter_value = {**p.parameter_value, "enabled": False}
    db_session.commit()
    assert tx(db_session, amount=500)["response_code"] == "00"

    # parameters the engine does not know are listed as reference only
    db_session.add(HostParameter(parameter_group="MY_GROUP", parameter_name="MY_SWITCH", parameter_value={"enabled": True}, description="mine"))
    db_session.commit()
    mine = next(c for c in client.get("/api/local-host/checks").json() if c["name"] == "MY_SWITCH")
    assert mine["affects_host"] is False and mine["known"] is False and mine["title"] == "MY_SWITCH"
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/checks/nope/toggle", json={"enabled": True}).status_code == 404


def test_simple_rules_builder_roundtrip_validation_and_engine(client, db_session):
    fields = client.get("/api/local-host/rules/fields").json()
    names = {f["name"] for f in fields}
    assert {"amount", "trancode", "hour", "mcc", "institution.code", "is_foreign", "card_status", "account_balance"} <= names
    bad = client.post("/api/local-host/rules/validate", json={"expression": "ammount > 5"}).json()
    assert bad["valid"] is False and "ammount" in bad["error"]
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/rules/validate", json={"expression": "  "}).json()["valid"] is False
    for expr in ["amount > 50000", "(trancode == '10' or trancode == '11')", "not is_foreign", "institution.code == 'XBANK'",
                 "hour < 5 and amount >= 20000", "(mcc != '5411' and mcc != '5812')", "is_foreign"]:
        assert client.post("/api/local-host/rules/validate", json={"expression": expr}).json()["valid"] is True, expr

    cj = {"logic": "AND", "conditions": [{"field": "amount", "op": ">", "value": "1000"}]}
    r = client.post("/api/authorizer-rules", json={"rule_code": "BIG_CASH", "name": "Big cash", "rule_mode": "BUILDER", "conditions_json": cj,
                    "expression": "amount > 1000", "action": "DECLINE", "response_code": "61", "message": "too big", "priority": 10,
                    "stop_on_match": True, "enabled": True})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    rid = r.json()["id"]
    assert tx(db_session, amount=2000)["response_code"] == "61"
    assert tx(db_session, amount=500)["response_code"] == "00"

    cj2 = {"logic": "AND", "conditions": [{"field": "amount", "op": ">", "value": "5000"}]}
    u = client.put(f"/api/authorizer-rules/{rid}", json={"expression": "amount > 5000", "conditions_json": cj2, "rule_mode": "BUILDER"})
    assert u.status_code == 200 and u.json()["conditions_json"] == cj2 and u.json()["rule_mode"] == "BUILDER"
    assert tx(db_session, amount=2000)["response_code"] == "00"
    assert tx(db_session, amount=6000)["response_code"] == "61"
    assert client.put(f"/api/authorizer-rules/{rid}", json={"enabled": False}).status_code == 200
    assert tx(db_session, amount=6000)["response_code"] == "00"

    t = client.post("/api/local-host/rules/test", json={"expression": "amount > 1000 and hour < 5", "pan": PAN, "overrides": {"amount": 5000, "hour": 2}}).json()
    assert t["valid"] and t["matched"] and t["context"]["amount"] == 5000 and t["context"]["hour"] == 2
    t2 = client.post("/api/local-host/rules/test", json={"expression": "amount > 1000 and hour < 5", "pan": PAN, "overrides": {"amount": 5000, "hour": 14}}).json()
    assert t2["valid"] and t2["matched"] is False
    t3 = client.post("/api/local-host/rules/test", json={"expression": "nope > 1", "pan": PAN}).json()
    assert t3["valid"] is False and "nope" in t3["error"]
    assert client.post("/api/local-host/rules/test", json={"expression": "amount > 1", "pan": "0000000000000000"}).status_code == 404


def test_every_field_in_the_reference_is_usable_in_a_real_transaction(client, db_session):
    cat = client.get("/api/local-host/algos/fields").json()
    paths = [f["python"] for g in cat["groups"] for f in g["fields"]]
    params = [f["sql"] for g in cat["groups"] for f in g["fields"]]
    assert len(paths) >= 90 and "tx.currency" in paths and "tx.tran_code" in paths and "tx.is_financial" in paths

    # PYTHON: read every single field, then check that the values are the real ones of this transaction
    code = "seen = [\n" + ",\n".join(f"    {p}" for p in paths) + "\n]\n"
    code += ("if tx.currency != '050' or tx.tran_code != '10' or tx.channel != 'ATM' or tx.amount != 2500 or tx.mti != '0200':\n"
             "    decline('99', 'tx fields do not match')\n"
             "if card.status != 'ACTIVE' or card.last4 != '0001' or not bank.code or customer.status != 'ACTIVE':\n"
             "    decline('98', 'card/bank/customer fields do not match')\n"
             "if profile.auth_code == '' and profile.card_code == '':\n"
             "    decline('97', 'profile fields are empty')\n"
             "log(len(seen))\nreturn False\n")
    add_algo(db_session, "ALL_PY", src=code)
    res = tx(db_session, amount=2500)
    chk = [c for c in res["checks"] if c["check_name"] == "Algo ALL_PY"][0]
    assert chk["check_status"] == "PASSED" and chk["message"] == "Condition not met", chk
    assert res["response_code"] == "00"

    # SQL: every :parameter is bound to a value
    db_session.query(HostAlgo).delete(); db_session.commit()
    sql = "SELECT 1 WHERE " + " AND ".join(f"({p} IS NOT NULL)" for p in params)
    add_algo(db_session, "ALL_SQL", language="SQL", src=sql, mode="MONITOR")
    res = tx(db_session, amount=2500)
    chk = [c for c in res["checks"] if c["check_name"] == "Algo ALL_SQL"][0]
    assert "[MONITOR] would DECLINE" in chk["message"], chk

GUIDE_MD = r'''# Rajon Host Control Center - quick guide

Menu: **14. Host Control Center**. It replaces the old *Host Configuration* table and menu *7.5 Authorizer Rules*: both are now the **Rules & Checks** tab.

## Where it sits in the authorization pipeline

```
card / customer / account checks
  -> Local Host policy            (host status, hours, source, channel, transaction matrix, currency, country, MCC, owner, velocity)
  -> Authorization profile limits (existing limit engine)
  -> Authorizer rules             (existing)
  -> Algo Control  PRE_AUTH       (your Python / SQL blocks)
  -> PIN / CVV / HSM checks
  -> balance + legacy limits
  -> Algo Control  POST_AUTH      (your Python / SQL blocks)
  -> approve + post to the ledger
```

## Local Host tab

* Left: **Global Default** plus one entry per bank. A bank inherits the Global policy section by section.
* On a bank, switch **Override** on for a section to give that bank its own values. Sections left off follow Global.
* Sections: Host status & defaults, Channel control, Source systems (ON_US, ITCL, NPSB, VISA, MASTERCARD ...),
  Transaction matrix, Cross-border, MCC, Terminal owners, Velocity.
* **Policy simulator** at the bottom evaluates a sample transaction against the saved policy.
* Changes apply to the next transaction immediately after **Save policy**. No restart needed.

Default decline codes: 57 not permitted, 61 exceeds amount, 13 below minimum, 65 velocity, 91 host unavailable, 58 terminal owner.

## Rules & Checks tab

Three layers, from simple to advanced: built-in checks, simple rules, Algo Control.

**Built-in checks** - switches for the protections the host engine really reads:

| Check | What it does | Decline |
|---|---|---|
| Account balance check | balance + overdraft must cover a debit | 51 |
| Card limit check | per-transaction and daily limits of the card (menu 5) | 61 |
| Account limit check | per-transaction and daily limits of the account (menu 6) | 61 |

Switching one OFF applies to every bank immediately. (Older versions of the page set the parameter to inactive but the engine
ignored that, so a check never really turned off. Fixed.) Request router / response builder / POS response control are stored as
reference only: the engine does not read them.

**My simple rules** - "if this, then decline / approve / flag" without code. Build the condition with dropdowns
(field, operator, value, ALL / ANY) or write the expression yourself; see the plain-words summary, test it on a real card, save.
Fields: `amount trancode currency hour mcc terminal_id is_foreign card_status account_balance daily_used institution.code
acquirer_bank ps_name bin channel` ... Rules run in priority order before the PIN / HSM checks. Anything more complex
(per bank, per card profile, history, block card / customer) belongs in Algo Control.

## Algo Control tab

An algo is a Python or SQL block with a scope (whole host, one bank, or one card profile), a stage and a mode.

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Stage PRE_AUTH | runs before PIN / HSM checks (cheap risk checks, velocity, blocks) |
| Stage POST_AUTH | runs after balance and limits passed, just before posting (can see `account.balance_after`) |
| Mode MONITOR | shadow mode: logs what it WOULD do, never declines or blocks. Start here, then switch to ENFORCE |
| Priority | lower number runs first |
| On error | SKIP = ignore a broken algo (fail-open), DECLINE = fail-closed |

### Python

```python
if tx.channel == 'ATM' and tx.amount > 20000 and (tx.hour >= 23 or tx.hour < 5):
    decline('57', 'High value ATM cash at night')

if history.declines('10m', 'card') >= 3:
    block_card('3 declines in 10 minutes', '62')

if customer.risk == 'HIGH' and tx.is_foreign and tx.amount > 20000:
    block_customer('HIGH risk customer abroad', '62')

if customer.is_vip and tx.amount < 50000:
    approve('VIP allow-list')        # stops the other algos; PIN, balance and limits still apply

flag('just watch this one')          # logs a warning, the transaction continues
return True                          # applies the default action set in the form
```

Decisions: `approve()`, `decline(rc, msg)`, `block_card(msg, rc)`, `block_customer(msg, rc)`, `flag(msg)`, `log(text)`.
`history.count / declines / approved / sum_amount / distinct / last` and `sql("SELECT ...", **params)` are available.
History excludes the transaction being authorized.

Not allowed: imports, `while`, `class`, `**`, file / network access, names starting with `_`. `range()` is limited to 2000 items.
Each run has a 400 ms / instruction budget.

### SQL

One read-only SELECT. It matches when the first column of the first row is true / non-zero.

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 3 FROM transactions
WHERE card_id = :card_id AND authorization_status = 'DECLINED' AND transaction_datetime >= :since_15m
```

Or choose the outcome from SQL by returning the columns `action`, `response_code`, `message`:

```sql
SELECT 'BLOCK_CARD' AS action, '62' AS response_code, 'Many terminals' AS message
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT terminal_id) FROM transactions
       WHERE card_id = :card_id AND transaction_datetime >= :since_1h) >= 4
```

### Fields Reference button

Lists every field (Python path and SQL parameter), the helpers and the SQL tables. Click a name to insert it in the editor.
Examples: `tx.amount`, `tx.hour` (terminal time from DE12, else host clock), `tx.host_hour` (always host clock),
`tx.channel`, `terminal.owner`, `bank.name`, `profile.auth_name`, `customer.risk`, `card.status`, `account.balance`.

### Actions

| Action | Effect (ENFORCE mode) |
|---|---|
| DECLINE | declines with the response code |
| BLOCK_CARD | sets the card to BLOCKED (audit logged) and declines; later transactions decline with 05 |
| BLOCK_CUSTOMER | sets the customer to BLOCKED (audit logged) and declines |
| APPROVE | risk-layer allow-list: skips the remaining algos. It never bypasses PIN, HSM, limit or balance checks |
| FLAG | writes a warning to the system log and continues |

Every save keeps a version (History button) that you can restore. The execution log lists matches and errors.

## Operations

* Host clock offset: set the environment variable `HOST_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS` (default 6).
* A bug in an algo or in the policy engine can never take the host down: errors are logged and the transaction continues
  (unless the algo is set to fail-closed).
* Algos are written by an authenticated administrator and run inside the host process in a restricted sandbox.
  Keep the admin login private.
'''

import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- locate the project
def find_root():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and not sys.argv[1].startswith("--"):
        return Path(sys.argv[1])
    cwd = Path.cwd()
    if (cwd / "backend" / "app").exists():
        return cwd
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if (here / "backend" / "app").exists():
        return here
    return Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator-github-prod")


ROOT = find_root()
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / f"{PATCH_NAME}_{datetime.now():%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}"
problems = []


def load(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    return raw.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ("\r\n" in raw)


def save(path, text, crlf):
    if crlf:
        text = text.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def backup(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    dest = BACKUP / path.relative_to(ROOT)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)


def check_syntax(path, text):
    if path.suffix == ".py":
        try:
            compile(text, str(path), "exec")
        except SyntaxError as exc:
            return f"syntax error: {exc}"
    return None


def edit(rel, label, marker, old, new, count=1):
    """Replace `old` by `new` in file `rel` (exactly `count` occurrences). Idempotent via `marker`."""
    path = ROOT / rel
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {rel} (file missing)  - {label}")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    text, crlf = load(path)
    if (marker and marker in text) or (old not in text and new in text):
        print(f"[ALREADY DONE] {label}")
        return
    found = text.count(old)
    if found != count:
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {label}  ({rel}: expected {count} match, found {found})")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    new_text = text.replace(old, new)
    err = check_syntax(path, new_text)
    if err:
        print(f"[FAILED] {label}: {err}; file NOT changed")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    backup(path)
    save(path, new_text, crlf)
    print(f"[APPLIED] {label}")


def write_new(rel, label, marker, content):
    path = ROOT / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        existing, _ = load(path)
        if marker in existing:
            if existing.strip() == content.strip():
                print(f"[ALREADY DONE] {label}")
                return
        backup(path)
    err = check_syntax(path, content)
    if err:
        print(f"[FAILED] {label}: {err}")
        problems.append(label)
        return
    path.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    print(f"[APPLIED] {label}")


def banner(title):
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f" {title}")
    print(f" Project folder: {ROOT}")
    print("=" * 72)
    if not (ROOT / "backend" / "app").exists():
        print("[STOP] backend/app not found here. Run from the project folder or pass the folder as argument.")
        sys.exit(2)


def finish(next_steps):
    print("=" * 72)
    if problems:
        print(f" FINISHED WITH {len(problems)} PROBLEM(S): " + "; ".join(problems))
        print(" Nothing else was touched for the failed edits. Send me this output if you need help.")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f" Done. Backups: {BACKUP}")
    for s in next_steps:
        print(" " + s)
    print("=" * 72)


banner("PATCH 7/7  Rules & Checks tab, friendly algo errors, built-in check fix, menu 7.5 retired")

# ======================================================================== BACKEND
# 1. router: friendly validation (no more raw 422) + built-in checks + simple-rule helpers
write_new("backend/app/local_host_router.py", "backend/app/local_host_router.py (friendly errors + /checks + /rules)",
          "REST API of the Rajon Local Host control center", LOCAL_HOST_ROUTER_PY)

# 2. engine: the built-in switches really switch the check off
edit("backend/app/host_engine.py", "host_engine.py: a switched-off built-in check is really skipped", "# [PATCH rules_checks:is_rule_enabled]",
'''            .filter(
                HostParameter.parameter_group == "RAJON_AUTH_RULES",
                HostParameter.parameter_name == param_name,
                HostParameter.active == True,  # noqa: E712
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not param:
            return default
        val = param.parameter_value''',
'''            .filter(
                HostParameter.parameter_group == "RAJON_AUTH_RULES",
                HostParameter.parameter_name == param_name,
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not param:
            return default
        # [PATCH rules_checks:is_rule_enabled]
        # an inactive parameter means the check was switched OFF (the old page used to set active = false,
        # but the engine only looked at active rows, so the check silently stayed ON)
        if not param.active:
            return False
        val = param.parameter_value''')

# 3. schema: a simple rule can be edited without losing its builder conditions
edit("backend/app/schemas.py", "schemas.py: AuthorizerRuleUpdate accepts rule_mode / conditions_json", "# [PATCH rules_checks:rule_update]",
'''    stop_on_match: Optional[bool] = None
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None


class AuthorizerRuleOut(AuthorizerRuleCreate):''',
'''    stop_on_match: Optional[bool] = None
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None
    # [PATCH rules_checks:rule_update]
    rule_mode: Optional[str] = None
    conditions_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


class AuthorizerRuleOut(AuthorizerRuleCreate):''')

# ======================================================================== FRONTEND
D = "frontend/src/pages/hostcontrol/"
write_new(D + "RulesAndChecksTab.tsx", "hostcontrol/RulesAndChecksTab.tsx (new)", "RULES & CHECKS", HC_RULES_TSX)
write_new(D + "HostControlCenterPage.tsx", "hostcontrol/HostControlCenterPage.tsx (Rules & Checks tab)", "RAJON HOST CONTROL CENTER", HC_PAGE_TSX)
write_new(D + "AlgoControlTab.tsx", "hostcontrol/AlgoControlTab.tsx (required-field hints, scope help)", "ALGO CONTROL  - Python / SQL risk blocks", HC_ALGO_TSX)

# readable error messages for every page (a 422 used to show as "[object Object]")
edit("frontend/src/api.ts", "api.ts: readable validation errors", "// [PATCH friendly_422]",
'''      errText = errData.detail || JSON.stringify(errData);
''',
'''      // [PATCH friendly_422]
      const d = errData.detail;
      if (Array.isArray(d)) {
        errText = d
          .map((x: any) => `${(x.loc || []).filter((p: any) => p !== 'body').join('.')}: ${x.msg}`)
          .join('; ');
      } else {
        errText = typeof d === 'string' ? d : d ? JSON.stringify(d) : JSON.stringify(errData);
      }
''')

# menu 7.5 is replaced by 14. Host Control Center (old bookmarks are redirected)
edit("frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx", "Layout.tsx: remove menu 7.5 Authorizer Rules", None,
     "  { to: '/authorizer-rules', label: '7.5. Authorizer Rules', icon: Sliders, group: 'SWITCH & SIMULATOR' },\n", "")
edit("frontend/src/App.tsx", "App.tsx: /authorizer-rules redirects to the Host Control Center", None,
     "              <AuthorizerRulesPage />\n",

# ======================================================================== TESTS + GUIDE
write_new("backend/tests/test_local_host.py", "backend/tests/test_local_host.py (updated)",

"""
rename_to_rajon.py  -  replace every BAOBAB / Baobab / baobab and Compass Plus name with your own.

Default is a DRY RUN: it only prints what it would change.

    python rename_to_rajon.py                      (dry run, production folder)
    python rename_to_rajon.py --apply              (really change files, rename files, migrate DB)
    python rename_to_rajon.py "E:\\HSM_V2\\thales-soft-hsm" --apply     (same for the Soft-HSM project)

Options:
    --name Rajon                     one word, letters/digits only (default Rajon)
    --new-backend-host HOST          after you rename the Render service, put its new host name here
                                     (e.g. rajon-backend.onrender.com) to update _redirects / netlify.toml

What it does
 1. Text in source, docs, config, scripts:
      Compass Plus TW / Compass Plus -> Rajon       BAOBAB-Inspired X -> Rajon X
      BAOBAB -> RAJON      Baobab -> Rajon      baobab -> rajon
    (UI titles, browser storage keys, logger names, parameter group BAOBAB_AUTH_RULES -> RAJON_AUTH_RULES,
     database file name baobab_host.db -> rajon_host.db, docs/BAOBAB_TO_HOST_MAPPING.md, ...)
 2. Renames files whose name contains baobab (the .db file and the mapping doc).
 3. Migrates SQLite database files found in the folder: host_parameters.parameter_group and display
    text in non-log tables (without this the authorization rules would not be found after the rename).
 4. NEVER touches URLs that contain baobab (your Render URL and GitHub repo): renaming those must be done
    in the Render / GitHub dashboards (see the checklist printed at the end).
Backups of every changed file go to _backups\\rename_<timestamp>\\ .
"""
import argparse
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("root", nargs="?", default=r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator")
ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="only list remaining Baobab / Compass Plus text, change nothing")
ap.add_argument("--name", default="Rajon")
ap.add_argument("--new-backend-host", default="")
args = ap.parse_args()

if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*", args.name):
    sys.exit("--name must be one word (letters and digits only), for example Rajon")

ROOT = Path(args.root)
if not ROOT.exists():
    sys.exit(f"[STOP] folder not found: {ROOT}")

NAME, UP, LOW = args.name, args.name.upper(), args.name.lower()
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / f"rename_{datetime.now():%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}"
SELF = Path(__file__).resolve()

TEXT_EXT = {".py", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".json", ".md", ".html", ".css", ".toml", ".txt",
            ".yml", ".yaml", ".cfg", ".ini", ".sh", ".bat", ".ps1", ".csv", ".example"}
TEXT_NAMES = {"_redirects", ".gitignore", "Procfile", ".env.example"}
SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "_backups", "dist", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv", "env", "release", ".idea", ".vscode"}
MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024

# (regex, replacement) applied in this order
RULES = [
    (re.compile(r"Compass Plus(?: TW)?"), NAME),
    (re.compile(r"BAOBAB[- ]?[Ii]nspired "), NAME + " "),
    (re.compile(r"BAOBAB"), UP),
    (re.compile(r"Baobab"), NAME),
    (re.compile(r"baobab"), LOW),
    (re.compile(r"baobab", re.I), NAME),                 # any odd spelling, e.g. BaoBab
    (re.compile(r"compass\s*plus(?:\s*tw)?", re.I), NAME),  # COMPASS PLUS, CompassPlus ...
]
# URLs / hosts containing baobab are protected (they must be renamed in Render / GitHub first)
PROTECT = [
    re.compile(r"https?://[^\s'\"<>)\]]*baobab[^\s'\"<>)\]]*", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b[\w\-]*baobab[\w\-]*\.(?:onrender\.com|netlify\.app)\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\b[\w\-]+/[\w\-]*baobab[\w\-]*\.git\b", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\bRajonRDX/[\w\-]*baobab[\w\-]*", re.I),
]
BACKEND_HOST_RE = re.compile(r"\b[\w\-]*baobab[\w\-]*\.onrender\.com\b", re.I)


def transform(text):
    """returns (new_text, number_of_replacements)"""
    if args.new_backend_host:
        text = BACKEND_HOST_RE.sub(args.new_backend_host.strip().replace("https://", "").rstrip("/"), text)
    saved = []

    def stash(m):
        saved.append(m.group(0))
        return f"\u0000P{len(saved) - 1}\u0000"

    for p in PROTECT:
        text = p.sub(stash, text)
    total = 0
    for rx, rep in RULES:
        text, n = rx.subn(rep, text)
        total += n
    for i, s in enumerate(saved):
        text = text.replace(f"\u0000P{i}\u0000", s)
    return text, total


def want(path):
    if path.resolve() == SELF:
        return False
    if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in path.relative_to(ROOT).parts[:-1]):
        return False
    return (path.suffix.lower() in TEXT_EXT or path.name in TEXT_NAMES) and path.stat().st_size <= MAX_BYTES


def backup(path):
    dest = BACKUP / path.relative_to(ROOT)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)


mode = "APPLY" if args.apply else ("CHECK" if args.check else "DRY RUN")
print("=" * 72)
print(f" Rename to '{NAME}'  [{mode}]   folder: {ROOT}")
print("=" * 72)

if args.check:
    args.apply = False
    # CHECK = list leftovers only (steps 1-3 below run as a harmless dry run)
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 1. text files
changed, total_repl, skipped = [], 0, []
for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*")):
    if not path.is_file() or not want(path):
        continue
    try:
        raw = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        skipped.append(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))
        continue
    new, n = transform(raw)
    if n and new != raw:
        changed.append((path, new, n))
        total_repl += n

print(f"\n[1] Text replacements: {total_repl} in {len(changed)} files")
for path, _, n in changed:
    print(f"    {n:>4}  {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
if skipped:
    print("    skipped (not UTF-8):", ", ".join(skipped))

if args.apply:
    for path, new, _ in changed:
        backup(path)
        path.write_bytes(new.encode("utf-8"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 2. file renames
renames = []
for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*")):
    if path.is_file() and re.search("baobab", path.name, re.I):
        if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in path.relative_to(ROOT).parts[:-1]):
            continue
        new_name = path.name
        for rx, rep in RULES[2:]:
            new_name = rx.sub(rep, new_name)
        renames.append((path, path.with_name(new_name)))

print(f"\n[2] File renames: {len(renames)}")
for old, new in renames:
    status = ""
    if new.exists():
        status = "  (target exists - SKIPPED)"
    print(f"    {old.relative_to(ROOT)}  ->  {new.name}{status}")
    if args.apply and not new.exists():
        old.rename(new)

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 3. SQLite migration
LOG_WORDS = ("log", "audit", "hsm_operation", "journal")
db_files = []
for folder in (ROOT, ROOT / "backend"):
    for nm in (f"{LOW}_host.db", "baobab_host.db"):
        p = folder / nm
        if p.exists() and p not in db_files:
            db_files.append(p)

DB_RULES = [("Compass Plus TW", NAME), ("Compass Plus", NAME), ("BAOBAB-Inspired ", NAME + " "),
            ("BAOBAB-inspired ", NAME + " "), ("BAOBAB", UP), ("Baobab", NAME), ("baobab", LOW)]

print(f"\n[3] SQLite databases found: {len(db_files)}")
for dbp in db_files:
    print(f"    {dbp.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    if args.apply:
        backup(dbp)
    con = sqlite3.connect(str(dbp))
    cur = con.cursor()
    tables = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%'")]
    grand = 0
    for t in tables:
        if any(w in t.lower() for w in LOG_WORDS):
            continue
        cols = [c[1] for c in cur.execute(f'pragma table_info("{t}")')
                if re.search(r"CHAR|TEXT|CLOB|JSON", (c[2] or "").upper())]
        for c in cols:
            hits = 0
            for old, new in DB_RULES:
                hits += cur.execute(f'select count(*) from "{t}" where instr("{c}", ?) > 0', (old,)).fetchone()[0]
                if args.apply:
                    # UPDATE OR IGNORE keeps UNIQUE constraints safe
                    cur.execute(f'update or ignore "{t}" set "{c}" = replace("{c}", ?, ?) where instr("{c}", ?) > 0',
                                (old, new, old))
            if hits:
                grand += hits
                print(f"       {t}.{c}: {hits} value(s)")
    if args.apply:
        con.commit()
        ok = cur.execute("pragma integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"       integrity_check: {ok}")
    elif grand == 0:
        print("       nothing to migrate")
    con.close()

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 4. what is still left
OLD = re.compile(r"baobab|compass\s*plus", re.I)


def remaining():
    hits = []
    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*")):
        if not path.is_file() or not want(path):
            continue
        try:
            lines = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8").splitlines()
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
        for n, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            probe = line
            for p in PROTECT:
                probe = p.sub("", probe)
            if OLD.search(probe):
                hits.append(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}:{n}: {line.strip()[:110]}")
    return hits


left = remaining() if (args.apply or args.check) else []
if args.apply or args.check:
    print(f"\n[4] Old names still in files (protected URLs ignored): {len(left)}")
    for h in left[:40]:
        print("    " + h)
    if not left:
        print("    CLEAN - the folder no longer contains Baobab / Compass Plus text.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------ summary
print("\n" + "=" * 72)
if not args.apply:
    print(" DRY RUN finished - nothing was changed. Re-run with --apply to make the changes.")
else:
    print(f" Done. Backups: {BACKUP}")
    print(" Next: git add -A && git commit -m \"Rename to " + NAME + "\" && git push")
print("""
 STILL TO DO BY HAND (these live outside the code):
   1. Render:  host backend service -> Settings -> Name  (changes the URL, then run this script again with
               --new-backend-host <new-host>.onrender.com so _redirects / netlify.toml follow).
               If DATABASE_URL is set in Render's environment and points to baobab_host.db, change it to rajon_host.db.
   2. GitHub:  repository Settings -> Rename (the old URL redirects; update `git remote set-url origin <new url>`).
   3. Netlify: Site configuration -> Change site name (optional).
   4. Postgres instead of SQLite?  run:
         UPDATE host_parameters SET parameter_group = REPLACE(parameter_group, 'BAOBAB', '%s')
         WHERE parameter_group LIKE '%%BAOBAB%%';
   5. Everyone logs in once more (browser storage keys were renamed).
   6. Run the same script on the Soft-HSM folder (E:\\HSM_V2\\thales-soft-hsm) so both projects match.
""" % UP)
print("=" * 72)

    "frontend/src/pages/SimulatorAndJournal.tsx",
    "frontend/src/pages/HsmAndMonitorPages.tsx",
    "README.md",
]

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {".venv", "venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__", ".git", "release", "dist"}
EXCLUDE_FILES = {".env", "rajon_host.db"}


def main() -> int:
    print("=" * 72)
    print("  RAJON HOST SIMULATOR — RELEASE VALIDATOR & ZIP BUILDER")
    print("=" * 72)

    missing = []
    for rel in REQUIRED_SEVEN_MODULES + REQUIRED_OTHER_FILES:
        if not (ROOT_DIR / rel).exists():
            missing.append(rel)

    if missing:
        print("[ERROR] Missing required files:")
        for m in missing:
            print(f"  - {m}")
        return 1

    print("[OK] All 7 core Python modules and frontend files are present.")

    # Syntax check all Python files
    syntax_errors = []
    for py_file in (ROOT_DIR / "backend").rglob("*.py"):
        try:
            py_compile.compile(str(py_file), doraise=True)
        except py_compile.PyCompileError as exc:
            syntax_errors.append(str(exc))

    if syntax_errors:
        print("[ERROR] Python syntax errors detected:")
        for err in syntax_errors:
            print(err)
        return 1

    print("[OK] All Python backend files passed syntax verification.")

    release_dir = ROOT_DIR / "release" / "rajon-host-simulator"
    if release_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(release_dir)
    release_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    copied_count = 0
    for item in ROOT_DIR.rglob("*"):
        rel = item.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)
        if any(part in EXCLUDE_DIRS for part in rel.parts):
            continue
        if item.name in EXCLUDE_FILES or item.suffix == ".zip":
            continue
        target = release_dir / rel
        if item.is_dir():
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(item, target)
            copied_count += 1

    zip_path = ROOT_DIR / "rajon-host-simulator-release.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for file_path in release_dir.rglob("*"):
            if file_path.is_file():
                arcname = file_path.relative_to(release_dir.parent)
                zf.write(file_path, arcname)

    print(f"[OK] Copied {copied_count} clean source files into {release_dir}")
    print(f"[OK] Created deployable ZIP archive: {zip_path}")
    print("=" * 72)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""tools/fix_final_bugs.py - final bug fixes. Run from project root. Supports --dry-run."""
import datetime, shutil, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator")
DRY = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / ("final_fix_" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"))
failed = []


def load(rel):
    p = ROOT / rel
    raw = p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig")
    return p, raw.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ("\r\n" if "\r\n" in raw else "\n")


def store(rel, p, text, eol):
    if DRY:
        return
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(p, dest)
    p.write_bytes(text.replace("\n", eol).encode("utf-8"))


def fix(rel, old, new, many=False):
    p, text, eol = load(rel)
    if old not in text:
        if new in text:
            print("[SKIP] already applied:", rel)
        else:
            print("[FAIL] anchor not found:", rel, "|", old[:60].replace("\n", " "))
            failed.append(rel)
        return
    if not many and text.count(old) != 1:
        print("[FAIL] anchor not unique:", rel)
        failed.append(rel)
        return
    store(rel, p, text.replace(old, new), eol)
    print(("[DRY] " if DRY else "[OK]  ") + rel)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
install_transaction_log_viewer_v1.py
Part 1 of 3 — Database Schema Extensions, TIC v2.164e Decoder Engine Integration,
Host Engine Trace & Metadata Capture, and Non-Destructive Historical Backfill.
"""

import argparse
import os
import py_compile
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


def detect_project_root(explicit_root: str | None = None) -> Path:
    if explicit_root:
        root = Path(explicit_root).resolve()
    else:
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        if not (root / "backend").exists() and (root.parent / "backend").exists():
            root = root.parent
    required = [
        root / "backend" / "app" / "models.py",
        root / "backend" / "app" / "host_engine.py",
        root / "backend" / "app" / "main.py",
        root / "frontend" / "src",
    ]
    for req in required:
        if not req.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Project structure check failed: missing {req}")
    return root


class SafeInstaller:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, dry_run: bool = False):
        self.root = root
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.backup_dir = root / "_backups" / f"tx_log_viewer_v1_{ts}"
        self.modified_files: list[str] = []
        self.created_files: list[str] = []

    def backup_file(self, path: Path) -> None:
        if not path.exists() or self.dry_run:
            return
        rel = path.relative_to(self.root)
        dest = self.backup_dir / rel
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

    def write_file(self, rel_path: str, content: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        existed = target.exists()
        if existed:
            old = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if old == content:
                print(f"  [=] Unchanged: {rel_path}")
                return
            self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        if existed:
            self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [M] Updated:   {rel_path}")
        else:
            self.created_files.append(rel_path)
            print(f"  [+] Created:   {rel_path}")

    def patch_file(self, rel_path: str, marker: str, anchor: str, replacement: str) -> None:
        target = self.root / rel_path
        if not target.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Target file not found: {rel_path}")
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if marker in text:
            print(f"  [=] Patch already applied ({marker}): {rel_path}")
            return
        if anchor not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Expected anchor not found in {rel_path} for marker {marker}")
        new_text = text.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)
        self.backup_file(target)
        if not self.dry_run:
            target.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        self.modified_files.append(rel_path)
        print(f"  [P] Patched ({marker}): {rel_path}")

    def validate_python_files(self, rel_paths: list[str]) -> None:
        if self.dry_run:
            return
        for rel in rel_paths:
            p = self.root / rel
            if p.exists() and p.suffix == ".py":
                py_compile.compile(str(p), doraise=True)
                print(f"  [OK] Syntax verified: {rel}")

SEP = chr(221)   # Ý
SSEP = chr(179)  # ³


def _unescape(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\\x([0-9a-fA-F]{2})", lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1), 16)), s)


def _decode_bitmap(hex_str: str) -> Tuple[List[int], str]:
    bits = bin(int(hex_str, 16))[2:].zfill(len(hex_str) * 4)
    return [i + 1 for i, b in enumerate(bits) if b == "1"], bits


def _read_bitmap(msg: str, pos: int) -> Tuple[List[int], str, Optional[str], str, int]:
    ph = msg[pos : pos + 16]
    pos += 16
    if bin(int(ph, 16))[2:].zfill(64)[0] == "1":
        sh = msg[pos : pos + 16]
        pos += 16
        fh = ph + sh
    else:
        sh = None
        fh = ph
    fields, bits = _decode_bitmap(fh)
    # Field 1 is secondary bitmap indicator, never returned as a regular data field
    fields = [f for f in fields if f != 1]
    return fields, ph, sh, bits, pos


def _read_field(msg: str, pos: int, fnum: int) -> Tuple[str, int]:
    if fnum not in FIELD_DEFS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported TIC field number: F{fnum}")
    _, _, lt, fl = FIELD_DEFS[fnum]
    if lt == "FIXED":
        if pos + fl > len(msg):
            raise ValueError(f"Field F{fnum} truncated (expected {fl} chars, got {len(msg) - pos})")
        return msg[pos : pos + fl], pos + fl
    if lt == "LVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 1]); pos += 1; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "LLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 2]); pos += 2; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "LLLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 3]); pos += 3; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "LLLLLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos : pos + 5]); pos += 5; return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    if lt == "PLLLLLVAR":
        l = int(msg[pos + 1 : pos + 5]) if msg[pos : pos + 1] == "0" else int(msg[pos : pos + 5])
        pos += 5
        return msg[pos : pos + l], pos + l
    raise ValueError(f"Unhandled length type {lt}")


def _pf3(v: str):
    tc = v[0:3]; fa = v[3:5]; ta = v[5:7]
    detail = {
        "F3.1 Transaction Code":  f"{tc} — {TRAN_CODES.get(tc, 'Configurable / Custom')}",
        "F3.2 From Account Type": f"{fa} — {ACCT_TYPES.get(fa, 'Unknown')}",
        "F3.3 To Account Type":   f"{ta} — {ACCT_TYPES.get(ta, 'Unknown')}",
    }
    return detail, {"F3.1": tc, "F3.2": fa, "F3.3": ta}

    if len(v) == 5:
        retain = v[2]; rc = v[3:5]
        detail = {

            "F39.2 Response Code":         f"{rc} — {RESPONSE_CODES.get(rc, 'Unknown')}",

    rc = v.strip()[:2]
    return {"F39 Response Code": f"{rc} — {RESPONSE_CODES.get(rc, 'Unknown')}"}, {"F39": v}


def _pf43(v: str):
    subs = [
        ("F43.1", 30), ("F43.2", 30), ("F43.3", 3), ("F43.4", 3), ("F43.5", 30),
        ("F43.6", 30), ("F43.7", 30), ("F43.8", 3), ("F43.9", 8), ("F43.10", 10),
        ("F43.11", 4), ("F43.12", 25), ("F43.13", 3), ("F43.14", 9), ("F43.15", 4),
    ]
    labels = [
        "Terminal Owner", "Terminal City", "Terminal State", "Terminal Country",
        "Terminal Address", "Terminal Branch", "Terminal Region", "Terminal Class",
        "Terminal Date", "Terminal PS Name", "Terminal FI Name",
        "Terminal Retailer Name", "Terminal County", "Terminal ZIP Code",
        "Terminal Time Offset",
    ]
    detail = {}; compact = {}; ptr = 0
    for (key, w), label in zip(subs, labels):
        chunk = v[ptr : ptr + w]
        stripped = chunk.strip()
        if key == "F43.8" and stripped:
            detail[f"{key} {label}"] = f"{stripped} — {TERM_CLASS.get(stripped.zfill(3), 'Unknown')}"
        elif stripped:
            detail[f"{key} {label}"] = stripped
        compact[key] = chunk
        ptr += w
    if not detail:
        detail["Terminal Name/Location"] = v.strip()
    return detail, compact

def _parse_uamp(raw: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    text = raw.replace(chr(13), "")
    parts = text.split(chr(16))
    result: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for p in parts:
        p = p.strip(chr(19)).strip()
        if "=" in p:
            k, v = p.split("=", 1)
            k_clean = k.strip()
            v_clean = v.strip()
            if k_clean in ("NP", "RPK"):
                v_clean = "***MASKED_SECRET***"
            elif k_clean in ("P2", "ExtPAN") and v_clean:
                v_clean = mask_pan(v_clean)
            result[k_clean] = v_clean
        elif p:
            result[p] = ""
    return result


def _apply_names(d: Dict[str, str], nm: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    return {f"{k} ({nm[k]})" if k in nm else k: v for k, v in d.items()}


def _uamp_compact(raw: str) -> str:
    d = _parse_uamp(raw)
    return "".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in d.items())


def _build_compact(mti: str, header: Dict[str, str], fields_compact: List[Tuple[int, str, Any]]) -> str:
    short_mti = mti[1:] if len(mti) == 4 else mti
    parts = [f"{short_mti}:", f"H1){header['H1']}{SEP}H2){header['H2']}{SEP}H3){header['H3']}{SEP}"]
    for fnum, raw, compact in fields_compact:
        if isinstance(compact, dict) and len(compact) > 1:
            sub_parts = [f"{k}){v}" for k, v in compact.items()]
            parts.append(SSEP.join(sub_parts) + SSEP + SEP)
        elif isinstance(compact, dict) and len(compact) == 1:
            k, v = next(iter(compact.items()))
            parts.append(f"{k}){v}{SEP}")
        else:
            parts.append(f"F{fnum}){raw}{SEP}")
    return "".join(parts)


def mask_sensitive_wire_string(raw_msg: str) -> str:
    """Mask PAN and PIN blocks in raw TIC or ISO wire strings before returning to UI."""
    if not raw_msg:
        return ""
    out = re.sub(
        r"(A4M\d{5}\d{4}[0-9A-Fa-f]{16,32})(\d{2})(\d{12,19})",
        lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}{mask_pan(m.group(3))}",
        raw_msg,
    )
    out = re.sub(
        r"(F2\))(\d{12,19})",
        lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}{mask_pan(m.group(2))}",
        out,
    )
    out = re.sub(r"(F52\))[0-9A-Fa-f]{16}", r"\1****************", out)
    out = re.sub(r"(F35\))[^Ý]+", r"\1***MASKED_TRACK2***", out)
    out = re.sub(r"(F45\))[^Ý]+", r"\1***MASKED_TRACK1***", out)
    return out


def decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(raw_msg: str, allow_full_pan: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Master decoder entry point reusing `tic_decoder.py` logic for TIC/TCI v2.164e
    and falling back to `iso_standard_codec.py` if an ISO 8583:1987 message is supplied.
    Always returns ascending numeric field order, flat rows for UI tables, subfields,
    warnings, errors, and masked sensitive fields.
    """
    if not raw_msg or not raw_msg.strip():
        return {
            "valid": False,
            "format": "EMPTY",
            "header": {},
            "mti": "",
            "mti_description": "",
            "primary_bitmap": "",
            "secondary_bitmap": None,
            "fields_present": [],
            "parsed_fields": [],
            "flat_rows": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "parse_errors": {"message": "Empty message content"},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": "",
        }

    msg = _unescape(raw_msg.replace("\n", "").replace("\r", "").strip())
    a4m_idx = msg.find("A4M")

    # Standard ISO 8583:1987 fallback if not TIC
    if a4m_idx == -1:
        iso_res = decode_iso8583_1987(msg)
        if not iso_res.get("valid"):
            return {
                "valid": False,
                "format": "UNKNOWN",
                "header": {},
                "mti": iso_res.get("mti", ""),
                "mti_description": "Unknown / Invalid Format",
                "primary_bitmap": "",
                "secondary_bitmap": None,
                "fields_present": [],
                "parsed_fields": [],
                "flat_rows": [],
                "warnings": iso_res.get("warnings", []),
                "parse_errors": {"format": iso_res.get("error", "Missing A4M header")},
                "compact_tic": "",
                "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
            }
        bmap = iso_res.get("bitmap", {})
        raw_f = iso_res.get("raw_fields", {})
        parsed_fields = []
        flat_rows = []
        for fnum in sorted(int(k) for k in raw_f.keys() if str(k).isdigit()):
            if fnum == 1:
                continue
            val = raw_f[str(fnum)]
            fname, dtype, ltype, flen = ISO8583_FIELDS.get(fnum, ("Unknown", "ANS", "LLVAR", None))
            if fnum == 2:
                safe_val = val if allow_full_pan else mask_pan(val)
            elif fnum in (35, 45, 52, 53, 63):
                safe_val = f"***MASKED_F{fnum}***"
            else:
                safe_val = val
            parsed_fields.append({
                "field_number": fnum,
                "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
                "field_name": fname,
                "data_type": dtype,
                "length_type": ltype,
                "raw_value": safe_val,
                "display_value": safe_val,
                "subfields": [{"key": "value", "value": safe_val}],
            })
            flat_rows.append({
                "field_number": fnum,
                "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
                "field_name": fname,
                "subfield_key": fname,
                "value": safe_val,
            })
        mti_val = iso_res["mti"]
        return {
            "valid": True,
            "format": "ISO8583_1987",
            "header": {"Protocol": "ISO 8583:1987"},
            "mti": mti_val,
            "mti_description": MTI_NAMES.get(mti_val, "ISO 8583 Message"),
            "primary_bitmap": bmap.get("primary_hex", ""),
            "secondary_bitmap": bmap.get("secondary_hex"),
            "fields_present": sorted(f for f in bmap.get("fields_present", []) if f != 1),
            "parsed_fields": parsed_fields,
            "flat_rows": flat_rows,
            "warnings": iso_res.get("warnings", []),
            "parse_errors": {},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
        }

    if a4m_idx > 0:
        msg = msg[a4m_idx:]

    if len(msg) < 28:
        return {
            "valid": False,
            "format": "TIC_V2164E",
            "header": {},
            "mti": "",
            "mti_description": "",
            "primary_bitmap": "",
            "secondary_bitmap": None,
            "fields_present": [],
            "parsed_fields": [],
            "flat_rows": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "parse_errors": {"header": "TIC/TCI message is too short (< 28 chars)"},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
        }

    h1, h2, h3 = msg[0:3], msg[3:5], msg[5:8]
    header_info = {
        "H1 Start Indicator": h1,
        "H2 Protocol Version": h2,
        "H3 Reject Status": h3,
    }
    header_for_compact = {"H1": h1, "H2": h2, "H3": h3}
    warnings: List[str] = []

    if h1 != "A4M":
        warnings.append(f"Unexpected start indicator: '{h1}' (expected 'A4M')")
    if h3 != "000":
        rmap = {"001": "Not a TIC/TCI message", "197": "Invalid MAC"}
        warnings.append(f"Reject H3={h3}: {rmap.get(h3, 'Bad field #' + h3)}")

    pos = 8
    mti = msg[pos : pos + 4]
    pos += 4
    if mti.startswith("9"):
        orig = "0" + mti[1:]
        mti_name = f"REJECT of {MTI_NAMES.get(orig, 'Unknown')} ({orig})"
        warnings.append(f"Reject message (MTI={mti})")
    else:
        mti_name = MTI_NAMES.get(mti, "Unknown MTI")

    try:
        present, ph, sh, _, pos = _read_bitmap(msg, pos)
    except Exception as exc:
        return {
            "valid": False,
            "format": "TIC_V2164E",
            "header": header_info,
            "mti": mti,
            "mti_description": mti_name,
            "primary_bitmap": "",
            "secondary_bitmap": None,
            "fields_present": [],
            "parsed_fields": [],
            "flat_rows": [],
            "warnings": warnings,
            "parse_errors": {"bitmap": str(exc)},
            "compact_tic": "",
            "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
        }

    parsed_fields: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    flat_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    parse_errors: Dict[str, str] = {}
    compact_fields: List[Tuple[int, str, Any]] = []

    # Strictly ascending numeric order, never treating Field 1 as a data field
    for fnum in sorted(f for f in present if f != 1):
        try:
            raw_val, pos = _read_field(msg, pos, fnum)
            fname, dtype, ltype, _ = FIELD_DEFS.get(fnum, ("Unknown", "ANS", "LLVAR", None))

            detail: Dict[str, Any] = {}
            compact: Any = None
            safe_raw = raw_val

            if fnum == 2:
                safe_raw = raw_val if allow_full_pan else mask_pan(raw_val)
                detail = {
                    "PAN": safe_raw,
                    "BIN (First 6)": raw_val[:6] if len(raw_val) >= 6 else raw_val,
                    "Length": str(len(raw_val)),
                }
                compact = {"F2": safe_raw}
            elif fnum == 3:
                if len(raw_val) >= 7:
                    detail, compact = _pf3(raw_val)
                else:
                    detail = {"Processing Code": raw_val}
                    compact = {"F3": raw_val}
            elif fnum in (4, 5, 6, 54):
                amt_fmt = f"{int(raw_val)/100:,.2f}" if raw_val.isdigit() else raw_val
                detail = {"Raw Minor Units": raw_val, "Formatted Amount": amt_fmt}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": raw_val}
            elif fnum == 22:
                detail, compact = _pf22(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 25:
                detail, compact = _pf25(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 28:
                detail, compact = _pf28(raw_val)
            elif fnum in (35, 45):
                safe_raw = f"***MASKED_TRACK_{'2' if fnum == 35 else '1'}_DATA***"
                detail = {"Track Data": safe_raw}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": safe_raw}
            elif fnum == 39:
                detail, compact = _pf39(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 43:
                detail, compact = _pf43(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 44:
                detail, compact = _pf44(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 48:
                detail, compact = _pf48(raw_val)
            elif fnum in (52, 53, 63):
                safe_raw = f"***MASKED_{fname.upper().replace(' ', '_')}***"
                detail = {fname: safe_raw}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": "****************"}
            elif fnum == 61:
                detail, compact = _pf61(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 70:
                code = raw_val.strip().lstrip("0") or "0"
                detail = {"F70 Network Mgmt Code": f"{raw_val.strip()} — {NETWORK_MGMT_CODES.get(code, 'Unknown')}"}
                compact = {"F70": raw_val.strip()}
            elif fnum == 95:
                detail, compact = _pf95(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 104:
                net = raw_val.strip()
                detail = {"Host Network ID": f"{net} — {HOST_NET_IDS.get(net, 'Other')}"}
                compact = {"F104": net}
            elif fnum == 105:
                detail, compact = _pf105(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 106:
                detail, compact = _pf106(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 121:
                safe_raw = raw_val[:3] + "***" + raw_val[6:] if len(raw_val) >= 6 else "***"
                detail, compact = _pf121(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 122:
                safe_raw = "***" + raw_val[3:]
                detail, compact = _pf122(raw_val)
            elif fnum == 123:
                uamp = _parse_uamp(raw_val)
                detail = _apply_names(uamp, UAMP_F123_NAMES)
                compact = {"F123": _uamp_compact(raw_val)}
            elif fnum == 124:
                uamp = _parse_uamp(raw_val)
                detail = _apply_names(uamp, UAMP_F124_NAMES)
                compact = {"F124": _uamp_compact(raw_val)}
            elif fnum == 125:
                uamp = _parse_uamp(raw_val)
                detail = _apply_names(uamp, UAMP_F125_NAMES)
                compact = {"F125": _uamp_compact(raw_val)}
            elif fnum == 126:
                detail, compact = _pf126(raw_val)
            else:
                detail = {fname: raw_val.strip()}
                compact = {f"F{fnum}": raw_val}

            sub_list = [{"key": k, "value": str(v)} for k, v in detail.items() if v is not None and str(v) != ""]
            if not sub_list:
                sub_list = [{"key": fname, "value": safe_raw.strip()}]

            summary_val = (
                " | ".join(f"{s['key']}: {s['value']}" for s in sub_list)
                if len(sub_list) > 1
                else sub_list[0]["value"]
            )

            parsed_fields.append({
                "field_number": fnum,
                "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
                "field_name": fname,
                "data_type": dtype,
                "length_type": ltype,
                "raw_value": safe_raw,
                "display_value": summary_val,
                "subfields": sub_list,
            })

            for idx, s in enumerate(sub_list):
                flat_rows.append({
                    "field_number": fnum,
                    "field_tag": f"F{fnum}" if idx == 0 else "",
                    "field_name": fname if idx == 0 else "",
                    "subfield_key": s["key"],
                    "value": s["value"],
                })

            compact_fields.append((fnum, safe_raw, compact))
        except Exception as exc:
            parse_errors[f"F{fnum}"] = str(exc)
            warnings.append(f"Error reading F{fnum}: {exc}")
            break

    remaining = msg[pos:]
    if remaining:
        warnings.append(f"{len(remaining)} unparsed trailing character(s)")

    compact_line = _build_compact(mti, header_for_compact, compact_fields)
    return {
        "valid": len(parse_errors) == 0,
        "format": "TIC_V2164E",
        "header": header_info,
        "mti": mti,
        "mti_description": mti_name,
        "primary_bitmap": ph,
        "secondary_bitmap": sh if sh else None,
        "fields_present": sorted(f for f in present if f != 1),
        "parsed_fields": parsed_fields,
        "flat_rows": flat_rows,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "parse_errors": parse_errors,
        "compact_tic": compact_line,
        "sanitized_raw": mask_sensitive_wire_string(msg),
    }


def extract_metadata_from_tic(raw_msg: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Extracts structured transaction columns from a raw TIC message for DB persistence & backfill."""
    dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(raw_msg, allow_full_pan=False)
    fmap = {f["field_number"]: f for f in dec.get("parsed_fields", [])}

    def _raw(fnum: int) -> Optional[str]:
        return fmap[fnum]["raw_value"].strip() if fnum in fmap and fmap[fnum].get("raw_value") else None

    f43_subs = {s["key"]: s["value"] for s in fmap.get(43, {}).get("subfields", [])}
    term_owner = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.1 " in k), None)
    term_city = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.2 " in k), None)
    term_addr = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.5 " in k), None)
    merch_name = next((v for k, v in f43_subs.items() if "F43.12" in k), None) or term_owner

    f3_raw = _raw(3) or ""
    tc_prefix = f3_raw[:3] if len(f3_raw) >= 3 else ""
    tx_type_name = TRAN_CODES.get(tc_prefix)

    return {
        "mcc": _raw(18),
        "pos_entry_mode": _raw(22),
        "pos_condition_code": _raw(25),
        "acquirer_id": _raw(32),
        "forwarding_id": _raw(33),
        "approval_code": _raw(38),
        "terminal_id": _raw(41),
        "terminal_owner": term_owner,
        "terminal_name": term_addr or term_city or _raw(41),
        "merchant_name": merch_name,
        "source_account": _raw(102),
        "destination_account": _raw(103),
        "transaction_type_name": tx_type_name,
    }


def compare_request_and_response(req_raw: Optional[str], resp_raw: Optional[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Builds a side-by-side comparison of Request vs Response ISO/TIC fields in ascending numeric order."""
    req_dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(req_raw or "") if req_raw else {"parsed_fields": []}
    resp_dec = decode_full_tic_or_iso_message(resp_raw or "") if resp_raw else {"parsed_fields": []}

    req_map = {f["field_number"]: f for f in req_dec.get("parsed_fields", [])}
    resp_map = {f["field_number"]: f for f in resp_dec.get("parsed_fields", [])}

    all_fnums = sorted(set(req_map.keys()) | set(resp_map.keys()))
    comparison: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for fnum in all_fnums:
        if fnum == 1:
            continue
        rf = req_map.get(fnum)
        spf = resp_map.get(fnum)
        fname = (rf or spf or {}).get("field_name") or FIELD_DEFS.get(fnum, ("Unknown",))[0]
        req_val = rf["display_value"] if rf else None
        resp_val = spf["display_value"] if spf else None
        comparison.append({
            "field_number": fnum,
            "field_tag": f"F{fnum}",
            "field_name": fname,
            "in_request": rf is not None,
            "in_response": spf is not None,
            "request_value": req_val,
            "response_value": resp_val,
            "differs": (req_val or "") != (resp_val or ""),
        })
    return comparison


def export_decoded_message_excel_bytes(decoded: Dict[str, Any], rrn: str = "TX") -> Optional[bytes]:
    """Generates an in-memory `.xlsx` report using the styling from `tic_decoder.py`."""
    if not HAS_OPENPYXL:
        return None
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")

    C_NAVY = "1B2A4A"
    C_TEAL = "0D6E6E"
    C_STEEL = "2E5F8A"
    C_ICE = "E8F4FD"
    C_LTGRAY = "F5F5F5"
    C_GOLD = "D4AF37"
    C_BORDER = "B0BEC5"

    def _fill(c): return PatternFill("solid", fgColor=c)
    def _font(b=False, c="000000", s=10, it=False): return Font(bold=b, color=c, size=s, italic=it, name="Calibri")
    def _border(st="thin", c=C_BORDER):
        sd = Side(style=st, color=c)
        return Border(left=sd, right=sd, top=sd, bottom=sd)
    def _align(h="left", v="center", w=False): return Alignment(horizontal=h, vertical=v, wrap_text=w)

    ws1 = wb.active
    ws1.title = "Summary"
    ws1.column_dimensions["A"].width = 28
    ws1.column_dimensions["B"].width = 65

    c = ws1.cell(row=1, column=1, value="TIC / TCI ISO 8583 · Decoded Message Report")
    c.fill = _fill(C_NAVY); c.font = _font(True, "FFFFFF", 13); c.alignment = _align("center")
    ws1.merge_cells("A1:B1")

    c2 = ws1.cell(row=2, column=1, value=f"Reference (RRN): {rrn} | Generated: {ts}")
    c2.fill = _fill(C_NAVY); c2.font = _font(False, "D0D0D0", 10, True); c2.alignment = _align("center")
    ws1.merge_cells("A2:B2")

    overview = [
        ("Format", decoded.get("format", "TIC_V2164E")),
        ("MTI", f"{decoded.get('mti', '')} — {decoded.get('mti_description', '')}"),
        ("Primary Bitmap", decoded.get("primary_bitmap", "")),
        ("Secondary Bitmap", decoded.get("secondary_bitmap") or "— not present"),
        ("Fields Present", str(decoded.get("fields_present", []))),
    ]
    for k, v in (decoded.get("header") or {}).items():
        overview.append((k, str(v)))

    r = 4
    for idx, (k, v) in enumerate(overview):
        bg = C_ICE if idx % 2 == 0 else C_LTGRAY
        ca = ws1.cell(row=r, column=1, value=k)
        cb = ws1.cell(row=r, column=2, value=v)
        ca.fill = _fill(bg); ca.font = _font(True); ca.border = _border()
        cb.fill = _fill(bg); cb.font = _font(False); cb.border = _border()
        r += 1

    r += 1
    ct = ws1.cell(row=r, column=1, value="COMPACT TIC-FORMAT OUTPUT")
    ct.fill = _fill(C_TEAL); ct.font = _font(True, "FFFFFF", 11)
    ws1.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=2)
    r += 1
    cc = ws1.cell(row=r, column=1, value=decoded.get("compact_tic", ""))
    cc.fill = _fill("FFF8E1"); cc.font = _font(False, "5D4037", 9, True)
    cc.alignment = _align("left", "center", True); cc.border = _border("medium", C_GOLD)
    ws1.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=2)

    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("Fields Detail")
    ws2.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws2.column_dimensions["B"].width = 34
    ws2.column_dimensions["C"].width = 38
    ws2.column_dimensions["D"].width = 55

    headers = ["Field", "Field Name", "Subfield / Key", "Value"]
    for ci, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
        hc = ws2.cell(row=1, column=ci, value=h)
        hc.fill = _fill(C_STEEL); hc.font = _font(True, "FFFFFF", 10); hc.alignment = _align("center")

    for idx, row_item in enumerate(decoded.get("flat_rows", []), start=2):
        bg = C_ICE if idx % 2 == 0 else C_LTGRAY
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=1, value=row_item["field_tag"]).fill = _fill(bg)
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=2, value=row_item["field_name"]).fill = _fill(bg)
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=3, value=row_item["subfield_key"]).fill = _fill(bg)
        ws2.cell(row=idx, column=4, value=row_item["value"]).fill = _fill(bg)

    buf = io.BytesIO()
    wb.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()
'''


def apply_v1(installer: SafeInstaller) -> None:
    # 1. Write tic_decoder_engine.py
    installer.write_file("backend/app/tic_decoder_engine.py", TIC_DECODER_ENGINE_PY)

    # 2. Patch backend/app/models.py to add additive columns on Transaction and TransactionTraceEvent table
    models_anchor = '    response_message_reference: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36))\n'
    models_replacement = (
        '    response_message_reference: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(36))\n'
        '# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:transaction_extra_columns]\n'
        '    correlation_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(60), index=True)\n'
        '    approval_code: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(12))\n'
        '    mcc: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(10), index=True)\n'
        '    pos_entry_mode: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(10))\n'
        '    pos_condition_code: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(10))\n'
        '    acquirer_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(30), index=True)\n'
        '    forwarding_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(30))\n'
        '    terminal_name: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(120))\n'
        '    terminal_owner: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(120))\n'
        '    merchant_name: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(120))\n'
        '    source_account: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(40), index=True)\n'
        '    destination_account: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(40))\n'
        '    transaction_type_name: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(80))\n'
        '    decline_reason: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(250))\n'
        '    processing_duration_ms: Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(Integer, default=1)\n'
    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/models.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:transaction_extra_columns]",
        models_anchor,
        models_replacement,
    )

    trace_model_anchor = '    processing_system: Mapped[Optional["ProcessingSystem"]] = relationship("ProcessingSystem", foreign_keys=[processing_system_id])\n'
    trace_model_replacement = trace_model_anchor + '''

# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:transaction_trace_event_model]
class TransactionTraceEvent(Base):
    """
    Structured transaction-wise processing trace event recorded during actual pipeline execution
    or reconstructed from persisted TransactionCheck/HsmOperation/AccountLedger records.
    """
    __tablename__ = "transaction_trace_events"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=gen_uuid)
    transaction_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), ForeignKey("transactions.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    correlation_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(60), index=True)
    event_order: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    event_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(60), nullable=False)
    event_category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False, default="PIPELINE")
    event_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False)
    event_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default="COMPLETED")
    response_code: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(10))
    duration_ms: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
    message: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    details_json: Mapped[Optional[Dict[str, Any]]] = mapped_column(JSON)
    event_timestamp: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=utc_now, index=True)
'''
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/models.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:transaction_trace_event_model]",
        trace_model_anchor,
        trace_model_replacement,
    )

    # 3. Patch backend/app/host_engine.py to capture extra fields, timing, and TransactionTraceEvent rows
    he_import_anchor = "from app.security import mask_pan, mask_raw_tic_message\n"
    he_import_replacement = (
        "from app.security import mask_pan, mask_raw_tic_message\n"
        "# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:host_engine_imports]\n"
        "from app.context_trace import get_correlation_id\n"
        "from app.tic_decoder_engine import extract_metadata_from_tic, TRAN_CODES\n"
        "from app.models import TransactionTraceEvent\n"
    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/host_engine.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:host_engine_imports]",
        he_import_anchor,
        he_import_replacement,
    )

    he_init_anchor = "        self.checks_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n        self.check_counter: int = 0\n"
    he_init_replacement = (
        "        self.checks_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n"
        "        self.check_counter: int = 0\n"
        "# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:host_engine_start_timer]\n"

    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/host_engine.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:host_engine_start_timer]",
        he_init_anchor,
        he_init_replacement,
    )

    he_tx_anchor = '            completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),\n        )\n        self.db.add(tx)\n        self.db.flush()\n'
    he_tx_replacement = '''            completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )
# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v1:populate_tx_metadata_and_trace]
        tic_meta = extract_metadata_from_tic(raw_request_msg)
        f3_code = (fields.get("3", "0100000") or "0100000")[:3]

        tx.processing_duration_ms = max(1, int((time.perf_counter() - getattr(self, "pipeline_t0", time.perf_counter())) * 1000))
        failed_chk = next((c for c in self.checks_log if c["check_status"] == "FAILED"), None)
        tx.decline_reason = failed_chk["message"] if (not approved and failed_chk) else (None if approved else resp_desc)

        self.db.add(tx)
        self.db.flush()

        # Persist structured TransactionTraceEvent records for actual executed stages
        trace_order = 1
        self.db.add(TransactionTraceEvent(
            transaction_id=tx.id,
            correlation_id=tx.correlation_id,
            event_order=trace_order,
            event_code="TRANSACTION_RECEIVED",
            event_category="INGRESS",
            event_name="TRANSACTION RECEIVED",
            event_status="PASSED",
            response_code="00",
            duration_ms=1,
            message=f"Incoming {mti} transaction {tx_ref} received via {source_channel} (STAN {tx.stan}, RRN {tx.rrn}).",
        ))
        for chk in self.checks_log:
            trace_order += 1
            cname_up = chk["check_name"].upper()
            cat = "VALIDATION"
            if "MESSAGE" in cname_up:
                cat = "PARSING"
            elif "ROUTING" in cname_up or "NETWORK" in cname_up:
                cat = "ROUTING"
