                          {Object.entries(dec.parse_errors || {}).map(([k, v]) => (
                            <div key={k} className="text-rose-300">
                              🔴 Parse Error ({k}): {String(v)}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {isoViewMode === 'RAW' ? (
                        <div className="space-y-3">
                          <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4">
                            <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
                              Sanitized Raw Wire Frame
                            </div>
                            <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
                              {activeMsg.raw_message}
                            </pre>
                          </div>
                          {dec.compact_tic && (
                            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-amber-500/30 rounded-xl p-4">
                              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase text-amber-400 mb-1.5">
                                Rajon TIC Compact Format (Ý / ³ Delimiters)
                              </div>
                              <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-amber-200 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
                                {dec.compact_tic}
                              </pre>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-800">
                            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200">
                              Parsed Fields (Ascending Numeric Order · {filteredFields.length} Fields)
                            </span>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={isoFieldSearch}
                              onChange={(e) => setIsoFieldSearch(e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="Search field number, name, or value..."
                              className="w-64 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                            <thead>
                              <tr className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 border-b border-slate-800">
                                <th className="py-2 px-3 w-20">Field</th>
                                <th className="py-2 px-3 w-56">Field Name</th>
                                <th className="py-2 px-3 w-56">Subfield / Key</th>
                                <th className="py-2 px-3">Decoded Value</th>
                                <th className="py-2 px-3 w-20 text-right">Copy</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-mono">
                              {filteredFields.map((f: any) => {
                                const subs = f.subfields || [{ key: f.field_name, value: f.display_value }];
                                const isMulti = subs.length > 1;
                                const isExp = expandedFields[f.field_number] ?? true;
                                return (
                                  <React.Fragment key={f.field_number}>
                                    {subs.map((sub: any, sIdx: number) => {
                                      if (sIdx > 0 && !isExp) return null;
                                      return (
                                        <tr key={`${f.field_number}-${sIdx}`} className="hover:bg-slate-900/50">
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-bold text-indigo-300">
                                            {sIdx === 0 ? (
                                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span>{f.field_tag}</span>
                                                {isMulti && (
                                                  <button
                                                    type="button"
                                                    onClick={() =>
                                                      setExpandedFields({
                                                        ...expandedFields,
                                                        [f.field_number]: !isExp,
                                                      })
                                                    }
                                                    className="text-[10px] px-1 rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-400"
                                                  >
                                                    {isExp ? '−' : `+${subs.length}`}
                                                  </button>
                                                )}
                                              </div>
                                            ) : (
                                              ''
                                            )}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-sans font-semibold text-slate-200">
                                            {sIdx === 0 ? f.field_name : ''}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-sans text-slate-400">{sub.key}</td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-emerald-300 break-all">{sub.value}</td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right">
                                            <button
                                              type="button"
                                              onClick={() => copyText(`${f.field_number}-${sIdx}`, String(sub.value))}
                                              className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                                              title="Copy field value"
                                            >
                                              {copiedKey === `${f.field_number}-${sIdx}` ? (
                                                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                                              ) : (
                                                <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                              )}
                                            </button>
                                          </td>
                                        </tr>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                  </React.Fragment>
                                );
                              })}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })()
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 4: KEYS & CRYPTO */}
          {!tabLoading && activeTab === 'CRYPTO' && cryptoData && (

          {activeTab === 'TRACE' && (

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5">

                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {!traceData && !tabLoading && (
                <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-dashed border-slate-800 rounded-xl py-14 text-center space-y-3">
                  <Terminal className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-400 mx-auto" />
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">
                    Click [ Generate / Load Transaction Trace ] above to inspect the stage-by-stage execution log
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto">
                    Displays exact timestamps, stage durations, and validation outcomes recorded during the transaction lifecycle.
                  </p>

              )}

              {traceData && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  {/* Formatted Switch Log Output */}
                  <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 overflow-x-auto">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-400 mb-2">
                      Switch Investigation Trace Output
                    </div>
                    <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                      {traceData.formatted_trace}
                    </pre>
                  </div>

                  {/* Structured Timeline Cards */}
                  <div className="bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 mb-2">
                      Structured Stage Timeline ({traceData.events?.length || 0} Stages · Total {traceData.total_duration_ms} ms)
                    </div>
                    {(traceData.events || []).map((ev: any) => (
                      <div
                        key={ev.event_order}
                        className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 flex items-start justify-between gap-2"
                      >
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-indigo-400 font-bold">
                              #{ev.event_order}
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-bold text-white">{ev.event_name}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 font-mono">
                              {ev.event_category}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-slate-300 mt-1">{ev.message}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right font-mono shrink-0">
                          <span
                            className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              ev.event_status === 'PASSED' || ev.event_status === 'APPROVED'
                                ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                                : 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {ev.event_status}
                          </span>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1">{ev.duration_ms} ms</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 6: RELATED TRANSACTIONS */}
          {!tabLoading && activeTab === 'RELATED' && relatedData && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white">
                    Linked Lifecycle &amp; Related Transactions (RRN {relatedData.rrn} / STAN {relatedData.stan})
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                    Linked strictly by Original Transaction FK, Reversal Registry, RRN/STAN, or Correlation ID.
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-300 font-mono text-xs font-semibold">
                  {relatedData.related_count} Linked Record(s)
                </span>
              </div>

              {relatedData.related_count === 0 ? (
                <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                  No reversals, clearing advices, or duplicate transmissions are linked to this transaction.
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                  <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 border-b border-slate-800">
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Relationship</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Txn ID</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Date / Time</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">MTI</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Type</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">RRN / STAN</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Amount</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Status</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Link Basis</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Open</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-mono">
                      {(relatedData.related_transactions || []).map((rt: any) => (
                        <tr key={rt.id} className="hover:bg-slate-900/60">
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-sans">
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-300 font-semibold text-[11px]">
                              {rt.relationship_type}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-white font-semibold">{rt.transaction_reference}</td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-slate-300">
                            {rt.date} {rt.time}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center text-indigo-300">{rt.mti}</td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-sans text-slate-200">{rt.transaction_type}</td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-slate-300">
                            {rt.rrn} / {rt.stan}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right text-white font-semibold">
                            {Number(rt.amount).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} {rt.currency}

                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center font-sans">
                            <StatusBadge status={rt.status} />
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-sans text-slate-400">{rt.link_basis}</td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right font-sans">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onSelectRelatedTx(rt.id)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-[11px] font-semibold"
                            >
                              Open <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// Helper UI Subcomponents
const DetailSection: React.FC<{
  title: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ title, action, children }) => (
  <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-2">

  label,
  value,
  mono,
}) => (

    <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0">{label}:</span>
    <span className={`text-right text-slate-200 break-all ${mono ? 'font-mono font-medium' : ''}`}>
      {value ?? '—'}
    </span>
  </div>
);

export default TransactionLogViewerPage;

# ==============================================================================
# 4. SMART FRONTEND ROUTER & SIDEBAR PATCHERS
# ==============================================================================

def patch_frontend_app_tsx(installer: SafeInstaller) -> None:
    rel = "frontend/src/App.tsx"
    path = installer.root / rel
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "TransactionLogViewerPage" in text:
        print(f"  [=] {rel} already imports TransactionLogViewerPage")
        return

    # 1. Insert import at top after last import
    import_stmt = "import { TransactionLogViewerPage } from './pages/TransactionLogViewerPage';\n"
    last_import_match = list(re.finditer(r"^import .+?;\s*$", text, flags=re.MULTILINE))
    if last_import_match:
        idx = last_import_match[-1].end()
        text = text[:idx] + "\n" + import_stmt + text[idx:]
    else:
        text = import_stmt + text

    # 2. Insert Route for /transaction-logs
    if "<Route" in text:
        route_jsx = '          <Route path="/transaction-logs" element={<TransactionLogViewerPage />} />\n'
        if "</Routes>" in text:
            text = text.replace("</Routes>", route_jsx + "        </Routes>", 1)

    installer.backup_file(path)
    if not installer.dry_run:
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    installer.modified_files.append(rel)
    print(f"  [P] Wired /transaction-logs route in {rel}")


def patch_frontend_layout_tsx(installer: SafeInstaller) -> None:
    rel = "frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx"
    path = installer.root / rel
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "/transaction-logs" in text:
        print(f"  [=] {rel} already contains /transaction-logs navigation item")
        return

    # Detect existing nav item pattern in Layout.tsx
    # Pattern A: { to: '/log-portal', label: '...', icon: ... } or { path: '/log-portal', ... }
    inserted = False

    # Try matching object literal with '/log-portal' or '/simulator'
    for anchor_route in ("'/log-portal'", '"/log-portal"', "'/simulator'", '"/simulator"'):
        pos = text.find(anchor_route)
        if pos != -1:
            # Find enclosing { ... }
            line_start = text.rfind("\n", 0, pos) + 1
            line_end = text.find("\n", pos)
            if line_end == -1:
                line_end = len(text)
            sample_line = text[line_start:line_end]

            # Build matching line for Transaction Log Viewer
            new_line = sample_line.replace(anchor_route, "'/transaction-logs'")
            # Replace label/name value inside the line
            new_line = re.sub(
                r"(label|name|title)\s*:\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]",
                r"\1: 'Transaction Log Viewer'",
                new_line,
            )
            if "Transaction Log Viewer" not in new_line:
                # Fallback if label was on another line
                continue
            if not new_line.rstrip().endswith(","):
                new_line = new_line.rstrip() + ","
            text = text[:line_end] + "\n" + new_line + text[line_end:]
            inserted = True
            break

    # Pattern B: JSX <NavLink to="/log-portal"...> or <Link to="/log-portal"...>
    if not inserted:
        nav_match = re.search(
            r'(<(?:NavLink|Link)\s+[^>]*to=["\']/log-portal["\'][\s\S]*?</(?:NavLink|Link)>)',
            text,
        )
        if nav_match:
            block = nav_match.group(1)
            new_block = block.replace("/log-portal", "/transaction-logs")
            new_block = re.sub(r">([^<]+)</", ">Transaction Log Viewer</", new_block, count=1)
            text = text.replace(block, block + "\n" + new_block, 1)
            inserted = True

    if not inserted:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Could not safely locate navigation anchor in {rel}")

    installer.backup_file(path)
    if not installer.dry_run:
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    installer.modified_files.append(rel)
    print(f"  [P] Added 'Transaction Log Viewer' sidebar link in {rel}")


# ==============================================================================
# 5. APPLY ALL PART 3 CHANGES
# ==============================================================================

def apply_v3(installer: SafeInstaller) -> None:
    # 1. Create database_indexes_tx_logs.py
    installer.write_file("backend/app/database_indexes_tx_logs.py", DATABASE_INDEXES_PY)

    # 2. Wire ensure_transaction_log_indexes into backend/app/database.py
    db_anchor = "    synchronize_database_schema(engine, Base)\n"
    db_replacement = (
        "    synchronize_database_schema(engine, Base)\n"
        "# [PATCH tx_log_viewer_v3:ensure_tx_log_indexes]\n"
        "    from app.database_indexes_tx_logs import ensure_transaction_log_indexes\n"
        "    ensure_transaction_log_indexes(engine)\n"
    )
    installer.patch_file(
        "backend/app/database.py",
        "[PATCH tx_log_viewer_v3:ensure_tx_log_indexes]",
        db_anchor,
        db_replacement,
    )

    # 3. Extend transaction_logs_router.py with column preferences endpoints
    router_rel = "backend/app/routers/transaction_logs_router.py"
    router_path = installer.root / router_rel
    router_text = router_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Install Transaction Log Viewer Part 3 (Indexes, Frontend UI, Navigation & Tests)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--project-root", default=None, help="Explicit path to project root")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate without modifying files")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-build-check", action="store_true", help="Skip npm build check")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = detect_project_root(args.project_root)
    print(f"=== RAJON Transaction Log Viewer Installer v3 (Final) ===\nProject Root: {root}\nDry Run: {args.dry_run}")
    installer = SafeInstaller(root, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    apply_v3(installer)

    if not args.dry_run:
        # 1. Sync DB indexes
        sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "backend"))
        from app.database import init_db
        init_db()
        print("  [OK] Database performance indexes verified.")

        # 2. Run pytest verification if pytest is installed
        try:
            res = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "backend/tests/test_transaction_log_viewer.py", "-q"],
                cwd=str(root),
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
            )
            if res.returncode == 0:
                print(f"  [OK] Pytest suite passed:\n{res.stdout.strip()}")
            else:
                print(f"  [!] Pytest output:\n{res.stdout}\n{res.stderr}")
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"  [i] Skipped pytest auto-run: {exc}")

        # 3. Optional frontend TypeScript / Vite check
        if not args.skip_build_check and (root / "frontend" / "package.json").exists():
            npm_cmd = "npm.cmd" if os.name == "nt" else "npm"
            try:
                b_res = subprocess.run(
                    [npm_cmd, "run", "build"],
                    cwd=str(root / "frontend"),
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    timeout=120,
                )
                if b_res.returncode == 0:
                    print("  [OK] Frontend production build (`npm run build`) succeeded.")
                else:
                    print(f"  [!] Frontend build output:\n{b_res.stdout}\n{b_res.stderr}")
            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"  [i] Skipped frontend build check: {exc}")

    print("\n--- Summary (Installer v3) ---")
    print(f"Created files  ({len(installer.created_files)}): {installer.created_files}")
    print(f"Modified files ({len(installer.modified_files)}): {installer.modified_files}")
    if not args.dry_run and installer.modified_files:
        print(f"Backups stored in: {installer.backup_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""tools/fix_final_bugs.py - final bug fixes. Run from project root. Supports --dry-run."""
import datetime, shutil, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator")
DRY = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
BACKUP = ROOT / "_backups" / ("final_fix_" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"))
failed = []


def load(rel):
    p = ROOT / rel
    raw = p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig")
    return p, raw.replace("\r\n", "\n"), ("\r\n" if "\r\n" in raw else "\n")


def store(rel, p, text, eol):
    if DRY:
        return
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(p, dest)
    p.write_bytes(text.replace("\n", eol).encode("utf-8"))


def fix(rel, old, new, many=False):
    p, text, eol = load(rel)
    if old not in text:
        if new in text:
            print("[SKIP] already applied:", rel)
        else:
            print("[FAIL] anchor not found:", rel, "|", old[:60].replace("\n", " "))
            failed.append(rel)
        return
    if not many and text.count(old) != 1:
        print("[FAIL] anchor not unique:", rel)
        failed.append(rel)
        return
    store(rel, p, text.replace(old, new), eol)
    print(("[DRY] " if DRY else "[OK]  ") + rel)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
fix_all_issues.py (Part 1 of 3 — Master Orchestrator, Database Models, Schemas & Seed Data)
===========================================================================================
RAJON Private Host Simulator — Enterprise Payment Switch Review, Bug Fixes & Feature Pack

Designed by Senior Payment Switch Architect (Visa/Mastercard/ITCL QCash Host Engineering).
Works seamlessly with your existing `tools/patcher.py` conventions, creates timestamped
backups in `_backups/`, supports `--dry-run`, and is 100% idempotent.

Split Architecture (3 Parts to avoid truncation and maintain clean modularity):
  - fix_all_issues.py        (Part 1: Models, Schemas, Seed Data & Master Orchestrator)
  - fix_all_issues_part2.py  (Part 2: Routers, API Endpoints, Limit Reset, Routing Engine)
  - fix_all_issues_part3.py  (Part 3: Frontend React/TSX Pages & Automated Test Suite)

Usage from project root:
  python fix_all_issues.py --dry-run
  python fix_all_issues.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import py_compile
import shutil
import sys
from typing import Dict, List, Optional


def resolve_project_root() -> Path:
    """Dynamically locate the project root whether run from root or tools/."""
    candidates = [
        Path.cwd(),
        Path(__file__).resolve().parent,
        Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent,
        Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator"),
    ]
    for cand in candidates:
        if (cand / "backend" / "app" / "models.py").exists() and (cand / "frontend" / "src" / "App.tsx").exists():
            return cand.resolve()
    raise RuntimeError(
        "CRITICAL: Could not locate RAJON Host Simulator project root "
        "(expected backend/app/models.py and frontend/src/App.tsx). "
        "Please run this script from your project root directory."
    )


PROJECT_ROOT = resolve_project_root()
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))


class SafeRepairEngine:
    """
    Self-contained, idempotent, backup-first repair engine compatible with `tools/patcher.py`.
    Verifies project structure, creates timestamped backups in `_backups/`, compiles Python
    files immediately after writing, and tracks all applied modifications.
    """

    PROTECTED_NAMES = {".env", "rajon_host.db", "rajon_host.db-journal", "rajon_host.db-wal"}
    PROTECTED_EXTS = {".db", ".sqlite", ".sqlite3"}

    def __init__(self, step_id: str, title: str, dry_run: bool = False):
        self.step_id = step_id
        self.title = title
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        self.timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.backup_dir = PROJECT_ROOT / "_backups" / f"{self.step_id}_{self.timestamp}"
        self.backed_up: set[Path] = set()
        self.summary: List[str] = []
        self.errors: List[str] = []

    def _safe_path(self, rel_path: str) -> Path:
        clean = rel_path.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
        target = (PROJECT_ROOT / clean).resolve()
        if not str(target).startswith(str(PROJECT_ROOT)):
            raise ValueError(f"Path escapes project root: {rel_path}")
        if target.name in self.PROTECTED_NAMES or target.suffix.lower() in self.PROTECTED_EXTS:
            raise ValueError(f"Refusing to touch protected file: {rel_path}")
        return target

    @staticmethod
    def _to_crlf(text: str) -> str:
        return text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").replace("\n", "\r\n")

    @staticmethod
    def _sha256(text: str) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _backup(self, target: Path) -> None:
        if not target.exists() or target in self.backed_up:
            return
        rel = target.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)
        dest = self.backup_dir / rel
        if not self.dry_run:
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(target, dest)
        self.backed_up.add(target)

    def write_file(self, rel_path: str, content: str, description: str = "") -> bool:
        try:
            target = self._safe_path(rel_path)
            norm = self._to_crlf(content)
            if target.exists():
                existing_norm = self._to_crlf(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
                if self._sha256(existing_norm) == self._sha256(norm):
                    msg = f"[SKIP-IDENTICAL] {rel_path} ({description or 'already up to date'})"
                    print(" ", msg)
                    self.summary.append(msg)
                    return True
                self._backup(target)
                op = "UPDATED"
            else:
                op = "CREATED"

            if not self.dry_run:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                    f.write(norm)
                if target.suffix.lower() == ".py":
                    py_compile.compile(str(target), doraise=True)

            tag = f"DRY_RUN_{op}" if self.dry_run else op
            msg = f"[{tag}] {rel_path} — {description or f'{len(norm.splitlines())} lines'}"
            print(" ", msg)
            self.summary.append(msg)
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            err = f"[ERROR] {rel_path}: {exc}"
            print(" ", err)
            self.errors.append(err)
            return False

    def patch_anchor(
        self,
        rel_path: str,
        marker: str,
        anchor: str,
        replacement: str,
        mode: str = "replace",
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Idempotent anchored modification.
        mode: "replace" | "insert_after" | "insert_before" | "append"
        """
        try:
            target = self._safe_path(rel_path)
            if not target.exists():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing target file: {rel_path}")

            raw = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            work = raw.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
            ext = target.suffix.lower()
            comment_marker = f"// [PATCH {marker}]" if ext in {".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".css"} else f"# [PATCH {marker}]"

            if comment_marker in work or f"[PATCH {marker}]" in work:
                msg = f"[SKIP-IDEMPOTENT] {rel_path} [{marker}] already applied"
                print(" ", msg)
                self.summary.append(msg)
                return True

            anchor_lf = anchor.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
            rep_lf = replacement.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

            if mode == "append":
                sep = "" if work.endswith("\n") else "\n"
                work = f"{work}{sep}\n{comment_marker}\n{rep_lf}\n"
            else:
                if anchor_lf not in work:
                    raise ValueError(f"Expected anchor for [{marker}] not found in {rel_path}")
                if mode == "replace":
                    work = work.replace(anchor_lf, f"{comment_marker}\n{rep_lf}", 1)
                elif mode == "insert_after":
                    work = work.replace(anchor_lf, f"{anchor_lf}\n{comment_marker}\n{rep_lf}", 1)
                elif mode == "insert_before":
                    work = work.replace(anchor_lf, f"{comment_marker}\n{rep_lf}\n{anchor_lf}", 1)
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f"Unknown patch mode: {mode}")

            self._backup(target)
            final_crlf = self._to_crlf(work)
            if not self.dry_run:
                with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                    f.write(final_crlf)
                if ext == ".py":
                    py_compile.compile(str(target), doraise=True)

            tag = "DRY_RUN_PATCHED" if self.dry_run else "PATCHED"
            msg = f"[{tag}] {rel_path} [{marker}]"
            print(" ", msg)
            self.summary.append(msg)
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            err = f"[ERROR] {rel_path} [{marker}]: {exc}"
            print(" ", err)
            self.errors.append(err)
            return False

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=utc_now)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=utc_now, onupdate=utc_now)

    issuer_institution: Mapped[Optional["Institution"]] = relationship("Institution", foreign_keys=[issuer_institution_id])
    acquirer_institution: Mapped[Optional["Institution"]] = relationship("Institution", foreign_keys=[acquirer_institution_id])

def apply_part1(engine: SafeRepairEngine) -> None:
    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("  STEP 1 / 3: APPLYING DATABASE MODELS, SCHEMAS & SEED DATA")
    print("=" * 78)

    # 1. Patch backend/app/models.py: Remove dangerous delete-orphan on Customer & add PanRoutingRule
    models_path = PROJECT_ROOT / "backend" / "app" / "models.py"
    models_txt = models_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").replace("\r\n", "\n")

    if MODELS_OLD_CUSTOMER_REL in models_txt:
        engine.patch_anchor(
            "backend/app/models.py",
            "fix_customer_cascade_500",
            MODELS_OLD_CUSTOMER_REL,
            MODELS_NEW_CUSTOMER_REL,
            mode="replace",
        )

    engine.patch_anchor(
        "backend/app/models.py",
        "add_pan_routing_rule_model",
        "",
        MODELS_LIMIT_RESET_AND_PAN_ROUTING,
        mode="append",
    )

    # 2. Patch backend/app/schemas.py: Add LimitUsageReset & PanRoutingRule schemas
    engine.patch_anchor(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        "add_limit_reset_and_pan_routing_schemas",
        "",
        SCHEMAS_APPEND_PAYLOAD,
        mode="append",
    )

    # 3. Patch backend/app/seed_data.py: Seed PanRoutingRule & sanitize any composite bank short_names
    engine.patch_anchor(
        "backend/app/seed_data.py",
        "seed_pan_routing_rules_and_clean_bank_names",
        "    for prefix, low, high, plen, icode, ctype, prod, scheme, on_us in bin_definitions:",
        SEED_PAN_ROUTING_PATCH,
        mode="insert_before",
    )


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="RAJON Payment Switch Comprehensive Repair & Enhancement Pack (Master Orchestrator)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Simulate all patches and file updates without writing to disk",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--part1-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="Run only Part 1 (Models, Schemas & Seed Data)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    print("=" * 78)
    print("  RAJON PRIVATE HOST SIMULATOR — COMPREHENSIVE ARCHITECT REPAIR")
    print(f"  Project Root : {PROJECT_ROOT}")
    print(f"  Mode         : {'DRY-RUN (no files modified)' if args.dry_run else 'LIVE EXECUTION'}")
    print("=" * 78)

    engine = SafeRepairEngine(
        step_id="fix_all_issues",
        title="Comprehensive Payment Switch Review, Bug Fixes & Feature Enhancement",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # Execute Part 1
    apply_part1(engine)

    # Auto-chain Part 2 and Part 3 if present
    if not args.part1_only:
        try:
            import fix_all_issues_part2  # type: ignore
            fix_all_issues_part2.apply_part2(engine)
        except ImportError:
            print("\n  [INFO] fix_all_issues_part2.py not yet placed in project root.")
            print("         Type 'next' in chat to receive Part 2 and Part 3.")

        try:
            import fix_all_issues_part3  # type: ignore
            fix_all_issues_part3.apply_part3(engine)
        except ImportError:
            print("\n  [INFO] fix_all_issues_part3.py not yet placed in project root.")

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print(f"  REPAIR EXECUTION SUMMARY ({'DRY-RUN' if args.dry_run else 'APPLIED'})")
    print("=" * 78)
    for item in engine.summary:
        print(" ", item)

    if engine.backed_up and not args.dry_run:
        print(f"\n  [BACKUP] Timestamped backups saved to: {engine.backup_dir.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}")

    if engine.errors:
        print("\n  [FAILURES DETECTED]:")
        for err in engine.errors:
            print("  ", err)
        return 1

    print("\n  [SUCCESS] All available repair stages verified and compiled cleanly.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

MAINTENANCE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT = r'''
# ==============================================================================
# CUSTOMER DATA MAINTENANCE — SEARCH + CARD REASSIGN (fixed)
# ==============================================================================

@router.get('/maintenance/search')
def search_maintenance_data(
    q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search term"),
    mode: Optional[str] = Query("all", description="customer | pan | account | all"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """
    Unified 360 search used by Customer Data Maintenance page.
    mode isolates the lookup surface so a partial PAN no longer returns every
    loosely matching customer/card combination.
    """
    clean_q = (q or "").strip()
    mode = (mode or "all").lower().strip()
    if mode not in ("customer", "pan", "account", "all"):
        mode = "all"

    matched_cust_ids_set: set = set()

    if not clean_q:
        # Default workspace — most recent customers
        for c in db.query(Customer).order_by(Customer.created_at.desc()).limit(40).all():
            matched_cust_ids_set.add(c.id)
    else:
        term = f"%{clean_q}%"
        exact = clean_q

        if mode in ("customer", "all"):
            for c in db.query(Customer).filter(
                (Customer.customer_number.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.first_name.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.last_name.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.mobile_number.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.email.ilike(term))
                | (Customer.id == exact)
            ).all():
                matched_cust_ids_set.add(c.id)

        if mode in ("account", "all"):
            for a in db.query(Account).filter(
                (Account.account_number.ilike(term)) | (Account.id == exact)
            ).all():
                if a.customer_id:
                    matched_cust_ids_set.add(a.customer_id)

        if mode in ("pan", "all"):
            # Prefer precise PAN matching to avoid "multiple cards" noise.
            # 1) exact full PAN or masked
            # 2) prefix match on test_pan_reference (min 6 chars)
            pan_q = db.query(Card)
            if len(clean_q) >= 15 and clean_q.isdigit():
                pan_q = pan_q.filter(Card.test_pan_reference == clean_q)
            elif len(clean_q) >= 6:
                pan_q = pan_q.filter(
                    (Card.test_pan_reference.startswith(clean_q))
                    | (Card.masked_pan.ilike(term))
                    | (Card.test_pan_reference.ilike(term))
                )
            else:
                pan_q = pan_q.filter(
                    (Card.masked_pan.ilike(term)) | (Card.cardholder_name.ilike(term))
                )
            for crd in pan_q.limit(50).all():
                if crd.customer_id:
                    matched_cust_ids_set.add(crd.customer_id)

    matched_cust_ids = list(matched_cust_ids_set)

    # All accounts (for link dropdown)
    all_accounts = db.query(Account).order_by(Account.account_number.asc()).all()
    all_accounts_out = []
    for a in all_accounts:
        all_accounts_out.append({
            "id": a.id,
            "account_number": a.account_number,
            "account_type": a.account_type,
            "currency": a.currency,
            "available_balance": float(a.available_balance or 0),
            "ledger_balance": float(a.ledger_balance or 0),
            "account_status": a.account_status,
            "customer_id": a.customer_id,
            "customer_name": (
                f"{a.customer.first_name} {a.customer.last_name or ''}".strip()
                if a.customer else ""
            ),
            "institution_code": a.institution.institution_code if a.institution else None,
        })

    # All customers (for reassign dropdown)
    all_customers_mini = [
        {
            "id": c.id,
            "customer_number": c.customer_number,
            "name": f"{c.first_name} {c.last_name or ''}".strip(),
        }
        for c in db.query(Customer).order_by(Customer.customer_number.asc()).limit(200).all()
    ]

    customers_out = []
    for cid in matched_cust_ids:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == cid).first()
        if not cust:
            continue

        # Accounts belonging to this customer
        accts = db.query(Account).filter(Account.customer_id == cust.id).all()
        acct_list = []
        for a in accts:
            lim = db.query(AccountLimit).filter(AccountLimit.account_id == a.id).first()
            acct_list.append({
                "id": a.id,
                "account_number": a.account_number,
                "account_type": a.account_type,
                "currency": a.currency,
                "available_balance": float(a.available_balance or 0),
                "ledger_balance": float(a.ledger_balance or 0),
                "overdraft_limit": float(a.overdraft_limit or 0),
                "account_status": a.account_status,
                "branch_code": a.branch_code,
                "limits": {
                    "per_transaction_limit": float(lim.per_transaction_limit) if lim else None,
                    "daily_limit": float(lim.daily_limit) if lim else None,
                    "daily_used": float(lim.daily_used) if lim else 0,
                } if lim else None,
            })

        # Cards belonging to this customer (deduplicated by id)
        cards = db.query(Card).filter(Card.customer_id == cust.id).all()
        seen_card_ids = set()
        card_list = []
        for card in cards:
            if card.id in seen_card_ids:
                continue
            seen_card_ids.add(card.id)

            # Auto-heal missing CardAccount from legacy linked_account_id
            if not card.card_accounts and card.linked_account_id:
                fallback = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == card.linked_account_id).first()
                if fallback:
                    healed = CardAccount(
                        card_id=card.id,
                        account_id=fallback.id,
                        account_role="PRIMARY",
                        currency=fallback.currency,
                        priority=1,
                        status="ACTIVE",
                    )
                    db.add(healed)
                    db.flush()

            ca_links = []
            for ca in sorted(card.card_accounts or [], key=lambda x: (x.priority or 99)):
                ca_links.append({
                    "id": ca.id,
                    "account_id": ca.account_id,
                    "account_number": ca.account.account_number if ca.account else "UNKNOWN",
                    "account_type": ca.account.account_type if ca.account else "SAVINGS",
                    "available_balance": float(ca.account.available_balance) if ca.account else 0.0,
                    "currency": ca.currency,
                    "account_role": ca.account_role,
                    "priority": ca.priority,
                    "status": ca.status,
                })

            pin_p = card.pin_profile
            card_list.append({
                "id": card.id,
                "test_pan_reference": card.test_pan_reference,
                "masked_pan": card.masked_pan,
                "cardholder_name": card.cardholder_name,
                "expiry_month": card.expiry_month,
                "expiry_year": card.expiry_year,
                "card_type": card.card_type,
                "card_product": card.card_product,
                "card_status": card.card_status,
                "linked_account_id": card.linked_account_id,
                "institution_id": card.institution_id,
                "institution_code": card.institution.institution_code if card.institution else None,
                "card_accounts": ca_links,
                "pin_profile": {
                    "pin_offset_reference": pin_p.pin_offset_reference if pin_p else None,
                    "verification_method": pin_p.pin_verification_method if pin_p else "VISA_PVV",
                    "pvk_key_reference": pin_p.pvk_key_reference if pin_p else "PVK_VISA_01",
                    "cvv_reference": pin_p.cvv_reference if pin_p else None,
                    "retry_counter": pin_p.retry_counter if pin_p else 0,
                    "pin_status": pin_p.pin_status if pin_p else "ACTIVE",
                } if pin_p else None,
            })

        customers_out.append({
            "id": cust.id,
            "customer_number": cust.customer_number,
            "first_name": cust.first_name,
            "last_name": cust.last_name,
            "email": cust.email,
            "mobile_number": cust.mobile_number,
            "address": cust.address,
            "customer_status": cust.customer_status,
            "risk_category": cust.risk_category,
            "institution_id": cust.institution_id,
            "institution_code": cust.institution.institution_code if cust.institution else None,
            "institution_name": cust.institution.name if cust.institution else None,
            "accounts": acct_list,
            "cards": card_list,
        })

    # Stable ordering
    customers_out.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("customer_number") or "")

    try:
        db.commit()  # persist any auto-healed CardAccount rows
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()

    return {
        "mode": mode,
        "query": clean_q,
        "customers": customers_out,
        "all_accounts": all_accounts_out,
        "all_customers": all_customers_mini,
        "total_customers": len(customers_out),
        "total_cards": sum(len(c["cards"]) for c in customers_out),
        "total_accounts": sum(len(c["accounts"]) for c in customers_out),
    }


@router.put("/cards/{card_id}/reassign-customer")
def reassign_card_customer(
    card_id: str,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    """Move a card to a different customer (lab maintenance)."""
    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()
    if not card:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Card not found")
    new_cust_id = payload.get("customer_id")
    if not new_cust_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="customer_id is required")
    new_cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == new_cust_id).first()
    if not new_cust:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Target customer not found")

    before = serialize_entity(card)
    old_cust_id = card.customer_id
    card.customer_id = new_cust.id
    # Optionally keep institution alignment
    if new_cust.institution_id:
        card.institution_id = new_cust.institution_id
    after = serialize_entity(card)
    record_audit(
        db,
        "CARD",
        card.id,
        "REASSIGN_CUSTOMER",
        performed_by=current_user,
        before_state=before,
        after_state=after,
        change_summary=f"Reassigned card {card.masked_pan} from customer {old_cust_id} to {new_cust.customer_number}",
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(card)
    return {
        "status": "reassigned",
        "card_id": card.id,
        "masked_pan": card.masked_pan,
        "new_customer_id": new_cust.id,
        "new_customer_number": new_cust.customer_number,
    }
'''


# ==============================================================================
# 2. FRONTEND — Modern Customer Data Maintenance 360 page
# ==============================================================================

MODERN_MAINTENANCE_PAGE = r'''import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  User,
  CreditCard,
  Landmark,
  Trash2,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  Unlink,
  RefreshCw,
  Edit3,
  KeyRound,
  Plus,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  Loader2,
  X,
  ChevronRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

type SearchMode = 'all' | 'customer' | 'pan' | 'account';

const MODE_TABS: { id: SearchMode; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; hint: string }[] = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'All', icon: <Search size={14} />, hint: 'CIF, name, PAN or account' },
  { id: 'customer', label: 'Customer', icon: <User size={14} />, hint: 'Customer number / name / mobile' },
  { id: 'pan', label: 'PAN / Card', icon: <CreditCard size={14} />, hint: 'Full or partial PAN' },
  { id: 'account', label: 'Account', icon: <Landmark size={14} />, hint: 'Account number' },
];

export const CustomerDataMaintenancePage: React.FC = () => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<SearchMode>('all');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allAccounts, setAllAccounts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allCustomers, setAllCustomers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedCustId, setSelectedCustId] = useState<string>('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ total_customers: 0, total_cards: 0, total_accounts: 0 });

  // Modals
  const [editAccountModal, setEditAccountModal] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [pinModalCard, setPinModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [newPin, setNewPin] = useState('1234');
  const [linkModalCard, setLinkModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [targetAccountId, setTargetAccountId] = useState('');
  const [linkRole, setLinkRole] = useState('SECONDARY');
  const [reassignModalCard, setReassignModalCard] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [reassignCustId, setReassignCustId] = useState('');

  const loadWorkspace = useCallback(
    async (query: string = searchTerm, activeMode: SearchMode = mode) => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (query.trim()) params.set('q', query.trim());
        params.set('mode', activeMode);
        const res = await apiFetch(`/maintenance/search?${params.toString()}`);
        const custList = res.customers || [];
        setCustomers(custList);
        setAllAccounts(res.all_accounts || []);
        setAllCustomers(res.all_customers || []);
        setStats({
          total_customers: res.total_customers ?? custList.length,
          total_cards: res.total_cards ?? 0,
          total_accounts: res.total_accounts ?? 0,
        });
        if (custList.length > 0) {
          const still = custList.find((c: any) => c.id === selectedCustId);
          setSelectedCustId(still ? still.id : custList[0].id);
        } else {
          setSelectedCustId('');
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message || 'Search failed');
        setCustomers([]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [searchTerm, mode, selectedCustId]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadWorkspace('', 'all');
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const selectedCust = useMemo(
    () => customers.find((c) => c.id === selectedCustId) || null,
    [customers, selectedCustId]
  );

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
  };

  const switchMode = (m: SearchMode) => {
    setMode(m);
    loadWorkspace(searchTerm, m);
  };

  const flash = (text: string, isError = false) => {
    if (isError) {
      setError(text);
      setMsg('');
    } else {
      setMsg(text);
      setError('');
    }
  };

  // ---------- Account balance edit ----------
  const handleSaveAccountEdit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editAccountModal) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/accounts/${editAccountModal.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_type: editAccountModal.account_type,
          available_balance: Number(editAccountModal.available_balance),
          ledger_balance: Number(editAccountModal.ledger_balance),
          overdraft_limit: Number(editAccountModal.overdraft_limit || 0),
          account_status: editAccountModal.account_status,
        }),
      });
      flash(
        `Account ${editAccountModal.account_number} updated — Available ${Number(
          editAccountModal.available_balance
        ).toLocaleString()} ${editAccountModal.currency}`
      );
      setEditAccountModal(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message || 'Update failed', true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Delete account ----------
  const handleDeleteAccount = async (acct: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete account ${acct.account_number}? Cards will be detached.`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/accounts/${acct.id}?force=true`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Account ${acct.account_number} deleted`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Link / Unlink / Promote ----------
  const handleLinkAccount = async () => {
    if (!linkModalCard || !targetAccountId) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/${linkModalCard.id}/accounts`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_id: targetAccountId,
          account_role: linkRole,
          priority: (linkModalCard.card_accounts?.length || 0) + 1,
        }),
      });
      flash(`Linked account to ${linkModalCard.masked_pan} as ${linkRole}`);
      setLinkModalCard(null);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleUnlink = async (linkId: string, acctNum: string, maskedPan: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Unlink ${acctNum} from ${maskedPan}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/accounts/${linkId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Unlinked ${acctNum}`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleSetPrimary = async (linkId: string, acctNum: string) => {
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/accounts/${linkId}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ account_role: 'PRIMARY', priority: 1 }),
      });
      flash(`${acctNum} is now PRIMARY`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- PIN change ----------
  const handleChangePin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!pinModalCard) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/cards/${pinModalCard.id}/pin`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ new_pin: newPin }),
      });
      flash(`PIN updated for ${pinModalCard.masked_pan} — new PVV/Offset: ${res.new_pvv || 'OK'}`);
      setPinModalCard(null);
      setNewPin('1234');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Reassign card to another customer ----------
  const handleReassignCustomer = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reassignModalCard || !reassignCustId) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/cards/${reassignModalCard.id}/reassign-customer`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ customer_id: reassignCustId }),
      });
      flash(
        `Card ${reassignModalCard.masked_pan} moved to customer ${res.new_customer_number}`
      );
      setReassignModalCard(null);
      setReassignCustId('');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Delete card ----------
  const handleDeleteCard = async (card: any) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete card ${card.masked_pan}?`)) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/cards/${card.id}?force=true`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      flash(`Card ${card.masked_pan} deleted`);
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  // ---------- Update customer basics ----------
  const handleUpdateCustomer = async (fields: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (!selectedCust) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/customers/${selectedCust.id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify(fields),
      });
      flash('Customer updated');
      await loadWorkspace(searchTerm, mode);
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err.message, true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldAlert className="text-emerald-500" size={22} />
            Customer Data Maintenance 360
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-2xl">
            Search by Customer, PAN or Account. Inspect relationships, edit balances, re-link
            accounts, change PIN, reassign cards, and delete entities — all in one modern workspace.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/20">
            {stats.total_customers} customers
          </span>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
            {stats.total_cards} cards
          </span>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">
            {stats.total_accounts} accounts
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Alerts */}
      {msg && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> {msg}
          <button onClick={() => setMsg('')} className="ml-auto opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-400 text-xs font-mono">
          <ShieldAlert size={16} /> {error}
          <button onClick={() => setError('')} className="ml-auto opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search mode tabs + bar */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {MODE_TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => switchMode(t.id)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                mode === t.id
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/25'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              {t.icon}
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
            <Search size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={MODE_TABS.find((t) => t.id === mode)?.hint || 'Search…'}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-sm font-mono focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/40 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20"
          >
            {loading ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Search size={14} />}
            Search
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSearchTerm('');
              loadWorkspace('', mode);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} /> Reset
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* Main split layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 min-h-[520px]">
        {/* Left: customer list */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
              Matched Customers
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-500">{customers.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[640px]">
            {loading && customers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                <Loader2 className="animate-spin mx-auto mb-2" size={20} /> Searching…
              </div>
            )}
            {!loading && customers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                No customers matched. Try a different mode or term.
              </div>
            )}
            {customers.map((c) => {
              const active = c.id === selectedCustId;
              return (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCustId(c.id)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 transition-colors ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-l-2 border-l-emerald-500'
                      : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 border-l-2 border-l-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500">
                      {c.customer_number}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${
                        c.customer_status === 'ACTIVE'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                          : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {c.customer_status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-medium mt-0.5 truncate">
                    {c.first_name} {c.last_name}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                    <span className="text-sky-400">{c.institution_code || '—'}</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span>{(c.cards || []).length} cards</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span>{(c.accounts || []).length} accts</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: detail workspace */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-4">
          {!selectedCust ? (
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-16 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">
              Select a customer from the left list or search by PAN / Account above.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Customer header card */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <User size={18} className="text-emerald-500" />
                      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">
                        {selectedCust.first_name} {selectedCust.last_name}
                      </h2>
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                        {selectedCust.customer_number}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Bank</div>
                        <div className="text-sky-400 font-bold">
                          {selectedCust.institution_code || '—'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Mobile</div>
                        <div className="text-slate-200">{selectedCust.mobile_number || '—'}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Risk</div>
                        <div>{selectedCust.risk_category || 'NORMAL'}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide">Status</div>
                        <div
                          className={
                            selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE'
                              ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold'
                              : 'text-rose-400 font-bold'
                          }
                        >
                          {selectedCust.customer_status}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        handleUpdateCustomer({
                          customer_status:
                            selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'BLOCKED' : 'ACTIVE',
                        })
                      }
                      className="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      {selectedCust.customer_status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Block' : 'Activate'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Accounts section */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                <div className="px-5 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Landmark size={16} className="text-amber-500" />
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold">Accounts</h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 ml-auto">
                    {(selectedCust.accounts || []).length}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                  {(selectedCust.accounts || []).length === 0 && (
                    <div className="p-6 text-xs text-slate-400 text-center">No accounts</div>
                  )}
                  {(selectedCust.accounts || []).map((a: any) => (
                    <div
                      key={a.id}
                      className="px-5 py-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-emerald-500">
                          {a.account_number}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                          {a.account_type} · {a.account_status} · OD {Number(a.overdraft_limit || 0).toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="text-sm font-bold font-mono">
                          {Number(a.available_balance).toLocaleString()}{' '}
                          <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">{a.currency}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          Ledger {Number(a.ledger_balance).toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setEditAccountModal({ ...a })}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600/10 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-600/20"
                        >
                          <Edit3 size={12} /> Balance
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteAccount(a)}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-600/10 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-600/20"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={12} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Cards section */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                <div className="px-5 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CreditCard size={16} className="text-sky-500" />
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold">Cards</h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 ml-auto">
                    {(selectedCust.cards || []).length}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
                  {(selectedCust.cards || []).length === 0 && (
                    <div className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-400 text-center">No cards</div>
                  )}
                  {(selectedCust.cards || []).map((card: any) => (
                    <div
                      key={card.id}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 p-4 space-y-3"
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-sky-400">
                              {card.masked_pan}
                            </span>
                            <span
                              className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${
                                card.card_status === 'ACTIVE'
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'
                                  : 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {card.card_status}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-1">
                            Ref {card.test_pan_reference} · {card.cardholder_name} · Exp{' '}
                            {String(card.expiry_month).padStart(2, '0')}/{card.expiry_year} ·{' '}
                            {card.card_product}
                          </div>
                          {card.pin_profile && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-400/90 font-mono mt-1">
                              {card.pin_profile.verification_method} · PVV/Offset{' '}
