#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
FILE 3 OF 3: tools/install_lmk_key_mgmt_part3_ui_and_tests.py
Implements LMK-Centric Key Management & Key Ownership (Part 3):
  1. Updates `frontend/src/pages/KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage.tsx` with JSX-safe headings:
     - Active Cryptographic Authority & Provider Switcher (INTERNAL_HSM vs EXTERNAL_HSM)
     - Live Soft-HSM LMK Status & Domain Check Value (`NC` -> `ND`, KCV `D3B82A0000000000`, FW `1347-0900`)
     - Persistence Risk & Audit Deliverable Tab (Part G)
     - Provider-Isolated Key Inventory table (Alias, Identifier, Type, Thales Code, Usage, Scheme, Version, Status, LMK Domain, Masked LMK Block, KCV)
     - External Soft-HSM Key Creation (`A0`), Key Import (`A6`), Key Export (`A8`), Key Rotation (`A0`), KCV Verification (`BU`), and Key Deletion
     - Strict masking: sensitive clear key material is never displayed or stored.
  2. Creates `backend/tests/test_lmk_centric_key_management.py` verifying LMK ownership,
     A0/A6/A8/BU command formatting, LMK domain mismatch protection, and provider isolation.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def write_frontend_key_management_page() -> None:
    page_path = ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "pages" / "KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage.tsx"
    tsx = """import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../services/api';

interface KeyRecord {
  id: string;
  key_identifier: string;
  key_name: string;
  key_type: string;
  thales_key_type_code: string;
  key_usage: string;
  key_scheme: string;
  key_version: number;
  key_status: string;
  kvc: string;
  algorithm: string;
  key_length: number;
  provider_type: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM';
  lmk_id: string;
  lmk_check_value: string | null;
  encrypted_key_block: string;
  masked_key_block: string;
  institution_code?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

export const KeyCeremonyWorkbenchPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [lmkStatus, setLmkStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [auditReport, setAuditReport] = useState<any>(null);
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<KeyRecord[]>([]);
  const [providerFilter, setProviderFilter] = useState<string>('ACTIVE_PROVIDER');
  const [remoteUrlInput, setRemoteUrlInput] = useState<string>('http://127.0.0.1:8000');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [banner, setBanner] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err' | 'warn'; msg: string } | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'inventory' | 'a0_generate' | 'a6_import' | 'a8_export' | 'audit'>('inventory');

  // A0 Key Generation Form State
  const [a0Alias, setA0Alias] = useState('ZPK_EXT_ISS_01');
  const [a0Name, setA0Name] = useState('External Interchange ZPK');
  const [a0Type, setA0Type] = useState('ZPK');
  const [a0Scheme, setA0Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a0Mode, setA0Mode] = useState('0');
  const [a0ZmkAlias, setA0ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a0Result, setA0Result] = useState<any>(null);

  // A6 Key Import Form State
  const [a6Alias, setA6Alias] = useState('ZPK_PARTNER_IMP_01');
  const [a6Name, setA6Name] = useState('Imported Partner ZPK');
  const [a6Type, setA6Type] = useState('ZPK');
  const [a6ZmkAlias, setA6ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a6EncKey, setA6EncKey] = useState('');
  const [a6Scheme, setA6Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a6Result, setA6Result] = useState<any>(null);

  // A8 Key Export Form State
  const [a8KeyAlias, setA8KeyAlias] = useState('AWK_ATM_01');
  const [a8ZmkAlias, setA8ZmkAlias] = useState('ZMK_MAIN');
  const [a8Scheme, setA8Scheme] = useState('U');
  const [a8Result, setA8Result] = useState<any>(null);

  const loadAll = async (filterOverride?: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const statusRes = await api.get('/hsm/lmk-key-management/status');
      setLmkStatus(statusRes.data);
      if (statusRes.data?.remote_url) {
        setRemoteUrlInput(statusRes.data.remote_url);
      }
      const effFilter = filterOverride || providerFilter;
      const qParam = effFilter === 'ACTIVE_PROVIDER' ? statusRes.data.active_provider : effFilter;
      const keysRes = await api.get(`/hsm/lmk-key-management/keys?provider_type=${qParam}&include_superseded=true`);
      setKeys(keysRes.data.keys || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || e.message || 'Failed to load HSM key status' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAll();
  }, []);

  const handleSwitchProvider = async (mode: 'INTERNAL_HSM' | 'EXTERNAL_HSM') => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/hsm/lmk-key-management/provider', {
        provider_mode: mode,
        remote_url: remoteUrlInput,
      });
      setLmkStatus(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: res.data.online ? 'ok' : 'warn',
        msg: `Switched Cryptographic Authority to ${res.data.active_provider} (LMK KCV: ${res.data.lmk_check_value})`,
      });
      await loadAll(mode);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Provider switch failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleSyncExternalKeys = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/hsm/lmk-key-management/sync-seeded');
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Synchronized & BU-verified ${res.data.count} LMK-encrypted keys from External Soft-HSM (Domain ${res.data.lmk_check_value})`,
      });
      await loadAll('EXTERNAL_HSM');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to sync keys from External Soft-HSM' });
    }
  };

  const handleGenerateA0 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA0Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/hsm/lmk-key-management/generate', {
        key_identifier: a0Alias,
        key_name: a0Name,
        key_type: a0Type,
        key_scheme: a0Scheme,
        mode: a0Mode,
        export_zmk_key_identifier: a0Mode === '1' ? a0ZmkAlias : undefined,
      });
      setA0Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A0 (A100) succeeded. Stored LMK key block for '${res.data.key.key_identifier}' (KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A0 key generation failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleImportA6 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA6Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/hsm/lmk-key-management/import', {
        key_identifier: a6Alias,
        key_name: a6Name,
        key_type: a6Type,
        zmk_key_identifier: a6ZmkAlias,
        encrypted_key_under_zmk: a6EncKey,
        key_scheme_lmk: a6Scheme,
      });
      setA6Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A6 (A700) succeeded. Imported '${res.data.key.key_identifier}' under LMK (KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A6 key import failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleExportA8 = async () => {
    setBanner(null);
    setA8Result(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/hsm/lmk-key-management/export', {
        key_identifier: a8KeyAlias,
        zmk_key_identifier: a8ZmkAlias,
        export_scheme: a8Scheme,
      });
      setA8Result(res.data);
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Soft-HSM Command A8 (A900) succeeded. Exported '${a8KeyAlias}' under '${a8ZmkAlias}' (KCV: ${res.data.kcv})`,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Soft-HSM A8 key export failed' });
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyBu = async (alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post(`/hsm/lmk-key-management/verify-kcv/${alias}`);
      setBanner({
        type: res.data.kcv_matched ? 'ok' : 'warn',
        msg: `Soft-HSM BU (BV00) check for '${alias}': Calculated KCV ${res.data.calculated_kvc} (Stored: ${res.data.stored_kvc}) | Raw: ${res.data.raw_response}`,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || `BU check failed for ${alias}` });
    }
  };

  const handleRotateKey = async (alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.post('/hsm/lmk-key-management/rotate', { key_identifier: alias });
      setBanner({
        type: 'ok',
        msg: `Rotated '${alias}' via Soft-HSM A0: v${res.data.previous_version} to v${res.data.new_version} (New KCV: ${res.data.key.kvc})`,
      });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || `Rotation failed for ${alias}` });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteKey = async (id: string, alias: string) => {
    setBanner(null);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/hsm/keys/${id}?force=true`);
      setBanner({ type: 'ok', msg: `Deleted key record '${alias}' from Host inventory` });
      await loadAll();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Delete failed' });
    }
  };

  const loadAuditDeliverable = async () => {
    setActiveTab('audit');
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/hsm/lmk-key-management/audit-report');
      setAuditReport(res.data);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setBanner({ type: 'err', msg: 'Failed to load audit report' });
    }
  };

  const isExternal = lmkStatus?.active_provider === 'EXTERNAL_HSM';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Active Cryptographic Authority Banner */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white font-mono">
              LMK-Centric Key Management & Cryptographic Ownership
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Thales payShield 10K LMK Domain Isolation · Zero Clear Key Storage · Live A0 / A6 / A8 / BU / NC Execution
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleSwitchProvider('INTERNAL_HSM')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
                !isExternal ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              Internal Simulator HSM
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleSwitchProvider('EXTERNAL_HSM')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
                isExternal ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              External Soft-HSM Authority
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* LMK Domain Status Grid */}
        {lmkStatus && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">Active Authority</div>
              <div className={`font-bold mt-1 ${isExternal ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-sky-400'}`}>
                {lmkStatus.active_provider} ({lmkStatus.online ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'})
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">LMK Domain Check Value (NC)</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-amber-400 mt-1">
                Slot %{lmkStatus.lmk_id || '00'} · {lmkStatus.lmk_check_value}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded">
              <div className="text-slate-400">HSM State & Firmware</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1">
                {lmkStatus.hsm_state} ({lmkStatus.firmware})
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded md:col-span-2">
              <div className="text-slate-400 mb-1">External Soft-HSM Endpoint & Seeded LMK Sync</div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={remoteUrlInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setRemoteUrlInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-emerald-300 text-xs"
                  placeholder="https://your-soft-hsm.onrender.com"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleSyncExternalKeys}
                  className="bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1 rounded text-white font-bold whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Sync LMK Keys
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {lmkStatus?.persistence_audit?.ephemeral_risk && (
          <div className="bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-700/60 rounded p-2.5 text-xs font-mono text-amber-200">
            <strong>LMK Persistence Notice:</strong> {lmkStatus.persistence_audit.ephemeral_risk}
          </div>
        )}

        {banner && (
          <div
            className={`p-3 rounded text-xs font-mono border ${
              banner.type === 'ok'
                ? 'bg-emerald-950/70 border-emerald-700 text-emerald-200'
                : banner.type === 'warn'
                ? 'bg-amber-950/70 border-amber-700 text-amber-200'
                : 'bg-rose-950/70 border-rose-700 text-rose-200'
            }`}
          >
            {banner.msg}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2 font-mono text-xs">
        {[
          { id: 'inventory', label: '1. Key Inventory & LMK Domains' },
          { id: 'a0_generate', label: '2. Generate Key (Soft-HSM A0)' },
          { id: 'a6_import', label: '3. Import Key (Soft-HSM A6)' },
          { id: 'a8_export', label: '4. Export / Translate Key (Soft-HSM A8)' },
          { id: 'audit', label: '5. Mandatory LMK Audit Deliverable (Part G)' },
        ].map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            onClick={() => (t.id === 'audit' ? loadAuditDeliverable() : setActiveTab(t.id as any))}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded font-bold transition ${
              activeTab === t.id ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800'
            }`}
          >
            {t.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: KEY INVENTORY */}
      {activeTab === 'inventory' && (
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
              Cryptographic Key Inventory (Sensitive Key Material Strictly Hidden)
            </h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Filter Provider:</span>
              {['ACTIVE_PROVIDER', 'EXTERNAL_HSM', 'INTERNAL_HSM', 'ALL'].map((pf) => (
                <button
                  key={pf}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setProviderFilter(pf);
                    loadAll(pf);
                  }}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded ${
                    providerFilter === pf ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  {pf}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left font-mono text-xs border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Key Alias</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Provider</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Type (Thales)</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Usage</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Scheme</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Ver</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">KCV</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">LMK Domain</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">LMK-Encrypted Block (Masked)</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-2">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60">
                {keys.map((k) => (
                  <tr key={k.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 font-bold text-emerald-400">
                      <div>{k.key_identifier}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal">{k.key_name}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2">
                      <span
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          k.provider_type === 'EXTERNAL_HSM'
                            ? 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-700'
                            : 'bg-sky-950 text-sky-300 border border-sky-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {k.provider_type}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 text-slate-200">
                      {k.key_type} <span className="text-slate-400">({k.thales_key_type_code})</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 text-slate-300">{k.key_usage}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 text-amber-300 font-bold">{k.key_scheme}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 text-slate-300">v{k.key_version}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 font-bold text-amber-400">{k.kvc}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 text-sky-300">
                      {k.lmk_check_value ? `${k.lmk_check_value.slice(0, 6)} (%${k.lmk_id})` : 'INTERNAL'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2 text-slate-400" title="Clear keys are never stored or displayed">
                      {k.masked_key_block}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-2">
                      <span
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          k.key_status === 'ACTIVE'
                            ? 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300'
                            : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                        }`}
                      >

test_lmk_centric_key_management.py — Automated Verification for LMK-Centric Key Management
"""

from unittest.mock import patch
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.config import settings

client = TestClient(app)


def _auth_headers() -> dict:
    resp = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"username": settings.ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": settings.ADMIN_PASSWORD})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {resp.json()['access_token']}"}


def _mock_soft_hsm_execute(raw_command: str, header_length: int = 4, synthetic_mode: bool = False, source_host: str = "TEST"):
    assert synthetic_mode is False, "External key management must never request synthetic_mode=True (clear keys)"
    cmd = raw_command[header_length:header_length + 2].upper()
    body = raw_command[header_length + 2:]

    if cmd == "NC":
        return {
            "status_code": "00",
            "raw_request": raw_command,
            "raw_response": "0000ND00D3B82A00000000001347-0900",
            "parsed_response": [
                {"tag": "LMK Check Value", "value": "D3B82A0000000000"},
                {"tag": "Firmware Version", "value": "1347-0900"},
            ],
        }
    if cmd == "A0":
        mode = body[0]
        scheme = body[4]
        lmk_tok = f"{scheme}A1B2C3D4E5F60718293A4B5C6D7E8F90" if scheme != "S" else "S1006472TN0000A1B2C3D4E5F60718293A4B5C6D7E8F9012345678"
        kcv = "8F4E2A"
        zmk_tok = "U99887766554433221100FFEEDDCCBBAA" if mode == "1" else ""
        parsed = [{"tag": "Key under LMK", "value": lmk_tok}]
        if zmk_tok:
            parsed.append({"tag": "Key under ZMK/TMK", "value": zmk_tok})
        return {
            "status_code": "00",
            "raw_request": raw_command,
            "raw_response": f"0000A100{lmk_tok}{zmk_tok}{kcv}",
            "parsed_response": parsed,
        }
    if cmd == "A8":
        return {
            "status_code": "00",
            "raw_request": raw_command,
            "raw_response": "0000A900U99887766554433221100FFEEDDCCBBAA8F4E2A",
            "parsed_response": [{"tag": "Key under ZMK", "value": "U99887766554433221100FFEEDDCCBBAA"}],
        }
    if cmd == "A6":
        return {
            "status_code": "00",
            "raw_request": raw_command,
            "raw_response": "0000A700UA1B2C3D4E5F60718293A4B5C6D7E8F908F4E2A",
            "parsed_response": [{"tag": "Key under LMK", "value": "UA1B2C3D4E5F60718293A4B5C6D7E8F90"}],
        }
    if cmd == "BU":
        return {
            "status_code": "00",
            "raw_request": raw_command,
            "raw_response": "0000BV008F4E2A0000000000",
            "parsed_response": [{"tag": "Key Check Value", "value": "8F4E2A0000000000"}],
        }
    return {"status_code": "68", "raw_response": "0000ER68"}

    headers = _auth_headers()

    with patch("app.lmk_key_management_service.ExternalSoftHSMBridge.execute_command", side_effect=_mock_soft_hsm_execute), \\
         patch("app.lmk_key_management_service.ExternalSoftHSMBridge.fetch_status", return_value={
             "status": "ONLINE",

        assert "12_lmk_compatibility_and_persistence_limitations" in body

        gen_zmk = client.post("/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/generate", json={

            "key_name": "External Test ZMK",
            "key_type": "ZMK",
            "key_scheme": "U",
            "mode": "0",
        }, headers=headers)
        assert gen_zmk.status_code == 200
        zmk_data = gen_zmk.json()["key"]
        assert zmk_data["provider_type"] == "EXTERNAL_HSM"
        assert zmk_data["lmk_check_value"] == "D3B82A0000000000"
        assert zmk_data["encrypted_key_block"].startswith("U")

        db = SessionLocal()
        try:

            assert db_rec.clear_key_hex is None
        finally:

        gen_zpk = client.post("/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/generate", json={
            "key_identifier": "ZPK_EXT_TEST_01",
            "key_name": "External Test ZPK",
            "key_type": "ZPK",
            "key_scheme": "U",
            "mode": "1",
            "export_zmk_key_identifier": "ZMK_EXT_TEST_01",
        }, headers=headers)
        assert gen_zpk.status_code == 200
        assert gen_zpk.json()["exported_key_under_zmk"] == "U99887766554433221100FFEEDDCCBBAA"

        exp_res = client.post("/api/hsm/lmk-key-management/export", json={

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step00_01.py
STEP 0 — Prerequisites & Installer Framework — Script 1 of 2
Creates tools/patcher.py, PROGRESS.md, and docs/CONTRACTS.md.
"""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import py_compile
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()

PATCHER_CODE = r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
tools/patcher.py — Enterprise Installer & Anchored Patch Framework
RAJON Private Host Simulator | Windows CRLF & Idempotent Patch Engine
"""

import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import py_compile
import shutil
import sys
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
BACKUP_ROOT = BASE_DIR / "_backups"
PROGRESS_FILE = BASE_DIR / "PROGRESS.md"
CONTRACTS_FILE = BASE_DIR / "docs" / "CONTRACTS.md"

PROTECTED_FILENAMES = {".env", "rajon_host.db", "rajon_host.db-journal", "rajon_host.db-wal"}
PROTECTED_EXTENSIONS = {".db", ".sqlite", ".sqlite3"}


@dataclass
class OperationRecord:
    action: str
    rel_path: str
    status: str
    details: str = ""


class PatcherError(Exception):
    """Raised when a path safety check or anchored patch fails."""


class PatcherSession:
    def __init__(self, step_id: str, title: str, dry_run: bool = False):
        self.step_id = step_id
        self.title = title
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        self.timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.backup_dir = BACKUP_ROOT / f"{self.step_id}_{self.timestamp}"
        self.records: List[OperationRecord] = []
        self.failed: bool = False
        self.BackedUpPaths: set[Path] = set()

    def _ensure_safe_path(self, rel_path: str) -> Path:
        clean_rel = rel_path.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
        target = (BASE_DIR / clean_rel).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(BASE_DIR):
            raise PatcherError(f"Path escapes BASE_DIR ({BASE_DIR}): {rel_path}")
        if target.name in PROTECTED_FILENAMES or target.suffix.lower() in PROTECTED_EXTENSIONS:
            raise PatcherError(f"Refusing to modify protected database/env file: {rel_path}")
        return target

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_crlf(text: str) -> str:
        return text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").replace("\n", "\r\n")

    @staticmethod
    def _sha256(text: str) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _backup_file(self, target: Path) -> Optional[Path]:
        if not target.exists() or target in self.BackedUpPaths:
            return None
        rel = target.relative_to(BASE_DIR)
        dest = self.backup_dir / rel
        if not self.dry_run:
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(target, dest)
        self.BackedUpPaths.add(target)
        return dest

    def _format_marker(self, target: Path, marker: str) -> str:
        ext = target.suffix.lower()
        if ext in {".py", ".toml", ".sh", ".yaml", ".yml", ".gitignore"} or target.name == ".gitignore":
            return f"# [PATCH {marker}]"
        if ext in {".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".css"}:
            return f"// [PATCH {marker}]"
        if ext in {".html", ".md"}:
            return f"<!-- [PATCH {marker}] -->"
        return f"# [PATCH {marker}]"

    def write_file(self, rel_path: str, content: str) -> bool:
        try:
            target = self._ensure_safe_path(rel_path)
            normalized = self._normalize_crlf(content)

            if target.exists():
                existing_raw = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                existing_norm = self._normalize_crlf(existing_raw)
                if self._sha256(existing_norm) == self._sha256(normalized):
                    self.records.append(OperationRecord("WRITE", rel_path, "SKIPPED_IDENTICAL", "File already up to date"))
                    print(f"  [SKIP] {rel_path} (identical content)")
                    return True

                self._backup_file(target)
                action_label = "OVERWRITE"
            else:
                action_label = "CREATE"

            if not self.dry_run:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                    f.write(normalized)
                if target.suffix.lower() == ".py":
                    py_compile.compile(str(target), doraise=True)

            status_label = f"DRY_RUN_{action_label}" if self.dry_run else action_label
            self.records.append(OperationRecord("WRITE", rel_path, status_label, f"{len(normalized.splitlines())} lines"))
            print(f"  [{status_label}] {rel_path} ({len(normalized.splitlines())} lines)")
            return True

        except Exception as exc:
            self.failed = True
            self.records.append(OperationRecord("WRITE", rel_path, "FAILED", str(exc)))
            print(f"  [ERROR] Failed writing {rel_path}: {exc}")
            return False

    def patch_file(self, rel_path: str, edits: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> bool:
        try:
            target = self._ensure_safe_path(rel_path)
            if not target.exists():
                raise PatcherError(f"Target file does not exist: {rel_path}")

            raw_text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            working = raw_text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
            original_working = working
            applied_count = 0

            for idx, edit in enumerate(edits, start=1):
                marker_id = edit.get("marker") or f"{self.step_id}:edit{idx}"
                marker_line = self._format_marker(target, marker_id)
                action = edit.get("action", "").strip().lower()
                anchor = edit.get("anchor", "")
                text = edit.get("text", "")

                anchor_lf = anchor.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
                text_lf = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

                if marker_line in working or f"[PATCH {marker_id}]" in working:
                    print(f"  [IDEMPOTENT] {rel_path} already contains marker [{marker_id}] — skipping edit.")
                    continue

                if action == "append":
                    sep = "" if working.endswith("\n") else "\n"
                    working = f"{working}{sep}\n{marker_line}\n{text_lf}\n"
                    applied_count += 1
                    continue

                if not anchor_lf:
                    raise PatcherError(f"Edit [{marker_id}] in {rel_path} is missing an 'anchor' string.")

                occurrences = working.count(anchor_lf)
                if occurrences == 0:
                    self._report_manual_patch_guidance(rel_path, marker_id, action, anchor_lf, text_lf, "MISSING ANCHOR")
                    raise PatcherError(f"Anchor not found for [{marker_id}] in {rel_path}")
                if occurrences > 1:
                    self._report_manual_patch_guidance(rel_path, marker_id, action, anchor_lf, text_lf, f"AMBIGUOUS ANCHOR ({occurrences} matches)")
                    raise PatcherError(f"Anchor matched {occurrences} times for [{marker_id}] in {rel_path}")

                if action == "insert_after":
                    replacement = f"{anchor_lf}\n{marker_line}\n{text_lf}"
                    working = working.replace(anchor_lf, replacement, 1)
                elif action == "insert_before":
                    replacement = f"{marker_line}\n{text_lf}\n{anchor_lf}"
                    working = working.replace(anchor_lf, replacement, 1)
                elif action == "replace":
                    replacement = f"{marker_line}\n{text_lf}"
                    working = working.replace(anchor_lf, replacement, 1)
                else:
                    raise PatcherError(f"Unsupported patch action '{action}' in [{marker_id}]")

                applied_count += 1

            if working == original_working:
                self.records.append(OperationRecord("PATCH", rel_path, "SKIPPED_IDEMPOTENT", "All markers already present"))
                return True

            self._backup_file(target)
            final_crlf = self._normalize_crlf(working)

            if not self.dry_run:
                with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                    f.write(final_crlf)
                if target.suffix.lower() == ".py":
                    py_compile.compile(str(target), doraise=True)

            status_label = "DRY_RUN_PATCHED" if self.dry_run else "PATCHED"
            self.records.append(OperationRecord("PATCH", rel_path, status_label, f"{applied_count} edit(s) applied"))
            print(f"  [{status_label}] {rel_path} ({applied_count} edit(s) applied)")
            return True

        except Exception as exc:
            self.failed = True
            self.records.append(OperationRecord("PATCH", rel_path, "FAILED", str(exc)))
            print(f"  [ERROR] Patch failed for {rel_path}: {exc}")
            return False

    @staticmethod
    def _report_manual_patch_guidance(rel_path: str, marker_id: str, action: str, anchor: str, text: str, reason: str) -> None:
        print("\n" + "!" * 78)
        print(f"  MANUAL PATCH GUIDANCE REQUIRED — {reason}")
        print(f"  Target File : {rel_path}")
        print(f"  Patch Marker: [PATCH {marker_id}]")
        print(f"  Operation   : {action.upper()}")
        print("-" * 78)
        print("  EXPECTED ANCHOR:")
        for line in anchor.splitlines():
            print(f"    | {line}")
        print("-" * 78)
        print("  CODE TO APPLY:")
        for line in text.splitlines():
            print(f"    + {line}")
        print("!" * 78 + "\n")

    def record_progress(
        self,
        completed: List[str],
        remaining: List[str],
        modified_files: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        known_issues: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        if self.dry_run or self.failed:
            return
        PROGRESS_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        header_needed = not PROGRESS_FILE.exists()
        now_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        lines: List[str] = []
        if header_needed:
            lines.append("# RAJON PRIVATE HOST SIMULATOR — IMPLEMENTATION PROGRESS\n")
            lines.append("Authoritative execution log updated automatically by `tools/patcher.py`.\n")

        lines.append(f"## [{now_str}] `{self.step_id}` — {self.title}")
        if modified_files:
            lines.append("- **Touched Files**: " + ", ".join(f"`{m}`" for m in modified_files))
        for item in completed:
            lines.append(f"- [x] **Completed**: {item}")
        for rem in remaining:
            lines.append(f"- [ ] **Next / Remaining**: {rem}")
        if known_issues:
            for issue in known_issues:
                lines.append(f"- **Issue/Note**: {issue}")
        else:
            lines.append("- **Known Issues**: None")
        lines.append("")

        existing = PROGRESS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if PROGRESS_FILE.exists() else ""
        marker_tag = f"<!-- PROGRESS:{self.step_id} -->"
        if marker_tag in existing:
            return
        lines.insert(1 if header_needed else 0, marker_tag)
        full_text = existing + ("\n" if existing and not existing.endswith("\n") else "") + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
        with open(PROGRESS_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write(self._normalize_crlf(full_text))
        print(f"  [PROGRESS] Updated PROGRESS.md for {self.step_id}")

    def record_contracts(self, section_title: str, contract_items: List[str]) -> None:
        if self.dry_run or self.failed:
            return
        CONTRACTS_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        header_needed = not CONTRACTS_FILE.exists()
        existing = CONTRACTS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if CONTRACTS_FILE.exists() else ""
        marker_tag = f"<!-- CONTRACT:{self.step_id} -->"
        if marker_tag in existing:
            return

        lines: List[str] = []
        if header_needed:
            lines.append("# RAJON PRIVATE HOST SIMULATOR — PUBLIC CONTRACTS & INTERFACES\n")
            lines.append("Tracks database tables, columns, API routes, schemas, settings, and React routes.\n")
        lines.append(marker_tag)
        lines.append(f"## `{self.step_id}` — {section_title}")
        for item in contract_items:
            lines.append(f"- {item}")
        lines.append("")

        full_text = existing + ("\n" if existing and not existing.endswith("\n") else "") + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
        with open(CONTRACTS_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write(self._normalize_crlf(full_text))
        print(f"  [CONTRACTS] Updated docs/CONTRACTS.md for {self.step_id}")

    def finish(self) -> int:
        print("\n" + "=" * 78)
        print(f"  SUMMARY: {self.step_id} — {self.title} {'(DRY-RUN)' if self.dry_run else ''}")
        print("=" * 78)
        for rec in self.records:
            print(f"  {rec.action:<7} | {rec.status:<18} | {rec.rel_path:<42} | {rec.details}")
        if self.BackedUpPaths and not self.dry_run:
            print(f"\n  Backups saved to: {self.backup_dir.relative_to(BASE_DIR)}")
        print("=" * 78)
        if self.failed:
            print("  [RESULT] FAILED — One or more operations did not complete cleanly.")
            return 1
        print("  [RESULT] SUCCESS — All operations verified.")
        return 0


# Top-level convenience wrappers for installer scripts
_default_session: Optional[PatcherSession] = None


def get_session(step_id: str = "step00", title: str = "Manual Patch Session", dry_run: bool = False) -> PatcherSession:
    global _default_session
    if _default_session is None:
        _default_session = PatcherSession(step_id=step_id, title=title, dry_run=dry_run)
    return _default_session


def write_file(rel_path: str, content: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> bool:
    sess = get_session(dry_run=dry_run)
    return sess.write_file(rel_path, content)


def patch_file(rel_path: str, edits: List[Dict[str, str]], dry_run: bool = False) -> bool:
    sess = get_session(dry_run=dry_run)
    return sess.patch_file(rel_path, edits)


def parse_installer_args(description: str) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=description)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Simulate all file creations and patches without modifying disk")
    return parser.parse_args()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = parse_installer_args("RAJON Shared Patcher Framework")
    print(f"[OK] RAJON Patcher Framework ready at {BASE_DIR} (dry_run={args.dry_run})")

        modified_files=["tools/patcher.py", "PROGRESS.md", "docs/CONTRACTS.md"],
    )

    session.record_contracts(
        section_title="Installer & Patcher Framework (`tools/patcher.py`)",

    )

  4. Automated pytest verification (backend/tests/test_step00_prerequisites.py)

from pathlib import Path
import sys

SCHEMA_SYNC_CODE = '''"""
schema_sync.py — Non-Destructive Database Schema Synchronizer
Automatically creates missing tables and adds missing nullable columns to existing
SQLite / PostgreSQL tables without deleting or altering existing data.
"""

import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Set
from sqlalchemy import inspect, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase

logger = logging.getLogger("rajon.schema_sync")


def _compile_column_type(column, dialect) -> str:
    try:
        return column.type.compile(dialect=dialect)
    except Exception:
        return "TEXT"


def synchronize_database_schema(engine: Engine, base_cls: type[DeclarativeBase]) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
    """
    1. Creates any brand-new tables registered on `base_cls.metadata`.
    2. Inspects every existing table and issues `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ...`
       for any newly defined ORM columns that do not yet exist in the physical database.
    Never drops tables, never drops columns, and never deletes existing rows.
    """
    summary: Dict[str, List[str]] = {"created_tables": [], "added_columns": []}

    inspector = inspect(engine)
    existing_tables: Set[str] = set(inspector.get_table_names())

    # 1. Create missing tables first
    base_cls.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

    inspector_after = inspect(engine)
    after_tables: Set[str] = set(inspector_after.get_table_names())
    for tbl in sorted(after_tables - existing_tables):
        summary["created_tables"].append(tbl)
        logger.info("[SchemaSync] Created new table: %s", tbl)

    # 2. Check existing tables for missing columns
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        for table_name, table_obj in base_cls.metadata.tables.items():
            if table_name not in existing_tables:
                continue

            db_cols = {c["name"].lower() for c in inspector_after.get_columns(table_name)}
            for col in table_obj.columns:
                if col.name.lower() in db_cols:
                    continue

                col_type_sql = _compile_column_type(col, engine.dialect)
                default_clause = ""

                # If a column has a simple scalar default and is non-nullable, provide a safe default
                if not col.nullable and col.default is not None and getattr(col.default, "is_scalar", False):
                    arg = col.default.arg
                    if isinstance(arg, bool):
                        default_clause = f" DEFAULT {1 if arg else 0}" if engine.dialect.name == "sqlite" else f" DEFAULT {'TRUE' if arg else 'FALSE'}"
                    elif isinstance(arg, (int, float)):
                        default_clause = f" DEFAULT {arg}"
                    elif isinstance(arg, str):
                        safe_str = arg.replace("'", "''")
                        default_clause = f" DEFAULT '{safe_str}'"

                alter_sql = f'ALTER TABLE "{table_name}" ADD COLUMN "{col.name}" {col_type_sql}{default_clause}'
                conn.execute(text(alter_sql))
                summary["added_columns"].append(f"{table_name}.{col.name}")
                logger.info("[SchemaSync] Added missing column: %s.%s (%s)", table_name, col.name, col_type_sql)

    return summary
'''

TEST_STEP00_CODE = '''"""
test_step00_prerequisites.py — Tests for Step 0:
1. LOG_RAW_DATA=True raw visibility & LOG_RAW_DATA=False masking fallback
2. Non-destructive schema synchronization (adding missing columns to existing SQLite tables)
"""

import os
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, MetaData, String, Table, create_engine, inspect, text

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"

from app.config import settings
from app.database import Base
from app.iso_tic import build_tic_message, decode_tic_message
from app.schema_sync import synchronize_database_schema
from app.security import mask_pan, mask_raw_tic_message, sanitize_dict


def test_log_raw_data_enabled_by_default():
    assert settings.LOG_RAW_DATA is True
    pan = "4567890123450001"
    # With LOG_RAW_DATA=True, mask_pan and sanitize_dict preserve raw synthetic values
    assert mask_pan(pan) == pan
    sample = {"pan": pan, "pin_block": "1122334455667788", "cvv": "011"}
    sanitized = sanitize_dict(sample)
    assert sanitized["pan"] == pan
    assert sanitized["pin_block"] == "1122334455667788"
    assert sanitized["cvv"] == "011"

    raw_msg, compact = build_tic_message(
        "0200",
        {2: pan, 3: "0100000", 4: "000000100000", 11: "123456", 37: "000020526991", 49: "BDT", 52: "A1B2C3D4E5F60718"},
    )
    assert mask_raw_tic_message(compact) == compact
    decoded = decode_tic_message(raw_msg)
    assert decoded["valid"] is True
    assert decoded["detailed_fields"]["F52 PIN"]["value"] == "A1B2C3D4E5F60718"


def test_log_raw_data_can_be_toggled_off(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "LOG_RAW_DATA", False)
    pan = "4567890123450001"
    assert mask_pan(pan) == "456789******0001"
    sample = {"pan": pan, "pin_block": "1122334455667788"}
    sanitized = sanitize_dict(sample)
    assert sanitized["pan"] == "456789******0001"
    assert sanitized["pin_block"] == "***MASKED***"


def test_schema_sync_adds_missing_columns_without_data_loss():
    temp_engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", future=True)
    with temp_engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            text(
                "CREATE TABLE customers ("
                "id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, "
                "customer_number VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, "
                "first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL"
                ")"
            )
        )
        conn.execute(
            text("INSERT INTO customers (id, customer_number, first_name) VALUES ('c1', 'CUST-001', 'Mehedi')")
        )

    summary = synchronize_database_schema(temp_engine, Base)
    assert any(col.startswith("customers.") for col in summary["added_columns"])

    inspector = inspect(temp_engine)
    col_names = {c["name"] for c in inspector.get_columns("customers")}
    assert "last_name" in col_names
    assert "risk_category" in col_names

    with temp_engine.connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute(text("SELECT customer_number, first_name FROM customers WHERE id = 'c1'")).fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        assert row[0] == "CUST-001"
        assert row[1] == "Mehedi"
'''

                    "text": "_backups/\n",

                "anchor": "    HSM_HEADER_LENGTH: int = 4",
                "text": "    LOG_RAW_DATA: bool = True",
            }
        ],
    )

    # 4. Patch backend/app/security.py so LOG_RAW_DATA=True preserves raw PANs, PIN blocks, and dicts
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/security.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step00_02:mask_pan_raw",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": 'def mask_pan(pan: str) -> str:\n    """Mask PAN leaving first 6 and last 4 digits visible."""',
                "text": (
                    "    if getattr(settings, 'LOG_RAW_DATA', True):\n"
                    "        return str(pan or '')"
                ),
            },
            {
                "marker": "step00_02:sanitize_dict_raw",

class ProcessingSystem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "processing_systems"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=gen_uuid)

    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False)
    system_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False, default="HOST_SWITCH")  # HOST_SWITCH, CARD_SCHEME, NATIONAL_SWITCH, INTERNAL
    message_format: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), nullable=False, default="TIC_V2164E")  # TIC_V2164E, ISO8583_1987
    enabled: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)

SEED_ADDITION = '''

def seed_processing_systems_and_institutions(db: Session) -> None:
    """
    Idempotently seeds:
      1. Processing Systems: ITCL (default), VISA, MASTERCARD, NPSB, INTERNAL
      2. Initial Banks (all assigned to ITCL): xBank, yBank, zBank
      3. Institution-to-Processing-System participation records (all initial banks -> ITCL)
      4. Sample BIN Ranges mapped to xBank, yBank, zBank under ITCL
    Safe to run on every startup, including existing databases.
    """
    from app.models import (
        BinRange,
        Institution,
        InstitutionProcessingSystem,
        ProcessingSystem,
    )

    ps_definitions = [
        (
            "ITCL",
            "Information Technology Consultants Ltd (QCash Host Switch)",
            "HOST_SWITCH",
            "TIC_V2164E",
            True,
            True,
            {
                "protocol": "Rajon TIC/TCI v2.164e",
                "country": "BD",
                "default_currency": "BDT",
                "header_h1": "A4M",
                "settlement_cutover": "23:59",
            },
        ),
        (
            "VISA",
            "VisaNet / Visa Clearing Exchange (VCX)",
            "CARD_SCHEME",
            "ISO8583_1987",
            True,
            False,
            {
                "protocol": "ISO 8583:1987 VIP",
                "default_currency": "USD",
                "network_id": "0002",
            },
        ),
        (
            "MASTERCARD",
            "Mastercard Banknet / MDS",
            "CARD_SCHEME",
            "ISO8583_1987",
            True,
            False,
            {
                "protocol": "ISO 8583:1987 CIS/MDS",
                "default_currency": "USD",
                "network_id": "0003",
            },
        ),
        (
            "NPSB",
            "National Payment Switch Bangladesh (Bangladesh Bank)",
            "NATIONAL_SWITCH",
            "ISO8583_1987",
            True,
            False,
            {
                "protocol": "ISO 8583:1987 NPSB",
                "country": "BD",
                "default_currency": "BDT",
                "network_id": "0050",
            },
        ),
        (
            "INTERNAL",
            "RAJON Internal Host Loopback",
            "INTERNAL",
            "TIC_V2164E",
            True,
            False,
            {
                "protocol": "INTERNAL_LOOPBACK",
                "default_currency": "BDT",
            },
        ),
    ]

    ps_map = {}
    for code, name, stype, fmt, enabled, is_def, cfg in ps_definitions:
        existing_ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == code).first()
        if not existing_ps:
            existing_ps = ProcessingSystem(
                ps_code=code,
                name=name,
                system_type=stype,
                message_format=fmt,
                enabled=enabled,
                is_default=is_def,
                configuration=cfg,
            )
            db.add(existing_ps)
            db.flush()
        ps_map[code] = existing_ps

    itcl_ps = ps_map["ITCL"]

    # Seed initial banks (xBank, yBank, zBank) — all strictly assigned to ITCL
    bank_definitions = [
        ("XBANK", "xBank PLC", "xBank", "123456", "123456", "BOTH", "SETL-XBANK-001"),
        ("YBANK", "yBank Limited", "yBank", "223456", "223456", "BOTH", "SETL-YBANK-002"),
        ("ZBANK", "zBank Commercial PLC", "zBank", "323456", "323456", "BOTH", "SETL-ZBANK-003"),
    ]

    inst_map = {}
    for icode, iname, short, acq_id, fwd_id, role, setl_acct in bank_definitions:
        inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == icode).first()
        if not inst:
            inst = Institution(
                institution_code=icode,
                name=iname,
                short_name=short,
                acquirer_id=acq_id,
                forwarding_id=fwd_id,
                role=role,
                processing_system_id=itcl_ps.id,
                country_code="050",
                currency="BDT",
                settlement_account_number=setl_acct,
                status="ACTIVE",
                configuration={"on_us_host": "ITCL", "stand_in_enabled": True},
            )
            db.add(inst)
            db.flush()
        inst_map[icode] = inst

        # Ensure primary ITCL participation link exists in institution_processing_systems
        link = (
            db.query(InstitutionProcessingSystem)
            .filter(
                InstitutionProcessingSystem.institution_id == inst.id,
                InstitutionProcessingSystem.processing_system_id == itcl_ps.id,
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not link:
            db.add(
                InstitutionProcessingSystem(
                    institution_id=inst.id,
                    processing_system_id=itcl_ps.id,
                    member_id=f"ITCL-{icode}",
                    acquirer_id=acq_id,
                    network_identifier="ITCL_QCSH",
                    issuer_enabled=True,
                    acquirer_enabled=True,
                    message_format="TIC_V2164E",
                    routing_configuration={"priority": 1, "is_primary_host": True},
                    status="ACTIVE",
                )
            )
            db.flush()

    # Seed sample BIN ranges under ITCL
    # Note: 456789 matches existing seeded cards (4567890123450001..0005)
    bin_definitions = [
        ("456789", "4567890000000000", "4567899999999999", 16, "XBANK", "DEBIT", "VISA_DEBIT_CLASSIC", "ITCL", True),
        ("456790", "4567900000000000", "4567909999999999", 16, "XBANK", "CREDIT", "VISA_GOLD_CREDIT", "ITCL", True),
        ("512345", "5123450000000000", "5123459999999999", 16, "YBANK", "DEBIT", "MC_DEBIT_STANDARD", "ITCL", True),
        ("489012", "4890120000000000", "4890129999999999", 16, "ZBANK", "DEBIT", "QCASH_PROPRIETARY_DEBIT", "ITCL", True),
    ]

    for prefix, low, high, plen, icode, ctype, prod, scheme, on_us in bin_definitions:
        existing_bin = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.bin_prefix == prefix).first()
        if not existing_bin and icode in inst_map:
            db.add(
                BinRange(
                    bin_prefix=prefix,
                    bin_low=low,
                    bin_high=high,
                    pan_length=plen,
                    institution_id=inst_map[icode].id,
                    processing_system_id=itcl_ps.id,
                    card_type=ctype,
                    card_product=prod,
                    scheme=scheme,
                    country_code="050",
                    currency="BDT",
                    is_on_us=on_us,
                    status="ACTIVE",
                )
            )

    db.commit()
'''

                    "        return"

            },

        ],
    )

    session.record_progress(

        contract_items=[

    existing = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == payload.ps_code.upper()).first()

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ps)
    return ps

def _serialize_institution(inst: Institution) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": inst.id,
        "institution_code": inst.institution_code,
        "name": inst.name,
        "short_name": inst.short_name,
        "acquirer_id": inst.acquirer_id,
        "forwarding_id": inst.forwarding_id,
        "role": inst.role,
        "processing_system_id": inst.processing_system_id,
        "ps_code": inst.primary_processing_system.ps_code if inst.primary_processing_system else "ITCL",
        "ps_name": inst.primary_processing_system.name if inst.primary_processing_system else "ITCL Switch",
        "country_code": inst.country_code,
        "currency": inst.currency,
        "settlement_account_number": inst.settlement_account_number,
        "status": inst.status,
        "configuration": inst.configuration or {},
        "created_at": inst.created_at,
        "updated_at": inst.updated_at,
    }


@router.get("/institutions", response_model=List[InstitutionOut])
def list_institutions(db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    insts = db.query(Institution).order_by(Institution.institution_code.asc()).all()
    return [_serialize_institution(i) for i in insts]


@router.post("/institutions", response_model=InstitutionOut)
def create_institution(payload: InstitutionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    icode = payload.institution_code.upper()
    existing = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == icode).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Institution '{icode}' already exists")

    # Resolve processing system (default to ITCL if not supplied)
    ps_id = payload.processing_system_id
    if not ps_id:
        ps_code_target = (payload.ps_code or "ITCL").upper()
        ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == ps_code_target).first()
        if not ps:
            ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.ps_code == "ITCL").first()
        if not ps:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Default ITCL processing system not found in database")
        ps_id = ps.id
    else:
        ps = db.query(ProcessingSystem).filter(ProcessingSystem.id == ps_id).first()
        if not ps:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Specified processing system not found")

    inst = Institution(
        institution_code=icode,
        name=payload.name,
        short_name=payload.short_name or payload.name,
        acquirer_id=payload.acquirer_id,
        forwarding_id=payload.forwarding_id,
        role=payload.role,
        processing_system_id=ps_id,
        country_code=payload.country_code,
        currency=payload.currency,
        settlement_account_number=payload.settlement_account_number,
        status=payload.status,
        configuration=payload.configuration,
    )
    db.add(inst)
    db.flush()

    # Automatically create primary participation link in institution_processing_systems
    link = InstitutionProcessingSystem(
        institution_id=inst.id,
        processing_system_id=ps.id,
        member_id=f"{ps.ps_code}-{icode}",
        acquirer_id=payload.acquirer_id,
        network_identifier=f"{ps.ps_code}_HOST",
        issuer_enabled=True,
        acquirer_enabled=True,
        message_format=ps.message_format,
        routing_configuration={"is_primary_host": True},
        status="ACTIVE",
    )
    db.add(link)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inst)
    return _serialize_institution(inst)


@router.put("/institutions/{inst_id}", response_model=InstitutionOut)
def update_institution(inst_id: str, payload: InstitutionUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == inst_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Institution not found")
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for k, v in data.items():
        setattr(inst, k, v)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inst)
    return _serialize_institution(inst)


@router.delete("/institutions/{inst_id}")
def delete_institution(inst_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == inst_id).first()
    if not inst:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Institution not found")
    if inst.cards or inst.accounts:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Cannot delete institution with active cards or accounts. Soft close instead.")
    db.delete(inst)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "deleted", "institution_id": inst_id}

    inst = db.query(Institution).filter(Institution.id == inst_id).first()

    if not ps:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Processing system not found")

    existing = db.query(InstitutionProcessingSystem).filter(

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Institution is already linked to this processing system")

    link = InstitutionProcessingSystem(
        institution_id=inst_id,
        processing_system_id=payload.processing_system_id,
        member_id=payload.member_id,
        acquirer_id=payload.acquirer_id,
        network_identifier=payload.network_identifier,
        issuer_enabled=payload.issuer_enabled,
        acquirer_enabled=payload.acquirer_enabled,
        message_format=payload.message_format or ps.message_format,
        routing_configuration=payload.routing_configuration,
        status=payload.status,
    )
    db.add(link)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(link)
    return {
        "id": link.id,
        "institution_id": link.institution_id,
        "institution_code": inst.institution_code,
        "institution_name": inst.name,
        "processing_system_id": link.processing_system_id,
        "ps_code": ps.ps_code,
        "ps_name": ps.name,
        "member_id": link.member_id,
        "acquirer_id": link.acquirer_id,
        "network_identifier": link.network_identifier,
        "issuer_enabled": link.issuer_enabled,
        "acquirer_enabled": link.acquirer_enabled,
        "message_format": link.message_format,
        "routing_configuration": link.routing_configuration,
        "status": link.status,
        "effective_from": link.effective_from,
        "effective_to": link.effective_to,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
        "updated_at": link.updated_at,
    }

@router.post("/bin-ranges", response_model=BinRangeOut)
def create_bin_range(payload: BinRangeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    prefix = payload.bin_prefix.strip()

        bin_high=bin_high,

        institution_id=payload.institution_id,
        processing_system_id=ps_id,
        card_type=payload.card_type,
        card_product=payload.card_product,
        scheme=payload.scheme,
        country_code=payload.country_code,
        currency=payload.currency,
        is_on_us=payload.is_on_us,
        status=payload.status,
    )
    db.add(b)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(b)
    return _serialize_bin(b)

@router.get("/bin-ranges/lookup/{pan}")
def lookup_bin_for_pan(pan: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    clean_pan = "".join(ch for ch in pan if ch.isdigit())
    if len(clean_pan) < 6:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PAN is too short for BIN lookup (minimum 6 digits)")

    # Check 6, 8, 10, 12 digit prefixes
    matched = None
    for length in (12, 10, 8, 6):
        if len(clean_pan) >= length:
            prefix = clean_pan[:length]
            matched = db.query(BinRange).filter(BinRange.bin_prefix == prefix).first()
            if matched:
                break

    if not matched:
        # Fallback to general range check
        all_bins = db.query(BinRange).all()
        for b in all_bins:
            if b.bin_low and b.bin_high:
                if b.bin_low.ljust(19, '0') <= clean_pan.ljust(19, '0') <= b.bin_high.ljust(19, '9'):
                    matched = b
                    break

    if not matched:
        return {"found": False, "pan_masked": pan[:6] + "*" * (len(pan) - 10) + pan[-4:] if len(pan) >= 10 else "****", "message": "No matching BIN range found. Defaulting to On-Us ITCL switch."}

    return {
        "found": True,
        "bin_prefix": matched.bin_prefix,
        "institution": {
            "id": matched.institution.id,
            "code": matched.institution.institution_code,
            "name": matched.institution.name,
            "acquirer_id": matched.institution.acquirer_id,
        },
        "processing_system": {
            "id": matched.processing_system.id,
            "code": matched.processing_system.ps_code,
            "name": matched.processing_system.name,
        },
        "card_product": matched.card_product,
        "scheme": matched.scheme,
        "is_on_us": matched.is_on_us,
    }
'''

def test_list_processing_systems(client):
    res = client.get("/api/processing-systems")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    codes = [p["ps_code"] for p in data]
    assert "ITCL" in codes
    assert "VISA" in codes
    assert "MASTERCARD" in codes
    assert "NPSB" in codes


def test_list_institutions_default_itcl(client):
    res = client.get("/api/institutions")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    codes = [i["institution_code"] for i in data]
    assert "XBANK" in codes
    assert "YBANK" in codes
    assert "ZBANK" in codes
    for inst in data:
        assert inst["ps_code"] == "ITCL"


def test_create_institution_defaults_to_itcl(client):
    payload = {
        "institution_code": "IFIC",
        "name": "IFIC Bank PLC",
        "acquirer_id": "443322",
        "role": "BOTH"
    }
    res = client.post("/api/institutions", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["institution_code"] == "IFIC"
    assert data["ps_code"] == "ITCL"


def test_bin_lookup_for_pan(client):
    # 4567890123450001 belongs to XBANK under ITCL
    res = client.get("/api/bin-ranges/lookup/4567890123450001")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["found"] is True
    assert data["institution"]["code"] == "XBANK"
    assert data["processing_system"]["code"] == "ITCL"

              + Add BIN Range
            </button>
          </form>

          {/* BIN Table */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                  <th className="py-2.5">BIN Prefix</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Issuing Bank</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Processing System</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Card Product</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">Scheme</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5">On-Us?</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
                {bins.map((b) => (
                  <tr key={b.id}>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-bold text-emerald-500">{b.bin_prefix}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 font-sans font-medium">{b.institution_name} ({b.institution_code})</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-400">{b.ps_code}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{b.card_product}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{b.scheme}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5">{b.is_on_us ? 'YES' : 'NO'}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
'''

def test_entities_have_institution_links(db_session):
    xbank = db_session.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == "XBANK").first()
    assert xbank is not None

    cust = db_session.query(Customer).first()
    assert cust.institution_id == xbank.id

    acct = db_session.query(Account).first()
    assert acct.institution_id == xbank.id

    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    assert card.institution_id == xbank.id


def test_transaction_records_institution_and_ps_code(db_session):
    proc = HostTransactionProcessor(db_session)
    res = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": "4567890123450001",
            "3": "0100000",
            "4": "000000150000",
            "11": "300001",
            "32": "123456",  # XBANK acquirer ID
            "37": "000095000001",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res["response_code"] == "00"

    tx = db_session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == res["transaction_id"]).first()
    assert tx is not None
    assert tx.ps_code == "ITCL"
    assert tx.is_on_us is True
    assert tx.issuer_institution_id is not None
    assert tx.acquirer_institution_id is not None
    assert tx.issuer_institution_id == tx.acquirer_institution_id


def test_api_creates_card_with_institution(client, db_session):
    ybank = db_session.query(Institution).filter(Institution.institution_code == "YBANK").first()
    cust = db_session.query(Customer).first()
    acct = db_session.query(Account).first()

    payload = {

        "expiry_year": 2028,
        "linked_account_id": acct.id,
        "institution_id": ybank.id,
    }
    res = client.post("/api/cards", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()

                    "            if bin_match.processing_system:\n"
                    "                ps_code_val = bin_match.processing_system.ps_code\n"

                ),
            },

                    "            idempotency_key=idem_key,\n"
                    "            issuer_institution_id=card.institution_id if (card and card.institution_id) else issuer_inst_id,\n"
                    "            acquirer_institution_id=acquirer_inst_id,\n"
                    "            ps_code=ps_code_val,\n"
                    "        )"

            },

"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step03_01.py

  1. AuditTrail ORM model in backend/app/models.py

  3. backend/app/audit_service.py for capturing before/after state diffs
  4. PUT and DELETE endpoints with 409 Conflict protection for Customers, Accounts, Cards
  5. GET /api/audit-trail endpoint in backend/app/api_routes.py
  6. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step03_crud_and_audit.py

from pathlib import Path
import sys

AUDIT_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
audit_service.py — Entity Snapshot and Audit Trail Logger
Captures before/after JSON states and diff summaries for regulatory audit compliance.
"""

from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models import AuditTrail


def serialize_entity(entity: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Serialize a SQLAlchemy declarative model into a clean JSON-serializable dict."""
    if entity is None:
        return {}
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    for col in entity.__table__.columns:
        val = getattr(entity, col.name, None)
        if hasattr(val, "isoformat"):
            out[col.name] = val.isoformat()
        elif hasattr(val, "__float__"):
            out[col.name] = float(val)
        else:
            out[col.name] = val
    return out


def record_audit(
    db: Session,
    entity_type: str,
    entity_id: str,
    action: str,
    performed_by: str = "admin",
    before_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    after_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    change_summary: Optional[str] = None,
) -> AuditTrail:
    """Record an immutable audit trail entry."""
    entry = AuditTrail(
        entity_type=entity_type.upper(),
        entity_id=str(entity_id),
        action=action.upper(),
        performed_by=performed_by,
        before_state=before_state,
        after_state=after_state,
        change_summary=change_summary,
    )
    db.add(entry)
    db.flush()
    return entry
'''

def test_customer_update_creates_audit_entry(client, db_session):
    cust = db_session.query(Customer).first()
    assert cust is not None

    update_payload = {
        "first_name": "Tariq Updated",
        "email": "tariq.new@example.test",
        "risk_category": "VIP"
    }
    res = client.put(f"/api/customers/{cust.id}", json=update_payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["first_name"] == "Tariq Updated"
    assert data["risk_category"] == "VIP"

    audit = (
        db_session.query(AuditTrail)
        .filter(AuditTrail.entity_type == "CUSTOMER", AuditTrail.entity_id == cust.id)
        .order_by(AuditTrail.created_at.desc())
        .first()
    )
    assert audit is not None
    assert audit.action == "UPDATE"
    assert audit.before_state["first_name"] == "Tariq"
    assert audit.after_state["first_name"] == "Tariq Updated"


def test_delete_customer_with_linked_accounts_fails_409(client, db_session):
    cust = db_session.query(Customer).filter(Customer.accounts.any()).first()
    assert cust is not None

    # Normal delete without force must return 409 Conflict
    res = client.delete(f"/api/customers/{cust.id}")
    assert res.status_code == 409
    assert "active accounts" in res.json()["detail"].lower()


def test_card_update_and_audit(client, db_session):
    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    assert card is not None

    payload = {
        "cardholder_name": "NEW CARDHOLDER NAME",
        "expiry_month": 11,
        "expiry_year": 2029,
        "card_status": "BLOCKED"
    }
    res = client.put(f"/api/cards/{card.id}", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["cardholder_name"] == "NEW CARDHOLDER NAME"
    assert res.json()["card_status"] == "BLOCKED"

    audit = (
        db_session.query(AuditTrail)
        .filter(AuditTrail.entity_type == "CARD", AuditTrail.entity_id == card.id)
        .order_by(AuditTrail.created_at.desc())
        .first()
    )
    assert audit is not None
    assert audit.action == "UPDATE"
    assert audit.after_state["card_status"] == "BLOCKED"


def test_query_audit_trail_endpoint(client, db_session):
    res = client.get("/api/audit-trail")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_card_profile_crud_and_conflict_check(client, db_session):
    # 1. Create a custom profile
    payload = {
        "profile_code": "PROF_CUSTOM_01",
        "profile_name": "Custom Student Debit Profile",
        "card_product": "VISA_STUDENT",
        "domestic_enabled": True,
        "international_enabled": False,
        "ecommerce_enabled": False,
        "contactless_enabled": True,
        "cash_enabled": True
    }
    create_res = client.post("/api/card-profiles", json=payload)
    assert create_res.status_code == 200
    prof_id = create_res.json()["id"]

    # 2. Update the profile
    update_res = client.put(f"/api/card-profiles/{prof_id}", json={"ecommerce_enabled": True})
    assert update_res.status_code == 200
    assert update_res.json()["ecommerce_enabled"] is True

    # 3. Check audit trail
    audit = db_session.query(AuditTrail).filter(
        AuditTrail.entity_type == "CARD_PROFILE",
        AuditTrail.entity_id == prof_id,
        AuditTrail.action == "UPDATE"
    ).first()
    assert audit is not None
    assert audit.after_state["ecommerce_enabled"] is True

    # 4. Deleting a profile referenced by cards must return 409
    std_prof = db_session.query(CardProfile).filter(CardProfile.profile_code == "PROF_DOM_STD").first()
    del_conflict = client.delete(f"/api/card-profiles/{std_prof.id}")
    assert del_conflict.status_code == 409

    # 5. Deleting unreferenced custom profile succeeds
    del_ok = client.delete(f"/api/card-profiles/{prof_id}")
    assert del_ok.status_code == 200


def test_transaction_code_delete(client, db_session):
    tc = TransactionCode(
        transaction_code="99",
        transaction_name="Test Temp Code",
        processing_code="0990000",
        default_mti="0200"
    )
    db_session.add(tc)
    db_session.commit()

    del_res = client.delete(f"/api/transaction-codes/{tc.id}")

    audit = db_session.query(AuditTrail).filter(

                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Target Entity:</span> {selectedAudit.entity_type} ({selectedAudit.entity_id})</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Timestamp:</span> {new Date(selectedAudit.created_at).toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-400">Action:</span> <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{selectedAudit.action}</span> by {selectedAudit.performed_by}</div>
                <div className="text-slate-300 font-sans pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">{selectedAudit.change_summary}</div>
              </div>

              {selectedAudit.before_state && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-400 font-bold mb-1">State Before Change:</div>
                  <pre className="bg-slate-950 text-rose-300 p-3 rounded-lg max-h-48 overflow-y-auto text-[11px]">
                    {JSON.stringify(selectedAudit.before_state, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {selectedAudit.after_state && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-1">State After Change:</div>
                  <pre className="bg-slate-950 text-emerald-300 p-3 rounded-lg max-h-48 overflow-y-auto text-[11px]">
                    {JSON.stringify(selectedAudit.after_state, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 py-12 text-center">
              Select an audit event to inspect the before/after state diff.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
'''
