def test_link_multiple_accounts_to_card(client, db_session):
    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    cust = card.customer

    # Create a secondary CURRENT account for the customer
    sec_acct = Account(
        account_number="2002009999",
        customer_id=cust.id,
        account_type="CURRENT",
        currency="BDT",
        available_balance=Decimal("50000.00"),
        ledger_balance=Decimal("50000.00"),
        account_status="ACTIVE",
        institution_id=card.institution_id,
    )
    db_session.add(sec_acct)
    db_session.commit()

    # Link secondary account to card via API
    payload = {
        "account_id": sec_acct.id,
        "account_role": "SECONDARY",
        "priority": 2,
    }
    res = client.post(f"/api/cards/{card.id}/accounts", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["account_number"] == "2002009999"
    assert data["account_role"] == "SECONDARY"
    assert data["priority"] == 2

    # Query card accounts
    get_res = client.get(f"/api/cards/{card.id}/accounts")
    assert get_res.status_code == 200
    links = get_res.json()
    assert len(links) >= 2


def test_de3_account_selection_savings_vs_current(db_session):
    proc = HostTransactionProcessor(db_session)
    card = db_session.query(Card).filter(Card.test_pan_reference == "4567890123450001").first()

    # Seeded primary account is SAVINGS (balance: 150,000.00)
    primary_acct = db_session.query(Account).filter(Account.id == card.linked_account_id).first()
    assert primary_acct.account_type == "SAVINGS"

    # Add a CURRENT account with 20,000.00 balance
    curr_acct = Account(
        account_number="2002008888",
        customer_id=card.customer_id,
        account_type="CURRENT",
        currency="BDT",
        available_balance=Decimal("20000.00"),
        ledger_balance=Decimal("20000.00"),
        account_status="ACTIVE",
        institution_id=card.institution_id,
    )
    db_session.add(curr_acct)
    db_session.flush()

    # Link CURRENT account to the card
    db_session.add(
        CardAccount(
            card_id=card.id,
            account_id=curr_acct.id,
            account_role="SECONDARY",
            currency="BDT",
            priority=2,
            status="ACTIVE",
        )
    )
    db_session.commit()

    # Transaction 1: DE3 = 0100100 (digits 3-4 = 01 -> Current/Checking account requested)
    res_curr = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": card.test_pan_reference,
            "3": "0100100",  # 010 (tran code) + 01 (From Checking) + 00 (To Unspecified)
            "4": "000000050000",  # 500.00 BDT
            "11": "400001",
            "37": "000099000001",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res_curr["response_code"] == "00"
    tx_curr = db_session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == res_curr["transaction_id"]).first()
    assert tx_curr.account_id == curr_acct.id

    # Transaction 2: DE3 = 0101100 (digits 3-4 = 11 -> Savings account requested)
    res_sav = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": card.test_pan_reference,
            "3": "0101100",  # 010 (tran code) + 11 (From Savings) + 00 (To Unspecified)
            "4": "000000050000",  # 500.00 BDT
            "11": "400002",
            "37": "000099000002",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res_sav["response_code"] == "00"
    tx_sav = db_session.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.id == res_sav["transaction_id"]).first()
    assert tx_sav.account_id == primary_acct.id
'''


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 04: Complete Card and Account Multi-Linking")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step04",
        title="Implement Complete Multi-Account Card Linking & DE3 Account Selection Engine",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add CardAccount schemas
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step04:schemas_card_account_links",
                "action": "append",
                "text": (
                    "\n# ==============================================================================\n"
                    "# STEP 4 SCHEMAS: CARD & ACCOUNT MULTI-LINKING\n"
                    "# ==============================================================================\n\n"
                    "class CardAccountLinkCreate(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    account_id: str\n"
                    '    account_role: str = "SECONDARY"  # PRIMARY, SECONDARY\n'
                    "    priority: int = 2\n"
                    '    status: str = "ACTIVE"\n\n\n'
                    "class CardAccountLinkUpdate(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    account_role: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    priority: Optional[int] = None\n"
                    "    status: Optional[str] = None\n\n\n"
                    "class CardAccountLinkOut(BaseModel):\n"
                    "    id: str\n"
                    "    card_id: str\n"
                    "    account_id: str\n"
                    "    account_number: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    account_type: Optional[str] = None\n"
                    "    currency: str\n"
                    "    available_balance: Optional[float] = None\n"
                    "    account_role: str\n"
                    "    priority: int\n"
                    "    status: str\n"
                    "    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n"
                ),
            }
        ],
    )

    # 2. Patch backend/app/api_routes.py to add endpoints for card accounts
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/api_routes.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step04:api_routes_schema_imports",
                "action": "insert_after",
                "anchor": "    CardUpdate,",
                "text": (
                    "    CardAccountLinkCreate,\n"
                    "    CardAccountLinkOut,\n"
                    "    CardAccountLinkUpdate,"
                ),
            },
            {
                "marker": "step04:api_card_account_endpoints",
                "action": "insert_before",
                "anchor": "# ==============================================================================\n# 3. TRANSACTION CODES, HOST CONFIGURATION & RESPONSE CODES",
                "text": (
                    "# --- CARD & ACCOUNT MULTI-LINKING (STEP 4) ---\n\n"
                    "@router.get('/cards/{card_id}/accounts', response_model=List[CardAccountLinkOut])\n"
                    "def list_card_accounts(card_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not card:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card not found')\n"
                    "    links = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id).order_by(CardAccount.priority.asc()).all()\n"
                    "    out = []\n"
                    "    for l in links:\n"
                    "        acct = l.account\n"
                    "        out.append({\n"
                    "            'id': l.id,\n"
                    "            'card_id': l.card_id,\n"
                    "            'account_id': l.account_id,\n"
                    "            'account_number': acct.account_number if acct else None,\n"
                    "            'account_type': acct.account_type if acct else None,\n"
                    "            'currency': l.currency,\n"
                    "            'available_balance': float(acct.available_balance) if acct else 0.0,\n"
                    "            'account_role': l.account_role,\n"
                    "            'priority': l.priority,\n"
                    "            'status': l.status,\n"
                    "        })\n"
                    "    return out\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/cards/{card_id}/accounts', response_model=CardAccountLinkOut)\n"
                    "def link_account_to_card(card_id: str, payload: CardAccountLinkCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == card_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not card:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card not found')\n"
                    "    acct = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == payload.account_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not acct:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Account not found')\n"
                    "    existing = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id, CardAccount.account_id == acct.id).first()\n"
                    "    if existing:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Account is already linked to this card')\n\n"
                    "    if payload.account_role == 'PRIMARY':\n"
                    "        db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == card.id).update({'account_role': 'SECONDARY'}, synchronize_session=False)\n"
                    "        card.linked_account_id = acct.id\n\n"
                    "    link = CardAccount(\n"
                    "        card_id=card.id,\n"
                    "        account_id=acct.id,\n"
                    "        account_role=payload.account_role,\n"
                    "        currency=acct.currency,\n"
                    "        priority=payload.priority,\n"
                    "        status=payload.status,\n"
                    "    )\n"
                    "    db.add(link)\n"
                    "    db.flush()\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_ACCOUNT', link.id, 'CREATE', performed_by=current_user,\n"
                    "                 after_state=serialize_entity(link),\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Linked account {acct.account_number} to card {card.masked_pan} as {payload.account_role}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(link)\n"
                    "    return {\n"
                    "        'id': link.id,\n"
                    "        'card_id': link.card_id,\n"
                    "        'account_id': link.account_id,\n"
                    "        'account_number': acct.account_number,\n"
                    "        'account_type': acct.account_type,\n"
                    "        'currency': link.currency,\n"
                    "        'available_balance': float(acct.available_balance),\n"
                    "        'account_role': link.account_role,\n"
                    "        'priority': link.priority,\n"
                    "        'status': link.status,\n"
                    "    }\n\n\n"
                    "@router.put('/cards/accounts/{link_id}', response_model=CardAccountLinkOut)\n"
                    "def update_card_account_link(link_id: str, payload: CardAccountLinkUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    link = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.id == link_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not link:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card account link not found')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(link)\n"
                    "    if payload.account_role == 'PRIMARY':\n"
                    "        db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == link.card_id).update({'account_role': 'SECONDARY'}, synchronize_session=False)\n"
                    "        card = db.query(Card).filter(Card.id == link.card_id).first()\n"
                    "        if card:\n"
                    "            card.linked_account_id = link.account_id\n\n"
                    "    for k, v in payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():\n"
                    "        setattr(link, k, v)\n"
                    "    after = serialize_entity(link)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'CARD_ACCOUNT', link.id, 'UPDATE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before, after_state=after,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Updated card account link {link.id}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(link)\n"
                    "    acct = link.account\n"
                    "    return {\n"
                    "        'id': link.id,\n"
                    "        'card_id': link.card_id,\n"
                    "        'account_id': link.account_id,\n"
                    "        'account_number': acct.account_number if acct else None,\n"
                    "        'account_type': acct.account_type if acct else None,\n"
                    "        'currency': link.currency,\n"
                    "        'available_balance': float(acct.available_balance) if acct else 0.0,\n"
                    "        'account_role': link.account_role,\n"
                    "        'priority': link.priority,\n"
                    "        'status': link.status,\n"
                    "    }\n\n\n"
                    "@router.delete('/cards/accounts/{link_id}')\n"
                    "def unlink_account_from_card(link_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    link = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.id == link_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not link:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Card account link not found')\n"
                    "    remaining = db.query(CardAccount).filter(CardAccount.card_id == link.card_id).count()\n"

                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Cannot unlink the only account from a card. A card must have at least one linked account.')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(link)\n"

                    "                 change_summary=f'Unlinked account {link.account_id} from card {link.card_id}')\n"

                    "    return {'status': 'deleted', 'link_id': link_id}\n\n"

def test_customer_pagination_and_search(client, db_session):
    # Test search by partial name
    res = client.get("/api/customers?q=Tariq&page=1&page_size=10")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert "items" in data
    assert data["total"] >= 1
    assert any("Tariq" in c["first_name"] for c in data["items"])


def test_card_search_by_partial_pan_and_status(client, db_session):
    # Test search by partial PAN digits "0003" (which is seeded as BLOCKED)
    res = client.get("/api/cards?pan=0003&status=BLOCKED")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert "items" in data
    assert data["total"] == 1
    assert data["items"][0]["card_status"] == "BLOCKED"

def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 05: Advanced Search and Pagination")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step05",
        title="Add Advanced Search, Filtering, and Server-Side Pagination Across All Entities",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,

                    "from typing import Generic, TypeVar\n\n"
                    "T = TypeVar('T')\n\n"

                    "    items: List[T]\n"
                    "    total: int\n"
                    "    page: int\n"
                    "    page_size: int\n"
                    "    total_pages: int\n"

    )

    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/api_routes.py",
        [

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step06.py
STEP 6 — PIN, PVV and Card Generation Lab (Single Unified Installer)
Adds:
  1. backend/app/card_crypto_service.py (Luhn generation, PVV, Offset, CVV, PIN block calculations)
  2. Pydantic v2 schemas in backend/app/schemas.py
  3. API endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py (/api/cards/{id}/pin, /api/crypto/*, /api/cards/generate-test-card)
  4. frontend/src/pages/CardCryptoLabPage.tsx
  5. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  6. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step06_card_crypto.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from tools.patcher import PatcherSession, parse_installer_args

CARD_CRYPTO_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
card_crypto_service.py — Card Issuing, Luhn Validation, and Cryptographic Calculations
Interfaces with SoftHsmCryptoCore for Visa PVV, IBM 3624, CVV, and ISO PIN Blocks.
"""

import random
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from app.hsm_adapter import SoftHsmCryptoCore


def validate_luhn(pan: str) -> bool:
    """Validate Primary Account Number using Luhn formula (ISO/IEC 7812)."""
    clean = re.sub(r"\\D", "", pan or "")
    if len(clean) < 12:
        return False
    digits = [int(d) for d in clean]
    checksum = 0
    reverse_digits = digits[::-1]
    for i, d in enumerate(reverse_digits):
        if i % 2 == 1:
            doubled = d * 2
            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            checksum += d
    return checksum % 10 == 0


def calculate_luhn_check_digit(partial_pan: str) -> str:
    """Calculate the 1-digit Luhn check digit for a partial PAN."""
    clean = re.sub(r"\\D", "", partial_pan)
    digits = [int(d) for d in clean]
    checksum = 0
    # The check digit will be at an even position from right when appended
    for i, d in enumerate(digits[::-1]):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            doubled = d * 2
            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            checksum += d
    remainder = checksum % 10
    return str((10 - remainder) % 10)


def generate_luhn_pan(bin_prefix: str = "456789", length: int = 16) -> str:
    """Generate a valid synthetic PAN under a given BIN prefix matching Luhn check digit."""
    clean_bin = re.sub(r"\\D", "", bin_prefix)
    random_digits_needed = length - len(clean_bin) - 1
    if random_digits_needed < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"BIN prefix length ({len(clean_bin)}) exceeds or equals target PAN length ({length})")
    
    middle = "".join(str(random.randint(0, 9)) for _ in range(random_digits_needed))
    partial = f"{clean_bin}{middle}"
    check_digit = calculate_luhn_check_digit(partial)
    full_pan = f"{partial}{check_digit}"
    assert validate_luhn(full_pan)
    return full_pan


def calculate_visa_pvv_detailed(pan: str, pin: str, pvki: str = "1", pvk_id: str = "PVK_VISA_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate Visa PVV with step-by-step intermediate cryptographic visibility."""
    pvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(pvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    pan11 = pan[-12:-1]  # Rightmost 11 digits excluding Luhn check digit
    tsp = f"{pan11}{pvki[0]}{pin[:4]}"
    cipher = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(tsp, pvk_hex, decrypt=False)
    
    digits_found = [ch for ch in cipher if ch.isdigit()]
    decimalized_alphas = [str(int(ch, 16) - 10) for ch in cipher if ch in "ABCDEF"]
    combined = "".join(digits_found + decimalized_alphas)
    pvv = combined[:4]
    
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "pin": pin,
        "pvki": pvki,
        "pvk_id": pvk_id,
        "pvk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(pvk_hex),
        "tsp_constructed": tsp,
        "3des_cipher_hex": cipher,
        "decimalized_sequence": combined,
        "calculated_pvv": pvv,
    }


def calculate_ibm_offset_detailed(pan: str, pin: str, pvk_id: str = "PVK_VISA_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate IBM 3624 PIN Offset with step-by-step intermediate visibility."""
    pvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(pvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    dec_table = "0123456789012345"
    val_data = pan[-16:].zfill(16)
    enc = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(val_data, pvk_hex, decrypt=False)
    natural_pin = "".join(dec_table[int(enc[i], 16)] for i in range(len(pin)))
    offset = "".join(str((int(pin[i]) - int(natural_pin[i]) + 10) % 10) for i in range(len(pin)))
    
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "pin": pin,
        "pvk_id": pvk_id,
        "validation_data": val_data,
        "encrypted_validation_data": enc,
        "natural_pin": natural_pin,
        "calculated_offset": offset[:4],
    }


def calculate_cvv_detailed(pan: str, expiry_yy_mm: str, service_code: str = "101", cvk_id: str = "CVK_MAIN_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate CVV1 / CVV2 / iCVV with intermediate DES blocks."""
    cvk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(cvk_id, "5566778899AABBCC5566778899AABBCC")
    calculated_cvv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_cvv(pan, expiry_yy_mm, service_code, cvk_hex)
    return {
        "pan": pan,
        "expiry_yy_mm": expiry_yy_mm,
        "service_code": service_code,
        "cvk_id": cvk_id,
        "cvk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(cvk_hex),
        "calculated_cvv": calculated_cvv,
    }


def pack_pin_block_detailed(pin: str, pan: str, format_name: str = "ISO_0", awk_id: str = "AWK_ATM_01") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Pack clear PIN into ISO Format 0, 1, or 3 PIN block and encrypt under AWK."""
    awk_hex = SoftHsmCryptoCore.INTERNAL_CLEAR_KEYS.get(awk_id, "1A2B3C4D5E6F70811A2B3C4D5E6F7081")
    
    if format_name.upper() == "ISO_0":
        pin_part = f"0{len(pin)}{pin}".ljust(16, "F")
        pan12 = pan[-13:-1].zfill(12)
        pan_part = f"0000{pan12}"
        clear_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.xor_hex(pin_part, pan_part)
    elif format_name.upper() == "ISO_1":
        # Format 1: 1 + L + PIN + Random Pad
        rand_pad = "".join(f"{random.randint(0, 15):X}" for _ in range(14 - len(pin)))
        clear_block = f"1{len(pin)}{pin}{rand_pad}"
    elif format_name.upper() == "ISO_3":
        # Format 3: 3 + L + PIN + Random (F-pad) XOR PAN
        rand_pad = "".join(f"{random.choice('0123456789ABCDEF')}" for _ in range(14 - len(pin)))
        pin_part = f"3{len(pin)}{pin}{rand_pad}"
        pan12 = pan[-13:-1].zfill(12)
        pan_part = f"0000{pan12}"
        clear_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.xor_hex(pin_part, pan_part)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported PIN block format: {format_name}")

    encrypted_block = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clear_block, awk_hex, decrypt=False)
    
    return {
        "format": format_name.upper(),
        "pin": pin,
        "pan": pan,
        "awk_id": awk_id,
        "awk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(awk_hex),
        "clear_pin_block": clear_block,
        "encrypted_pin_block": encrypted_block,
    }
'''

TEST_STEP06_CODE = '''"""
test_step06_card_crypto.py — Tests for Step 6 Luhn Generation, Visa PVV, CVV, and PIN Change
"""

import os
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"

from app.database import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.main import app
from app.models import Card, PinProfile
from app.card_crypto_service import (
    calculate_cvv_detailed,
    calculate_luhn_check_digit,
    calculate_visa_pvv_detailed,
    generate_luhn_pan,
    pack_pin_block_detailed,
    validate_luhn,
)
from app.seed_data import seed_initial_data
from app.security import create_access_token
from app.config import settings


@pytest.fixture()
def db_session():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    session = SessionLocal()
    seed_initial_data(session)
    yield session
    session.close()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture()
def client(db_session):
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        token = create_access_token(subject=settings.ADMIN_USERNAME)
        c.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        yield c


def test_luhn_generation_and_validation():
    pan = generate_luhn_pan("456789", 16)
    assert pan.startswith("456789")
    assert len(pan) == 16
    assert validate_luhn(pan) is True
    # Invalidate check digit
    bad_pan = pan[:-1] + str((int(pan[-1]) + 1) % 10)
    assert validate_luhn(bad_pan) is False


def test_visa_pvv_calculation():
    # Test known vector
    res = calculate_visa_pvv_detailed("4567890123450001", "1234", "1", "PVK_VISA_01")
    assert len(res["calculated_pvv"]) == 4
    assert res["calculated_pvv"].isdigit()


def test_cvv_derivation():
    res = calculate_cvv_detailed("4567890123450001", "2812", "101")
    assert len(res["calculated_cvv"]) == 3
    assert res["calculated_cvv"].isdigit()


def test_iso0_pin_block_packing():
    res = pack_pin_block_detailed("1234", "4567890123450001", "ISO_0")
    assert len(res["encrypted_pin_block"]) == 16
    assert len(res["clear_pin_block"]) == 16


def test_card_pin_change_endpoint(client, db_session):
    card = db_session.query(Card).first()
    pin_prof_before = card.pin_profile.pin_offset_reference

    # Change PIN to 4321
    res = client.post(f"/api/cards/{card.id}/pin", json={"new_pin": "4321"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["status"] == "updated"
    assert data["new_pvv"] != pin_prof_before

    db_session.refresh(card.pin_profile)
    assert card.pin_profile.pin_offset_reference == data["new_pvv"]
    assert card.pin_profile.retry_counter == 0
'''


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_installer_args("Step 06: PIN, PVV and Card Generation Lab")
    session = PatcherSession(
        step_id="step06",
        title="Implement PIN, PVV, CVV, ISO PIN Block, and Synthetic Card Personalization Lab",
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # 1. Write backend/app/card_crypto_service.py
    session.write_file("backend/app/card_crypto_service.py", CARD_CRYPTO_SERVICE_CODE)

    # 2. Patch backend/app/schemas.py to add card crypto schemas
    session.patch_file(
        "backend/app/schemas.py",
        [
            {
                "marker": "step06:schemas_card_crypto",
                "action": "append",
                "text": (
                    "\n# ==============================================================================\n"
                    "# STEP 6 SCHEMAS: PIN, PVV, CVV & SYNTHETIC CARD GENERATION\n"

"""
INSTALLER: tools/install_step07.py
STEP 7 — Complete Operation and Cryptographic Log Portal (Single Unified Installer)
Adds:
  1. ApiAuditLog & CryptoEvent ORM models in backend/app/models.py
  2. Contextvars correlation tracing middleware in backend/app/context_trace.py
  3. Granular 6-step PIN/PVV instrumentation in backend/app/hsm_adapter.py
  4. Unified timeline API endpoints in backend/app/api_routes.py
  5. UnifiedLogPortalPage.tsx in frontend/src/pages/
  6. Route registration in App.tsx and Layout.tsx
  7. Automated Pytest test suite in backend/tests/test_step07_log_portal.py
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(r"E:\HOST_VSCODE\host-simulator").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

CONTEXT_TRACE_CODE = '''"""
context_trace.py — Request-Scoped Correlation and Cryptographic Event Tracing
Uses contextvars to trace end-to-end execution across API routes and HSM cryptographic steps.
"""

from contextvars import ContextVar
import json
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
import uuid
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import Response

# Request-scoped correlation ID
current_correlation_id: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("current_correlation_id", default="")
# Request-scoped crypto event collector
current_crypto_trace: ContextVar[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = ContextVar("current_crypto_trace", default=[])


def get_correlation_id() -> str:
    cid = current_correlation_id.get()
    if not cid:
        cid = f"CORR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}"
        current_correlation_id.set(cid)
    return cid


def record_crypto_step(
    operation_type: str,
    step_number: int,
    step_name: str,
    key_id: Optional[str] = None,
    key_kcv: Optional[str] = None,
    raw_input: Optional[str] = None,
    raw_output: Optional[str] = None,
    expected_output: Optional[str] = None,
    status: str = "COMPLETED",
    details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    duration_ms: int = 1,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Record an individual cryptographic transformation step into the current request trace."""
    event = {
        "correlation_id": get_correlation_id(),
        "operation_type": operation_type,
        "step_number": step_number,
        "step_name": step_name,
        "key_id": key_id,
        "key_kcv": key_kcv,
        "raw_input": raw_input,
        "raw_output": raw_output,
        "expected_output": expected_output,
        "status": status,
        "details": details or {},
        "duration_ms": max(1, duration_ms),
    }
    trace = current_crypto_trace.get()
    trace.append(event)
    return event


class CorrelationTraceMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        # 1. Establish or extract correlation ID
        corr_id = request.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID") or f"CORR-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}"
        token_corr = current_correlation_id.set(corr_id)
        token_trace = current_crypto_trace.set([])

        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        
        # Read body safely for API auditing (skip websockets)
        req_body = None
        if request.url.path.startswith("/api") and not request.url.path.startswith("/api/ws"):
            try:
                body_bytes = await request.body()
                if body_bytes:
                    try:
                        req_body = json.loads(body_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
                    except Exception:
                        req_body = {"raw": body_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            response: Response = await call_next(request)
        except Exception:
            current_correlation_id.reset(token_corr)
            current_crypto_trace.reset(token_trace)
            raise

        dur_ms = max(1, int((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000))
        response.headers["X-Correlation-ID"] = corr_id

        # 2. Persist ApiAuditLog and CryptoEvents asynchronously or at end of request
        if request.url.path.startswith("/api") and not request.url.path.startswith("/api/ws"):
            try:
                from app.database import SessionLocal
                from app.models import ApiAuditLog, CryptoEvent
                
                db = SessionLocal()
                try:
                    audit = ApiAuditLog(
                        correlation_id=corr_id,
                        http_method=request.method,
                        path=request.url.path,
                        status_code=response.status_code,
                        client_ip=request.client.host if request.client else "127.0.0.1",
                        user_agent=request.headers.get("User-Agent", "Unknown"),
                        duration_ms=dur_ms,
                        request_headers=dict(request.headers),
                        request_body=req_body,
                        response_body={"status": response.status_code},
                    )
                    db.add(audit)
                    
                    # Flush crypto trace events collected during this request
                    trace_events = current_crypto_trace.get()
                    for ev in trace_events:
                        db.add(CryptoEvent(**ev))
                    
                    db.commit()
                except Exception:
                    db.rollback()
                finally:
                    db.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

        current_correlation_id.reset(token_corr)
        current_crypto_trace.reset(token_trace)
        return response
'''

LOG_PORTAL_PAGE_CODE = '''import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

        ].map(([k, label, Icon]: any) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${

                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'

      {/* TAB 1: UNIFIED TIMELINE */}

          <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">

              <Eye size={16} className="text-emerald-500" /> Correlated Request Deep Dive
            </h2>
            {selectedCorrelation ? (
              <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-mono">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                  <div>Correlation ID: <span className="text-sky-400 font-bold">{selectedCorrelation.correlation_id}</span></div>
                  <div>HTTP: {selectedCorrelation.api_audit?.http_method} {selectedCorrelation.api_audit?.path} ({selectedCorrelation.api_audit?.status_code})</div>
                  <div>Duration: {selectedCorrelation.api_audit?.duration_ms} ms</div>
                </div>

                {selectedCorrelation.crypto_steps && selectedCorrelation.crypto_steps.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-400 mb-1.5">Granular Cryptographic Steps ({selectedCorrelation.crypto_steps.length}):</div>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
                      {selectedCorrelation.crypto_steps.map((st: any) => (
                        <div key={st.id} className="p-2.5 rounded bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-[11px] space-y-1">
                          <div className="flex justify-between text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                            <span>Step {st.step_number}: {st.step_name}</span>
                            <span>{st.status}</span>
                          </div>
                          {st.raw_input && <div><span className="text-slate-400">Input:</span> <span className="break-all text-sky-300">{st.raw_input}</span></div>}
                          {st.raw_output && <div><span className="text-slate-400">Output:</span> <span className="break-all text-amber-300">{st.raw_output}</span></div>}
                          {st.expected_output && <div><span className="text-slate-400">Expected:</span> <span className="break-all text-emerald-300">{st.expected_output}</span></div>}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono py-16 text-center">
                Click any timeline event on the left to inspect its correlated API parameters and HSM cryptographic transformations.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: GRANULAR CRYPTO TRACE */}
      {tab === 'CRYPTO' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">Soft-HSM Granular Transformation Steps (Visa PVV & PIN Translation)</h2>
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400">
                <th className="py-2.5">Correlation ID</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Step</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Operation</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Key (KCV)</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Raw Input</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Calculated Output</th>
                <th className="py-2.5">Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200/60 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
              {cryptoEvents.map((ev) => (
                <tr key={ev.id}>
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-sky-400 font-bold">{ev.correlation_id}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 font-bold">#{ev.step_number} {ev.step_name}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">{ev.operation_type}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 text-amber-400">{ev.key_id} ({ev.key_kcv})</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 break-all max-w-xs">{ev.raw_input || 'N/A'}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 break-all max-w-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">{ev.raw_output || 'N/A'}</td>
                  <td className="py-2.5">
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500">
                      {ev.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: API AUDIT LOG */}
      {tab === 'API' && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 overflow-x-auto">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold mb-3">HTTP API Dispatch Logs (X-Correlation-ID Tracked)</h2>
          <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
            {logs.filter(l => l.category === 'API').map((apiLog, idx) => (
              <div key={idx} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-sky-400">{apiLog.title}</span>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Correlation: {apiLog.correlation_id}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{apiLog.status}</span>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{apiLog.duration_ms} ms</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
'''

def test_correlation_id_header_injected(client):

def test_transaction_generates_granular_crypto_events(client, db_session):

                    "            extracted_pin = SoftHsmCryptoCore.unpack_iso0_pin_block(encrypted_pin_block, pan, awk_clear)\n"

                    "            # Step 5: PVK Encryption & Decimalization\n"
                    "            calc_pvv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_visa_pvv(pan, extracted_pin, pvki, pvk_clear)\n"

                    "            'id': h.id,\n"

RULES_EVALUATOR_CODE = '''"""
rules_evaluator.py — Whitelist AST Expression Evaluator & Context Builder
Executes custom authorizer rule expressions safely without using eval() or exec().
"""

import ast
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


class SafeEvalError(Exception):
    """Raised when an expression contains forbidden nodes or syntax errors."""


class SafeAstEvaluator:
    ALLOWED_OPERATORS = {
        ast.Eq: lambda a, b: a == b,
        ast.NotEq: lambda a, b: a != b,
        ast.Lt: lambda a, b: a < b,
        ast.LtE: lambda a, b: a <= b,
        ast.Gt: lambda a, b: a > b,
        ast.GtE: lambda a, b: a >= b,
        ast.In: lambda a, b: a in b,
        ast.NotIn: lambda a, b: a not in b,
        ast.And: lambda a, b: a and b,
        ast.Or: lambda a, b: a or b,
        ast.Not: lambda a: not a,
    }

    @classmethod
    def evaluate(cls, expression: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        clean_expr = expression.strip()
        if not clean_expr:
            return False
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(clean_expr, mode="eval")
            return bool(cls._eval_node(tree.body, context))
        except Exception as exc:
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Rule evaluation error in '{clean_expr}': {exc}")

    @classmethod
    def _eval_node(cls, node: ast.AST, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
            return node.value

        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            key = node.id
            if key == "true":
                return True
            if key == "false":
                return False
            if key == "null" or key == "none":
                return None
            if key in context:
                return context[key]
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Undefined variable in rule context: '{key}'")

        if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
            val = cls._eval_node(node.value, context)
            attr = node.attr
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                return val.get(attr)
            if hasattr(val, attr):
                return getattr(val, attr)
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Cannot resolve attribute '{attr}' on {type(val)}")

        if isinstance(node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple)):
            return [cls._eval_node(elt, context) for elt in node.elts]

        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
            op_type = type(node.op)
            if op_type in cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS:
                operand = cls._eval_node(node.operand, context)
                return cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS[op_type](operand)
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden unary operator: {op_type}")

        if isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
                for val_node in node.values:
                    if not cls._eval_node(val_node, context):
                        return False
                return True
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
                for val_node in node.values:
                    if cls._eval_node(val_node, context):
                        return True
                return False
            raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden boolean operator: {type(node.op)}")

        if isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
            left = cls._eval_node(node.left, context)
            for op, comparator_node in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
                op_type = type(op)
                right = cls._eval_node(comparator_node, context)
                if op_type not in cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS:
                    raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden comparison operator: {op_type}")
                # Numeric type coercion for comparisons
                if isinstance(left, (int, float, Decimal)) and isinstance(right, (int, float, Decimal)):
                    left_cmp = float(left)
                    right_cmp = float(right)
                else:
                    left_cmp = left
                    right_cmp = right

                if not cls.ALLOWED_OPERATORS[op_type](left_cmp, right_cmp):
                    return False
                left = right
            return True

        raise SafeEvalError(f"Forbidden syntax node: {type(node).__name__}")


def build_rule_context(
    mti: str,
    fields: Dict[str, str],
    tx_code: str,
    tx_amount: Decimal,
    card: Any = None,
    customer: Any = None,
    account: Any = None,
    issuer_inst: Any = None,
    acquirer_inst: Any = None,
    ps_code: str = "ITCL",
    card_limit: Any = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Constructs a normalized dictionary containing all transaction parameters for rule evaluation."""
    pan = fields.get("2", "")
    bin_prefix = pan[:6] if len(pan) >= 6 else ""

    inst_code = ""
    inst_name = ""
    if issuer_inst:
        inst_code = issuer_inst.institution_code
        inst_name = issuer_inst.name
    elif card and hasattr(card, "institution") and card.institution:
        inst_code = card.institution.institution_code
        inst_name = card.institution.name

    acq_code = acquirer_inst.institution_code if acquirer_inst else ""
    hour = int(fields.get("12", "120000")[:2]) if len(fields.get("12", "")) >= 2 else 12

    return {
        "trancode": str(tx_code),
        "tran_code": str(tx_code),
        "mti": str(mti),
        "amount": float(tx_amount),
        "currency": fields.get("49", "BDT"),
        "pan": pan,
        "bin": bin_prefix,
        "mcc": fields.get("18", "5411"),
        "terminal_id": fields.get("41", ""),
        "merchant_id": fields.get("32", ""),
        "institution": {
            "code": inst_code,
            "name": inst_name,
        },
        "acquirer_bank": acq_code,
        "issuer_bank": inst_code,
        "ps_name": ps_code,
        "channel": fields.get("25", "00"),
        "hour": hour,
        "card_status": card.card_status if card else "ACTIVE",
        "account_balance": float(account.available_balance) if account else 0.0,
        "daily_used": float(card_limit.daily_used) if card_limit else 0.0,
        "is_foreign": fields.get("19", "050") != "050",
    }
'''

AUTHORIZER_RULES_PAGE_CODE = '''import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sliders, ShieldCheck, Code2, Play, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { apiFetch } from '../api';

export const AuthorizerRulesPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'BUILTIN' | 'BUILDER' | 'CUSTOM'>('CUSTOM');
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [params, setParams] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedRule, setSelectedRule] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [testExpression, setTestExpression] = useState('trancode == "10" and amount > 50000');
  const [testContext, setTestContext] = useState(
    JSON.stringify({ trancode: "10", amount: 65000, institution: { code: "IFIC" }, card_status: "ACTIVE" }, null, 2)
  );
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  // New rule form
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    rule_code: 'RULE_HIGH_VAL',
    name: 'Decline Transactions Over 50,000 BDT',
    description: 'Fraud threshold rule rejecting high single-ticket debit amounts',
    priority: 50,
    rule_mode: 'SCRIPT',
    expression: 'amount > 50000',
    action: 'DECLINE',
    response_code: '61',
    message: 'High value transaction flagged by Host Authorizer Rule',
    stop_on_match: true,
    enabled: true,
  });

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const [rList, pList] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch('/authorizer-rules'),
        apiFetch('/host-parameters'),
      ]);
      setRules(rList);
      setParams(pList.filter((p: any) => p.parameter_group === 'RAJON_AUTH_RULES'));
      if (rList.length > 0 && !selectedRule) setSelectedRule(rList[0]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const handleCreateRule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await apiFetch('/authorizer-rules', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      setMsg(`Successfully created rule ${form.rule_code}`);
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMsg(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRule = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this authorizer rule?')) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/authorizer-rules/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      setMsg('Rule deleted.');
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleTestExpression = async () => {
    try {
      let parsedContext = {};
      try {
        parsedContext = JSON.parse(testContext);
      } catch {
        alert('Invalid JSON in Test Context');
        return;
      }
      const res = await apiFetch('/authorizer-rules/dry-run', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ expression: testExpression, context: parsedContext }),
      });
      setTestResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  };

  const toggleParam = async (p: any) => {
    const current = p.parameter_value?.enabled ?? p.active;
    const nextVal = { ...p.parameter_value, enabled: !current };
    await apiFetch(`/host-parameters/${p.id}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify({ parameter_value: nextVal, active: !current }),
    });
    loadData();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Host Authorizer Rules Engine</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Define dynamic pre-auth verification and fraud checks with safe AST expression evaluation (eval/exec-free)
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 font-bold">
            Execution Stage: PRE_CRYPTO
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {msg && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono">
          {msg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}

        {[

          ['BUILTIN', '2. Built-in RAJON Checks', ShieldCheck],
          ['BUILDER', '3. Visual Condition Builder', Sliders],
        ].map(([k, label, Icon]: any) => (
          <button
            key={k}
            onClick={() => setTab(k)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition ${
              tab === k
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Icon size={15} />
            <span>{label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: CUSTOM RULES & TEST BENCH */}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">

              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex justify-between items-center">

              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
                {rules.map((r) => (

              <input placeholder="Value (e.g. 50000)" className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              Generated expression: <code className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">amount &gt; 50000</code>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import os

def test_safe_ast_evaluator_valid_expressions():
    ctx = {
        "trancode": "10",
        "amount": 25000.0,
        "institution": {"code": "IFIC", "name": "IFIC Bank"},
        "card_status": "ACTIVE",
        "bin": "456789"
    }

    # Match test
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('trancode == "10" and amount > 20000', ctx) is True
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('institution.code == "IFIC"', ctx) is True
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('bin in ["456789", "512345"]', ctx) is True

    # No match test
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('amount > 50000', ctx) is False
    assert SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('card_status != "ACTIVE"', ctx) is False


def test_safe_ast_evaluator_rejects_unsafe_operations():
    ctx = {"amount": 100}
    with pytest.raises(SafeEvalError):
        # Forbidden function calls
        SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('__import__("os").system("echo 1")', ctx)

    with pytest.raises(SafeEvalError):
        # Forbidden attribute execution
        SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate('amount.__class__.__mro__', ctx)


def test_authorizer_rule_declines_transaction_in_host_engine(db_session):
    # Create a rule rejecting transactions with amount > 10,000 with RC 61
    rule = AuthorizerRule(
        rule_code="TEST_MAX_10K",
        name="Decline over 10K",
        priority=10,
        expression="amount > 10000",
        action="DECLINE",
        response_code="61",
        message="Transaction exceeds custom authorizer rule threshold",
        enabled=True,
    )
    db_session.add(rule)
    db_session.commit()

    proc = HostTransactionProcessor(db_session)
    res = proc.process_transaction({
        "transaction_code": "10",
        "mti": "0200",
        "test_clear_pin_helper": "1234",
        "fields": {
            "2": "4567890123450001",
            "3": "0100000",
            "4": "000001500000",  # 15,000 BDT > 10,000 threshold
            "11": "700001",
            "37": "000099700001",
            "41": "ATM01",
            "49": "BDT",
        },
    })
    assert res["response_code"] == "61"
    assert res["authorization_status"] == "DECLINED"

    db_session.refresh(rule)
    assert rule.hit_count >= 1
'''

                    "@router.post('/authorizer-rules', response_model=AuthorizerRuleOut)\n"
                    "def create_authorizer_rule(payload: AuthorizerRuleCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    code = payload.rule_code.upper().strip()\n"
                    "    existing = db.query(AuthorizerRule).filter(AuthorizerRule.rule_code == code).first()\n"
                    "    if existing:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f'Authorizer rule {code} already exists')\n"
                    "    rule = AuthorizerRule(**payload.model_dump())\n"
                    "    rule.rule_code = code\n"
                    "    db.add(rule)\n"
                    "    db.flush()\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'AUTHORIZER_RULE', rule.id, 'CREATE', performed_by=current_user, after_state=serialize_entity(rule),\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Created authorizer rule {rule.rule_code}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(rule)\n"
                    "    return rule\n\n\n"
                    "@router.put('/authorizer-rules/{rule_id}', response_model=AuthorizerRuleOut)\n"
                    "def update_authorizer_rule(rule_id: str, payload: AuthorizerRuleUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    rule = db.query(AuthorizerRule).filter(AuthorizerRule.id == rule_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not rule:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Authorizer rule not found')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(rule)\n"
                    "    for k, v in payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():\n"
                    "        setattr(rule, k, v)\n"
                    "    after = serialize_entity(rule)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'AUTHORIZER_RULE', rule.id, 'UPDATE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before, after_state=after,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Updated authorizer rule {rule.rule_code}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    db.refresh(rule)\n"
                    "    return rule\n\n\n"
                    "@router.delete('/authorizer-rules/{rule_id}')\n"
                    "def delete_authorizer_rule(rule_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    rule = db.query(AuthorizerRule).filter(AuthorizerRule.id == rule_id).first()\n"
                    "    if not rule:\n"
                    "        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Authorizer rule not found')\n"
                    "    before = serialize_entity(rule)\n"
                    "    db.delete(rule)\n"
                    "    record_audit(db, 'AUTHORIZER_RULE', rule_id, 'DELETE', performed_by=current_user, before_state=before,\n"
                    "                 change_summary=f'Deleted authorizer rule {rule.rule_code}')\n"
                    "    db.commit()\n"
                    "    return {'status': 'deleted', 'rule_id': rule_id}\n\n\n"
                    "@router.post('/authorizer-rules/dry-run', response_model=RuleDryRunResponse)\n"
                    "def dry_run_authorizer_rule(payload: RuleDryRunRequest, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):\n"
                    "    try:\n"
                    "        matched = SafeAstEvaluator.evaluate(payload.expression, payload.context)\n"
                    "        return RuleDryRunResponse(matched=matched, valid=True)\n"
                    "    except Exception as exc:\n"
                    "        return RuleDryRunResponse(matched=False, valid=False, error=str(exc))\n"
                ),
            },
        ],

    128: ("Secondary MAC",                       "HEX", "FIXED",  16),
}


def decode_iso8583_1987(raw_msg: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Decodes a standard ISO 8583:1987 message with 16-hex or 32-hex bitmap.
    Returns parsed fields, MTI, warnings, and format metadata.
    """
    clean = raw_msg.strip().replace(" ", "").replace("\\n", "").replace("\\r", "")
    if len(clean) < 20:
        return {"valid": False, "error": "Message is too short for ISO 8583:1987", "format": "UNKNOWN"}

    mti = clean[:4]
    if not mti.isdigit():
        return {"valid": False, "error": f"Invalid ISO MTI: '{mti}'", "format": "UNKNOWN"}

    pos = 4
    # Read primary bitmap (16 hex chars = 64 bits)
    primary_hex = clean[pos : pos + 16]
    pos += 16

    try:
        bits = bin(int(primary_hex, 16))[2:].zfill(64)
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"valid": False, "error": f"Invalid primary bitmap hex: {exc}", "format": "ISO8583_1987"}

    has_secondary = bits[0] == "1"
    secondary_hex = None
    if has_secondary:
        secondary_hex = clean[pos : pos + 16]
        pos += 16
        sec_bits = bin(int(secondary_hex, 16))[2:].zfill(64)
        full_bits = bits + sec_bits
    else:
        full_bits = bits

    present_fields = [i + 1 for i, b in enumerate(full_bits) if b == "1" and i != 0]

    raw_fields: Dict[str, str] = {}
    detailed_fields: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    warnings: List[str] = []

    for fnum in present_fields:
        if fnum not in ISO8583_FIELDS:
            warnings.append(f"Field DE{fnum} present in bitmap but not defined in standard 1987 dictionary")
            break

        name, dtype, ltype, flen = ISO8583_FIELDS[fnum]
        try:
            if ltype == "FIXED":
                val = clean[pos : pos + flen]
                pos += flen
            elif ltype == "LLVAR":
                plen = int(clean[pos : pos + 2])
                pos += 2
                val = clean[pos : pos + plen]
                pos += plen
            elif ltype == "LLLVAR":
                plen = int(clean[pos : pos + 3])
                pos += 3
                val = clean[pos : pos + plen]
                pos += plen
            else:
                warnings.append(f"Unhandled length type {ltype} for DE{fnum}")
                break

            raw_fields[str(fnum)] = val
            detailed_fields[f"DE{fnum} {name}"] = val
        except Exception as exc:
            warnings.append(f"Error parsing field DE{fnum}: {exc}")
            break

    # Determine matched transaction code from DE3
    proc_code = raw_fields.get("3", "000000")
    tc_derived = proc_code[:2] if len(proc_code) >= 2 else "10"

    return {
        "valid": True,
        "format": "ISO8583_1987",
        "mti": mti,
        "bitmap": {
            "primary_hex": primary_hex,
            "secondary_hex": secondary_hex,
            "fields_present": present_fields,
        },
        "raw_fields": raw_fields,
        "detailed_fields": detailed_fields,
        "derived_transaction_code": tc_derived,
        "warnings": warnings,
    }


def build_iso8583_1987(mti: str, fields: Dict[int, str]) -> str:
    """Builds a standard ISO 8583:1987 message with hex bitmap."""
    clean_fields = {int(k): str(v) for k, v in fields.items() if v is not None and str(v) != ""}
    present_fnums = sorted(f for f in clean_fields.keys() if f != 1)
    needs_secondary = any(f > 64 for f in present_fnums)

    bits = ["0"] * (128 if needs_secondary else 64)
    if needs_secondary:
        bits[0] = "1"
    for f in present_fnums:
        if 1 <= f <= len(bits):
            bits[f - 1] = "1"

    bitmap_hex = "".join(f"{int(''.join(bits[i:i+4]), 2):X}" for i in range(0, len(bits), 4))
    body_parts = []

    for fnum in present_fnums:
        if fnum not in ISO8583_FIELDS:
            continue
        _, dtype, ltype, flen = ISO8583_FIELDS[fnum]
        val = clean_fields[fnum]

        if ltype == "FIXED" and flen is not None:
            if dtype == "N":
                val = val.zfill(flen)[:flen]
            else:
                val = val.ljust(flen)[:flen]
            body_parts.append(val)
        elif ltype == "LLVAR":
            body_parts.append(f"{len(val):02d}{val}")
        elif ltype == "LLLVAR":
            body_parts.append(f"{len(val):03d}{val}")

    return f"{mti}{bitmap_hex}{''.join(body_parts)}"
'''

def test_standard_iso8583_pack_and_unpack():
    fields = {
        2: "4567890123450001",
        3: "010000",
        4: "000000100000",
        11: "123456",
        37: "000020526991",
        41: "ATM00001",
        49: "050"
    }
    raw = build_iso8583_1987("0200", fields)
    assert raw.startswith("0200")
    
    decoded = decode_iso8583_1987(raw)
    assert decoded["valid"] is True
    assert decoded["format"] == "ISO8583_1987"
    assert decoded["mti"] == "0200"
    assert decoded["raw_fields"]["2"] == "4567890123450001"
    assert decoded["raw_fields"]["11"] == "123456"
    assert decoded["derived_transaction_code"] == "01"


def test_parse_raw_endpoint_detects_tic_v2164e(client):
    # TIC message starts with A4M
    tic_raw, _ = build_tic_message("0200", {2: "4567890123450001", 3: "0100000", 4: "000000100000", 11: "998877", 49: "BDT"})
    res = client.post("/api/simulator/parse-raw", json={"raw_message": tic_raw})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["format"] == "TIC_V2164E"
    assert data["mti"] == "0200"
    assert data["fields"]["11"] == "998877"


def test_parse_raw_endpoint_detects_standard_iso8583(client):
    # Standard ISO message starts with 0200 + hex bitmap
    iso_raw = build_iso8583_1987("0200", {2: "4567890123450002", 3: "010000", 4: "000000250000", 11: "334455"})
    res = client.post("/api/simulator/parse-raw", json={"raw_message": iso_raw})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["format"] == "ISO8583_1987"
    assert data["mti"] == "0200"
    assert data["fields"]["2"] == "4567890123450002"
    assert data["fields"]["11"] == "334455"
'''

KEY_CEREMONY_SERVICE_CODE = '''"""
key_ceremony_service.py — Split-Component Key Ceremony & Key Exchange Service
Implements DES odd-parity adjustment, 2/3 component XOR assembly, KCV calculation,
and key translation under Zone Master Keys (ZMK).
"""

import re
import secrets
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from app.hsm_adapter import SoftHsmCryptoCore


def enforce_des_odd_parity(hex_key: str) -> str:
    """Adjusts the least significant bit (LSB) of each byte so that it has odd parity."""
    raw = bytes.fromhex(hex_key.replace(" ", "").upper())
    adjusted = bytearray()
    for b in raw:
        # Count bits in the top 7 bits
        bits_count = bin(b & 0xFE).count("1")
        # If even, set LSB to 1; if odd, set LSB to 0
        lsb = 1 if (bits_count % 2 == 0) else 0
        adjusted.append((b & 0xFE) | lsb)
    return adjusted.hex().upper()


def validate_des_parity(hex_key: str) -> bool:
    """Validates that every byte in the key has odd parity."""
    raw = bytes.fromhex(hex_key.replace(" ", "").upper())
    for b in raw:
        if bin(b).count("1") % 2 == 0:
            return False
    return True


def generate_random_des_key(length_bits: int = 128) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Generates a cryptographically secure random 2-Key (128-bit) or 3-Key (192-bit) 3DES key with odd parity."""
    num_bytes = 16 if length_bits == 128 else 24
    rand_bytes = secrets.token_bytes(num_bytes)
    adjusted_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(rand_bytes.hex().upper())
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(adjusted_hex)
    return {
        "key_hex": adjusted_hex,
        "length_bits": length_bits,
        "kcv": kcv,
        "odd_parity": True,
    }


def split_key_into_components(key_hex: str, num_components: int = 3) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Splits a key into 2 or 3 random components that XOR back to the original key."""
    clean_key = key_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    num_bytes = len(clean_key) // 2
    components = []

    running_xor = bytes.fromhex(clean_key)
    for _ in range(num_components - 1):
        rand_comp = secrets.token_bytes(num_bytes)
        rand_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(rand_comp.hex().upper())
        components.append({
            "component_number": len(components) + 1,
            "hex": rand_hex,
            "kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(rand_hex),
        })
        running_xor = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(running_xor, bytes.fromhex(rand_hex)))

    # Final component is the remaining XOR
    final_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(running_xor.hex().upper())
    components.append({
        "component_number": len(components) + 1,
        "hex": final_hex,
        "kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(final_hex),
    })

    return {
        "original_key_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_key),
        "num_components": num_components,
        "components": components,
    }


def assemble_components(components_hex: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Assembles 2 or 3 clear components via XOR into the final operational key."""
    if len(components_hex) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Key assembly requires at least 2 components")

    clean_comps = [c.replace(" ", "").upper() for c in components_hex]
    key_len = len(clean_comps[0])
    for c in clean_comps:
        if len(c) != key_len:
            raise ValueError("All components must have identical length (32 or 48 hex chars)")

    running_bytes = bytes.fromhex(clean_comps[0])
    for c in clean_comps[1:]:
        comp_bytes = bytes.fromhex(c)
        running_bytes = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(running_bytes, comp_bytes))

    assembled_hex = enforce_des_odd_parity(running_bytes.hex().upper())
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(assembled_hex)

    return {
        "assembled_key_hex": assembled_hex,
        "length_bits": len(assembled_hex) * 4,
        "kcv": kcv,
        "odd_parity": True,
        "components_count": len(components_hex),
        "component_kcvs": [SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(c) for c in clean_comps],
    }


def import_key_under_zmk(encrypted_key_hex: str, zmk_hex: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Decrypts a working key received under a ZMK and computes its clear KCV."""
    clean_enc = encrypted_key_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    clean_zmk = zmk_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    clear_key = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clean_enc, clean_zmk, decrypt=True)
    clear_key_parity = enforce_des_odd_parity(clear_key)
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clear_key_parity)
    return {
        "clear_key_hex": clear_key_parity,
        "kcv": kcv,
        "zmk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_zmk),
    }


def export_key_under_zmk(clear_key_hex: str, zmk_hex: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Encrypts a working key under a ZMK for secure export/exchange."""
    clean_key = clear_key_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    clean_zmk = zmk_hex.replace(" ", "").upper()
    encrypted_key = SoftHsmCryptoCore.des3_ecb_hex(clean_key, clean_zmk, decrypt=False)
    kcv = SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_key)
    return {
        "encrypted_key_hex": encrypted_key,
        "key_kcv": kcv,
        "zmk_kcv": SoftHsmCryptoCore.calculate_kcv(clean_zmk),
    }
'''

TEST_STEP10_CODE = '''"""
test_step10_hsm_keys.py — Tests for Step 10 HSM Key Management & Key Ceremony
"""

import os
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"

from app.database import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.main import app
from app.models import HsmKeyReference
from app.key_ceremony_service import (
    assemble_components,
    enforce_des_odd_parity,
    export_key_under_zmk,
    generate_random_des_key,
    import_key_under_zmk,
    split_key_into_components,
    validate_des_parity,
)
from app.seed_data import seed_initial_data
from app.security import create_access_token
from app.config import settings


@pytest.fixture()
def db_session():
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    session = SessionLocal()
    seed_initial_data(session)
    yield session
    session.close()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)


@pytest.fixture()
def client(db_session):
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        token = create_access_token(subject=settings.ADMIN_USERNAME)
        c.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
        yield c


def test_odd_parity_enforcement_and_validation():
    # Known key
    raw_key = "0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF"
    parity_key = enforce_des_odd_parity(raw_key)
    assert validate_des_parity(parity_key) is True


def test_split_and_assemble_three_components():
    rand = generate_random_des_key(128)
    orig_key = rand["key_hex"]
    orig_kcv = rand["kcv"]

    # Split into 3 parts
    split = split_key_into_components(orig_key, 3)
    assert len(split["components"]) == 3

    # Assemble back
    comps = [c["hex"] for c in split["components"]]
    assembled = assemble_components(comps)
    assert assembled["kcv"] == orig_kcv


def test_assemble_and_register_endpoint(client, db_session):
    payload = {
        "key_identifier": "AWK_TEST_CEREMONY_01",
        "key_type": "AWK",
        "components": [
            "11111111111111111111111111111111",
            "22222222222222222222222222222222"
        ]
    }
    res = client.post("/api/hsm/ceremony/assemble-components", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert data["key_identifier"] == "AWK_TEST_CEREMONY_01"
    assert len(data["kvc"]) == 6

    # Verify key was persisted into the database with its clear hex
    key_db = db_session.query(HsmKeyReference).filter(HsmKeyReference.key_identifier == "AWK_TEST_CEREMONY_01").first()
    assert key_db is not None
    assert key_db.clear_key_hex is not None


def test_export_and_import_under_zmk():
    zmk = "0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF"
    working_key = "1A2B3C4D5E6F70811A2B3C4D5E6F7081"

    exported = export_key_under_zmk(working_key, zmk)
    assert len(exported["encrypted_key_hex"]) == 32

    imported = import_key_under_zmk(exported["encrypted_key_hex"], zmk)
    assert imported["kcv"] == exported["key_kcv"]
'''
